tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000450༄༅// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang rat+na shrī'i phyi yi bka' 'bum nor bu'i bang

mdzod pod nga)bzhugs so//!2 "2 1$0000350 mi chos kyi 'dun ma thugs kyi dpal be'u// 322) oṃ swasti/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs// lhun gyis grub cing mi zad mdzod 'dzin pa// dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma dam pa yi// zhabs kyi pad+mor gtsug gis rtag tu 'dud/ kha tsam tshig tsam ku re kyal ka dang*// bzhad gad ngo dga' phye gtor med pa yi// rang gi zhe 'dod snying po rdo rje'i tshig /'gyur ba med pas rang gi bu la gdams// 'dir 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang*/ da ltar phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po thams cad dang*/ rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa thams cad kyis thugs kyi dgongs pa/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i blo ni smon pa/ dngos su byed pa ni 'jug pa/ brtul zhugs 'dzin pa ni sgrub pa/ rkyen gyis mi bskyod pa ni gegs sel/ ji ltar bsams pa bzhin du 'byung ba ni grub thob/ lhun gyis grub pa ni 'bras bu/ thabs mkhas pa sna tshogs kyi sgrub pa ni gsang sngags/ bsam sbyor 'di lta bu'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa ni kun tu bzang po/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag po phyag na rdo rje/ rdo rje 'chang ba de nyid yin la/ de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems de ni rang gi rig pa skye 'gag med cing spros pa kun dang bral ba/ rang byung lhun gyis grub cing 'dus ma byas pas/ rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*// dus gsum bla ma rnams dang skad cig kyang*// 'bral du mi btub 'bral ba med pa ni// dpa' bo chen po khyod kyis thugs la zhog /lo 'ga' nga yi drung du ma 'ong bar// gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa bla med pa// mi 'bral 'gyur ba med pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// dpag med 'gro ba mang po smin mdzad zhu// rdzas dang yo byad dngos po ci yod pa// nga la bsngos par gyur pa gang yin kun// nga yi bu sdug 'gro ba mtho dman la// ches na brgyags shing chung na yid tshims pas// ran pa lo re tsam gyi 'tsho ba las// mi che mi chung gnang na pha jo dga'// ka ca'i dngos po ci yang ma bskur bar// rten gyi rnam pa bsngos pa yod na yang*// 'khyer bkur rtsol sgrub mang po sdug bsngal bas// 'thad pa'i gnas su legs par chol la zhog

/dbus kyi sa 'di mi zur shin tu mthug /phrag dog che la dgon pa rnyed dka' bas// nga yang nyid kyi drung du mchi ba yin// sa mtha' thams cad bskor ba'i brtul zhugs la// mig ldan brtse bar gnas pa kun gyis smod// de dag bden par ngas kyang bsam pa yin// dbang bskur byin rlabs mang po byas gyur na// sgom tshugs 'chor zhing tshe dang srog la gnod// skyon gyi phung por bla ma dam pas gsungs// nye gnas chos med brgyags na ya pho 'chol la 'chor// phra ma smra la dga' na 'khor rnams mthun mi srid// gnam sa rjes kyis bkang na gzhon pa'i so nams 'chor// nor gyi gsog brun dga' na rang gzhan thams cad phung*// ston pa'i bka' bsgrags bar chad mi 'ong gsung*// zab pa'i mdo bzhi bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// skyes chen khyod kyi phyag len mdzad par zhu// phyi mi nang mi gang yin ma shes na// zhang ston khu 'dzu ri pa a tsa ma// tshad med snying rje rang 'khris med pa yis// 'khor la dga' dga' gdung gdung ma byas na// rgya mtsho lta bu'i tshogs pa ga la 'phel// mchog gi zung dang sa bdag rgyal po yis// ston pa'i zhabs tog byas par ma gyur na// rgyal bas 'gro ba smin par mi spyod pa// rten 'brel nyid kyis nges pas thugs la bzhag /gsung rab de dag yang dang yang du blta// ri bo mchog rab lta bu mi chen gyi// slob ma snying por gyur pa gang yin pa// mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes par byas pa la// bla ma dam pa'i bka' stsal ji bzhin du// 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu sdud pa yi// 'gro ba smin pa'i sdong grogs gyis shig ces// mi chos 'dun ma med pa'i chos kyis gdams// lha chos 'dun ma 'gro ba smin pa'i thabs// lha 'dre mi gsum phur gzhi g.yab kyi bdag /bram ze rgya mtsho rdul gyi brtul zhugs gzung*// sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyi rjes su bslab// zab dang rgya che mdo sde yang yang blta// snying rje pad+ma dkar po ngo mtshar che// chen po'i chen po thams cad kyis// che 'bring chung gsum mi dang zas nor dang*// dngos po thams cad khyad du gsod pa 'ong*// brtse bas gus 'dud byed pa'i byams pa dang*// bde gshegs snying po'i rgyal po de bzhin nyid// gnyis med don rtogs rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis// gzung 'dzin nga bzang rlom pa'i khyad sod 'dis// snang ba bla ma'i rtsa ltung dang po 'byung*// rgyal ba'i bstan pa myur du 'jig par gsung*// de phyir thams cad bla ma dam par bkur// snang srid lha dang bla ma khyed rang gsungs// mgon po rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das// lhun grub 'gyur ba med pa de bzhin gshegs// gang du bzhugs pa'i gnas su mos gus bya// tshe dang dbang phyug bsod nams thams cad 'phel// byams pa chen po'i ting 'dzin nad med pas// dus gsum rgyal bas bdud tshogs gdug pa can// mnyam nyid rang gi ngang du zhi mdzad cing*// gnyis med gcig tu dul bar gyur pa la// bdud kyi tshogs rnams btul zhes gong mas gsungs// rtag tu byams pa'i ting 'dzin sgom par mdzad// gtan du sdod tshis mkhar lan drags na yang*// mkhar lan tshar na 'di'am pha rol tu// ban dhe cis kyang mas kyang 'gro bar 'dug

/mkhar lan tshod gzung gzhi gcig brtan par bya// dgon sa mang po bzung na 'brog khung dang*// sdig rdo bstan pa'i yan lag dam pa yin// bsod nams zang zing rnyed dang bkur sti grags pa dang*// mchod cing brjid par byed pa'i skyes bus btud gyur cing*// rang nyid rang la ngom zhing mgu bar gyur pa na// bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen seng ge'i 'o ma yis// tha mal lus 'di bcag nas yon tan chud zos cing*// bdud tshogs kun gyis gtse bar 'gyur ba'i phyir// de tshe lus sems dag ni mkha' 'gro bya ltar rgyu// nag po'i rtsa lag rnams kyis glags rnyed ga la 'gyur// ston pas gsungs pa bdag cag de yis rjes su 'brang*// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can kun gyi khur 'khur ba// 'di tshod tsam gyis bdag mgu rigs pa ma yin zhes// bsod nams rgya mtsho 'gro ba kun dang gcig gyur na// bre mig phul gyis mi khengs phyir na lus mi 'jig /rang gi lus la 'chi med rgyal ba'i nges shes dang*// rang byung lhun grub gnyis med 'gyur ba med pa'i sems// gsum po 'di yis lus dang longs spyod bsrungs par gyur// rnam gsum gdams ngag 'di la khyed kyis nan tan mdzod// ra lnga med par 'brog la 'gro ba ma yin ltar// dpag med yon tan rgya mtsho nyid kyi skur gtams kyang*// brtse zhing gdung bas khyed la gdams par gyur ba las// thugs dang 'gal bar gyur na bzod pa mdzad par zhu// 'di phyi gar yang ma bltas ma bsams pa'i// slob ma che 'bring bzang ngan mang po zhig /phyogs rnams kun tu bsam pa bsgrub 'dod pa// rjes su 'jug pa mang po de dag gi /re sa thug sgo bsam sa nga yin pas// bdag blo sgrub pa byed la gzhol bar gyur// de dag bsrung bar bya ba'i don ched du// lo 'ga' tsam zhig sgrub pa byed dgos byung*// su yang nga yi drung du ma gtong zhig /bdag gi skyin pa khyed kyis mdzad par zhu// 'gro ba dpag tu med pa smin mdzad zhu// khyed kyi tshogs pa skyong ba'i mthun pa'i rkyen// rdzas dang yo byad zhabs 'bring mang po yis// bskur yang zhabs tog mang po bya snyam yang*// dgos pa thams cad drwamig bzhin du song*// tshogs pa mi skyong dgos pa drwa mig kyang*// nyon mongs gsum gyi 'khor lo kho nar 'dug

/de phyir bu slob yon bdag thams cad la// sngon bzhin slong ba'i brtul zhugs ma spyad pas// phud du 'os pa'i thang thung bskur rgyu med// thugs kyi btang ngo snyam du mi dgongs zhu// ral pa can yang btsal bas ma rnyed lags// rgod po'i gcig shos bdag la 'bul bar zhu// ji ltar pha ni bu la brtse ba yi// rgyal srid brin na dga' bar gyur pa las// tsig prig cung zad tsam gyis dga' ba med pa ltar// bu gcig khyed kyi thugs la dgongs par zhu// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi dam pa'i chos// bslab gsum rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes pa las// snum phyis ngo dgas drung du 'ongs pa la// dga' ba med par khyod kyi thugs la zhog /chos lnga dgos 'dod kun 'byung rin chen gter// zab mo gsang sngags snying po gter mdzod las// lug ril phub ma 'phyar bar gyur pa la// rang gzhan su dga' khyod kyis thugs la zhog /dus gnad stobs bcu gdul bya smin pa'i thabs// mun nag glog bzhin skad gcig ded pa'i tshe// bya byed mang po log pa'i rdzi sbud rlung sbud kyi// mos gus de ko su la ci zhig bya// grub pa'i rjes mchog mi nor gtam tshogs kun// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsum rten 'brel gyis// rang gzhan don chen sgrub par mi byed par// chud zos rgyal sras rnams la rigs pa min// mtho dman cal col mang po 'di 'dra'i tshig /gzhan gyis mthong zhing thos par gyur pa ni// ma dad blo yis sgro skur 'ong srid pas// shin tu sba zhing gsang bar mdzad par zhu// dge bas byang chub chen po mchog thob shog /mi chos kyi 'dun ma thugs kyi dpal be'u zhes bya ba rdzogs so// // 323) ༄// rgya gar la cis kyang mi bzhud ces dge ba'i bshes gnyen kha rag rtsa la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ dpal dwags la sgam po'i dgon pa nas shākya'i dge slong ldom bu pa rin chen dpal gyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen kha rag rtsa ba la springs pa/

spyir byang phyogs kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'dir/ ston pas zhabs kyis bcag bstan pa'i snying po byung*/ gdul bya snod ldan yod pa la/ rnal 'byor pa ku sā li pa gcig la nga tsam pa'i bsod nams 'du zhing yod pa su byung khyed rang gi thugs la mnga'/ de tsam zhig yin pa la byas pa dang lag rjes sor zhig kyang med par/ gdong sha ni mi la byin/ byin sha ni khyi la byin nas khyed slob ma yang zung cig ci thon snyam pa yin pa la/ de la dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa'i ngos nas/ nga la mnyes pa rnam gsum gyis mnyes par byas/ nga'i 'gran zla med pa'i bu gcig pur gyur/ ci re a ma'i bu gcig pu khye rang la re/ bsam rgyu bu las med pas/ rgya gar phan chad du bzhud zer ba de rna bas thos tsam du mi bzod/ bod kyi ri khrod gang dgyes dgyes su bzhugs nas nga rang gi bla ma'i mchod gnas byed pa zhig 'dod pa yin pa la/ rgyus yod su byung thams cad na re rgya gar du 'gro bar thugs thag bcad/ khyed kyis ci bzlas kyang mi nyan/ ci 'jigs khyod la 'jigs zer ba la/ ma snying bu la chags pas sgam por lan cig byon dang ci gsung bzhin bya zhus pa ma gnang*/ de nas khong zer ba bden par 'dug snyam nas ston pa dbang seng ba gsum po btang ba yin pa la/ bzhes kyis byon du re ba yin pa la tsā ri ba gzhan rnams byon pas khyed ma byon/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bla ma dam pa'i bka' ga la gcog ste/ don gyis khyod rang gis dge bshes pa mthar thug pa yin zer/ dge 'dun spyi sgos thams cad kyi zhal nas kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen las bu gces pa med pa la/ de phar gtong ba sku stangs re zhan na/ snying yang mi rje 'am/ rgya gar nas tshur ni mi ldog nges na gsung*/ khyed rgya gar la bzhud na slob dpon jo sras dang shes rab 'od la sogs pa'i dge 'dun phal mo che zhig rgya gar du bzhud nas tshur mi ldog pa'i nyen yod/ skyi shod pa rnams na re yang*/

khos ched du rgya gar du btang ba yin/ mi nor gtam gsum kho'i khongs su song zer skad/ de thams cad la nga 'bu mi 'jigs/ khyed rang gi sgrub pa ci 'phel gcig pus chog ma shi ba gcig pus chog ji ltar byas kyang btub snyam pa la/ nga 'bu'i nye gnas sgom pa rin she rdo rje gdan du shi zer ba thos pa la brten nas nga rang yang shes pa 'phros/ dge 'dun thams cad kyang thugs ngal gyis zin/ mi la dris pa la song ba mang yang tshur log pa nyung zer bas/ rta po dkrogs kyis 'drogs/ mi pho yes kyis dngangs/ nga la nga rgyu med/ gdung ba'i sems kyis bsam gyin glo ba ma dga' bas/ yid bzhin nor 'dra rigs kyi bu// khyed yul gang du byon yang rgya gar yul// gnas gang du bzhugs kyang rdo rje gdan// byang chub chen po khyed rang nyid// bu nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// cis kyang mi bzhud bzhugs par zhu// zhu rten du gser gyi mdo mang tshar cig nga'i dpe cha rnams gzhan yang ngo mtshar la rmad du byung ba'i rten gcig spongs dag gis sku skal du bsngos pa dang gsum 'bul zhing mchis/ gtsigs rnam pa gsum la/ skyi shod pa dang slob ris nye 'brel rnams khyed rang sgrub pa byed pa las gzhan gyi zhe 'dod mi byed pa dang gcig nga 'bus mthun rkyen mtha' dag bsgrub pa dang gnyis/ dben zhing nyams dga' 'dod pa'i gnas gcig tu dpon g.yog gnyis sgrub pa byed pa dang gsum 'bul zhing mchis/ sgrub pa'i 'bras bu gsum la/ sku'i rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa lus kyis rgya gar dang*/ rgya nag dang*/ hor dang*/ dru gu dang*/ 'jig rten thams cad du son pa dang gcig gsung de rnams su thos pa dang gnyis/ thugs de rnams su khyab pa dang gsum/ sgrub pa'i dngos grub tu 'bul zhing mchis/ cis kyang thugs la gdags par zhu/ gal po che yi gtam yin pas// ku re pag shi mi bdog /rta rje gling bzhi bde 'khor la// bu gcig chibs la yar la spyon// 'dod pa'i don rnams grub pa po// don kun grub pa yar la spyon// chags bral chen po'i dbang phyug gtso// tshul khrims rgyan gyis mdzes pa khyod// bzod pa'i go cha brtan pa po// brtson 'grus rta la bzhon nas ni// bsam gtan dben pa'i nags khrod 'dir// shes rab chen po'i drung du shog

/bu gcig pha yi drung du shog /yab sras mjal ba'i chos zhig bshad// gnyug ma'i ngang du ngal gcig gso// 'od gsal chen por gnyid log pas// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon tan rnams// rmi lam tshul du mthong gyur pa// gong ma rnams kyis bltas pa yi// ltad mo ngo mtshar rmad 'di la// yar spyon gzigs mo mdzad par zhu// // 324) ༄// tshangs par spyod pa tshul khrims kyi bsrung bya dbyangs can bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs// thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// rgyal po khab kyi 'tsho byed kyi// a mra'i 'tshal du dbyar gnas par// zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dus kyi tshe// rgyal po chen po ma skyes dgra// 'tsho byed gzhon nus bskyed la sogs// rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du song*// thub pa 'khor dang bcas pa la// lud pa dang ni sbrid pa'i sgra// cung zad tsam yang ma thos nas// rgyal po 'jigs shing skrag pa yis// 'tsho byed gzhon nu la dris pas// rgyal po bcom ldan 'das de ni// sgra ni chung ba bzhed cing dgyes// chung bas 'dul zhing chung ba yi// bsngags pa yang ni brjod mdzad ces// 'tsho byed gzhon nus smras pa las// rgyal po 'jigs pa bral gyur nas// bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar phyin// rigs drug bsod nams mi 'dra bas// dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu ni// ji ltar thob pa zhus pa las// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa// rgyal po chen po khyod kyi 'khor// mngag gzhug byed pa bran zhig gis// rgyal po'i 'byor pa mthong ba las// bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu zhes// bsod nams 'dod cing dga' ba yis// dad pas khyim nas rab tu byung*// skra dang kha spu bregs nas kyang*// ngur smrig bgos te de dag gis// mi dge bcu po spangs pa las// rgyal pos de dag mthong ba las// bran gyi las rnams mi 'chol zhing*// phyag dang bsnyen bkur 'dud pa dang*// chos gos bsod snyoms mal stan dang*// sman dang yo byad thams cad kyis// rgyal pos bsnyen bkur byed pa ni// dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu zhes// thub pa chen pos bka' bstsal to// gzhan yang zhing pa la sogs pa// sna tshogs rigs rnams thams cad kyang*// de dang 'dra bar shes par bya// rgyal po chen pos sangs rgyas rnams// 'jig rten dag tu byung ba na// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi chos// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// don bzang tshig 'bru bzang po dang*// ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs pa dang*// dag dang byang dang tshangs spyod pa// de dag nyan par gyur pa las// thos nas 'di ltar gnas gsum po// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug la// ston pa'i dag pa tshol ba ni// nyon mongs 'di dag gang gis kyang*// sems la khyab par gyur ba na// mi shes bzhin du shes zhes smra// ma mthong bzhin du mthong ngo zhes// gzhan dag la yang yun ring du// gnod cing phan pa ma yin pa'i// sdug bsngal mang po bskyed byed pas// de ltar nyon mongs ma spangs pa'i// lus ngag yid kyi 'du byed rnams// 'di la yod pa ma yin pas// 'di yis chos ni gang ston pa// bsdus sam rgyas par 'chad kyang rung*// zhi ba zab pa rtogs dka' ba// rtog ge'i spyod yul ma yin zhing*// mkhas shing mdzangs pas rigs pas na// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gi

/sems kyis rtogs par mi 'gyur bas// khyim gyi skyon rnams shes pa yis// nor dang nye du 'khor gyi tshogs// mang ngam yang na nyung yang rung*// thams cad spangs par gyur nas kyang*// skra dang kha spu bregs pa dang*// chos gos ngur smrig bgos nas kyang*// dad pas rab tu 'byung bar gyur// de bzhin rab tu byung nas de// tshul khrims dag dang ldan pa yin// so sor thar pa'i sdom pa yis// shin tu bsams par gyur pa dang*// spyod dang spyod yul phun sum tshogs// kha na ma tho phra mo la'ang*// 'jigs par lta bar gyur pa dang*// bslab pa'i gzhi rnams blangs pa dang*// blangs la slob par 'gyur ba yin// de yis srog gcod spangs pa dang*// log par gyur pa nyid yin te// chad pa spangs shing mtshon cha spangs// 'dzem dang snying rjer ldan pa yin// srog chags grog sbur yan chad kyi// srog gcod pa las log pa 'o// ma byin len pa spangs pa yin// byin par gyur ba len pa dang*// byin pa la yang dga' ba yin// sbyin pa lhag par gtong ba dang*// rkun ma ma yin brkam chags min// gtsang zhing dag dang bdag nyid kyis// kha na ma tho med par yang*// bsrung zhing ma yin len pa las// log par gyur pa nyid yin no// mi gtsang spyod pa spangs nas kyang*// spyod pa ngan pa spangs pa yin// dag dang gtsang dang dri nga med// 'khrig dang smad rim chos dang bral// mi gtsang spyod las log pa 'o// rdzun du smra ba spangs pa yin// bden par smra zhing bden la dga'// mnyan par 'os dang yid ches dang*// brtan dang 'jig rten mi bslu ba// rdzun du smra las log pa 'o// phra ma'i tshig rnams spangs pa yin// phan tshun thos par gyur pa rnams// dbye ba'i bsam pas mi smra zhing*// bye ba rnams ni bsdum pa dang*// mthun pa rnams ni gzengs bstod cing*// mthun na dga' dang mgu ba dang*// mthun par byed pa'i tshig smra ba// phra ma las ni log pa 'o// de yis tshig rtsub spangs pa yin// tshig gdug rtsub dang mi snyan dang*// pha rol spa 'gong byed pa dang*// skye bo mang po gzhan dag ni// yid la 'thad pa ma yin dang*// snying du mi sdug mi dga' dang*// yid du mi 'ong ba dang ni// mnyam gzhag 'jog par mi 'gyur pa// de lta bu yi tshig spangs nas// mi sdug rnar snyan snying la bab// dga' bar byed dang grong khyer pa// snyan cing 'jebs dang rnam par gsal// rnam par rig byed mnyan par 'os// mi brten 'gal min thub med dang*// skye bo mang la sdug pa dang*// dga' dang mgu dang yid 'ong dang*// mnyam par gzhag dang 'jog 'gyur pa// de lta bu yi tshig smra ba// tshig rtsub pa las log pa 'o// de yis tshig 'khyal spangs pa yin// dus su smra dang yang dag smra// kho na nyid du smra ba dang*// don smra chos smra rtogs pa smra// khong du chud par byed pa'i tshig

/dus dang 'dren ma ma yin dang*// gleng gzhi dan rtags bcas pa dang*// don dang chos dang ldan pa ste// tshig 'khyal pa las log pa 'o// de ni nyo tshong spangs nas kyang*// nyo tshong dag las log pa 'o// gzhal lugs srang dang tshad dag la// g.yo sgyu spangs nas log pa yin// gsug len

lkog za 'brid g.yo dang bsdigs pa dang*// gsad dang bcing dang gcad pa dang*// dgug dang brdeg pa'i bsam pa dang*// 'od dang bud med lhan cig nyal// zhing gzhi khyim dang tshong khang gzhi// glang po rta dang ba glang dang*// lug dang bya gag phag len dang*// bran pho bran mo las byed dang*// zho shas 'tsho ba len pa dang*// bud med skyes pa khye'u+u mo// gser dngul 'bru rjen len pa dag /spangs nas de las log pa yin// de ni za gcig pa yin te// nub mo spangs shing dus min pa'i// kha zas spangs par gyur pa yin// dus su rgyu zhing spyod pa yis// sbyor ba la ni brtson pa yin// de ni lus ni 'tsho tsam gyi// chos gos kyis kyang chog shes shing*// tshod zin ran par spyod pa yin// lus 'tsho tsam gyi gos dang ni// lto 'grangs tsam gyi bsod snyoms kyis// chog shes tshod kyang zin pa des// dper na 'dab chags bya dag ni// gang dang gang du lding ba der// 'dab gshog bcas par lding ba bzhin// chog shes yod pa'i dge sbyong ni// gang dang gang du 'gro ba der// lhung bzed chos gos bcas par 'gro// rgyal po chen po 'di ltar yang*// dge sbyong bram ze kha cig ni// dad pas sbyin pa spyad nas kyang*// sa bon tshogs dang 'byung po'i tshogs// sna tshogs rtsom pa la sbyor bar// brtson par gnas pa 'di dag las// de ni spang shing log pa yin// de bzhin zas dang skom dang gos// dri dang me tog lo ma dang*// 'bras bu'i gsog 'jog la sogs pa// gsog 'jog sna tshogs rtsom pa la// sbyor bar brtson pa de lta bu// de las log par gyur pa yin// gnas mal mthon po chen po ni// sna tshogs rtsom zhing sbyor ba dang*// brtsom pas gnas par byed pa dang*// cha bzhag sna tshogs sbyor ba ni// mnye dang 'khrul dang dri phyis dang*// me tog dri dang byug pa dang*// kha dog 'chang ba sen mo dang*// so dang gdong gi byi dor dang*// mchil lham gos gsar kha tshar can// cha bzhag sna tshogs byed pa dang*// glang po rta dang shing rta dang*// khyu mchog ra lug 'gyed pa dang*// bro gar dmag la blta la sogs// ltad mo sna tshogs blta ba dang*// glang po rta dang shing rta'i skad// rnga dang dung dang rol mo'i sgra// snyan ngag tshig dang yi ge dang*// grags pa'i gtam snyan 'dod la sogs// sgra rnams sna tshogs nyan pa dang*// ug shud khra

rgyan shog dang rgyan po dang*// sna tshogs gtam gyi sbyor ba la// brtsam dang sbyor dang brtson pa rnams// spangs shing log par gyur pa yin// chos la brtson par 'gyur ba yi// rtsod pa sna tshogs smra ba dang*// pho nyar bgrod dang sna 'dren dang*// kha gsag gzhog slong thob kyis 'jal// rnyed pas rnyed pa bsgrub pa dang*// 'byung po'i skad dang khyim pa'i dpyad// ne tso bya yi dpyad la sogs// sman gyi sbyor ba la sogs pa// yon po'i dpyad las log pa yin// gzhan yang sman gyi bye brag dang*// las dang sbyin las la sogs dang*// dgra dang zun gnyen gyi rgyal po rnams// pham rgyal ji ltar 'gyur la sogs// nyi zla gza' skar ltas rnams kyis// ji ltar 'gyur ba la sogs pa// dge sbyong rnams kyis yon po yi// dpyad kyi log pa'i 'tsho ba las// de dag log par gyur pa yin// de ltar de ni 'phags pa yi// tshul khrims phung po de dag dang*// ldan par gyur pa de yis ni// bde ba kha na ma tho ba// med pa nyams su myong byed cing*// dbang po'i sgo ni bsdams pa dang*// kun tu bsrungs pa'i dran pa dang*// 'grus skyong dran pas yid bsrungs pas// gnas skabs mnyam par spyod pa yin// de yi mig gis gzugs rnams ni// mthong na yid bde mi 'gyur zhing*// yid mi bde bar mi 'gyur ro// de dag mtshan mar mi 'dzin zhing*// mngon rtags su yang mi 'dzin to// gzhi ni gang gi phyir zhe na// mig gi dbang po sdom pa yis// ma bsdams par ni gnas pa de// 'jig rten la ni brnab sems dang*// yid mi bde ba 'byung 'gyur bas// mi dge sdig pa'i tshogs rnams ni// sems kyi rjes su 'brang 'gyur pas// de rnams bsdams pa'i phyir 'bad cing*// bsrungs pas mig gi dbang po yis// mig gi dbang po sdom par byed// de bzhin rna bas sgra dang ni// snas dri lces ro lus kyis reg

/yid kyis chos rnams gong ma bzhin// dbang po'i sgo rnams bsdams pa yis// nang gi bde ba gnod med pa// nyams su myong zhing 'gro ba dang*// bzlog dang de bzhin blta ba dang*// rnam par blta dang bskum pa dang*// brkyang dang snam sbyar chos gos dang*// lhung bzed len pas byed pa dang*// 'gro dang 'greng dang 'dug pa dang*// nyal dang mi nyal smra ba dang*// mi smra ba dang de bzhin du// gnyid kyis dub pa sel ba yang*// shes bzhin du ni gnas pa yis// de yang gong gi 'phags pa yi// tshul khrims phung por ldan pa dang*// dbang po'i sgo rnams bsdams pa dang*// kun tu bsrungs pa'i dran pa dang*// 'grus skyong dran pas yid bsrungs pas// nang gi bde ba gnod med pa// nyams su myong bar gyur pa de// 'gro dang ldog la sogs rnams su// shes bzhin mchog dang ldan pa yis// nyams su myong bar gyur pa yin// de ltar 'phags pa'i tshul khrims kyi// phung po lnga dang ldan pa dang*// dbang po'i sgo rnams bsdams pa dang*// dran dang shes bzhin mchog de dang*// ldan pas gnas mal dben pa dang*// dgon pa shing drung khang stong du// 'dug ste dkyil mo krung bcas shing*// lus kyang drang por bsrang nas kyang*// dran pa sngon du bzhag bya ste// 'jig rten brnab sems spangs nas kyang*// brnab sems bral ba'i bsam pa yis// lan grangs mang du gnas bya zhing*// brnab sems yongs su sbyong ba yin// 'jig rten la ni gnod sems dang*// rmugs dang gnyid dang rgod pa dang*// 'gyod dang the tshom yid gnyis las// brgal zhing dge ba'i chos rnams la// the tshom yongs su sbyong ba yin// sgrib pa lnga po 'di dag la// skyin po nad dang bral dang brtson// 'jigs pa bzhin du spangs pa dang*// de ltar sgrib pa rnam pa lnga// sems ni nyon mongs byed pa dang*// shes rab nyams chung byed pa dang*// mi mthun phyogs dang mthun pa dang*// myang ngan 'da' bar mi 'gyur ba// spangs nas 'dod dang sdig pa dang*// mi dge chos rnams las dben pa// rtog bcas dpyod bcas dben pa las// skyes pa'i dga' dang bde ba can// bsam gtan dang po rdzogs par byed// de yi dga' bde de nyid kyis// brlan zhing tshim par byed pa ni// chu dang 'dag chal bsres pa na// brlan zhing gsher ba de bzhin du// dga' dang bde bas ma khyab pa// cung zad tsam yang med pa ste// rgyal po chen po 'di yang ni// dge sbyong 'bras bu bstan pa yin// de ltar de ni rtog pa dang*// dpyod pa dag dang bral gyur cing*// nang ni yongs su dang gyur te// sems rgyud gcig tu gyur pa yis// rtog dang dpyod pa med pa yi// ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa yi// dga' ba dag dang bde ba can// bsam gtan gnyis pa rdzogs byas nas// dga' bdes tshim zhing khyab pa ni// dper na ri rtse'i bkod ma ni// chu bsil gang zhing khyab pa ltar// ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa yi// dga' dang bde bas khyab pa ni// rgyal po dge sbyong 'bras bu bstan// dga' ba'i 'dod chags dang bral bas// btang snyoms gnas shing dran pa dang*// shes bzhin can de bde ba ni// lus kyis myong bar 'gyur ba la// 'phags pa rnams kyis gang de la// dran ldan bde ba la gnas pa// btang snyoms pa 'o zhes brjod de// dga' ba med pa'i bde ba yis// khyab cing ma khyab med pa ni// dper na ut+pal 'dab ma dag

/chu las skyes par gyur pa ni// chu yis yongs su khyab pa ltar// dga' ba med pa'i bde ba yis// khyab cing yongs su khyab pa 'di// dge sbyong 'bras bu bstan pa yin// de ltar de yi bde ba yis// spangs te snga nas sdug bsngal yang*// spangs shing yid kyi bde ba dang*// mi bde ba yang nub pas na// bde dang sdug bsngal ma yin pa// btang snyoms dang ni dran pa ni// yongs su dag pa'i bsam gtan bzhi// rdzogs par byas nas gnas pa ste// de yi lus de dag pa dang*// rnam par byang ba'i sems kyis ni// lhag par mos te khyab pa dang*// rdzogs par byas te gnas pa ni// dper na ras yug chen po yis// lus 'di g.yogs par gyur ba bzhin// dag cing rnam par byang ba yin// sems kyis ma khyab cung zad med// rgyal po 'di yang dge sbyong gi /'bras bu bstan par gyur ba yin// rgyal po chen po gang gi tshe// 'phags pa'i nyan thos de dag gis// bde dang sdug bsngal spangs pa dang*// yid ni bde dang mi bde ba// nus pas bde sdug ma yin pa// btang snyoms dang ni dran pa yang*// yongs su dag pa'i bsam gtan bzhi// rdzogs par byas pa de yi tshe// de yi sems ni rgod pa 'am// zhum par gyur pa med pa yis// mi g.yo bar ni gnas pa thob// dper na mar me'i me lce ni// sus kyang ma bsgul ma bskyod na// rgod dang zhum pa'i skyon med par// mi g.yo 'bar ba de bzhin du// bsam gtan bzhi pa rdzogs pa'i sems// rgod cing zhum pa med pa yis// mi g.yo bar ni gnas pa thob// thob nas de yis 'di snyam du// 'byung ba bzhi las gyur pa'i lus// rags par gyur pa 'di la ni// bdag gi rnam shes gnas pas na// lus las yid ni bskyod nas kyang*// yid kyis lus ni sprul bar byed// ral gri shubs nas byung ba las// shubs dang ral gri ji bzhin du// lus las bskyod pa'i yid kyi gzugs// dman pa ma yin sprul par byed// de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa'i sems// yongs su dag cing byang ba dang*// nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs dang*// bral zhing drang por gyur pa dang*// lus su rung ba mi g.yo ba// thob nas rdzu 'phrul yul shes pa// mngon du bya ba'i shes pa la// sems ni mngon par gtong byed cing*// rdzu 'phrul yul rnams nyams su myong*// tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bar du yang*// lus kyis dbang ni bsgyur ba yi// bar du rdzu 'phrul thams cad ston// dper na rdza mkhan mkhas pa zhig

/'jim pa las ni snod kyi tshogs// rnam pa sna tshogs byed pa ltar// de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa'i sems// dag cing rnam par byang ba dang*// nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs dang*// bral zhing drang por gyur pa dang*// las su rung zhing mi g.yo ba// thob nas rdzu 'phrul ston pa 'di// rgyal po dge sbyong 'bras bu yin// de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa'i sems// dag cing rnam par byang ba dang*// nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs dang*// bral zhing drang por gyur ba dang*// las su rung zhing mi g.yo ba// thob nas lha yi rna ba yi// shes nas mngon par shes pa de// mngon sum nyid du bya ba'i sems// mngon du gtod par byed pa las// de yi lha yi rna ba ni// rnam dag mig las 'das pa yis// mi dang mi ma yin rnams kyi// ring ngam nye ba'i sgra rnams thos// dper na mi zhig dung 'bud pa// ri brag chen po'i khar 'dzegs nas// mtshan phyed bus na sgra de yis// grags shing khyab par gyur ba bzhin// de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa'i sems// dag cing byang ba mi g.yo ba// thob nas lha yi rna ba yi// mngon par shes pas nye ring gi /sgra rnams thos par gyur pa ni// rgyal po dge sbyong 'bras bu yin// mnyam gzhag dag cing byang ba dang*// las su rung zhing mi g.yo ba'i// sems de thob nas gzhan dag gi /sems kyi rnam grangs shes pa la// mngon du gtod pas shes pa ni// dper na mig ldan skyes bu yis// me long dkyil 'khor dag pa zhig /blangs nas byad bzhin blta ba ltar// sems kyi rgyud rnams shes pa ni// rgyal po dge sbyong 'bras bu yin// de bzhin gong gi sems de yis// de ltar sems shing gtod pa yis// skye ba dran par gyur ba ni// dper na mi zhig grong gzhan du// song nas gzhan du song ba las// phyin pa'i grong rnams dran pa ltar// skye ba sna tshogs dran pa 'di// rgyal po dge sbyong 'bras bu yin// de ltar gong gi sems de yis// 'chi 'pho skye ba shes pa yi// mngon par shes la sems gtod pas// lha mig rnam par dag pa yis// 'chi 'pho skye ba shes pa ni// sgo gsum nyes par spyod pa yis// ngan 'gro log par ltung ba dang*// legs par spyad pa'i 'bras bu ni// mtho ris gnas su skye ba dag

/dper na mig ldan skyes bu zhig /lam gyi bzhi mdor 'dug nas kyang*// skye bo'i tshogs kyi 'gro 'ong la// blta zhing rtog pa de bzhin du// 'chi 'pho skye ba shes pa yi// mngon par shes pas shes pa 'di// rgyal po dge sbyong 'bras bu yin// de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa'i sems// yongs su dag cing byang ba dang*// nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs dang*// bral zhing drang por gyur pa dang*// las su rung zhing mi g.yo ba// thob nas zag pa zad pa yi// shes pa mngon du bya ba yi// mngon par shes la sems gtod pas// sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa dang*// sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'gog pa dang*// sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam// 'phags pa'i bden pa yin no zhes// ji lta ba bzhin rab tu shes// de ltar shes shing mthong ba yis// 'dod pa'i zag par gyur ba las// sems ni rnam par grol bar 'gyur// srid pa dang ni ma rig pa'i// zag pa dag las sems grol 'gyur// rnam par grol nas bdag gis ni// skye ba zad do tshangs spyod bsten// bya ba byas so srid pa ni// 'di las gzhan pa mi shes zhes// rnam par grol ba'i ye shes nyid// thob par gyur pa de yis ni// dper na mtsho bran dwangs pa yi// 'gram na 'dug pa'i skyes bu yis// nya dang rus sbal nya phyis sam// dung rnams mthong ba de bzhin du// zag pa zad pa'i shes pa yis// 'phags pa'i bden pa mthong nas kyang*// 'dod dang srid dang ma rig pa'i// zag pa rnams las sems grol nas// srid pa 'di las gzhan med pa'i// rnam par grol ba'i ye shes nyid// mthong bar gyur pa 'di dag ni// rgyal po chen po dge sbyong gi /'bras bu bstan pa ma yin nam// ston pas de skad ces gsungs pas// rgyal po chen po ma skyes dgra// lha sbyin sdig pa'i grogs po yis// zin pas sdig pa mi dge ba// rnam pa sna tshogs byas pa dang*// chos kyi rgyal pos pha bsad pa'i// nyes pa thub pa'i spyan sngar bshags// de la thub pas 'di skad du// rgyal po chen po khyod nyid kyis// nyes pa shes shing mthong nas kyang*// bshags nas phyis kyang sdom byed na// khyod kyi dge ba'i chos rnams ni// mi nyams 'phel ba nyid du yang*// 'dod par bya ba nyid yin no// thub pas de skad gsungs nas kyang*// gzhi dang bral ba'i dad pa la// rgyal po bzhag pa nyid du mdzad//

// 325) ༄// thams cad mkhyen pa'i bde legs kun gyi gzhi gyur 'dul bar shin tu gces dgos pa// mtho dman nyes pa mang po yis// thams cad mi bder gyur pa na// 'gram dang nye 'gram ji bzhin du// legs par brtags nas bya 'o zhes// de yang thub pa chen pos gsungs// thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga' ba des shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa thams cad mngon du gyur pas/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa las 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung bar mkhyen cing thugs su chud nas/ las rnams bskal pa brgya yang ni// chud mi za ba tshogs dang dus// rnyed na lus can rnams kyi ni// 'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid// ces gsungs pas/ shes bya'i gshis las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa'i 'bras bu bde ba dang sdug bsngal du 'gyur ba/ rang nyid kyis byas shing bsags pa rang nyid kyis so sor myong bar 'gyur ba las/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi la sogs pa gzhan la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur bas/ mtsho chen po ma dros par bcom ldan 'das dgra bcom pa lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu sngon gyi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan pa dang*/ 'phags pa gyad bu nor/ sngon khye'u bden smra zhes bya bar gyur ba'i dus su/ mas ma g.yar mo la skur ba btab pa'i tshe gzhi mgo cog pas phye ba de'i rnam par smin pas lo brgya phrag mang po dang*/ lo stong phrag mang por sems can dmyal bar skyes nas las de'i lhag mas tshe rabs lnga brgyar gzhi med pa'i skur ba byung zhing tha mar 'phags pa dgra bcom pa chen po/ nyan thos chen po mchog brgyad kyi mal cha dang stan bsko ba rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa gyad bu nor du gyur kyang*/ mdza' bo dang sa la skyes kyis gzhi med par pham pa dang*/ bag tsam la brten pham pa la sogs pa'i skur ba mang po byung nas/ de bzhin gshegs pas de la bslab par bcas shing thub pa'i 'khor du gtogs pa rnams la rgya cher rnam par grags pa dang*/

pham pa dang lhag ma nyes ltung chen po lta zhog gi chu bo gang gā'i 'gram du bcom ldan 'das la/ nya dang rus sbal la sogs pa'i srog chags lnga brgya bskor ba byas pa las 'di dag dud 'gror 'gro ba'i rgyu ci lags zhus pas/ 'di dag sngon thub pa 'od bsrungs kyi bstan pa la/ bslab pa'i gzhi phran tshegs phran tshegs dag nyams pas/ dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes pa la sogs pa lung sman gyi gzhir gsungs pa dang*/ 'phags pa dge 'dun 'tsho rgya mtsho'i 'gram du nye tshe ba'i sems can dmyal pa mang po mthong ba dang*/ srog chags thag pa 'dra ba dang*/ gtun 'dra ba dang*/ phyags ma 'dra ba la sogs pa mthong ba rnams bcom ldan 'das la zhus pas/ dge 'dun gyi phyags ma la snabs dang mchil ma bskus pa la sogs pa'i rnam par smin par gsungs pas snabs dang mchil lud bskus pa la sogs pa phran tshegs nyes ltung tsam du yang bcas pa med pa'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa yang de 'dra na/ skye ba bcad pas e la'i 'dab tu skyes pa lta mos kyang ci dgos pa la skye ba gcod pa ni bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa yin pas ngan song gi nyes pa mi bskyed/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' khyad du bsad pas skyes pa yin snyam na/ las mi dge ba che 'bring gsum las 'bras bu sdug bsngal che 'bring gsum 'byung bar gsungs pa shin tu phra ba zhig khyad tu bsad na yang ci ga dkon mchog gsum khyad tu bsad par ma gyur grang*/ de ltar gyur na dkon mchog gsum la brten pas nyes pa cher song bzhag pas chog snyam na yang*/ skyabs dkon mchog spangs pa'i thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bde ba lta 'ong ba cang srid dam/ yang 'ga' re legs par bsrung*/ 'ga' re mi thub par 'dug ci 'dod red snyam na yang las 'dres ma gong dang 'dra ste/ de la rang rang shes pa ma gtogs pa sus kyang de la ci zhig bya/ rang la snying brtse yod pa rnams kyis 'di ltar shes par bya ste/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che la/

ltung bar rigs mthun pa so so nas bcas pa'i dgos pa spyi dang*/ bye brag rnam pa gnyis te/ spyi ni/ ngas 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gti mug 'dod chags dang bral bar bya ba'i phyir/ sems rnam par grol ba dang*/ shes rab rnam par grol bar bya ba'i phyir chos bstan pa la khyod kyis ci'i phyir mi mdzes pa de lta bu byas par gyur zhes rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas/ dge slong rnams la bka' bstsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs nas/ 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste/ 'di lta ste/ dge 'dun bsdu bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ dge 'dun legs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ dge 'dun bde bar gnas par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ gnong mi bkur ba'i gang zag rnams tshar bcad par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ ngo tsha shes pa rnams bde bar gnas par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mngon par ma dad pa rnams mngon par dad par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mngon par dad pa rnams phyir zhing dbyung bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ tshe 'di'i zag pa rnams bsdam par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ tshe rabs phyi ma rnams bzlog par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ nga'i tshangs par spyod pa skye bo mang po la phan pa yangs par 'gyur ba lha dang mi'i bar dag la yang dag par bstan pa yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ba'o// zhes pa spyi'i dgos pa gsungs pa dang*/ bye brag gi dgos pa ni/ dge slong rab tu byung ba mang po chos gos mang po 'chang ba dang*/ stan bzang po mang po dang*/ srin bal gyi stan 'ba' zhig nyams su len pas lung 'bogs pa dang*/ klog pa dang*/ kha ton byed pa dang*/ rnal 'byor dang yid la bya ba dang*/ sems kyi zhi gnas gtong bar byed ces/ smad par byed/ 'phya bar byed/ phyar ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed nas gso dka' ba dang*/ dgang dka' ba dang*/ 'dod pa che ba dang*/ chog mi shes pa smad cing*/ gso sla ba dang*/ dgang sla ba dang*/ 'dod pa chung ba dang*/

chog shes pa dang*/ phri ba dang*/ yo byad bsnyungs pa dang*/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang*/ mdzes pa dang*/ tshod shes pa nyid kyi bsngags pa brjod nas bcas pa ste/ de yang shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan la sogs pa shākya lnga brgya rab tu byung ba las/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti chen po byung nas bden pa ma mthong bas/ smad na dbral dka' bar dgongs nas gdul ba la mkhas pa bla na med pa yin pas/ zla ba gsum nang du yang dag 'jog la bzhag nas su dang yang mi 'phrad pa las/ tshe dang ldan pa nye sde dang mjal bas/ nye sde gang gis khyod mdzes pa dang 'khor mdzes pa dang ldan par gyur/ btsun pa bdag gi drung du rab tu 'byung 'dod pa zhig 'ongs na de la sbyangs pa'i yon tan rnams gnas par gyis shig ces brjod cing bsngags pa yang brjod par byed do// gal te de ltar bgyi'o zhes mchi na de rab tu 'byin par bgyid do// gal te bsnyen par rdzogs par 'tshal ba dang*/ gnas la zhugs pa dang*/ klog pa dang*/ kha 'don dang*/ yid la bgyi ba la zhugs pa zhig mchi na/ de la tshur dgon pa dang*/ bsod snyoms pa dang*/ chos gos gsum pa dang*/ phyag dar khrod pa dang*/ shing drung pa tshol cig ces mchi zhing shing drung ba nyid kyi bsngags pa yang brjod par bgyid do// gal te de ltar bgyi'o zhes mchi na de la yid la bgyi bar gsol bar bgyid/ de btsun pa gang gis bdag mdzes pa 'khor mdzes pa dang ldan pa'i rgyu ni de lags/ rkyen ni de lags so// zhes pa dang*/ legs so zhes pa gnang nas sbyangs pa'i yon tan de dag gi bsngags pa mi brjod pa ni nga'i bsngags pa mi brjod cing brjod pa ni nga'i bsngags pa brjod do// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ nye sde ngas dge slong dgon pa la dgon pa'i yongs su spang ba sbyin par bya ste/ dge slong dgon pa la de bzhin gshegs pa la bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir ltar 'gro ba'i dus ma yin pa med do// dge slong bsod snyoms pa dang*/

rnyed pas chog pa'i bsod snyoms pa dang*/ zas phyis mi len pa dang*/ stan gcig pa dang*/ chos gos gsum pa dang*/ phying ba pa dang*/ phyag dar khrod pa dang*/ shing drung pa dang*/ dur khrod pa dang*/ tsog bu pa dang*/ bla gab med pa dang*/ gzhi ji bzhin pa rnams la spang ba sbyin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir 'gro ba'i dus ma yin pa med do zhes gsungs pas/ shākya rnams kyi yo byad spangs nas chos gos gsum par byas nas bden pa mthong bas bar chad/ mdor na lhag pa'i yo byad tsam gyis bar chad du 'gyur ba dang*/ der yang ma zad de 'jig rten gyi mngon par shes pa lnga'i bar chad du yang g.yang gzhi dang*/ shing shun dang*/ dbyug gu dang ril pa la sogs pa lhag pa'i yo byad kyi bar du gcod par ston pa lkug phye'i skyes rabs su gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang ltung ba so so'i bye brag dge slong don nyung ba rnams dang*/ khyim pa dang mu stegs can rnams kyis 'di la nyes dmigs 'di dang 'di dag yod ces rnam par smad pa de nyid rgyur mdzad nas bkag pa ni bye brag gi dgag bya rnams te/ de yang ston pa thams cad mkhyen pas bde ba dang legs pa thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa 'dul ba'i sde snod 'di shin tu gces pa dang*/ chos dang 'dul ba ma yin pa'i skyon gyi mi nub par bya ba'i phyir/ gnas 'di dang 'di zhes bya bar/ ston pa tshul 'di ltar bzhugs pa'i dus su dge slong 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba la nyes ltung 'di dag byung ba las spyi bye brag gi dgag dgos gsungs nas 'di ltar mi bya ste/ byas na nyes pa dang ltung bar gsungs pa dang*/ dgra bcom pa chen po la sogs pa rnams la 'di ltar gnang ba'i rgyu mtshan gtan tshigs dang bcas pa gsungs so// de dag kyang mdor bsdus nas bsam pa nyon mongs pa gang yin pa ni nyon mongs pa'o// des kun nas bslang nas lus ngag gi bya ba mthar thug pa ni ltung ba ste las so// las des 'bras bu rnam par smin pa ngan song gsum du ltung ba'o// nyes pa dang ltung ba spangs pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyis byas pa ni dge ba'o// las dge ba des gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu lha dang mi'i bde ba dang*/
mthar thug byang chub rnam pa gsum don du gang gnyer ba de thob par shes par bya'o// //

326) ༄// 'dul ba'i bslab bya gsal ba'i me long*// dang por byang chub sems bskyed nas// bskal ba chen po grangs med gsum// thub pas pha rol phyin pa la// ji ltar spyad par gyur pa yis// byang chub ji ltar brnyes pa dang*// thub pa'i nyan thos chen po rnams// smon lam ji ltar btab pa yis// 'bras bu ji ltar byung ba dang*// lha sbyin byas pa mi gzo bas// rdzu 'phrul stobs las nyams nas kyang*// ston pas sngon gyi tshe rabs su// byas pa mi gzo la sogs pa// blun zhing rmongs par bstan pa dang*// mi dge ba yi bshes gnyen la// ma skyes dgra yis bsten pa yis// mtshams med lnga la sogs pa yi// nyes pa rnams kyis gos pa dang*// dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa yis// nyes pa'i skyon dang bral ba rnams// dge 'dun dbyen gyi gzhi rnams su// shin tu rgyas par bshad pa dang*// mdor na dkar nag las rnams kyis// rgyu las 'bras bu bstan nas kyang*// des na dge slong khyed kyis kyang*// byas pa gzo bar bya ba dang*// dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang*// sdig pa'i grogs po spang ba dang*// nag po'i las rnams spang ba dang*// dkar po'i las rnams thams cad la// khyed kyis bslab par bya'o zhes// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis bka' bstsal pa// thub pa'i 'dul ba'i sde snod las// lhag pa'i tshul khrims bslab pa la// nan tan chen pos bslab pa yis// 'bras bu byang chub thob par bya// ༈ //na mo rat+na gu ru// thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi// bskal pa brgya phrag rnams su yang*// las rnams chud zar mi 'gyur te// tshogs shing dus la bab pa na// lus can rnams la 'bras bur smin// zhes gsungs nas 'bras bu bde ba dang sdug bsngal da ltar smin pa rnams kyi rgyu 'di ni 'di yin zhes gsungs nas/ yang rjes la dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu gnag pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu gnag

gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi yang gcig tu dkar/ 'dres ma rnams kyi yang 'dres ma'o// dge slong dag de ltar bas na las gcig tu gnag pa dang 'dres ma rnams spangs te/ las gcig tu dkar ba dag kho na la brtsal 'bad bar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis bslab par bya'o// zhes gsungs so// de la nag po nag po gang zhe na/ 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug gsum bsam pa nyon mongs pas kun nas bslang ba'i lus ngag gi bya ba mthar thug pa la las zhes bya ste/ las dang nyon mongs pa de de las bzlog pa/ de'i gnyen por 'gro ba'i thabs ma bsten na 'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur te/ de yang chen pos dmyal ba/ 'bring gis yi dwags/ chung ngus dud 'gro'i skye gnas 'bras bu shin tu gnag pa 'byung ste/ de yang shes bya'i babs la sngon 'jig rten chags pa'i dus su/ 'od gsal gyi lha 'dzam bu'i gling du lhung bas/ bdud rtsi sa zhag mdzub mo thor thos lce la myangs pa'i ro'i sred pa la chags pas/ de nyid kyis mir gyur pa la sogs pa gsungs pa dang*/ dge slong lhung bzed la chags pas me gsum dus gcig 'bar ba la sogs pa 'dod pa la bsten pas ni mi dge ba cung zad kyang mi byed pa med do// zhes gsungs pa dang 'dra bar ltung ba sde lnga nyon mongs pa che 'bring rnam pa gsum gyi las 'bras bu yang de ltar 'gyur bar las dang 'bras bu rnam pa gzhag pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ye shes can/ thams cad mkhyen pa kho nas mkhyen pa'i lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che'o// thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon bsnyen par rdzogs pa bcu byung ba las/ 'dir mkhan po dang slob dpon 'os pa dang*/ dge 'dun mthun pas gsol ba dang gzhi'i las mi g.yo ba bsnyen par rdzogs par byas pa las bar chad gsum las/ skye ba'i bar chad klur sprul pa dang*/ pha ma bsad pa'i bsnyen par rdzogs pa la lus 'dis yon tan gong ma skye ba la bar du gcod par gsungs pa dang*/

gnas pa la bar du gcod pa yang bran dgra bcom pa thob pa dang*/ dge tshul gnyis kyis bsam pa na 'phos pas mthar dgra bcom pa la sogs pa yang shes par bya ba dang*/ mdzes pa ni mdzes pa'i bar chad nyid du gsungs pa'o// gzhan yang yul mtha' 'khob kyi gro bzhin skyes kyis nyi tshe ba'i sems can dmyal ba'i rgyu 'bras zhib par gsungs pas go bar byas la mkhas pas rab tu dbyung bar bya'o// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// btsun mo gsum la sogs pa yi// bud med drug khri spangs nas ni// dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu la// thub pa khyim nas rab tu byung*// lo drug dka' ba spyad nas ni// dgung lo sum cu rtsa lnga la// byang chub snying por bzhugs nas ni// ji srid zag med ma thob par// de srid dkyil krung bshig mi bya// de yis ji srid zag med pa// ma brnyes dkyil krung 'jig mi mdzad// mgon po byang chub sangs rgyas nas// wā rā ṇa sīr gshegs nas kyang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe// lnga pa dang ni nye lnga dang*// mtho ba lnga bcu rab tu byung*// ral pa can gyi tshang gshegs nas// bzang sde'i tshogs ni drug cu byung*// sde 'dong grong du gshegs nas kyang*// bu mo dga' mo dga' stobs gnyis// bden pa dag la rab tu bzhag /lteng rgyas gnas su gshegs nas kyang*// ral pa can stong rab tu phyung*// ga ya mgo yi mchod rten du// dge slong stong po de dag la// cho 'phrul gsum gyi gdams ngag gis// mya ngan 'das la rab tu bkod// ltang 'brang tshal seb gshegs nas kyang*// rgyal po gzugs can snying po dang*// lha yi tshogs rnams brgyad khri dang*// ma ga dha yi bram ze dang*// khyim bdag 'bum phrag du ma rnams// lhan cig bden pa dag la bkod// 'o ma'i tshal du gshegs nas kyang*// shā ri'i bu dang mo'u 'gal bu// bram ze stong rings rab tu phyung*// de yi tshe na dge slong rnams// bsnyen pa tshur shog gis rdzogs pas// 'ga' zhig rab tu 'byung 'dod nas// ring po'i lam nas 'ongs pa las// bar ma dor ni rgyun chad cing*// shi bar gyur ba'i gnas skabs rnams// dge slong rnams kyi gsol ba dang*// thub pa thugs rje chen po yis// ring po lam nas 'ongs pa rnams// dal bar gzigs nas dge 'dun la// bsnyen par rdzogs par gnang bar mdzad// der yang de dag ma bsdams pas// mkhan po dang ni slob dpon la// rab tu 'byung ba nyid du gnang*// slob dpon rnam pa lnga nyid de// dge tshul gsang ste las kyi dang*// gnas dang klog pa'i slob dpon no// mkhan po gnyis te gang zhe na// rab tu 'byin par byed pa dang*// bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa'o//

// 327) ༄// bcom ldan 'das ko'u sham bi dbyangs ldan gyi kun dga' ra bar zhes pa// bcom ldan 'das ko'u sham bi dbyangs ldan gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so// de yi dus su gdug pa dang*// gtum zhing pha rol gnon pa yi// dge slong sde snod gsum pa gnyis// phyogs dang bcas pas phan tshun du// mthun par mi smra'i brtul zhugs kyis// yangs pa can dang ko'u sham bir// phyogs bzung rtsod pa byed pa las// ston pa thugs rje chen po yis// phan tshun dge 'dun mi mthun zhing*// 'thab dang rtsod pa skye 'gyur na// ltung ba la sogs mi 'dod pa// gleng gzhi dran par mi bya 'o// de skad gsungs kyang ma btub nas// gso sbyong byed par gyur pa yang*// gso sbyong ma yin par byed nas// 'thab dang rtsod par byed pa yis// dge 'dun las rnams 'khrugs pa dang*// tha dad du ni gnas par gyur// tha dad rnam pa gnyis yin te// rang nyid rtsod pa'i sar song dang*// gnas nas dbyung bar byas pa 'o// mthun par gnas pa gnyis yin te// rang nyid mthun par gnas pa dang*// tshogs kyis mthun par bzhag pa 'o// de ltar gsungs kyang ma btub nas// phan tshun brdeg la zhugs pa dang*// khyim gyi nang du zhugs pa'i tshe// phan tshun brdeg par mi 'gyur ba'i// bstan la bar chad bya 'o gsungs// yang bka' bstsal pa/ tshig mi mthun la phyogs mnyam yang*// 'di gtso min zhes sems byed pa// dge 'dun dbye bar gyur na ko /de la sogs pa gsungs gyur kyang*// dge slong rnams kyis 'di skad ces// bde gshegs chos kyi rje lags te// bdag cag tshig ngan mi bzod ces// smras pa'i don la ma dgyes nas// de tshe rgyal ba mkha' la gshegs// chos rje thub pa chen po yis// bcu gnyis lo yi grangs snyed du// 'thab rtsod byed la btang snyoms mdzod// ko'u sham bi yi khyim bdag rnams// bcom ldan 'das dang ma mjal ba'i// nyes pa'i le lan bsam pa yis// dge slong rnams la mi smra zhing*// bsod snyoms bcad pas de rnams kyang*// ston pa'i drung du mnyan yod lhags// de tshe dge slong kun dga' bos// ji ltar bya ba zhus pa dang*// lag brdas gnas mal tha ma zhig

/bstan par bya ba ma gtogs par// mi smra phebs par mi smra zhing*// mi blta rnam par mi blta 'o// bdag cag rgas na ci yi phyir// gnas mal tha ma sbyin zhe na// tshul dang spyod pa log bsgrubs pas// ston pa'i thugs ma dgyes pa yis// khyed cag dge sbyong yin nam smros// go'u tam mi la stan dang ni// khyim bdag bsod snyoms byin pa las// gzhan du bya ba gong du 'dra// de ltar byas pas dge slong rnams// chos bzhin mthun pa'i blo skyes pas// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa// gnas nas phyung ba'i dge slong gis// dge 'dun rnams la dbyung bar gsol// gsol ba dang ni las byas pas// dge 'dun mthun par bya ba ste// mthun pa byin pa'i dge 'dun dang*// mthun par las rnams bya ba ste// mi mthun byed na 'gal tshabs can// bkra shis mthun pa'i gso sbyong la// mi bde ba la gso sbyong la// gzhan du byed na 'gal tshabs can// // 328) ༄// sku gsum rang bzhin la skur ba btab na rang phung bar 'gyur zhes pa// na mo rat+na gu ru/ chos kun mnyam nyid gdod nas rang bzhin rnam par dag pa thugs chud pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug de ni tshangs pa skye dgu'i bdag po yin// skyes mchog de yi drung du gnas pa rnams kyang shin tu dag par 'gyur ba ste// ma dag yod pa mi srid yod par yang ni mi mthong na// 'khrul pa nying 'khrul can khyod 'gro rnams sku gsum rang bzhin la// nyes pa'i skur ba mang po btab pas rang gzhan phung bar gyur pas na// dpe med rin po che khyod rang nyid rtag tu bsrung bar rigs pa yin// khyod la 'jig rten mgon pos snang ba sems dang de nyid ma bstan tam// // 329) ༄// zab gsang rtogs par 'dod na rtsa ba'i bla mar nges shes skye dgos par bstan pa// dad pa log ltar ma song ba/ bsod nams bdud du ma song ba/ tshogs gsog phung 'drer ma song ba/ sgrub pa 'dre sgrub tu ma song ba/

byas tshad sdug bsngal du ma song ba zhig dgos/ sku nam mkha' rang bzhin yang mi 'dod la/ zhing khams thams cad du gdul bya la cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa/ gsung brjod du med pa'i rang bzhin yang mi 'dor la/ zhing khams thams cad du dbyangs kyis go bar mdzad pa/ thugs spros pa thams cad dang bral yang*/ dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa mkhyen pa ni sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'o// gsang ba zab mo rtogs 'dod na// rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa de// sangs rgyas kyi nges shes skyes na go /go ba brjod du med par gnas// // 330) ༄// tug gis thug pa'i dus su bcu chos dang sum chos gar song ngam zhes shrī phug pa la gnang ba// dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi ngo bo bla ma rin chen dang*// des gsungs dam chos 'dod chags bral ba'i rin chen dang*// thub pa'i dge 'dun dul zhing nyer zhi rin chen dang*// rin chen dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan rin po ches/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po la gdams pa/ bdag nyams myong can yin/ phag mo gru'i gdan sa spyan lam du gzigs pa de la/ da 'di na phar la mi thon/ sdug par 'dug snyam pa'i bsam rkyang des nga'i lag pa bud/ mi de tsam zhig shi ba nyid la thugs rgyus mnga'/ bdag 'chi nges pa'i nad ma rungs pa mang du byung ba la/ dge 'dun la sku'i rim gro bcol bas tshegs med par phan par byung*/ phan par 'dug myong bas grub/ khyed kyi bka' shog bstod pa dang bcas pa de la phra ma khyer dogs pa'i bka' bkyon de la bdag shin tu 'jigs par byung*/ 'ga'i dus ngan chen po de dang thug pa dge 'dun grongs pa 'di ma lan na rung ste snyam pa'i bsam pa byung*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nas da lta phan chad du 'khor rnams kyi nang du yo byad phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel gyi gang zag re re 'ong*/ dper na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po la/

bu 'khor btsun mo rin po che mang yang*/ nor gyi dgos pa khyim bdag rin po ches bsgrub pa yin/ rje sgam po pa'i zhabs tog sgrub byed gdod mtha' bar gsum du/ bla ma chen po dpal gnas nang pa 'di yin par 'dug de la ngas kyang rtog pa cung zad skyes pa'i dus su yang nor la bor ral chen po 'byung bar 'dug khyed kyi nor la bor ral byung ba yang bdag gi zhabs tog tu yab sras gnyis la 'gran sems dang rnam par rtog pa byung ba ni cang srid dam/ sngon khyed nyid kyi zhal nas/ dred mo gcig sha za ba mthong bas rkang pa brgyad pa'i bstod pa byas shing phar ded gsung*/ de la dgos pa ci yod byas pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs zer/ de'i tshod la de ltar gyur na dred mo dang*/ dgra dang gnod pa byed mkhan rnams dpal he ru kar byas nas de la bstod pa ma yin nam/ tug gis thug pa'i dus su bcu chos dang sum chos zab mo de gar song ang*/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// skyob mdzad mi gcig chos kyi rje// mgon po dpal ldan rin po che// de yi gcig shos de 'dra na// gzhan gyi gcig shos ci 'dra ang*// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// bar chad bdud kyi tshogs la sogs// lha dang bla ma gnyis med pa// snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang*// bcud kyi sems can yi dam lha// mgon po phag mo gru pas gsung*// kwa re dga' re skyid tho le rgyal// bkra shis bde legs 'byung ba'i gnas// mi zad lhun grub gter chen 'di// e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// 'gro bas byang chub mchog thob shog /mgon po de la phyag 'tshal lo// shrī ri phug pa// // 331) ༄// tshul khrims rin po che la gces spras srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ba shākya'i zhu chos// oṃ swasti/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sdug bsngal chu srin 'dzin khris gang ba las// thabs dang shes rab mchog gi gru yis pha rol sgrol mdzad pa// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po chos rje phag mo gru pa yi// zhabs la spyi bos gus pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// thub pa'i bstan la gces spras mdzad gyur cing*// gong ma'i rjes bslab 'gro ba smin mdzad pa'i// gces pa'i bu yis bdag la zhus pa 'dir// gong ma'i gsung sgros cung zad bri bar bya// spyir bdag cag thams cad kyi 'dug lugs mi'i lus 'di thob kyang*/

thob par ni dka'/ blo gtad ni med/ 'jig par ni sla/ chu'i chu bur dang khyad par med par 'dug pas/ tshe 'di'i che thabs dang*/ bzang thabs dang*/ nga 'o dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ chos brgyad sna tshogs bsgrub par mi bya ste/ bsgrubs kyang 'grub par yang dka'/ rgya la gal te grub kyang nyes pa sna tshogs bskyed par byed pa ma gtogs pa/ phan pa dang bde ba 'byung ba mi srid pas 'jig rten pha rol gyi don bsam par bya'o// de la 'jig rten pha rol gyi don dang*/ tshe 'di'i don dang*/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad kyi so nams lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che 'di ma gtogs pa mi srid de/ de ltar yang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu kun gyi sa bzhin du// yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs// zhes pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang*/ tshul khrims kyis ni zhi ba 'dod rnams 'phags par 'gyur// stobs bcu'i spyod yul gnas shing tshul khrims nyams pa med// ces gsungs pas/ tshul khrims rin po che 'di dag gnas skabs dang mthar thug thams cad kyi yon tan thams cad sgrub par byed pa'i rten yin la/ ngan song gsum las thar bar byed pa yang tshul khrims/ mtho ris lha dang mi'i go 'phang thob par byed pa yang tshul khrims/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po chen po thob par byed pa yang tshul khrims/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob pa yang tshul khrims/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po sa nas sar 'phar zhing*/ sa bcu rgyun gyi mtha' ma la gnas shing dbang bskur ba thob par byed pa yang tshul khrims/ mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad thob pa yang tshul khrims 'ba' zhig tu gsungs pas/ tshul khrims rin po che la nan tan dang gces spras shin tu che bar mdzad par zhu 'tshal/

'o na de ltar gyur na tshul khrims gcig pu bsrungs pa la/ mtho dman gyi rim pa de tsam du 'gyur ba de ci yin snyam na/ so so'i zhe 'dod kyi bsam pa so so gang 'dod pa'i tshul khrims bsrungs pas 'bras bu de thob par 'gyur gyi/ tshu rol mthong ba'i rten gyi gang zag thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa'i shes rab kyis ni rgyud ma sbyangs/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa dang yang ma phrad/ bka' dang bstan bcos rgya mtsho chen po lta bu la shes rab kyi mig dang bral ba'i rten gyi gang zag kha cig mi dge ba rnam pa bcu spong ba so sor thar pa'i sdom pa/ nyan thos ngan pa 'ba' zhig gi chos yin te/ theg pa chen po'am gsang sngags gang gi yang chos 'di ma yin zhes log par zhugs pa/ lta ba log pa/ lam log pa/ spyod pa log pa rnams kyis snying po phyin ci log pa 'di 'dor zhing nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ chos ma yin pa mtha' dag nyams su len pa'i rten gyi gang zag de dag gi rjes su 'brang bar mi bya zhing tshig tsam yang mnyan par mi bya'o// de yang 'dir theg pa chen po gsang sngags rang gzhung gi dbang du byas na/ bcom ldan 'das rje btsun gyi rtsa ba'i rgyud chen po las/ tshul khrims 'chal la sngags 'grub par// rgyal ba rnams kyis ma gsungs te// mya ngan 'das grong 'gro ba ni// yul dang phyogs kyang ma yin no// zhes pa dang*/ yang rgyud chen po de nyid las/ ji ltar shing ta la'i mgo bcad na skyer mi rung ba dang 'dra bar/ tshul khrims 'chal bas sngags bsgrub pa yang de dang 'dra bar gsungs pa dang*/ yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud las kyang*/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi dam tshig ni mi dge ba bcu spong ba 'di nyid yin no// zhes pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad nas kyang*// dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya// de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu sbyin// zhes pa'i don bla ma rdo rje slob dpon las dang po thob pa'i bslab pa'i gnas bcu 'di spangs la de'i rjes la gzhan gcig bya'o bya ba ma yin te/

'di rten du bzhag nas dgyes pa rdo rje bslab ces pa dang*/ 'gro ba'i bla ma chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ ltung ba gnyis pa bde gshegs bka' 'das kyi ltung ba so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang bral ba yin te/ shan 'dra ba phyogs su bsdu la sogs pa ni phyogs snga mar mdzad pa dang*/ gsang sgo yal bar mi dor ces pa'i don yang mi dge ba rnam pa bcu spong pa 'di nyid gzhir gyur pa dang*/ mdor na rang nyid ngang du 'dug cing dge ba bcu rgyun spyad na/ sangs rgyas bar chad kun dang rnam par bral ba yin// zhes pa la sogs pa dpag tu med pa gsungs pa rang gis nges la/ 'dir bdag nyid chen po de nyid mya ngan 'da' kha na dug gi sngags rno ba nyams myong dang bcas pa yod pa la sman rta chang zhig gtong bar zhus pas/ 'di srog gi phyir yang mi rung zhes nyid kyi sku srog yal bar btang nas chang sun gcig kyang ma gsol ba 'di ni bdag cag thams cad kyi mngon du gyur cing grags pa yin pas/ tshul khrims rin po che rang gi srog dang bsdos la nan tan chen pos nyams su blang bar bya'o// 'o na theg pa chen po dang theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi dam tshig gcig tu bzhed pa/ nyan thos pa dang 'jig rten pa dang 'dra'am snyam na ma yin te/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa byang chub kyi sems kyi rjes su 'brangs nas tshul khrims bsrungs pas/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims gzhir bzhag nas/ sems can don byed dang*/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims dbyer med du gyur pas/ dus ci 'os gcig na sangs rgya zhing*/ gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi rang bzhin du gnas nas tshul khrims bsrungs pas na/ sgyogs dang 'khrul 'khor ji bzhin du/ tshe 'di'am bar do'am myur bar sangs rgyas par gsungs pa yin te/ chu gcig pu la 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsir sbyor ba yang chu yin/ ja dang chang du sbyor ba yang chu yin/

gzhan dang gzhan dag du btung ba'i bya ba byed pa yang chu yin pa dang 'dra ste/ zhi ba 'dod pa rnams gong nas gong du 'phags par 'gyur zhes pa dang*/ sangs rgyas stobs bcu'i spyod yul du gyur pa thob nas/ tshul khrims nyams pa med pas tshul khrims rin po che 'di 'ba' zhig la nan tan dang gces spras shin tu che bar nyams su blang bar bya'o// yang thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyi don phyin ci ma log pa'i dgongs pa/ sems can dmyal ba 'di dus dang rnam pa thams cad du dmyal bar rtag pa zhig yin nam/ 'on te thar pa'i gnas skabs kyang yod snyam du bsam par bya'o// rtag pa ni mi srid de/ 'dus byas g.yo ba'i rang bzhin gang la yang rtag pa med// ces pa dang*/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa zhes de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi bkas bcad pas/ dmyal ba yang 'dus byas yin pas mi rtag pa yin mod/ de ltar mi rtag nas mtho ris lha dang mi'i go 'phang thob pa'am/ yi dwags dang dud 'gro'i skye gnas su na 'phar bar byed pa 'di gang gis byed snyam du bsam par bya'o// de yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'od zer gyi bskul yang rung*/ rang gi blo stobs kyis rang rgyud la skyes kyang rung ste/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags sam/ zhe sdang ngam/ gti mug pa gang yang rung ba zhig spangs pas/ de las skyes pa'i ma chags pa'am/ zhe sdang med pa'am/ gti mug med pa rnam pa gsum gang rung gis/ dmyal ba nas gong du thon pa ma gtogs pa mi srid pas/ 'di'i skabs su tshul khrims rin po che 'di la so sor thar pa zhes ming 'dogs pa lags pas/ ngan song las thar bar byed pa yang tshul khrims gzhan gong du snyan du gsol ba dang 'dra bar/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan dang bde skyid thams cad bskyed par byed pa tshul khrims rin po che 'ba' zhig yin la/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dod chags 'dod chags dang bral bas sems rnam par grol ba dang*/

shes rab rnam par grol ba dang*/ zhe sdang 'dod chags dang bral bas sems dang shes rab rnam par grol ba dang*/ gti mug 'dod chags dang bral bas sems dang shes rab rnam par grol bar gsungs pa dang*/ yang chags pa'i bsam pa brnab sems kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las mi dge bas yi dwags la sogs pa dang*/ gnod sems gyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las mi dge bas dmyal ba la sogs pa dang*/ log par lta ba'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i las mi dge bas dud 'gro la sogs pa'i skye gnas gsum mam/ che 'bring chung gsum gyi dbye ba la sogs pas ngan song gsum la che 'bring chung gsum ji lta ba bzhin du 'byung zhing*/ mtho ris su skyes kyang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po nga la nus/ brgya byin gsad snyam pa'i bsam pa gcig gis 'dzam bu gling du lhung zhing mar gsar gyi gong bu bzhin du zhu ba dang*/ mdor na nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sa nas sar 'phar ba'i bar du gcod pa yang a cang che ste/ tshul khrims rnam par dag cing mthar ma thug na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu mi thob la sangs rgyas pa'i bar du gcod par yang 'gyur na/ gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos pas/ skyes bu chen po khyod kyis byang chub kyi sems sam theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor la gnas par byas nas/ tshul khrims rin po che la gces spras dang nan tan shin tu che bar byas te/ srog gi phyir yang btang bar mi bya'o// yang thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che bsrung ba yang 'di nyid yin te/ de ltar yang 'das ma byon da ltar phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam pa'i chos ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad/ nyams len lhag pa tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab rnam pa gsum las gzhan med de/ de ltar yang nyon mongs pa rnam pa gsum gyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las mi dge ba spangs pa las/

lhag pa ting nge 'dzin skye la/ ting nge 'dzin de las/ bsam gtan gyis ni 'dod pa'i yon tan smad pa 'dor// rig dang mngon par shes dang ting 'dzin mngon par 'grub// ces pas/ ting nge 'dzin las lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa dus gsum la chags pa dang thogs pa med pa'i ye shes/ rig pa gsum man chad thob par gsungs pa yin pas/ khyed nyid kyi thugs rgyud la ji ltar du bzhugs pa'i tshul khrims rin po che de dang*/ de las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ de las byung ba'i shes rab mngon par rtogs pa gsum po de ni bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum yin pas de la nan tan dang gces spras shin tu che bar mdzad pas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa yang 'dis 'grub/ 'khor ba dang ngan song sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las kyang 'dis grol/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan dpag tu med pa thams cad kyang 'di las skye ba yin pas/ khyed kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di/ nan tan shin tu che bar bsrung bar zhu ba dang*/ gzhan yang rang la gnod pa dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs su gyur pa thams cad la byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang bzod pa'i stobs chen po la gnas nas/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar chad du mi 'gro ba'i kha smras skyid sdug mtho dman thams cad la khong ji ltar 'dod pa'i rjes su btang ba dang*/ rdzas dang yo byad zang zing ci rigs pas rjes su bsdu ba dang*/ bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum la ci rigs par dgongs par bya yi/ mi rigs pa'i gnod pa sna tshogs kyis gnod par ni mi bya zhing bzod par ni bya ste/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ snying rjer ldan pa grong khyer 'jug pa na// bzod pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags// bzod pa'i stobs kyis mi yi seng ge rnams// lhag pa nyid ces bzod pa'i stobs sgra sgrogs// zhes gsungs pas/

bzod pa'i stobs la nan tan che bar 'bad par bya ba dang*/ skyid sdug mtho dman nyes pa ji ltar byung yang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi stobs la gnas nas bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi shugs kyis/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla na med pa'i dkon mchog rin po che gsum la mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod cing shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyal ba'i yum dang*/ 'phags pa sdong po bkod pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po dang*/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po dang*/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sogs pa'i rgyun bya zhing tshul khrims dang ldan pas bklag par bya ba dang*/ khyad par du rang la gnod pa sgrub cing*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs rgya chen pos gnod pa cher byung na 'dus pa chen po rin po che tog rgyun du bya zhing mchod pa dang gsol ba rgya chen po byas pas gnod pa thams cad rang shugs kyis zhi ba dang*/ yang na rgyal bar 'gyur ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi bka' yin te the tshom med do// a ye a ye i mo snying gtam cig /bzlas na zhe la e 'jog ang*// zhe la bzhag na dga' ba la// lag len byas na gsal bar mchi// deng sang dus kyi dge bshes rnams// sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu yi// mgon po phag mo gru pa dang*// mkhyen pa'i stobs dang nyams myong stobs// thams cad mkhyen pa'i bla ma dang*// 'jig rten gsum mgon ston pa yi// rjes su 'brang bar byed pa dang*// mchod cing gsol ba mi 'debs par// dman pa'i nang na dman pa nyid// nyon mongs rtog pas dkrugs pa yi// 'khor dang g.yog dang yang g.yog dang*// mi chos log par zhugs pa dang*// rmongs pas rang nyid phung rnams la// blo gtad snying bzhag byas nas kyang*// de dag ci gsung bka' bzhin du// mi chos 'dun ma dmag dang dmu// rdzas dang yo byad ci yod rnams// nyon mongs gsum gyi dbang du gtong*// ngan song gsum gyi rgyu 'bras sgrub// rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu yi// nyes tshogs phyin ci log bsgrubs pas// mtho bar 'gyur ba mi srid de// nyams su len par byed pa rnams// de rnams pas kyang ngan par 'gyur// de nas je ngan je ngan du// ngan pa'i chu yis khyer nas kyang*// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i gting du 'gro// deng sang dus kyi dge bshes kyi// thugs dgongs mdzad spyod ma lags sam// kye ho dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa// sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad spyod rnams// ston pa'i gsung dang mthun par mdzod// khyed la gzhen bskul mi 'tshal kyang*// nyid kyi bka' bstsal zhu don rnams// bdag gi nye gnas rgyal ba'i sras// mnyes pa gsum gyis bla ma yi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs byed pa// shākyas yang yang zhus pa las// bris pa'i dge ba gang yin des// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog
/rdzogs so// //

332) ༄// sems nyid rtogs par mos gus tshad du bskyal ba las gzhan bya thabs med par bstan pa// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gcig pu// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// zhabs kyi pad+mor rab btud nas// ji ltar gsungs pa'i don 'dir bri/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po'i zhal snga nas/ yi ge zhig skur gsungs pa'i ngos nas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rab thams cad kyi snying po/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags thams cad kyi bcud phyung ba/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa cig dang mjal nas/ de la mos gus tshad du bskyal ba ma gtogs pa gzhan med par gsungs te/ de ltar yang dpal sdom pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud nas/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu yi// rdo rje can zhabs pad+mor 'dud// ces pa dang*/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes bcom ldan dgyes mdzad nas gsungs pas/ khyed nyid kyi bla ma dam pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ nged rin po che'i bu slob du gyur pa thams cad kyi spyi gtsug gi nor bu rin po cher bzhugs shing*/ bdag nyid kyi yang bla mar gyur cing gsol ba rgyun chad med par 'debs pa'i rten du gyur pa/ ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po ma stongs kyi bar du/ bdag nyid chen po de dag gi g.yog tu gyur cing skad cig kyang mi 'bral bar smon lam btab pa rin po che smra ba dang*/ rin po che sgos lung ba rnam pa/ khyed rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam par bzhugs par 'dug khong rnam pa las kyang rang gi sems kyi de kho na nyid mngon par rtogs pa mi skye ba ni gtan mi srid/ sems kyi de kho na nyid de las ma gtogs pa mthar thug pa'i dam pa'i chos/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis btsal yang rnyed par mi srid cing*/

der ma 'dus pa yang med par bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyal ba'i yum rgyas par/ rnam par shes pa'i de bzhin nyid shes na/ chos thams cad kyi mdo dang rgyas pa shes par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa de'i don/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems/ sems gdod nas skye ba med pa nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu yin gsung pa'i don/ thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyi brjod bya de las gzhan ma mchis par/ bdag nyid chen po khyed kyi thugs la gzhag par bya'o// de gong nas gong du bogs 'don pa dang*/ gegs sel ba rnam pa gnyis yin te/ sems nyid rang bzhin rnam dag ni// 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad kun// sems kyi dkyil 'khor 'ba' zhig la// bdud dang bgegs dang bar chod ces// rmongs pa log par gang rtog pa// yod rtog rjes su 'brang mi bya// stong pa nyid kyis stong nyid la// bar du gcod par mi byed ces// bcom ldan rgyal ba'i yum du gsungs// rtag tu goms pa'i man ngag yin// zab pa'i gegs sel bstan pa'o// gnad kyi bogs 'don bstan pa ni// dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// gong du bstan pa'i bla ma la// sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen nyid// sku gsum lhun gyis grub par blta// nges pa'i shes pa skyes pa na// rdo rje 'chang chen nyid du 'gyur// des na bla ma dam pa la// mnyes pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis// mnyes par bya zhing mchod pas mchod// mnyes pa bsdus nas rnam gsum ste// sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes pa ni// sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa dang*// brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab ces// pha rol phyin drug bstan pa 'di// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa yi// brjod bya mthar thug snying po yin// rtogs pa skyes pa'i rnal 'byor la// 'di las gzhan pa'i bya rgyu med// byar med chen po skad pa de// rang snying dpang du btsugs pa yin// dam pa'i chos bzhin byed pa ni// byar med chen po'i rnal 'byor yin// chos dang mthun na zhabs tog yin// longs spyod g.yo ba thams cad kyis// mchod par byed pa smos ci dgos// 'di ltar nyams su blangs gyur na// mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*// tshe 'dir thob pa ma dka' na// gzhan lta smos kyang ci zhig 'tshal// skyes chen khyed kyis thugs la zhog

/'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis// 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog /rdzogs so// // 333) ༄// dge bshes bsam gtan pa'i spyan sngar gsungs pa dkar po bsam grub zhes pa// oṃ swa sti/ bla ma rin po ches/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po bsam gtan pa'i spyan sngar zhu ba/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'dun ma thams cad byang chub kyi sems la 'dri ba ma gtogs pa/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad la yang mi mnga'/ sa dang lam la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams la yang mi mnga' bar nges so// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyu bzang po des lam bzang po bgrod nas 'bras bu bzang po sangs rgyas pa'i phyir ro// yang de la don mthong rnam par shes// de yi khyad par sems las byung*// zhes gsungs pas/ don mthong ba byang chub kyi sems/ de yi khyad par gyi chos lus kyi las dang ngag gi las dang yid kyi las tshan po ches mthong chos su myur du 'byung ba'am/ skye ba 'di la 'gyur la skyes nas myong 'gyur tshe phyi ma la myong ba dang*/ lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur skye ba mang po la myong ba gsum du gsungs kyang*/ sems bkol ba las su rung ba/ rnal 'byor pa rnams ni sems bskyed pa tsam gyis 'grub ces pa gtan tshigs dang bcas pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pas/ khyed rang nyid kyi sems la 'dri zhing sems kyi dbang bsgyur ba lags par ni thugs su chud pa las/ nga la drir ci yod/ lung dang rigs pa'i nyams myong gis// gtan la phab pa'i dam chos 'di// gong ma rnams kyis nyams su blangs// rang gzhan gnyis kyi don chen grub// bslu ba med pa thugs la zhog /rgya la gal te rnal 'byor pas// yag yag thang thang 'dra ba yi// tshe 'di 'dun mas byas pa rnams// mi dge sdig pa'i bsam pa yis// byas pa'i dge ba 'dod pa ni// me phung nang gi pad+ma bzhin// 'grub par 'gyur pa srid ma yin// ji ltar 'o ma zangs gang du// sran ma tsam gyi dug gis kyang*// thams cad ma rungs gyur ba ni// bdag gi nyams su myong bas grub// kwa a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// log pa'i rtog pas nga re bslus// 'khrul pa'i shes pa yi re mug

/snyam pa'i bsam pa yang yang 'byung*// rang la yi mug ga yang chad// dkar po bsam pa sgrub dus su// log rtog can gyi lus ngag yid// sdig pa'i grogs por gyur pa la// sku mtshams bcad cing thag bcad nas// dkar po'i bsam pa bsgrub par bya// dge sems stobs can skye ba'i tshe// dam bca' chen po'i stobs kyis bsgrub// byang chub chen por yang yang bsngo// rlabs po che yi bya ba rnams// kha gtam tshig tu ma shor bar// rgya mtsho'i gting du gsang la bya// thams cad 'grub par the tshom med// gsang ba phyag rgya chen po yi// 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis// 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog /'bul ba bya ba dang*/ 'bul ba blang ba dang*/ bya ba mtha' dag gi gros 'dun lags so// spos kyi rim pa la sogs pa// shugs las byung na dngos grub yin// tung tung byed na ltogs 'gong yin// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon gyis// sems la gnod pa'i las bcol nas// rang gzhan sdug tu 'jug pa ni// rigs pa ma yin skyes chen khyed// // 334) ༄// bu gcig ri khrod dben pa bsten zhes pa brtul zhugs 'jigs med rdo rje// oṃ swasti/ mgon po dus gsum bdag nyid 'gyur ba med// skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs 'gro ba'i mgon// chos rgyal bla ma rin chen mchog nyid kyi// zhabs kyi pad+mor rtag tu gtsug gis 'dud// mi chos 'brel pa zab mor gyur// lha chos chos la skyes pa'i bu// dad cing gus pa'i gdung shugs kyis// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du// lus dang srog la ma bltas par// rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang bzhin// zab dang rgya che dam chos la// nyams myong rtogs pa skyes pa khyed// ji ltar gsungs pa 'di re mad// khyed nyid mi 'chi gdeng thob cing*// skye rga na 'chi sdug bsngal med// a pha a ma nye du dang*// gnyen 'brel thams cad skyong yang dgos// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan sngar yang*// khas blangs dam bcas ku re yin// ba glang mang po'i sa phyogs su// 'bu skad mi 'chad di ri ri// mi skad mi bzlo khyi skad zug

/dgos pa mi byed mi dgos sgrub// su yis khyod la ci bcol nas// smre sngags mang po bya ba kun// shes na da rung mi spong ba// glen pa rang snying mi rje 'am// sangs rgyas brgyud pa ma chad pa'i// snying po don gyi gdams ngag gis// ri khrod nags khrod gangs khrod du// rang rgyud smin par mi byed pa// a log pa'i shes pa yi re mug /'khrul pa'i rtog pas nga re bslus// kha sbyang sna sbyang dam chos kyi// rang mgo rang gis bskor ba 'di// e ma rang snying mi rje 'am// 'jig rten bya bzhag spros pa kun// khyed pas ngas kyang ma grub cing*// grub kyang dgos pa med pa la// log pa'i mngon zhen sna tshogs kyis// zhen par ma byed ri khrod bsten// bsod snyoms zas dang phyag dar khrod// gang du gnas kyang gzhal yas khang*// su dang 'grogs kyang yi dam lha// sgrub pa snying por mdzad par zhu// 'das dang ma byon da ltar dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba kun// lta ba rtogs pa'i gdeng yod kyang*// spyod pa brtul zhugs zab mo yis// rang gzhan don kun grub par gsung*// rje btsun chen po'i zhal snga nas// spyod pa glang po thabs su gces// bka' bstsal gsungs pa 'di re mad// kha ta nyams myong cung zad kyis// grong chog byed pa yi re mug /bu gcig ri khrod dben pa bsten// bsod snyoms kham gang gar yang rnyed// phyag dar khrod kyi gos ni bde// rtsa ba lo ma me tog dang*// 'bras bu rtag tu gnas tsa na// 'dod pa med kyang dbang med du// nyams rtogs yon tan thams cad skye// ku re min na de ltar mdzod// ji ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis// mun pa sel ba ji bzhin du// nyams rtogs 'od zer drwa ba yis// gdul bya'i pad+mo kha 'byed cing*// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// gdud rgyud 'tshob par byed na de// gong ma rnams kyi thugs dam yin// gzhan du byas pa don med pa// skyes chen khyed kyi thugs la zhog

/zhus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis// 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog/ // 335) ༄// sgro skur dang bral ba'i rgyal mtshan zhes shākya'i dge bsnyen 'phan po la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che la lus gus pas phyag 'tshal/ sems dang bas skyabs su 'chi'o// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po chos kyi rgyal po bla ma rin po che de nyid kyi bu'i dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ dge 'dun gyi sde rgya mtsho chen po lta bu/ 'gran gyi do zla thams cad dang bral ba/ 'dzam bu gling gi rgyan/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen du gyur pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che mnga' bdag dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi bdag po/ dge 'dun cham phu ba sde ma lag dang bcas pa/ dpon g.yog dang bcas pa/ phyogs ris dang bcas pa thams cad/ 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che'i sras dam par bzhugs pa lags/ de ltar gyur pa'i dbang gis rin po che'i bu slob nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bur gyur pa/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa 'jig rten du byung ba bdag cag gi bla ma dam par gyur pa rje btsun rin po che smar pa dang*/ stag lung thang pa dang*/ mchog tu gyur pa'i bdag nyid chen po rnams dang*/ nga 'bu 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad/ dus rnam pa thams cad du thugs la btags shing spyan rgyang gis btsas gces srung pas/ bdag cag ri khrod kyi ldom bu ba/ che ba'i yon tan ni med/ zas bsod snyoms/ gos phyag dar khrod/ gnas ri khrod dang phag phug na yod pa rnams la spyan ras kyi gzigs pas/ dper na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la shar bas ngar snabs kyang 'od 'tsher ba ltar/ 'gro ba mtho dman 'ga' zhig la cung zad phan par snang ba 'di yang*/ khyed nyid kyis spyan ras kyis gzigs shing thugs la btags pas de ltar gyur pa lags so// de bdag 'khor dang bcas pa shin tu thugs la btags/

phyag yang bzang*/ slad kyis don zhu ba/ mi lus rin po che 'di thob par ni shin tu dka'/ 'jig par ni sla/ 'khor ba ni gting mtha' med/ mi lus thob pa yang rgya mtsho cher yangs gnya' shing bu gar rus sbal mgrin pa chud pa 'dra bar gsungs pas/ chos rin po che nyams su blang pa la gces spras shin tu che bar mdzad par zhu/ 'o na de ltar yin mod kyi/ chos de gang yin snyam na/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gzhung lam dang gshegs shul/ grub pa thob cing brtul zhugs spyod pa rnams kyi nyams len/ bdag nyid chen po rnams kyis bsgrub pa/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rnam pa gnyis gsog pa las gzhan med par gsungs/ de las bsod nams kyi tshogs ni gang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs ni gang zhe na/ bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa pha rol phyin pa lnga ni bsod nams kyi tshogs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs su gsungs/ yar zhing dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang bla ma la pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa lngas mchod cing nyams su blangs pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs yin zhes kyang gsungs/ lam nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas na bla ma dam pa zhing dag ste/ de mnyes par byas pas tshogs gnyis zung du 'jug par gsungs te/ mdor na/ sangs rgyas yon tan bsam mi khyab// dam pa'i chos kyang bsam mi khyab// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun bsam mi khyab// bsam mi khyab la dad byas na// rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab// ces gsungs pa'i don lag tu blang ba'i rim pa/ spyi babs dang 'dug lugs/ sgro 'dogs skur ba med pa'i mtshan nyid 'di bsam zhing khong du chud par byed pa gal che/ de la zhing rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas dang*/ chos dang dge 'dun rnam pa gsum yin te/ sde rgya mtsho chen po lta bu de nyid la brten nas/ dkon mchog gsum de nyid ma gtogs pa gzhan med par khong du chud par bya ba dang*/ bla ma dam pa yang de nyid dang gnyis su med cing*/
