de nyid na bzhugs pa bsnyen bkur bar bya ba zhing rnam par dag pa'i mtshan nyid khong du chud par bya'o// dngos po rnam par dag pa ni/ khyed rang nyid kyi lus dang longs spyod/ kha rje dang dbang thang bde legs ji snyed cig yod pa thams cad dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma dam pa'i phyogs ma gtogs pa gzhan du spu'i rtse mo tsam yang mi 'gro zhing 'gro ba'i gnas med pa ni dngos po rnam par dag pa'o// zhing dang dngos po shin tu rnam par dag kyang*/ bsam pa shin tu rnam par dag pa 'di la bka' nan shin tu che bar gda' ste/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pa ma gtogs pa/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad/ 'khor ba'i rgyu dang 'bras bu/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sems ni skad cig tsam yang skyer mi rung zhes nan tan shin tu che bar gsungs pa lags pas/ khyed yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pas zin pas/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'ba' zhig gis mdzad pa thams cad nyams su blang ba shin tu gal che/ de ltar dge 'dun gyi sde rgya mtsho chen po lta bu/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gi rang bzhin de nyid la brten pas/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byed pa dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ ci byed 'gro ba la phan pa dang bde ba 'grub par 'dug pa sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims/ so sor thar pa ris bdun nam brgyad kyi sdom pa nyams su len pa sdom pa'i tshul khrims te/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa de dang*/ de nyams su len pa la bzod pa/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ nyams su len zhing rtsol ba dang brtson 'grus rtsom pa brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ 'di thams cad sems rtse gcig pa ma gtogs pa gzhan gang gis kyang mi 'grub pas bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ sems nyid gdod nas ma skyes pa shes pa dang*/

pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa lnga byang chub kyi sems rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa shes pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ de ltar pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa drug bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs zung du 'jug pa de nyid kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya ba ma gtogs pa mi srid pas skyon med pa dang*/ yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad khyed nyid ji ltar bzhugs pa de nyid la ma tshang pa med par shes par bya zhing blo thag gcod par bya'o// 'o na de ltar yin na yin pas chog mod/ khyed kyi ngo dga' dang phye gtor ci dgos de kun med pa'i chos cig khyod la 'ong du re ba yin mod snyam na/ de ni de ltar ma yin te/ de nyid la ji ltar yod pa de nyid ngo ma shes na 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por 'khyams pa'i rtsa ba ma rig pa zhes de la zer ba yin/ de shes na shes rab ces zer ba yin/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ shes rab kyis ni chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes nas// khams gsum ma lus pa las yang dag 'da' bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa yang shes rab stong pa nyid la zer ba yin/ dkon mchog gsum la brten nas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa la zer ba min snyam na/ de ltar yang sa bcu'i mdo nas/ sa drug la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba lugs su 'byung ba dang ldog pa rnam pa gnyis shes pa la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par gsungs pa dang*/ byang chub kyi snying por rten 'brel thugs su chud pas sangs rgyas pa yin zhes bya ba la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pas shes pa dang*/ 'di thams cad dbyer med pa mnyam pa nyid du rtogs nas thabs bor rgyu/ shes rab btsal rgyu gzhan du mi srid de gnyis med pa'i phyir ro// thabs dang shes rab gnyis lta a cang yang ches te/ yang*/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// gnyis su yod pa ma yin te// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin shes pa la// mya ngan 'das zhes brjod pa yin// zhes pa dang*/

gzugs stong pa'o// stong pa nyid gzugs so// zhes gsungs pas de ltar go na/ rlabs po che'i mdzad pa rlabs po che'i tshogs sogs pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde rgya mtsho chen po lta bu la ma bsten par mi mchi ste/ dper na slob dpon chen po shan+ta de ba bhu su ku'i spyod pas/ lkug pa dang glen pa lta bus nyams su len pa'i dus su chos kyi gtam tshig gcig kyang mi smra na/ tha mal pa lta smos kyang ci dgos pa yin te/ rin po che zhal snga nas slob dpon de nyid slob dpon bo dhi sa twa zhes bya ba slob dpon de nyid yin te/ bod la lan gsum du byon nas/ chos 'khor chen po dpal gyi bsam yas ni bzhengs/ bod la btsun pa 'ong ngam mi 'ong ba blta ba'i ched du sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung nas/ dus da ltar mnga' ris bod kyi rgyal khams su thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa lta bu yin pas/ mdor bsdus na tshogs gnyis zung du chud par bya ba las bsgrub rgyu gzhan med/ 'o na sgom zhes bya ba/ zhi zhi po'am/ gnas gnas po'am/ legs legs po zhig gzhan na yod pa ma yin te/ de nyid la sgom zhes ming 'dogs pa lags/ sgom de yang 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi bsdus pa'i chos/ zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos/ chos de dag thams cad rang rig pa la rang la yod bzhin pa 'di yin/ de dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gzigs mi gzigs gzigs par mi 'gyur ba de bsgom rgyu ma lags/ go rgyu yin/ de go na/ bdag ni mnyam par bzhag ce'am langs zhes rlom sems med// ci'i phyir zhe na chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes phyir// zhes gsungs pa yin pas de nyid la goms par bya'o// de yang phyag rgya chen po ma skyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i thabs 'di nyid de/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ting nge 'dzin rgyal po nas/

ngas ni ting 'dzin rgyal po 'di yi phyir// rgyal po'i khab kyi shar phyogs 'di nyid du// sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig rim gro byas// zhes pa dang*/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs pas/ ma skyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i thabs de nyid du shes par bya'o// nyams su myong ba ji ltar skyong ba'i thabs ni/ 'gro ba dang*/ 'chag pa dang*/ nyal ba dang*/ 'dug pa dang*/ spyod lam rnam bzhir dus rnam pa thams cad du yengs pa med par skyid sdug mthon dman thams cad gnyis med thug phrad du nyams su blangs pas/ chu thams cad rgya mtsho chen por phyin na lan tshwa'i ror gcig tu 'gyur ba bzhin du 'ong ba yin pas yengs pa med par nyams su blang bar bya'o// 'chi kha ma'i gdams ngag nam 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa dang*/ rdzas yo byad longs spyod dang gnyen 'dun thams cad bla ma dam pa dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phul nas dang po kho nar ma chags par bya/ de'i rjes la byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga'i steng du seng ge khri chen po zhig gi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma/ de'i steng du nyi ma/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang gdan bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du/ glo gtod thub pa yid ches pa'i bla ma yod na de bsgom/ de med na 'das ma byon dus gsum gyi bla ma thams cad/ rang nyid kyi rigs kyi bdag po rigs rnam lnga gang rung gcig gam bstan pa'i bdag po 'di nyid du mos la spyi bor bsgom/ de nas snying ga'am gsang gnas la sogs pa nas rang gi shes pa'i ngo bo yi ge hūm̐ bla ma sangs rgyas de'i thugs kar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du shad kyi thal nas bsgoms pa la lugs cig yin/ yang na rang gi sems bla ma sangs rgyas de nyid yin pas/

sems gzhan du lus pa med/ de nyid la dran pa rtse gcig tu ma yengs pa ni rnam shes bla mar 'pho ba'i man ngag de la ma yengs pas bla ma dam pa'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang rang gi shes pa gcig tu 'dres nas/ sems nyid gnyug ma rgyun tu goms pa de dang dbyer med gcig tu gyur pa/ ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag ltar// rang gi sems nyid 'od gsal dang*// shi ka bar do 'od gsal gnyis// dbyer med gcig tu gyur pa 'di// bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang chen nas// sangs rgyas brgyud pa ma chad pa'i// gnad kyi snying po gcig pu yin// tug gis thug pa'i dus tshod du// a pha a ma a zhang dang*// mtho dman kun gyis mi stongs pas// nyams su blang ba shin tu gces// bdag gi bla ma rin po che// 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gcig pu// nyid dang dbyer med gdan sa gnyis// g.yog po bdag dang bcas pa la// mchod pa chen pos mchod pa 'di// thugs la btags so bdag gi bu// yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sras// thub pa chen po'i 'khor rnam pa bzhi'i shākya'i sras kyi dge bsnyen 'phan po la/ snying tshig ngag gi gdams ngag sgro skur dang bral ba'i rgyal mtshan zhes bgyi ba bskur ba lags pas phan par gyur cig bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig/ //

336) ༄// mkha' 'gro gdam mam phung 'dre 'dod ces tsā ri dang ti si'i sgom chen rnams la gsungs pa// khyed tsā rir bzhugs pa'i sgom chen rnams// dur khrod rngam pa'i sgra sgrogs su// mkha' 'gro gdam mam phung 'dre 'dod// dug lnga nyon mongs gang skyes kyang*// rlag 'dre phung 'dre chen po yin// nyon mongs rnam rtog ma skyes pa// mkha' 'gro zhes ni bya ba yin// zhe sdang skyes pa med pa de// rdo rje mkha' 'gro bya ba yin// 'dod chags skyes pa med pa de// pad+ma mkha' 'gro bya ba yin// gti mug skyes pa med pa de// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro bya ba yin// nga rgyal skyes pa med pa de// rin chen mkha' 'gro bya ba yin// phrag dog skyes pa med pa de// las kyi mkha' 'gro bya ba yin// ma skyes skye med mkha' 'gro dang*// rgyun chad med par mi 'bral zhu// nged kyi pa pha rin po che// 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal snga nas// nyon mongs spyod pa'i 'gro sa la// dben pa yin zhes mi gsungs lags// nga bdag 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog la// sgrub pa yin zhes mi gsung lags// bu go'am shes sam dgos se kun// ༈ //yang ti se ba rnams la 'di skad ces bya ba ste/ khyed ti ser bzhugs pa'i sgom chen rnams// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas chen der// mkha' 'gro gdam bam phung 'dre 'dod// dug lnga nyon mongs gang skyes kyang*// rlag 'dre phung 'dre chen po yin// nyon mongs rnam rtog ma skyes pa// mkha' 'gro zhes ni bya ba yin// zhe sdang skyes pa med pa de// rdo rje mkha' 'gro bya ba yin// 'dod chags skyes pa med pa de// pad+ma mkha' 'gro bya ba yin// gti mug skyes pa med pa de// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro bya ba yin// nga rgyal skyes pa med pa de// rin chen mkha' 'gro bya ba yin// phrag dog skyes pa med pa de// las kyi mkha' 'gro bya ba yin// ma skyes skye med mkha' 'gro dang*// rgyun chad med par mi 'bral zhu// nged kyi pa pha rin po che// 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal snga nas// nyon mongs spyod pa'i 'gro sa la// dben pa yin zhes mi gsungs lags// nga bdag 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog la// sgrub pa yin zhes mi gsung lags// bu go'am shes sam dgos se kun// bu go'am shes sam dgos se kun//

// 337) ༄// sems skye med 'od gsal chen po de dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi bla ma zhes pa// kwa a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// lo dgu bsten pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rang la skyes pa'i bu gcig pu// mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes mdzad pa// da rung yab sras zhal ma 'tsho// de bden nam brdzun nam ji ltar lags// med kyang ku re bgyis pa yin// pha brtson 'grus chen po chos kyi rjes// bu tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la// a pha a ma phyogs ris kyi// nga bzang khyod bzang ga la khom// brgyud pa rin chen chos kyi gter// sems gnyis med 'od gsal chen po de// dus gsum sangs rgyas bla ma yin// bu khyed kyi snying la rtag tu bzhugs// 'bral ba med pa ngo mtshar che// ngo shes sam mi shes zer ba de// shes pa ci byed ma shes ci// shes dang ma shes lo rgyus kyis// su zhig 'tshangs la su zhig phung*// rje btsun chen po'i zhal snga nas// re dga' re skyid tho le rgyal// don chen thob pas yang rgyal yin// de yi thog tu 'brug slag pags rtsag gon// // 338) ༄// mi rtog pa skye tshul lho pa char 'bebs la mdzad pa// oṃ swasti/ skyob pa 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis ting nge 'dzin rgyal po nas/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na// mkha' bzhin byed pa med par mngon// zhes pa'i don rnam par mi rtog pa/ sems nyid 'od gsal ba chos sku phyag rgya chen po las rnam par mi rtog pa skye ba'i tshul rnam pa gsum ste/ byas pa dang ma byas pa dang gzhi bzhag tu yod pa rnam pa gsum ste/ de la byas pa'i rnam par rtog pa spang bya dang gnyen po rnam pa gnyis kyi tshul du gnas pa la/ sdig pa mi dge ba nyon mongs pa rnam pa gsum dgra bo yin pas/ zhe sdang ba bskyed pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang*/

tshul de dang 'dra bar log par lta ba dang*/ chags pa dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ mdor bsdus na ched du bskyed pa'i rtog pa ngan pa thams cad spang bar bya ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems dang*/ byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ lha bskyed pa'i rim pa la sogs pa ma skyes pa bskyed cing gong nas gong du goms par bya bar gsungs ste/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kyi byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun las/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi 'di kho na ste/ sdig to mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa mi bskyed pa dang*/ skyes pa spang ba dang*/ dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang*/ skyes pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar bya ba dang bzhi ston pas gsungs pa dang*/ gnyis pa rnam par rtog pa lung ma bstan zhes bya ba bzung bas mi zin/ bkag pas mi khegs/ char cig dang nyar cig rang dbang med par skye ba lags te/ 'di la bcom ldan 'das rje btsun chen po mi la'i zhal snga nas/ nyid bka' rdzogs pa chen po ba yin pa la/ rje btsun lho brag pa'i zhabs drung du byon nas/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags lus ngag yid gsum gyi gnad zab mo rnams kyis/ rang dbang med pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes pas/ rtog pa de 'gag par gsungs te/ de ltar yang*/ yang dag la khyad par med kyang*/ rnam rtog la khyad du snang*/ de ltar rtogs pa med pa'i gang zag phyi rabs rnams// tshig tsam don du khyer nas rang bslu gzhan bslu 'dra// zhes gsungs pas/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa/ rtsa rlung thig le gsum gyi man ngag gi gnad kyis phra rags kyi rnam par rtog pa bcom par gsungs pa lags/ gsum pa gzhi bzhag gi rnam par rtogs pa/ nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa yod ma myong ba la phyin ci log tu 'khrul pa yin la/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ dper na dogs pa'i 'du shes kyis ni dug langs pa// dug de khong du song ba med kyang brgyal bar 'gyur// de bzhin byis pa bdag dang bdag gir khas len pa// bdag der 'du shes yang dag mi rtag skyes zhing 'chi// zhes gsungs pa/

'khor ba'i rtsa ba gzhi bzhag gi rnam par rtog pa 'di dang gsum du thugs su chud par bya ste/ de la dang po ni rgyu dang 'bras bu dgag pa'i bslab pa dang*/ bsgrub pa'i bslab pa gnyis kyis ngan par lam du btang ba dang*/ bzang po goms par bya'o// gnyis pa lung ma bstan gyi rnam rtog zang zing mtho dman rnam pa sna tshogs ni/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags rtsa rlung gi gnad zab mos rang shugs kyis 'gag par bya'o// gzhi bzhag gi rnam pa rtog pa dang nga bdag tu 'dzin pa'i nyes pa ni/ sems nyid 'od gsal ba chos kyi sku phyag rgya chen po bsgrub par bya'o// 'das dang ma byon da ltar dang*// phyogs bcu'i dus gsum thams cad kyi// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis// gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad du// rang don gzhan don thams cad grub// bu rang la skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa// sems nyid 'od gsal chos sku dang*// 'bral ba med par nyams su longs// 'jig rten mgon po chos kyi rjes// bka' rgya mdzad nas gang gsungs pa// chos lnga'i man ngag gtsigs su che// ri khrod gangs khrod nags khrod du// dgon pa dben pa thams cad du// thugs dam nan tan mdzad par zhu// phun sum tshogs pa'i sa phyogs su// rdzas dang yo byad ched du btsal// sgrub pa btang snyoms chen por bzhag /'bad pa bzhes kyi khrag mthong bzhin// 'bad pa chen pos bsgrubs pa des// bla ma dus gsum rgyal ba kun// mnyes par bshad pa ma mchis pas// rtse gcig thugs dam nyams su blang*// de yang rje btsun zhal snga nas// shugs las byung na dngos grub yin// tung tung byed na ltogs 'gong yin// bka' bstsal gsungs pa 'di re bden// de phyir thugs dam gcig pu mdzad// dge bas byang chub mchog thob shog// lho pa char 'bebs la mdzad pa'o// // 339) ༄// stong dang mi stong kun las 'das pa rdo rje gcig pu zhes pa// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs// ma lus gcig tu gyur pa rdo rje 'chang*// mtshungs med dbang phyug phag mo gru pa yis// dus rnam rtag tu bkra shis bde legs shog

/'jig rten mgon po de yi thugs kyi sras// bsags pa mthar thug mnyam med dge ba'i bshes// yon tan rgya mtsho rab yangs skyes chen gyis// dad cing gus pas bka' stsal gsungs pa'i don// stong dang mi stong kun las rnam 'das pa// rdo rje gcig pu rin chen dgongs pa mchog /gsang ba'i snying po snyan du gsol ba las// thugs la dgongs nas mnyes pa thugs la btags// khyed kyi snyan pa'i 'brug sgra bstod pa yis// sangs rgyas bstod pas bla ma bstod pa dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur glegs bam phul// na bza' rin chen sku la gsol ba dang*// bdud rtsi bcud mchog zhal zas drangs pa rnams// thugs kyi dgongs bzhin thugs dgongs rdzogs par bgyis// gsungs don bdag gi dam chos rnams kyi lung*// gcig pu de ltar rnams kyang a cang ches// 'jig rten gsum mgon chos rje bla ma las// rgyal ba'i gsung rab ma lus thams cad dang*// de don dgrol bar mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang*// grub thob rnams kyi gdams ngag rin po che// ma lus kun gyi lung rnams bdag la gnang*// gong ma'i lung rnams ma lus 'di dag kyang*// khyed la sbyin gyis dga' mgur spyad par mdzad// ji ltar gsung bzhin zhabs rjes bskur ba lags// gsang ba'i zhus tshig bka' bstsal de yi don// dam bca' 'gyur ba med pa rdo rje nyid// thos bsam sgom pas sbyangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// bco brgyad 'dus nas tshogs 'khor byas nas kyang*// zhu ba zhus pas smras pa rdo rje'i gsung*// yod 'dzin med 'dzin mtha' las rnam 'das pas// sgrib pa'i bud shing bsreg pa'i ye shes ni// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi yon tan ma lus pas// sangs rgyas sras bcas 'gro kun nye bar 'tsho// tshig 'di smras pas kun kyang mgu bar 'gyur// stong par 'dzin pa'i lta bas rnam dben pa// sems nyid rdo rje 'di yis mngon du 'gyur// // 340)

༄// shin tu zab pa'i gdams ngag bdag dbang po rnon po'i rigs su skyes zhes pa// oṃ swasti/ bdag dbang po rnon po'i rigs su skyes// thag ring po cig nas bla ma bsnyags// thugs brtse bar dgongs nas gdams ngag gnang*// 'bad pa drag pos nyams su blangs// ri khrod dgon par gcig 'dug byas// bde sdug mtho dman char bzhin bab// nyams su myong bas rang rgyud tshims// ma yi nu zho rgyas na yang*// bu yi kha bu dka' mor gda'// dpon slob tshogs pa mi ldan pa// rgyal bas bdud kyi las su gsungs// na so rgas shing shi kha 'dir// slob ma gcig yod na dga' ba la// dga' blta dga' ste mi gda' na// 'on kyang snying dang 'dra ba yi// zab pa'i gdams ngag zab mo 'di// nam mkha'i rlung la bskur ba yin// rim gyis pa dang cig car ba// 'gro ba'i don la sems gzhol na// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// a ma'i nges shes skyes ma skyes// snying rje chen po skyes ma skyes// sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i bla ma la// byang sems brtan po bskyed ma bskyed// 'di dang phyi ma dus gsum du// rang gzhan ma lus thams cad kyi// so nam dam chos yin ma yin// snying nas yang yang bsam par bya// nges shes skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pas// snying nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad na// rang bas gzhan gces brtul zhugs kyis// bsdu dngos bzhi yis gzhan don brtsam// de la dang po sbyin pa ni// chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams// snyan pa'i tshig dang bcas pa yis// gdul bya'i skye bo 'dun par bya// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// bla ma rje btsun 'bri gung pa// bod mi zad gtso bo'i thor cog can// zab pa'i gdams ngag dmigs pa 'di// ka rang gi yul tu phyin tsam na// bstan pa'i gzhir gyur yul dbus su// bstan pa'i bdag po chen po rnams// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che// 'phrin las rnam bzhis bsrungs pa ltar// nag po gnam rdang 'khrigs pa'i sar// mtho dman mdzad pa ma mchis shing*// gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro// reg bya spong ba'i bstan pa de// thub pa'i dgongs pa yin mod kyang*// blo kha phyogs par dka' ba des// bla ma rje btsun chen po de// rang gi yul tu byon pa'i tshe// rje btsun byon pa'i sna len du// la kha'i ltang bu mi 'dur ram// dbus sa ser cig tu yun ring bzhugs// mchin pa khrag can mi gsol lam// grod pa glo can mi mur ram// bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas kyi// pha phogs sbyangs pa'i yon tan la// phyi la gcu 'phras mi rdeg gam// ma sru yon bdag mo rnams kyi// bu chung pang skor mi mdzad dam// grong chog mdzad pa'i phyag mtshan du// dril bu yu chag mi bsnams sam// kha mngar 'khril ba'i bdud rtsi la// zhal btsugs rna ba mi snyol lam// skyes chen 'di dag ma mdzad na// shin tu zab pa'i gdams ngag cig

/snying la yod pa khyod la gdams// // 341) ༄// gdan sa nyams dmas su gyur skabs mdzad pa'i bca' yig/ gdan sa med pa dang*/ stag lung thang pa grongs pa dang*/ slob ma la re ba ltar ma byung bas shes pa'i ltag chag tshogs skyong ba'i bsam pa ma byung*/ na so rgas pas nus pa yang zad/ da ni phan tshun gcig tu 'gro ba'am/ mtshams dam pa zhig byas la bsdad snyam pa yin/ de la khyed rnams kyis rgyags khye rgyags khye gsungs pa la/ rgyags la 'gyed rgyu/ nged yang dkon pas bskungs pa med/ na ning gzhe ning gnyis su mu ge byung*/ ngo cig mug shul du thal/ ngas za rgyu bzang po zos/ 'og ma rnams kyis phal cher sngo'i tsha ba la brten/ shi bsris sdug bsris byas pas ro ma byung tsam lags/ da khyed rnams kyis rgyags khye zer bas/ gsung ba bzhin du bsgrub pas/ zho gsum yan chad yod pa rnams kyis rgyags mi len pa dang*/ de man chad pa rnams rgyags len pa dang*/ lha dang yi ge mi 'bri bar dge sbyor la nan tan cher byed pa dang*/ snga ma'i bca' khrims ji lta ba bzhin du thog tu 'jog pa dang*/ bud med la glu len pa dang*/ tshong pa la rnying phrin snyog pa dang*/ yul mi kha nyen rnams kyis thog tu btsan po 'jing 'gril byas nas/ bu lon rnying phrin mi 'ded pa dang*/ ji ltar 'ong ba bags kyis snyogs pa dang*/ yod pa kun yang rgas shi dom ring mang po ma 'dzug yod tshad zos pa'i rjes la shan phyed/ za rgyu rnyed nas 'ong*/ bla mar chos zhus nas sgro 'dogs nam chod pa'i dus su 'dir mi bzhugs par phan tshun du bzhud pa dang*/ de la sogs pa legs pa mtha' dag khyed rnams kyis bsgrub par zhu/ mi ma tshan tshan snga ma kho na bzhin du rgyan byas nas/ tshan gang sngar byas na ni tshan gcig kyang 'gyed rgyu mi 'ong nas mchi/ tshan re re la nang gi rgyan byas nas brgya brgya'i re mo cig byas na dga'am yang snyam pas/ bgres po rnams kyi bka' gros mdzad par zhu/
chad 'di rnams las 'gal na/ nga yang ci bde byed pa yin// //

342) ༄// la chu'i ser tshos byed thabs dang 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i phan yon bstan pa// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po ches/ thugs rje dang mkhyen pa ldan pa de'i zhal snga nas/ bu'i dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ ci gsungs bka' bzhin du bsgrub pa rnams kyis chos 'di ltar mdzad par zhu/ de yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che rab tu byung ba la rag las/ rab tu byung ba chos gos ngur smrig la rag las/ ngur smrig sgrub par byed pa'i tshos dpag tu med pa cig yul mtha' 'khob na yang yod kyang*/ nor bu rin po che 'og na yod pa dmus long gi mi mthong ba dang 'dra ba/ mtha' 'khob kyi mis mi shes pa yin/ de la bcom ldan 'das kyis nga'i slob ma nyan thos nye gnas shin tu mkhas pa yin gsung bas khyed kyis nga'i tshig 'di gces spras su nyams su blang bar zhu/ de yang bod dbus gtsang gi mthil/ yul dbus/ g.yo ru dang dbu ru 'di'i tshos thams cad de rang na yod pa lags pas/ tshos de rnams 'di na ji ltar bsgrub pa dang 'dra bar mdzad par zhu 'tshal/ de la bod dbus kyi chu rtsa zhes yongs su grags pa'i tshos de ni/ khams na la chu'i rtsa ba yin te chu rtsa'i tshos dbus kyi dang 'dra bar 'ong ba yin/ sbogs bya ba de yang chu'i lo ma sa la mar bstan pa'i ngos de dmar por 'ong ba de yin/ lo ma yar bstan pa la chu dang 'dra/ lo ma rgyab dmar du long ba yang yod zer/ de la dang po rung ba byed pa'i dus/ lo ma dang sngo bu'i nus pa thams cad rtsa ba la mar thim pa/ ston zla tha chung sa cung zad ma 'khyags pa'i dus der rung ba legs par byas nas/ de'i shun pa nag po legs par bzhar/ phyir mi bkab bar ldum chod du khrims bur byas la bskam/ de'i sbogs de sbogs tshos byed na/ thug skyur bya/ nas bzang ba yos ser ba tsam du byas pa khrag khrom du btags la/ de tsha bar bskol ba'i nang du phabs ngan yang rung ste nyis 'gyur du ma tshig tsam du drod mtho bar byas la/

gos log mang pos btums/ zhag gsum tsam du bzhag pas/ skyur shin tu skyur bar 'ong ba de legs par btsags bcud nas btsags pa'i khu ba dang sbogs legs par brdungs pa'am/ shin tu zhib par rang thags pa btags pa'i phye ma skyur dang lhan du sbyar nas skya bas nan tan shin tu che bar bskrugs la/ sbogs la ska sla skyo tsha tsam bya/ chu rtsa de bas gar yang rung*/ chu yang yang du bsnan zhing yun ring du bskol/ de nas legs par phyar ba'am/ skye'am/ ras sam/ shas rtsing pa legs par bkrus nas dri ma med pa'i nang du/ 'og tu rdza'am zangs dri ma med pa mnyam par bzhag nas/ dang po btsag bar du bcang*/ tha mar bcud nas khu ba thon legs pa'i dwangs ma de/ gzod me che bar gtang la bskol/ de la me tog ser chil gyis byung ba cung zad ma khol ba'i nang du/ ras sam snam bu'am 'tshod rgyu gang yin de bcug nas 'og tu me cher btang*/ rgyun chad med par dkrugs/ phyar btso/ de nas lag pas btsir la tshos legs par 'jen zhing tshos pa'i dus su ber ka dri ma med pa gnyis la dkris shing yar then/ ber ka dri ma med pa gnyis kyis tshos kyi khu ba thems su bcug nas mar then pas/ tshos khu gron du mi 'gro/ de yang tshos khu dang po de'i nang du/ gces se bsod nams can gyi gos 'tshed pa yin/ de'i 'og ma de'i nang du chu bsnan nas bar pa'i 'tshed pa yin/ de'i rting la lan gnyis btsir ba'i tshos shal tha ma'i nang du/ snam thung dang*/ gos dri ma dang*/ rnam par ma dag pa kha bsgyur ba tsam byed pa gsum lags so// dus tshod nyi ma shin tu tsha ba la/ 'tshod rgyu'i snam gos shin tu tsha bar byas pa tshos khu'i nang du bcug pas/ tshos 'dzin zhing kha gsal ba lags/ de nas nyi ma la yun ring po bskam/ snam bu phyi nang ngo shes par byas la nyi ma la cung zad bzhag nas/ ma skams pa'i rlon pa bsdus nas thag pa'am rdang dri ma med pa la bkal nas grib skyabs su byas pas mdog shin tu gsal bar 'ong ba lags pas sbogs tshos dang*/

chu'i tshos dbus gtsang na ji ltar byed pa 'di rnams yul der dar ci thub gzigs par zhu/ de la dang po khyed rang gi na bza' mdzad/ de nas thams cad kyi na bza' byas na yul khams thams cad kyi gos ser po rtsol sgrub med par gyur nas/ rab tu byung ba thams cad la phan pa lags pas/ khyed kyis 'di dar ci thub blta bar zhu/ thug skyur 'di la phye mang du dgos par 'dug las dka' ba 'ong ba la sla bar 'ong ba'i thabs dang po'i thug skyur gyi rtsigs ma legs par bcud nas bzhag pa de dang*/ thug skyur rang gi ru ma phor gang yas chad dang*/ thug skyur gyi nyag nyog lhag lhog thams cad gze ma'am/ phu ru'am/ rdza'i snod legs pa'i nang du log dang phyogs thams cad phub ma zhib ma la sogs pas shin tu dro bar byas pa'i nang du gzhug de'i nang du chu tshan khol ma blugs la de'i nang du phye btab cing phabs ngan yang rung ste/ ci mang du btab nas yang chu tshan blugs te dkrugs nas kha legs par bcad cing btums nas zhag mang du bzhag pas khas mi tshugs pa tsam skyur por 'ong*/ de'i dngas ma dang sbogs pa sres nas bskol ba snga ma dang 'dra/ yang phyi ma'i snyigs ma'i nang du sngar ji ltar bstan pa dang 'dra bar rgyun chad med par byas na/ tshos rgyun chad med pa'i khu ba 'ong ba lags par gda' bas de ltar yang mdzad par zhu/ zhag mang por bzhag na yang je skyur du 'gro ba ma gtogs pa nyes pa ma mchis pa lags par gda'/ sbogs skya thal du mi 'gro bar non cung zad che bar 'dod na/ btsod cung zad gtong bar 'dug zha phyal thabs 'di/ yul dbus kyi 'di 'go khyim dang tha ma 'dzom pa bstan pa rin po che'i bka' rtags su 'dug pas/ 'di'i bya thabs dang bzo yang rjes su 'brangs nas mdzad par zhu dang 'dis kyang bstan pa dang dge 'dun la phan tu re ba yin/ dar cher 'ong du re ba yin/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig bcom ldan 'das kyis/

lha dang mi rnams la mdo sde dang ma sde dang ma mo bzhag go /klu rnams la ni mdo sde'o// 'dul ba ni zab pa zab par snang ba mthong bar dka' ba/ khong du chud par dka' ba/ dgongs pa mnga' ba/ 'jig rten gyi spyod pa dang mthun pa yin na/ dge slong rnams kyis 'dul ba zab pa nyid nas dgongs pa mnga' nyid dang*/ 'jig rten gyi spyod pa dang mthun pa nyid yin pas 'don par mi spro'o// 'di ni chos nyid yin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bstan pa'i yan lag gang zhig yongs su nyams pa de'i bsngags pa lhag par brjod par mdzad pa yin pas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' bstsal pa/ dge slong dag nga'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i gang zag la phan yon lnga yod de/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'khor bzhi mdun du bdar ba yin/ gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa gzhan la rag ma las pa yin/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi nang gi mdzod srung ba yin/ dge sbyong dang bram ze gzhan rnams kyi spyi bo la 'dug pa yin/ dam pa'i chos gnas par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ bslab pa'i ched kyi phyir skye bo mang po la phan pa dang*/ skye bo mang po la bde bar bzhugs pa yin no// mig ni gzugs la chags pa yis// lus dang ngag dang sems bsgribs nas// bsam gtan bzhi dang bral ba rnams// 'khor bar shin tu bsten pa 'gyur// rdzun gyi tshig ni gsungs pa na// lha rnams de nas dong ba dang*// zhal yang mnam dri nga ba par gyur nas su// mtho ris las kyang nyams par 'gyur// gang zhig chos bzhin 'dri ba la// chos ma yin pa ston byed na// chu na rgyu ba'i nya bzhin du// de ni lce ma mchis par 'gyur// gang zhig chos bzhin 'dri ba la// chos ma yin pa ston byed na// der ni skyes pa min skye zhing*// der ni skyes par skye mi 'gyur// gang zhig chos bzhin 'dri ba la// chos ma yin pa ston byed na// lhas ni dus su char mi 'bebs// der ni dus ma yin par 'bab// gang zhig chos bzhin 'dri ba la// chos ma yin pa ston byed na// sbrul bzhin du ni skye bo de yi// lce gnyis dag ni 'byung bar 'gyur// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa ni/

gzhan gyi sems bsrung ba dang bcas pa yin la/ nyan thos bsrung ba med pa dang*/ dug cha bsrung ba bcos su yod pa dang*/ bcos su med pa dang*/ bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga spyod kyang byang chub kyi sems mi gtong*/ bslab pa ma gtugs pa kho nar gsungs pa dang*/ zhus pa 'brel ba bul zhing kha na ma tho ba che ba gnyis ni nyes pas ma yin par smos zhig gsungs pa dang*/ de'i rgyu mtshan nye bar 'khor yang theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpas ni srid pa gcig gis nyon mongs pa thams cad zad par mi bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin pa rnams kyi nyon mongs pa dag ni rim gyis zad par 'gyur ba'i phyir zhes gsungs pas/ bslab pa ring du rjes su zhugs pa yin la/ nyan thos kyi theg pa rnams bslab pa ni mthar chags yin no zhes gsungs so// 'dod chags la sogs nyon mongs ldan pa yi// sems ni 'khor ba yin par kun tu brjod// nyon mongs rnam grol shes dang zla 'dra ba'i// srid pa rgya mtsho'i mthar song yongs su sgrub// gzugs ni 'byung ba chen po bzhi dang ldan// de ni bdag min bdag kyang gzugs ma yin// gzugs la bdag med bdag la gzugs med de// gzugs ni ston pa'i phung po bzhir yang rigs par bgyi// gang zhig skyes bu dag cing nyon mongs med// rab tu sdang med mi la khro byed pa'i// byis pa de la sdig pa phyir 'gro ste// rdzing rnams phyogs su rdul rnams gtor ba bzhin// gang zhig nyes med chad pas gcod// sdang ba min la rab sdang ba// gnas gzhan gang yang rung ba bcu// myur du thob par kho nar 'gyur// // 343)༄// lam gyi rnam gzhag bstan pa bstan bcos glang chen rol pa/ oṃ swasti/ na mo rat+na gu ru/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig dgos/

dge ba'i bshes gnyen des bstan par bya ba'i chos dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ thabs dang shes rab rnam pa gnyis su 'dus te/ de yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ thabs dang shes rab rkang gnyis gshog pa brkyang*// gar 'dod sar phyin bde ba'i gnas thob 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// de la kun rdzob kyi bden pa lus ngag yid gsum/ shes rab don dam pa'i bden pa de'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ de gnyis dbyer med zung du 'jug pa dang po rtogs pa rgyu/ bar du goms pa lam/ mtha' ma mthar thug pa 'bras bu'o// de yang dang po nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas na/ dngos po mtshan ma la mngon par zhen pa rnams kyi dbang du bya ste/ stong pa nyid kyi don 'ba' zhig bstan pas/ dngos po la mngon par zhen pa dang bral/ stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa'i gang zag la thabs kyi dge ba'i rtsa bas bogs 'don te/ stong pa nyid dga' 'dod chags blo// zhes pa dang*/ gang la zhen pa yod na de yang thongs// zhes pas so// de la nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas na/ yul dang bsam pa dngos po gsum gyis nyams su len te/ de la yul ni rnam pa gnyis te/ dman pa'i yul snying rje ba ma nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor bying ba rnams dmigs pa'i yul du byas nas/ bka' drin dran pa'i tshul gyis jo bo dkon mchog gsum dang*/ rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi dgongs pa sgrub par byed pa/ rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba yab rgyal po'i srid 'tsho zhing*/ khrims kyi rgyal po'i yul khams skyong bar byed pa lta bu ni 'phags pa'i zhing gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa sgrub pa dmigs pa'i yul du bya'o// yul de gnyis la brten nas bsam pa la go cha bgo ba ni/ ma nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad byang chub rin po che la 'god pa'i go cha dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs sgrub par byed pa rang nyid sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i go cha dang*/

rang gzhan thams cad sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i rgyu nges pa/ chos dkon mchog la legs par gnas pa'i go cha dang*/ rang nyid gang las skyes pa'i rigs kyi rgyud de 'dzin par byed pa/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par thar pa'i rjes su 'brang zhing dgongs pa sgrub pa'i go cha dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bdag rang gi rgyud ma smin pa smin par mdzad cing*/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che la 'god par mdzad pa'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong gi bar du mi 'bral zhing*/ skyob par mdzad pa'i mgon chen po de'i rnam par thar pa'i rjes su 'brang zhing dgongs pa sgrub par byed pa'i go chas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dag par bkol bar bya ste/ lus kyi bya ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gong ma'i rjes su 'brang ba ni lus dge ba'o// ngag gi bya ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gong ma'i rjes su 'brang ba ni ngag dge ba'o// bsam par bya ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gong ma'i rjes su 'jug pa ni yid dge ba'o// de ltar thabs de dag gi rnam par bshad pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ thub pa'i dbang po sku gsum bdag nyid can// de rjes zhugs pa 'phags pa'i dge 'dun ste// stong nyid snying rje las byung dam pa yi// dkon mchog yon tan dpag med rgya mtsho dang*// rigs su gyur pa brgyud pa'i bla ma ste// smin par mdzad pa mgon po bdag gi yab// ces pas/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas// sgom spros bcas kyis byang chub 'dod pa ni// shar du 'gro bar 'dod pa la// nub tu phyin pa dag dang mtshungs// zhes pa ni/ dbang po rab kyi rten gyi gang zag bsags pa rab tu gyur pas bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las dbang bzhi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa thob ste/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid de bsgoms pas/ stong nyid de'i rang gi ngang du gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa yang dag pa ma yin par go bas nyon mongs pa mgo mnan/

bsam pa'i shes rab kyis dgongs pa mthar phyin/ bsgom pa'i shes rab kyis nyon mongs pa rtsa nas 'don pa'i dbang du byas nas sgom 'byung ngo*// chos nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes des/ gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pas/ 'khor bar skye bar byed pa'i rgyu/ nyon mongs pa spangs pas lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa mthar phyin/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa/ 'khor ba dang myang ngan las 'das pa/ rang dang gzhan/ ji snyed gnyis su 'dug pa thams cad/ rang gi bsam pa ma gtogs pa gzhan med par rtogs pas/ lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa khong tu chud/ sems de nyid gdod ma nas skye 'gag dang bral bar rtogs pas shes rab kyi bslab pa nyams su myong*/ chos nyid bden pa'i rten 'brel gyis tshogs pa ma tshang pa med pa khong du chud pa/ yang dag pa'i don dang gnyis su med par sbyor bas sbyor ba'i lam/ chos thams cad skye 'gag spros pa'i mtha' dang bral bar mthong bas mthong ba'i lam/ mthong lam de'i rgyun goms par byed pas bsgom pa'i lam/ goms pa'i stobs kyis gong nas gong du 'phar zhing*/ skyon las dang nyon mongs pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad kyang goms pa'i shugs de nyid kyis spong*/ spangs pa'i yon tan gzung 'dzin 'jig pa la rten pa'i khams brgya la sogs pa dpag tu med pa g.yo zhing*/ 'jig rten gyi khams brgya stongs par byed pa dang*/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad skye 'gag med pa sems nyid kyi gshis su bdag nyid gcig pu'i 'od zer gyis smin par mdzad pa dang*/ skye ba med pa'i 'od zer de nyid la 'dod chags can rnams kyis lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che zhes khong du chud nas/ 'dod chags spang pa'i phyir tshul khrims la nan tan byed pa dang*/ zhe sdang can rnams kyis lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa zhes khong du chud nas/ mdo sde'i sde snod la nan tan tu byed pa dang*/ gti mug can rnams kyis lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa zhes mngon pa'i sde snod la slob pa dang*/

de rnams kyi don nyams su len pa'i stobs kyi dbang du byas na/ ma chags pa dang*/ zhe sdang med pa dang*/ gti mug med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas rang gzhan thams cad 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan la longs spyod pas/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sems can gyi don byed cing*/ ci bde dang ci skyid dang*/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa smin par byed pa dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i don khong du chud pas yul sna tshogs mthong bar gyur ba dbyer med pa'i don phyin ci ma log pa ston par byed pa bla ma lhun gyis grub pa'i sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa'i zhal blta bar nus pa dang*/ chos thams cad skye ba med par khong du chud pas/ spobs pa zad mi shes pas sgra gcig gis thams cad la go bar nus pa dang*/ chos nyid don dam pa las gyur pa'i chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid kyi don dpag tu med pa khong du chud pa dang*/ de la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa de dag chos nyid don dam pa las byung zhing*/ chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pa goms pa'i stobs kyis/ gong nas gong du 'pho ba la/ sa nas sar 'phar zhing sa'i yon tan dang ldan pa zhes bya ste/ de ltar skyon thams cad spangs pa dang*/ yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i ngo bo chos kyi sku mthar phyin pa ni mthar phyin pa'i lam zhes bya ste/ mdor na skye ba med pa'i don la 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan mtha' dag 'byung ba kho na'o// shes rab don dam pa de'i rnam par bshad pa mdor bsdus nas tshigs su bcad pa/ bla ma las byung mkhas pa'i stong pa nyid// rgyal ba'i yum gyur smra bsam brjod 'das 'di// 'khor 'das kun gyi bde skyid 'byung gnas te// nyon mongs gnyen por gyur pa bstan pa'i chos// nyon mongs gnyen por gyur pa rtogs pa'i chos// rtogs pa'i mthun rkyen bsgrub pa tshogs kyi lam// rtogs pa nyid du sbyor ba sbyor ba'i lam// bden pa mthong ba mthong ba'i lam yin te// bden pa'i don la goms pa bsgom pa'i lam// yon tan dpag tu med pa skye med goms las byung*// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs pa'i ngo bo nyid// spang bya gnyen po rnam dag chos sku ni// dbyer med spros dang bral ba'i ngo bo nyid du gnas// dbyer med zung du 'jug pa ni// shes rab stong pa nyid kyang thabs// lus dang ngag yid rnam pa gsum la gnas// lus ngag yid kyi rang bzhin yang*// stong pa nyid du lhun gyis grub// dbyer med pa'i don ma mthong bar thabs dang shes rab phyogs la zhen yang*/

bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ thabs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba shes rab kyis bogs 'don/ shes rab kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thabs kyis bogs 'don dgos gsungs pa dang*/ gnas lugs dbyer med par gnas pa blo phyogs rer phyin ci log tu bsgrubs pas/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyi yon tan gyi 'byung gnas zung du 'jug pa'i rang bzhin la gnas par bya'o// de la zung du 'jug pa ni/ thabs dngos po dang mtshan ma la shes rab stong pa nyid kyis rgyas 'debs pa dngos po yod par blta ba dang*/ stong pa nyid med par blta ba dang*/ blta mkhan gyi shes pa la rtog pa ma chud pas rmongs pa rnams kyi zung 'jug dang*/ mkhas pa rnams kyis rigs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad snang tsam mi 'gag pa/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa thabs kyi rang bzhin de rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gnas/ rigs pa'i shes rab kyis khong du chud pas shes rab kyi ngo bo/ de gnyis dbyer med pa mkhas pa rnams kyi zung 'jug sgom chen rnams kyi zung 'jug ni bla ma dam pa gcig gi gdams ngag la brten nas bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis la sogs pa nyams su blangs pas lus la bde ba skye ste/ de stong pa dang zung du 'jug pas bde stong zung 'jug dang*/ yul snang stong zung 'jug dang*/ shes pa rig stong zung 'jug la sogs par tshig yul du ma gyur pa/ rang nyid nyams su myong ba dbang dang byin rlabs kyis nyams su myong ba de rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi zung 'jug go /bla ma rin po che ni zung 'jug rnam pa gnyis su bzhed de/ de la dang po 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad rang gi sems gdod nas skye ba med par rtogs pa gzhir bzhag nas/ rtogs pa'i don ngam ngam shugs kyis goms pa'i stobs kyis bag chags kyi sa bon dag pa'i shugs kyis myong ba rang rig pa blo'i yul du gyur pa/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad dang dbyer med par gyur pa slob pa'i zung 'jug dang*/

mtho ris byung tshor bag chags kyi sa bon mtha' dag gnyis su med pa'i shugs kyis spangs nas/ sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa phyag rgya chen po lhun gyis grub pa 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa ni mi slob pa'i zung 'jug go /blo gros phyin ci log tu gyur pa'i skyes bu 'ga' zhig gis/ yod mtha' med mtha' dmigs pa'i yul du byas pa'i zung 'jug dang*// kun rdzob sna tshogs rigs pas stong par brtags pa'i zung 'jug dang*// bden pa ma mthong 'jig rten zhi gnas zung 'jug rnams// shin tu ngo mtshar 'jig rten zung 'jug ste// mkhas pa rnams kyis 'di la yid brtan byar mi rung*// zung 'jug 'ga' zhig gnyis med blo las 'das// sems nyid rang byung 'od gsal mi g.yo bas// 'khor ba'i bag chags sna tshogs rab bcom nas// dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor bsgyur ba mdzes// sems nyid 'od gsal chos sku bde chen gyis// bdud bzhi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bcom mdzad cing*// rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i yon tan rab rgyas pa// rtsol sgrub med par lhun gyis grub pa'i dbang phyug ni// mi slob zung 'jug rnam dag mthar phyin sku// mnyam med bla ma dam pa'i zung 'jug de dag gis// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba ma lus kyis// rnam dag zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i gnas thob shog /bstan bcos glang chen rol pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //

344) ༄// rnyed dka'i dal rten dang de chos dang 'phrad pa shin tu dka' ba ge god klur gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang jo bo lha bla na med pa'i dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po rnams kyis/ yul ris dang rgyal khams thams cad du/ bkra shis pa dang bde legs pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pas rgyas par gyur cig shin tu rgyas par gyur cig shin tu rab tu rgyas par gyur cig bla ma rin po ches/ spyir 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po gting mtha' med par gyur pa yin pa las/ tshe snga ma phan chad du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i thugs rje chen po'i 'od zer sprin gseb kyi glog lta bus bskul bas/ dkar po'i phyogs kyi blo gros shin tu phra ba'i phra ba zhig sad pa las/ de'i rjes su mthun pa'i grogs dang bshes su gyur pas/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du 'bral du ma btub pas/ phan pa dang bde ba je cher sgrubs shing grub pa las mi'i lus thob pa/ gnya' shing bu gar rus sbal gyi mgrin pa chud pa ltar shin tu dka' bar gyur pa yin la/ de bas kyang ches khyad par du 'phags shing dka' ba ni/ chos byed pa'i rigs su skye ba shin tu rnyed par dka' ba yin pa las/ khyed yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i bdag po/ stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po chen po lta bu/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi skyabs dang gnas dang dpung gnyen du gyur pa/ bla na med pa'i dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi gdung rgyud mi gcod pa/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa/ de'i mthu chen po mnga' zhing bstan pa'i mnga' bdag yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po nyi ma dang*/ zla ba lta bur gyur pa'i bdag po/

rang nyid kyi yab bcom ldan 'das rje btsun gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje lta bu'i sras su 'khrungs shing yab bdag nyid chen po de'i sras su gyur pa/ bka' tshul bzhin du bsgrub par mdzad pa'i yon bdag ge god klu la gdams pa/ yon bdag nyid kyi yab gong du ji ltar smos pa'i bdag nyid chen po de lta bu yin pas/ yab bdag nyid chen po de'i bka' ni/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyis gcod par nus pa'am/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams dang*/ bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs pa rnams kyis kyang*/ bka' gcog par bya ba ma yin na/ yab bdag nyid chen po de lta bu'i sras nyid kyis ni gsung bzhin du shin tu yang bsgrub par rigs pas/ yab chos kyi rgyal po de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gson nam 'das kyang rung ste/ log par lta ba rnams kyi ming shid ces grags pa de la/ khyed kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba 'ba' zhig tu mdzad cing*/ sta yu la khrag ma dmar ba bzhed par gda' bas/ yab kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung phan pa bde ba thams cad kyi gzhi/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma dus dang rnam pa thams cad kyi bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i gnas/ chos rin po che 'ba' zhig tu mdzad par zhu 'tshal/ u dum wa ra'i me tog ltar// mi lus thob pa shin tu dka'// dal dang 'byor ba rnyed dka' zhing*// mi rtag 'jigs su rung ba yi// srin po snying rje med pa yis// rnam par gtse bar 'gyur ba'i phyir// bu gcig skyes bu chen po yis// yab kyis ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin// khyed kyis thugs la bzhag nas kyang*// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'dir// ji ltar zla ba nya ba bzhin// kun gyi snying du sdug pa dang*// mdzes shing gsal bar gyur pa dang*// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bur mdzod// rje 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rgyal po bla ma rin po ches// rang gi sras dang 'dra ba yon bdag ge god klu la legs par gdams pa'i yi ge rdzogs so// yig rten srungs dar dar yug kha the'u ma nyams pa dmar po yug gcig 'bul zhing mchis//

// 345) ༄// dge ba'i sems kyang skad cig mi dge ba'i sems kyang skad cig ces pa// tshul khrims kyis ni zhi ba 'dod rnams 'phags par 'gyur// stobs bcu'i spyod yul gnas shing tshul khrims nyams pa med// ces gsungs pas/ tshul khrims ni thams cad mkhyen pa stobs bcu dang ldan pa'i rjes su 'brang ste/ de yang gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi stobs/ dge ba mi dge bar 'gyur ba gnas med/ mi dge ba dge bar 'gyur ba gnas med pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la mi dge ba rnam pa bdun gnang zhes grags pa ni/ de nyid byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod du legs par gsungs pa'i gnad/ srog gcod pa ni zhing dang bsam pa dang dngos po rnam pa gsum gyis bde bar 'gro ba 'pho ba'i gnad/ zhing byang chub sems dpa' dga' byed la/ bsam pa chags pa'i stobs kyis dngos po chags pa skye med du rtogs nas/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob pa lta bu dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa yul de dang lhan cig du gnas pas chags pa thams cad rnam par spong ba byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang gi bla ma bcom ma ba lha'i bshes gnyen lta bu dang*/ rdzun du smras pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don nyams su myong bar byas nas mi mthong smras pa drang srong chen po me dang*/ rgyal po sde ma pham pa/ bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyi lus snga ma kho na bzhin du gyur pa dang*/ ma byin pa blangs pas phan pa dang bde ba rgya chen por 'gyur ba/ sprang pos khur ba phrogs nas rang sangs rgyas la phul bas shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan lta bur gyur pa rnams la ni/ gzhi dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ mthar thug thams cad du nyes pa med pa tsam du bzhed kyang*/ yon tan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'byung bas thams cad mkhas pa dang shes rab zab mo'i rjes su 'brang ste/ de ltar yang*/ lha mo dpal phreng gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ dge ba'i sems kyang skad cig

/mi dge ba'i sems kyang skad cig /ces pa dang*/ bram ze'i khye'u khyi dkar po'i rkyen gyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la dad pa dang*// ma dad pa'i gnas skabs skad cig ma gzhir bzhag pa las/ las rgyu dang 'bras bu mtha' dag thams cad de nyid du bstan pa las rnam par 'byed par gsungs pas/ 'di thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag 'bri gung pa'i ma lags te/ ston pa'i gsung nyid kyis nges so// de ltar ma gyur na sa dang lam la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam pa gsum spong ba yang mi 'thad/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom nas sangs rgyas pa yang mi 'thad de/ ston pa'i gsung gi rjes su 'brang bar bya'o// // 346) ༄// byang chub sems gnyis 'dres pa zhes spang pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ nga'i bu'i dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ri khrod pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan la gdams pa/ khyed nga la bsten yun ring zhing mnyes pa thams cad kyis mnyes par byas pas/ ji ltar zhus pa'i gdams ngag 'di rnams gong du nas kyang nyams su myong ba dang*/ mngon par rtogs pa dang bcas nas khyed rang la yod pa yin mod kyi/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar dang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// stong nyid snying rje zhes bya ba// byang chub sems gnyis 'dres pa yin// lus ngag yid gsum spyod pa dang*// bya dang byed pa thams cad kun// 'di las gzhan med rnal 'byor pa// nyams su longs shig rang gi bu// dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid kyi sku// bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs// byang chub sems gnyis 'dres pa yin// 'di las gzhan na bla ma med// 'gro 'ong med pa'i de nyid la// su zhig su yi drung du 'ong*// rnal 'byor dbang phyug gang dga' nyid// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam mchog

/byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa// don du ma shes kha lta can// snying re rje yi snying rje'i yul// snying re rje ba de rnams kun// e ma ji ltar gyur zhig gu// byang sems dbyer med las byung ba// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// shin tu rnam par dag pa kun// yi ge dag dang mthun par yang*// thams cad so so phyag tu thengs// dbu zhu ril ba maṇ+ḍal gsum// bskur nas mchis pas yig rten lags// dge bas byang chub mchog thob shog /spang pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan la gdams pa// // 347) ༄// bu lhun gyis grub pa'i rang sems bsgom zhes pa bla ma lho pa char 'bebs la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ chos kun gdod nas rnam dag nam mkha' la// kun tu bzang po nyi ma rab gsal bas// mi shes mun pa'i rang sems snang mdzad pa// mgon po phag mo gru pa'i zhabs pad 'dud// chos kyi rje 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan rin po che de'i zhal snga nas/ 'khor ba dang myang ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems yin gsung*/ de'i don cung zhig snyan du gsol na/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis snang ba thams cad chos kyi sku spros pa thams cad dang bral zhing gdod nas zhi bar thugs su chud/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis chos thams cad nye bar zhi yang*/ rang gzhan gyi don byang chub kyi sems rin po ches/ thams cad kun tu bzang po rnam par rol pa'i sprin phung du thugs su chud cing rol par mdzad/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad rang gi sems phyin ci log tu 'khrul pas nye bar zhi ba'i dbyings su 'jug pa dang*/ sems can dmyal ba rnams ni mthong tshad thams cad la zhe sdang gi sems tshig pa za ba'i me chen po bsam pa'i rang gzugs de nyid kyis sregs pa dang*/ sdug bsngal bar gyur pa dang*/ yi dwags chags pa'i rang gzugs/ dud 'gro glen pa'i rang gzugs/ lha ma yin 'thab pa dang rtsod pa'i rang gzugs/

lha dang mi rnams bsam pa bzang ngan/ las bzang ngan du bsags pa'i bsam pa'i rang gzugs lags/ thub pa mgon po chos kyi rje// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yis// snang srid rang gzhan ma lus kun// rab kyis chos skur mthong ba dang*// 'bring gis rang sems yi dam lha// thams cad rang gi a mar mthong*// mthong lugs gsum po ma gtogs pa// ji ltar nam mkha'i pad+mo la// rmi lam bung bas 'jib pa dang*// rang snang 'khrul pa'i skra shad kyis// gcad par dka' ba'i zhags pa 'dis// sangs rgyas yon tan rang sems 'di// 'ching zhing gcod par mi byed na// rnam grol sa la gnas par dka'// ji ltar sbrang bu'i chu ngan gyis// sa steng bangs par mi 'gyur ltar// nyon mongs dag las 'byung ba yi// chos brgyad bsnyen bkur phra mos kyang*// rang gzhan smin par mi 'gyur pas// bu lhun gyis grub pa'i rang sems bsgom// gnyis med ngang la bzhugs par zhu// sems bskyed bsngo ba nan tan mdzod// rdzogs so// bla ma lho pa char 'bebs la gnang ba'o// // 348) ༄// rgyud tshod dang mthun pa'i chos bshad dgos par sgo glad ma la gdams pa// zhi ba rang bzhin dbyings las mi g.yo mnyam pa nyid// brtse ba'i bdag nyid zhe 'dod 'dzin bral ba// chos dang chos nyid dbyer med zung du 'jug /dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yab sras rnams kyi zhabs la 'dud// dpal chen de la mi chos lha chos gnyis med de// kha snying tha dad g.yo sgyu sna tshogs kyis// rang gzhan mgo skor mi mdzad 'gro mgon rin po che// skyabs chen dam pa khyod dang mi 'bral shog /brtse sems dang ma bral/ rgyab gtam ma byed/ rgyud tshod dang mthun pa'i chos shod/ mi'i seng ge cod pan can/ seng ge yang thog 'khrugs la 'bar/ de 'dra ba yi sku khams de/ 'di 'dra gcig gi sing por thal/ sgo glad ma la'o// // 349) ༄// gdan sa phag mo grur gdan sa'i khur mi theg par zhu ba'i phrin skur//

oṃ swasti/ spyir bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sgos bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi// mkhan slob gnyis kyi zhabs la 'dud// gdan sar bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun dang*// chen po gong ma'i dge 'dun la// mchid tshig zhu tshig ya zung zhu lags na// skyon med yon tan rab rdzogs pa'i// gdan sa dpal gyi phag mo gru// sprul sku rtsod pa med gyur pa// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i gnas// rab 'byams 'jig rten khams rnams su// shin tu dkon zhing rnyed dka' ba// rang byung rten gyis yongs su gang*// lcang lo can gyi pho brang ltar// byin rlabs rgya chen 'byung ba'i gnas// u rgyan grong khyer chen po ltar// dpa' bo mkha' 'gros yongs su gang*// byang chub chen po'i shing drung ltar// skyes chen yab sras gong ma rnams// 'od gsal thugs su chud pa'i gnas// dpa' bo me tog zla mdzes kyis// nags tshal kun tu bzang po ltar// ngo mtshar rmad du byung gyur cing*// skyon med yon tan rab rdzogs par// 'jig rten mgon po'i rgyal tshab tu// dbang bskur mnga' gsol mdzad nas kyang*// rang gzhan gnyis kyi don bsgrub pa// mkhan slob gnyis kyis dbu mdzad pa'i// phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun thams cad kyis// shin tu thugs la btags mod kyi// zhabs tog bya ba'i nus pa med// khyed la gces ka tshol ba min// blo thag snying nas chod pa yin// ku re kyal ka mi gsung zhu// dpal ldan 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// skyob pa phag mo gru pa la// bu chen gsum gyis dbu mdzad pa'i// mkhas btsun seng ge mchog 'dra zhing*// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// gtsug gi nor bu rin po che// mnyam pa med pas sa steng gang*// rmongs pa tha shal bdag 'dra la// gdan sar sdod pa'i gnyer kha med// mkhan slob gnyis kyis dbu mdzad pa'i// dam pa gong ma khyed rnams kyis// ku re kyal ka mi gsung zhu// chos rgyal mnyam med rin po ches// dus dang rnam pa thams cad du// gnyer med kho re chung ba yi// ldom bu dman pa bdag nyid la// sems sgom bka' bstsal gsungs pa las// gdan sar sdod cig ma gsungs pas// skyabs gnas bla ma dam pa yi// bka' dang 'gal bar ma phod pas// gdan sar sdod pa'i rngo ma thog

/mkhan slob gnyis kyis dbu mdzad pa'i// skyes chen gong ma khyed rnams kyis// ku re kyal kha mi gsung zhu// lhag bsam rnam par dag pa yis// rang gzhan brje bar ma nus shing*// 'du 'dzi g.yeng bas dub pa yis// ri dwags lta bu'i ngang tshul gyis// ri khrod dgon par mos pa skyes// bya bsam gyi khur dang bral ba la// mkhan slob gnyis kyis dbu mdzad pa'i// dam pa gong ma khyed rnams dang*// gdan sar bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun gyis// 'jig rten mgon po'i rgyal tshab tu// dbang bskur mnga' gsol mdzad pa las// thugs la 'dogs thabs gzhan med kyang*// rmongs pa yon tan chung ba dang*// chos rgyal gdan sa 'dzin pa ni// tha chung bu la ma babs pas// chen po babs la mkhas pa rnams// nam yang thugs su chud lags kyang*// ku re kyal ka gsungs pa la// gong nas yi mug mchi ma shor// gong ma rnams kyi bka' bstsal de// rin chen gser bas lci lags kyang*// nyams chung bdag gis ma khyag pas// mkhan slob gnyis kyis dbu mdzad pa'i// gong ma rnams la bzod par gsol// rdzogs so// //

350) ༄// dam tshig ldan zhing phyag rgya chen po la ma yengs par bsgom par gces pa// shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong kun// bag med spyod pa ma byed par// bslab gsum rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// dam tshig la sogs sdom pa rnams// srog la bab kyang mi btang bsrung*// rin chen bla ma spyi bor bsgom// mos gus mchod pas rgyun du mchod// lus ni lha yi sku nyid dang*// mi 'bral dran pa 'dun pa bsten// snang stong zung 'jug lha sku dang*// grags stong zung 'jug bzlas pa rnams// rtag tu ma yengs 'bad 'bungs thon// don gyis bla ma'i dgongs pa blang*// phyag rgya che la ma yengs bya// ma yengs bsgom pa shin tu gces// // 351) ༄// sdom gsum byang sems kyi spyod pa las 'bras bu rgyal ba'i sku gsum mdzes pa// na mo rat+na gu ru/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can la mar bsgom pa ni thabs yin/ de la byams pa skyes pa ni byams pa'o// ma de rnams 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal bsam pas snying rje ba ni snying rje'o// snying rje bas bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ byang chub thob par 'dod pa ni smon pa'o// de dam bca' dang cho gas bskyed pa ni smon pa byang chub kyi sems so// de'i ched du sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol ba ni dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims so// des sems can don byed pas ni sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims so// sems can don du lus ngag yid gsum mi dge bar sdom pa ni sdom pa'i tshul khrims so// byang chub sems mchog bla med rmad byung bas// lus ngag yid gsum tshul khrims rin po che// sdom gsum byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa las// 'bras bu rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i sku gsum mdzes// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stong par ma gyur tshe// 'gro rnams bde la 'god la skyabs su mchi//

// 352) ༄// gdan sa phag mo gru la tshigs lhugs kyi sgo nas bsngags pa// sems nyid spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i sku/ yon tan rin po che thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stong par ma gyur gyi bar du sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bdag nyid/ bla ma rin po ches 'gro ba thams cad rgyal bar gyur cig 'gro ba'i mgon po de'i gdan sa dpal gyi phag mo gru zhes bya ba/ rdo rje gdan byang chub kyi shing drung ltar spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i gnas/ 'og min gyi pho brang ltar theg pa chen po'i chos zab pa dang rgya che ba thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ u rgyan gyi grong khyer chen po ltar dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas gang ba/ lho phyogs dpal gyi ri ltar grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpag tu med pa'i bzhugs gnas/ byang chub sems dpa' me tog zla mdzes kyi nags tshal kun tu bzang po ltar/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po sgom pa'i mthun rkyen thams cad dang ldan pa/ bya skad snyan pa'i tshogs dang*/ shing dang*/ rtsa dang*/ me tog gi rigs dpag tu med pas shin tu mdzes pa/ shing ljon pa lo ma dang 'bras bu me tog gis spud pa/ bsil ba'i grib ma 'dzin cing tshad pa las skyob pa'i phreng ba can/ gcan gzan dang*/ ri dwags dang srogs chags rnams rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi byang chub kyi sems kyis byin gyis brlabs pas 'tshe ba med cing skyid par gnas pa/ rang byung gi rten dang khyad par du 'phags pa mang po bzhugs pa'i gnas su/ 'bangs kyi tha ma ldom bu dge slong rin chen dpal gyis/ bla ma dam pa nyid las byung ba'i me tog phra mo shin tu dad pa'i shugs kyis/ skyob mdzad bla ma dam pa dang*/ de'i rjes su slob pa'i dge 'dun bzhugs pa la// phra ba'i me tog phra bar gyur na yang*// bzod pa'i rang bzhin rnams la bzod par gsol// de las byung ba'i dge ba dri med gang bsags pas// bla ma rin chen mchog dang de yi sras rnams dang*// dus rnams rtag tu nam yang mi 'bral zhing*// 'gro rnams byang chub mchog la 'god par shog/

// 353) ༄// lta sgom spyod 'bras gzhan nas btsal mi dgos pa'i tshigs bcad dgu pa// na mo rat+na gu ru/ rgyun mi 'chad pa'i rnam rtog 'di// ye shes yin par da gzod shes// lta ba logs nas btsal mi dgos// tha mal shes pa yengs med 'di// sgom pa yin par da gzod shes// nyams myong gzhan nas btsal mi dgos// 'bral ma myong gi rang sems 'di// sangs rgyas yin par da gzod shes// 'bras bu gzhan nas btsal mi dgos// // 354) ༄// rang rgyud tha rgod dul na rin chen mchog tu 'gyur zhes pa// zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal mi g.yo bas// las dang nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa rnams// dag par byed cing yon tan rdzogs mdzad pa// rang byung bla ma rin po che dpal 'dud// spyir las kyi sgrib pa mi dang*/ mi khyod rang la nye bar 'khor ba'i chos brgyad po 'di kho na bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis spang bar byed pa yin nam min/ de yin na rang nyid 'jig rten dug gi sdong por byas nas gzhan gyi dug sel bar nus sam/ khyod la mi na re phan par 'dug zer ba de cis phan par 'dug soms dang*/ brlag rgyu chos brgyad po de min nam/ de spong bar byed na zha ngon khyod zhag 'ga' thab ka ngo bsrung dang*/ rnyed pas rnyed pa tshol/ yar dang nga bzang mang po ma bsgrub par/ en gcig khyod rang 'gro dgos pa de 'dra bar yang gyis la/ lus ngag yid gsum de'i phyogs su ma shor ba gal che ste/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gi zhal nas kyang*/ 'jig rten spyod pa ci yang ngas ni ma shes so gsungs/ lus ngag yid gsum brje ba yin// khong rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dam pa rnams// 'jig rten chos brgyad sna tshogs kyis// rang gzhan gyi mgo skor mi byed pa// khyod thugs rje chung ngam mi chos glen// kwa chos la sems pa'i dam pa rnams// tha mal mi gtsang bum pa 'di// 'ja' lus rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor du// log gis bsgyur nas ci tsug mchi// nyon mongs log pa'i smra brjod 'di// gsang sngags su bsgyur na mi dga' 'am// gzung 'dzin log pa'i rnam rtog 'di// 'od gsal du bgyis kyang ngo ma tsha// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi bde skyid rnams// stong nyid snying rje ma gtogs pa// gzhan nas 'byung ba mi srid ces// thub dbang bla mas mi gsung ngam// tshu rol mthong ba'i rmongs pa rnams// ma rig mun pa'i rgya mtsho ru// las nyon chu srin lto ba nas// thar pa med cing sdug bsngal ba// snying rje'i nang na snying rje ste// 'di la smon pa su zhig skye// gzhan lam sna 'dren pa'i rje btsun dam pa khyod// thugs la mi chos bag chags yod pa gzhan rkyen gyis// bslang bas khyod gnyis gzhan gyi mar khrid ded dpon byed// de tshe khyod nyid lus ngag yid gsum ji ltar gces// gang tshe khyod ni stong dang snying rje zung 'jug pa'i// 'od kyis gnas gsum gsal bar byed cing phan pa bskyed// dug ni gnod pa yin no khyed kyis sems la zhog

/thar pa'i lam sna shor bas 'jig rten chos kyis bslus// dmyal bar mngon phyogs gshin rje'i gzugs can 'jigs su rung*// skyob pa med pa de rnams skyob pa byed na ko /rang nyid de yi dbang du song na ji ltar skyabs su 'gyur// de phyir phan pa bskyed na 'khrul 'khor chos la dug sdong rnams dang spyod pa ma bstun cig bla ma dam pa rnams bdag gi lus yongs su bzhes su gsol/ bla ma dam pa rnams bdag la rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa bskyed du gsol/ bla ma'i mgo brdung mi bya/ 'dre nyal ba'i mig tu shing bu ma bsug rang thog tu khyi mi rbad/ rang bsod nams bsags pa dang*/ sgom la 'bad na 'dre la lus byin pas chog 'dre rnam rtog yin pas lus byin na 'dod mkhan med/ dad can brtson 'grus ldan pas dam chos nyams len pa/ zla ba yar ngo lta bur gong nas gong du 'phel/ dam pa'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs la bzhugs par gyur pa na/ rang rgyud tha rgod dul na rin chen mchog tu 'gyur// // 355) ༄// nyams rtogs 'bar ba'i thol glu sgom chen gyi bgro gleng*// rat+na na mo/ bdag med bdag tu 'dzin pa 'dis// 'gro drug 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams// stong pa gzugs su byung ba yis// bsam gyis mi khyab sdug bsngal myong*// da sdug bsngal de las thar 'dod na// bsdam du med pa'i sdom pa blang*// bskyed du med pa'i sems bskyed bya// bsgom du med pa'i phyag rgya bsgom// bgrod du med pa'i sa lam bgrod// thob rgyu med pa'i sku gsum thob// bcings pa med pa'i sems can rnams// rang gi ngang du grol bar bya// chad dang sgrub pa 'thad tshig gsum// med kyang ku re byas pa yin// lan grangs mang bas nyams kyang dga'// dngos po med pas yi yang mug /bla ma slob ma dam chos gsum// med kyang ku re byas pa yin// gzhan gyis glengs na nyams kyang dga'// dngos su med pas yi yang mug

/bdag med gzhan med yul med gsum// med kyang ku re byas pa yin// kun gyi rtsol ba nyams yang dga'// byung ba med pas yi yang mug /char la 'khang ra btang bas bab lo// yang mkhas par gsol ba gcig gis// sgom chen gcig bgro gleng gis ma thub nas/ sgom chen na re/ chos 'di la mkhas pa'i brgyud pa yin// thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang*// til+li nā ro paṇ+ḍi ta// kun bzang sgra sgyur lho brag pa// shes rab mthar phyin ras chen sku// bstan 'dzin zla 'od gzhon nur gyur// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa sogs// lung rigs man ngag nyams rtogs rnams// gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa yin// rmongs pa khyod la ci cha yod// 'ba' shang khyod rang kha rog sdod// zer lo// // 356) ༄// gdul bya'i rigs can tha dad la 'dul thabs tha dad kyis bstan par gdams pa// ji ltar gti mug las skyes pa// rta dang glang po la sogs pa// rigs kyi bye brag shes pa yis// 'dul thabs bye brag so sor bstan// log dang ma log ma nges pa'i// gdul bya rigs can tha dad la// 'dul ba'i bye brag tha dad pa// mkhas pa rnams kyi bsten par byed// sgom chen phyogs bcur gshegs pa rnams// nga 'bu gang la mnyes snyam na// tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab la// sgrub pa tshul bzhin mdzad gyur na// nga 'bu shin tu mnyes pa lags// sdod tshis mi bya 'gro tshis bya// rang mgo ma 'khor tsam re mdzod// bu gcig pha ltar brtse ba'i bdag nyid can// phun sum tshogs pa'i rang bzhin dge 'dun rnams// yon tan che yang mi ngoms rgya mtsho bzhin// yon tan mchog gis gang bar 'dod pa yis// brtse ba'i thugs kyis yang dang yang du spyod// mi shes blo can ma rangs gyur na yang*// kye ma skyes bu dam pa ngo mtshar zhes// 'jig rten 'di na su zhig mgu mi byed// 'jig rten mgon pos gsung pa yin// mkhas pa rang gi sems la dris// lar sems kyi gnas lugs ma go na// kun rdzob bde skyid thabs rnams kun// me yi nang du bsil ba tshol// bu snying gtam tshig gcig 'chad pa de// tshe la long med kyi dus tshod 'dir// log sred tshig gi gdams ngag la// 'dod pa'i bsam pa rab bcad de// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam mchog

/bde dang skyid pa'i 'byung gnas gtso// gser g.ya' dang bral ba lta bu yi// rang sems spros med rdo rje bsgom// bu log sred can gyi gang zag dang*// rang gi lta spyod mi bstun zhing*// mtho dman gyi gdams ngag sna tshogs kun// rtog pa'i sna kha yin pas na// mthar thug gi 'bras bur ma bsams par// 'gyur med lhun grub 'dus ma byas// bde chen rdo rje rang sems bsgom// bla ma bsten cing gus pa'i phan yon ni// 'jig rten gyi kha na ma tho ba gang yang mi 'byung ba dang*/ yon tan dang bde skyid thams cad zla ba yar ngo bzhin du 'phel ba dang*/ sdig pa thams cad 'dag pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad ma bsgrubs kyang 'grub pa dang*/ tshe phyi mar byang chub sems dpa'i bla ma gcig dang mjal ba dang*/ bla ma dam pas zin pa'i gang zag de ngan song du nam yang mi skye ba la sogs te rgyas par ni dpal 'byung ba'i rnam thar la sogs par shes par bya'o// mdor na phan yon mtha' med do// ma bsten cing ma gus pa'i nyes dmigs de las bzlog pa'o// gnas skabs dang mthar thug sgrub pa'i rten 'brel zab mo'o// // 257) ༄// dwags lha sgam po'i gdan sa dang brgyud 'dzin rnams la bsngags brjod kyi phrin yig/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dwags lha sgam po'i dgon pa nas// dpal dwags po rin chen la gsol ba 'debs// khong bla ma chen po gnas nang ba'i// lam sna 'di sgam por bsgyur du gsol// nged phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun yang*// khyed rje btsun pa la gsol ba 'debs// sgam po mi nub rgyal mtshan rtser// khyed bla ma rin chen bzhugs par zhu// nged phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun yang*// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa rnams// ma lus mtha' dag sgrub pa 'di// khyed bla ma chen po'i zhabs tog yin// dwags po rin chen gyi rgyud 'dzin rnams// khyed rje btsun pa la gsol ba 'debs// gdan sa dwags lha sgam po yi// bdag po rang gi khyim du byon// da yod bzhud snyam yang mi bgyid do// bzhud kyang zhabs la mi 'ju re// cis kyang thag chod bgyis pa lags// sgam po'i ri la bzhugs nas kyang*// gdan sa skyong ba'i dge 'dun rnams// mos gus dang gdung sems drag po yis// phyogs su blta blta mig kyang brdol// rgyug 'dur byas byas rkang pa zad// sna len gra bsham byed byed nas// phugs sris ci yod thang de thal// khong gi ji ltar bsam pa rnams// don med ma mdzad 'byon par zhu// ji ltar bzhed pa'i thugs dgongs rnams// mtha' dag thams cad bsgrub lags pas// sgam po'i re thag ma bcad cig

/lar byas pas mi phan grogs se kun// bla ma rje btsun dbu se yin// 'dzam gling yongs su grags pa yin// dpal nā ro'i gdung rgyud 'dzin pa lags// dgon pa dwags lha sgam po yin// dwags po rin chen gyi gdan sa yin// grub gnas gong na med pa lags// gnas dang rnal 'byor 'dzom pa lags// 'di la dga' ba byung re shi// kha tsam yin na rang la sdig /dwags po chen po'i rgyud 'dzin rnams// dga' bar soms dang rnal 'byor pa// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas pa lags// ngo mtshar bas kyang rmad du byung*// de las lhag pa gda' lags sam// // 358) ༄// zad pa bzhi yi dam chos kyis 'gro drug gi sdug bsngal rab tu zad pa// na mo gu ru/ rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma la// chos sku'i nges shes ma skyes na// mnyam nyid rtogs pa'i lta kham yang*// rang dang gong mas khrel bar zad// bde dang sdug bsngal gang snang ba// rang sems yin par ma rtogs na// rgyu 'bras mngon du gyur pa yang*// rje la kha slob byas par zad// spyod lam dus skabs thams cad du// rgyun chad med par ma rtogs na// mnyam rjes med pa'i kha lta yang*// rang la rang phye gtor bar zad// bslab gsum bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis// dug gsum zhi bar ma nus na// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yis// tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa yang*// gong ma'i tshig sgrub yin par zad// zad pa bzhi yi dam chos 'dis// 'gro drug sdug bsngal rab zad nas// bde chen thar pa thob par shog /bde chen thar pa thob par shog /bde chen thar pa thob par shog /gdung 'tshob bus ni pha la mngon lkog med// bran mo kha gsag che yang lkog mi thub// bya zhu can gyi chos ni sa le 'od// ye shes tshul khrims bu ni tshong dpon yin// skyid du re ba'i phru gu rnams// sdug tu bcug pa mthol lo bshags// rang dang 'dra ba'i slob ma rnams// gzhan du bzung ba mthol lo bshags// tshig 'jam mkhas pa'i bsngags pa la// tshig rtsub smras pa mthol lo bshags// rang la ltos 'jog byas pa rnams// re thag bcad pa mthol lo bshags// bsam pa gcig tu ma nges pa// gnyis phung byas pa mthol lo bshags// ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po las// gti mug dbang gis byis pa rmongs pas na// de dag stong pa zhi ba'i chos mi 'dod// su dag stong pa zhi la dga' ba ni// de dag rgyal ba'i chos 'di bzung ba yin// yang*/

chos nyid du yang mi dbang thams cad ltos// phyogs bcu 'jig rten dag na gang bzhugs dang*// rgyal ba mya ngan 'das pa kun snang ste// chos nyid kyi ni sangs rgyas mngon gsum bzhugs/ /chos rnams thams cad stong par shes par gyis// //

359) ༄// kha che'i paṇa chen shākya shrī'i spyan sngar phul ba'i springs yig/ oṃ swasti/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya'i shrī'i spyan sngar/ shākya'i sras kyi dge slong bsod snyoms pa rin chen dpal gyis zhu ba/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'jig tu nye ba'i dus la bab pas/ bstan pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs stobs 'phel bas/ dkar po phyogs kyi yul dang phyogs dang ris thams cad bcom pas thugs ngal bar gyur pa dang*/ bgrod dka' zhing rtsub pa'i shul ring po nas byon pa'i stobs kyi sku ngal bar gyur pa dang*/ skad rigs mi gcig pa'i nyes pas phan tshun gyi ngag brjod pa go bar dka' bar gyur pas gsung ngal ba dang*/ cung zad dub par gyur kyang thub pas lung bstan pa byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa'i gnas/ theg pa chen po'i rigs can sha stag gis gang ba/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang tshul khrims kyi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa la/ spyi gtsug gi nor bu rin po che ltar 'du shes shing*/ dad pa dang gus pa'i shugs rgya mtsho chen po'i rlabs ltar g.yo ba'i phyogs 'dir byon pa ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rang gi gnas pa khyim du bu byon pa lta bu lags shing*/ bod khams thams cad skal ba dang ldan pa lags la/ bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa thams cad kyang lus sems dga' bdes rgyas shing*/ nyid kyi thugs la btags pa la bdag kyang glo ba dga' zhing mchis/ slad kyi don zhu ba/ spyir bod kyi rgyal khams 'di rgya gar gi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i spyod yul lags so// paṇ+ḍi ta dang grub thob dang*/ yon tan can dpag tu med pa byon nas tshul khrims rin po che brtul zhugs 'dzin pa nyung bas phan rlabs po che ma thog pa lags/ de yang sngon slob dpon bo dhi sa twa zhes bgyi ba byung*/ de nas skabs su paṇ+ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na zhes bya ba byung*/

da ltar bod kyi rgyal khams 'di dge slong de gnyis kyis tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs gcig pu la brten pa lags/ da khyed kyis rgya gar na ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs de mdzad pas/ bod thams cad kyi mig rten du gyur pa lags/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang tshul khrims byon pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byon pa lags pas/ de la dga' ba dang dad pa dang*/ gus pa'i shugs kyis/ yul mtha' 'khob yin yang ko lpags ni nged kyang mi gon/ thul gog spu yod pa'i zla gam dang sha can lpags tshags dang phyam tse zla gam ni nams kyang mi gsol ba'i rang bzhin/ gos na bza' ther ba dang gru bzhi/ thub pas legs par bsngags shing 'os pa/ dge sbyong gi tshul dang mthun pa/ tshul khrims nyams pa dang cho ga nyams pa sngags mi 'chags pa'i phyam tse dang sha 'gag ma lags pa/ chos dang mthun pa'i na bza' phrug cig la/ ling pong dar srab 'gu che'i snam sbyar gcig dang*/ pong 'gu che rdo rje gsang lam ma'i thang ba gcig dang*/ li khri gcig nyi ma ris kyi sham thab gcig dang*/ phyi tse'u si/ nang ha pu/ bar srin rtel rna gcug pa'i 'phyar bu gcig dang*/ ling rin po che'i ri mo can gyi rngul gzan gcig dang*/ lnga 'bul zhing mchis pa/ nga'i nye gnas gcig la bskur nas mchis pas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la thugs brtse ba'i slad du/ na bza' phyag dar khrod kyi tshem bu 'di dag cis kyang sku la gsol bar zhu 'tshal/ gser srang gang mchis pa 'di/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen lo tsā bas zhal zas dgyes pa gcig tu legs par bsgrubs nas/ bdag gi bsod snyoms 'di zhal du 'du ba zhig mdzad par zhu 'tshal/ bdag gi nye gnas sgom pa dar gzhon gyis chab tsha zi po la srang lnga dang thud legs pa du ma zhig bskur nas mchis/ dgyes par gda' na da rung yang bskur rgyu mchis pa lags/ bod la kha zas legs pa mi 'dug gsung skad pas tig ta mang du 'dren par zhu/

dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po lo tsā ba la/ nang dar ser po kha the'u ma nyams pa gcig dang*/ dmar po kha the'u ma nyams pa gcig dang*/ srugs kha the'u ma nyams pa gcig dang gsum 'bul zhing mchis/ ji ltar sha chang 'dod yon gyi// ro yis rnam par myos pa yi// skye bos 'jig rten gang gyur cing*// gsang sngags theg chen yin smra yang*// mig ldan dga' zhing gus pa byed pa med// tsha sgo'i thang 'dra bod yul 'dir// u dum wa ra 'di byung ba// mkhas pa chen po lo tsā bas// snying dang mig bzhin btsa' bar zhu// nam mkha' mdzod dang rin chen bzhin// // 360) ༄// nag shod mkhan po la gdams pa'i gsang gtam chen mo bka' phrin// rje mnyam med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// mi kho bo rang gi 'dug lugs de// khyed rang nyid la cha yod mod// sngon bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du// sog g.yag la se bo man chad du// lus srog la bab kyang mi 'gro bar// dbus gtsang rig pa'i 'byung gnas su// ri khrod gangs khrod 'grims par bsams// de tshe 'di log pa'i blo gros kyis// 'jig rten chos brgyad bsam pa yis// khams su rnyed bkur ga la tshol// mi kho bo rang gi gser 'bum ni// rigs skyon dang bral ba'i mthing shog la// gser sbyangs pa bla ma'i gdams ngag de// mos gus shugs kyis sems la bris// smra bsam brjod med kyi ngo bor rtogs// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi yum// shes rab pha rol phyin pa de// bla ma'i drin gyis rang la rnyed// nga rang yang yon bdag cig yin nam snyam// che 'dod bzang 'dod kyi log rtog gis// ched du tshol na rang la sdig /shugs la byung na khab skud kyang*// dga' dang gus pas len pa yin// chen po'i rdzas gzhan smos ci dgos// lar cis kyang mi phan 'chi ba yi// sems sku gsum dbyer med ma gtogs pa// tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i skyabs gzhan med// rnam rtog 'ja' tshon ri mo yis// rmongs pa'i byis pa bslu bar byed// chos brgyad smig rgyu'i rgya mtsho la// tshe 'di log par bslus pa yi// byis pa rmongs pa'i ri dwags rnams// 'khrul pas skom drir 'chi ba yin// de nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyed// skyob pa skyabs chen rang sems bsgoms// rang sems bsgom pa ma gtogs pa// bla ma mnyes pa'i thabs gzhan med// gsang gtam chen mo'i bka' 'phrin gyi// yang lan gsang gtam chen mo 'di// skyes bu dam pa'i thugs la zhog

/rdzogs so// nags shod mkhan po la// // 361) ༄// 'du shes bzhi dang ldan pa'i sgo nas man ngag/ gu ru dam pa na mo/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gshegs shul/ dpal rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi man ngag grub thob thams cad kyi thugs kyi nying khu/ til+li pa'i dgongs pa/ bir+wa pa'i gsang rgyu/ nyams su blang ba'i man ngag la/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes/ gdams ngag la nor bu rin po che lta bu'i 'du shes/ rang nyid la khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pas nad pa lta bu'i 'du shes/ chos la bdud rtsi lta bu'i 'du shes bskyed/ snod dang mi ldan pa'i skye bo la/ be'u bum rang yang mi bstan par bya ste rang nyid kyis sgrub par bya'o// // 362) ༄// zhen pa gtong ba'i brtul bzhugs skad cig kyang mi 'bral bar bya ba'i gdams pa// 'di ltar dbang phyug 'khor los bsgyur// byams pa chen po'i zhags pa yis// skye dgu thams cad bzung nas kyang*// bsod nams bsags pa'i mthu stobs kyis// 'gro ba bde la 'god pa ni// zhe 'dod med pa'i brtul bzhugs kyis// thams cad grub par gyur pa yin// phan dang bsod nams stobs yod kyang*// gnas kyi zhen pa phra mo yis// phra ba'i mi chos 'dun ma yang*// 'grub par gyur ba mi srid na// bla med byang chub smos ci dgos// des na bde skyid 'dod pa rnams// zhen pa gtong ba'i brtul bzhugs dang*// skad cig tsam yang 'bral mi bya// chos rje bla ma'i zhal snga nas// sems gsum la sogs rten 'brel dang*// dus gsum rten 'brel 'bras bu ni// khams gsum pa yi rten 'brel dang*// bslab gsum yon tan 'brel ba ni// sa bon gang btub ston dang mtshungs// de bas byams dang snying rje sogs// sems gsum rgyal ba'i khang bzang mchog /thams cad kun gyi zhing sa bzhin// yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten yin// dkar nag las kyi rgyu lam 'bras// gang du 'gyur med 'bras bu spyod// babs kyi rten 'brel gnad du che// 'gyur med 'od gsal dri ma med// lhun grub bde ba chen po'i sku// sngon gyi thugs rje smon lam gyis// nged kyi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// 'gro drug kun gyi dpal du shar// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'byung gnas gtso// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang chen ni// tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i 'bras bu yin// brgyud pa gong ma'i rjes 'brangs pa// tshogs gnyis mig dang bral ba ni// gong ma'i rjes su snyogs pa dka'// rdo rje 'chang gi sprul pa mchog

/dpal ldan til+li zhes bya ba// rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po ni// snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can rnams// tshad med thugs rje chen po yis// rjes su bzung ba'i snang ba yin// gsang sngags gnad kyi man ngag gis// log par ltung ba'i sems can rnams// thugs rje chen pos bzung byas pa'i// sgrub pa dkyus su ma chod na// gong ma'i rjes su snyogs par dka'// 'gran zla med pa'i chen po khyed// dpal ldan nā ro paṇa chen gyis// ku sā li yi rnal 'byor pa// che thabs spangs pa'i til+li la// bcu gnyis bar du bsten byas te// dka' ba rnam pa bcu gnyis kyis// bla ma mnyes par byas pa las// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob// gong ma'i rjes 'jug rnal 'byor pa// che thabs nga rgyal rab spang nas// lus dang srog la sogs pa yis// bla ma mnyes par ma byas na// gong ma'i rjes su snyogs par dka'// bod du 'khrungs pa'i lo tsā ba// rje btsun mar pa lho brag pas// yab yum rang yul longs spyod dang*// lus srog bde skyid thams cad la// ltos pa med pa'i snying stobs kyis// bgrod par dka' ba'i rgya gar du// dpal chen nā ro'i drung du phyin// rgyud sde bzhi yi man ngag gis// rang gzhan thams cad smin par mdzad// snying stobs med pa'i rnal 'byor pas// gong ma'i rjes su snyogs par dka'// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la des// zwa tshwa med gsol ba'i spyod 'gros kyis// gangs kha ba can gyi ri khrod du// ras rkyang pa gcig gi na bza' gsol// nyal ba med pa'i 'dug lugs kyis// lo bzhi bcu lon pa'i bgres po des// dus rgyun chad med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// rlung srog rtsol gnad du bsnun pa yis// gtum mo ye shes me 'bar nas// mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub brnyes// sgrub pa snying por mi byed pa'i// bdag gi spyod pa 'di 'dras kyang*// gong ma'i rjes su snyogs par dka'// mtshungs pa med pa'i rje btsun pa// 'gran zla med pa'i 'gro ba'i mgon// mnyam med bla ma rnam gnyis kyis// bslab gsum rin chen rgyan thogs nas// stong dang snying rje dbyer med pa// spros med lhan cig skyes pa yis// rang gzhan thams cad smin par mdzad// rang sems chos skur ma rtogs na// gong ma'i rjes su snyogs par dka'// gong ma'i rjes su ma snyogs na// bdag lta shi dang ci ma 'dra// yang grub thob brgyud pa'i bla ma la// rang snying dpang du btsugs pa yi// gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs// gangs kha ba can gyi ri khrod du// brgyud pa gong ma'i rjes 'brangs nas// brgyud pa gong ma'i mdzad spyod kyis// dus rgyun chad med par gnas par smon// gangs kha ba can gyi ri khrod du// che thabs zang zing ma mchis kyang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdan sa der// sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur bas// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi bde skyid la// rtsol sgrub med par shugs kyis spyod// gangs kha ba can gyi ri khrod du// nye du gnyen 'brel thams cad kyis// sems sdug bsngal drag po mi bskyed kyang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro rnams// dus rgyud chad med par byin gyis rlob// gangs kha ba can gyi ri khrod du// 'jig rten spros pas mi g.yeng ste// byar med kyi ngang du sos dal skyong*// rje gong ma'i rjes su ma bslabs na// thugs la btags pa don re chung*// byin gyis brlabs pa chud re zos// gangs kha ba can gyi ri khrod du// rje gong ma rnams kyi spyod 'gros kyis// gangs kha ba can gyi ri khrod du// dus rgyun chad med par gnas par shog/
