// 363) ༄// nyon mongs che 'bring chung gsum spong sems drag po dgos pa sdom pa rin chen// 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa dang*/ lam bskyed rdzogs bsgoms pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma la gtor mas mnyes par byas pa dang*/ bla mar bsnyen bkur ba dang*/ rdo rje spun la tshogs kyi 'khor lo drangs pa dang*/ mdor na dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang dang gang bgyis pa des/ lus kyis sems can thams cad la phan thogs par gyur cig ces pa nas/ de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig /ces pa'i bar du'o// lus sems gnyis kyis ma myong ba'i// gsang sngags kyi gdams ngag che ba kun// chos rgyal bla ma'i zhal snga nas// chos mkhyid gang ma zhes bka' stsal gsung*// mkhyid gang ma yi dam chos kyis// rang la phan nam gzhan la phan// 'khor 'das kun gyi yon tan ma lus pa'i// 'byung gnas khams gsum kun gyi skyabs gcig pu// bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu spong ba'i sems// sdom pa rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa don du gnyer ba'i rten gyi gang zag sgrub pa pos/ yon tan rin po che rgyud la ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang*/ skyes pa gong nas gong du bogs 'don dgos pa/ de gang 'dod kyang gong du yon tan ma skyes pa'am/ bogs ma byung ba'i rgyu la bltas te/ de ngos zin nam mgo 'am gos la me shor ba'am/ pang du sbrul 'ongs pa ltar/ shin tu myur ba'i brtson 'grus kyis spang bar bya ste/ ma spangs na ni bskal pa grangs med pa gsum bas/ grangs med pa bye ba phrag mang por yang lha dang mi'i go 'phang tsam yang mi thob na/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ rgyu med pa'i 'bras bu ni mi srid pa nyid do// de la yon tan ma skyes na mi skye ba'i rgyu ngo shes par bya ste/ yon tan gang yin yang mi skye ba'i rgyu ni/

de rang du ltas pas rang gzhan bas lhag pa/ mngon par mtho ba dang*/ nges par legs pa gang yin pa de la yon tan zer la/ yon tan de rgyud la skye ba rang gi snga ma'i lus ngag yid gsum de spong dgos/ spangs pa'i tshul lugs khyim pa'i rtags spangs pa dang*/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags yang dag par blangs nas khyim dang 'dre ba med par/ zas bsod snyoms gos phyag dar khrod/ gnas shing drung du bcas nas klog pa'i 'khor los de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung*/ phung po lngas bsdus pa sdug bsngal ba dang*/ de 'byung bar byed pa'i rgyu kun 'byung*/ de 'gag pas 'gog pa'i rgyur 'gro ba'i thabs/ lam gyi bden pa la nges pa'i shes pa bskyed pa ni/ tha mal pa'i ngag spang pa'o// de skad du 'phags pa ba glang bdag gis/ tshul khrims rin po che bre mo'i gtam gyi bar chad ma zhugs sam zhes dris pa lta bu'o// tha mal pa'i yid spangs pa ni/ spong ba'i sems ni thob pa la// tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa brjod// ces slob dpon shan+ta de ba la sogs pas gsungs pa'i don/ ltung ba sde lnga nyon mongs pa dug gsum po che 'bring chung gsum spong bar gsungs pa/ mi gtsang spyod dang rku ba ni 'dod chags rags pa/ mi gsod pa ni zhe sdang rags pa/ mi chos bla ma ni gti mug chen po lhag ma'i sde dang ltung ba byed dang*/ spang ba'i ltung byed ni 'bring*/ bslab par bya ba'i chos ni tha ma ste/ de ltar nyon mongs pa che 'bring gsum spong ba'i bsam pa drag pos/ srog la bab kyang tshul khrims mi gtong ba zhig dgos la/ de yang kā ri kā nas/ gdug pa sbrul gyi khar bcug bla// lus la dka' thub mi bshig ces// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis bka' bstsal to// zhes pas srog la bab kyang mi gtong ba zhig dgos/ de yang sdom pa len pa'i dus su ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du khas blangs pa las dus 'di dang 'dir gnang ba'i skabs yod pas ci bder yang bya'o zhes dam bcas pa med pa dang*/

de bzhin gshegs pas mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung bar mkhyen pas de gnang ste mi mchi/ lar gnang ba'i gnas skabs bstan pa mar 'grib pa dang*/ yul mtha' 'khob tu gyur pas gang zag gi blo bcos pa'i 'dul ba yul chos su song bas gnang ba mang yang*/ dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu lta ci yang ma tshang ste/ lha dang mi'i 'bras bu tsam mi thob pas/ srog la bab kyang sems brtan pos bsrung ba ni/ yon tan ma skyes pa'i rgyu spong ba bstan pa'i/ spyir srung sems med pa'i gang zag dang*// bsod nams bsags pa chung ba dang*// dad med bdud kyi dbang song dang*// shes rab gsum gyi mig med pas// thub pa'i bstan pa 'jig par byed// lhag pa'i tshul khrims sun 'byin cing*// rgyu dang 'bras bu khyad du gsod// rje rin po che yi zhal snga nas// rgyu 'bras la nges shes ma skyes na// sdig pa che yang rgyan du mthong*// gsungs/ lar rgyu sngon du song ba'i 'bras bu la// lang kar gshegs pa la sogs pa// theg pa chen po'i mdo rnams su// de bzhin gshegs pas bkag pa dang*// dge slong phyi rkon 'dug lugs dang*// sha yi nyes pa mthong tsam na// za bar 'dod pa skyi sha tsha// dngos su za ba 'jigs kyang 'jigs// chang dang phyi dro'i kha zas rnams// bza' bar 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang*// khas blangs dam tshig nyams pa yis// ngan song gsum du mi 'gro ba// dus gsum rgyal bas ma gsungs pa'i// gdams ngag zab mo su las rnyed// bu rang la snying brtse yod gyur na// dran pa'i mel tshe 'bad par gyis// dran dang shes bzhin bag yod pa// chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba zhes// thub pa'i dbang pos gang gsungs pa// dran pa tsam du gcig na yang*// dran pa gzung yul tha dad do// spyir 'gog pa'i bden pa gzhir bzhag nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa skye ba dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab mang po dang*/

slob dpon 'phags pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che'i bzhed pa yang rnal 'byor pa'i blo'i dus tshod so sor thar pa zhes bya'o// 'gog pa de rang gi yon tan ma chags pa/ zhe sdang med pa gti mug med pa'o// de stobs 'phel ba zhe sdang med pa stobs 'phel ba la byams pa dang snying rje dang*/ yang na byang chub kyi sems so// //

364) ༄// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i snying gtam tshig gsum dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgyal seng la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' med pa rnams// gnyis med byang chub sems kyi gser 'gyur rtsis// sangs rgyas sku gsum bde ba chen por bsgyur mdzad pa// mnyam med bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// ku sā li yi gsang tshig 'di// nyams dang yon tan bskyed pa la// nor bu rin chen 'dra bar 'gyur// mi bzad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'di// rang nyid yin par ma shes na// tha snyad tshig la chags pa rnams// spang bya gnyen por ma shes pas// 'bad pa byas kyang 'bras bu med// spang bya 'khor ba ngos zin na// gnyen po de dang dbyer med gnas// gnyis ka rang gi bsam pa yin// bdag med bdag tu 'dzin pa de// gti mug ma rig chen po yin// bdag 'dzin nam mkha'i pad+mo la// chags sdang rtog pa'i mo sham bus// chos brgyad me tog kha dog bltas// khams gsum 'khor ba'i grong khyer du// dug gsum sdug bsngal lo 'bras de// 'khrul pa'i byis pas rgyan du thogs// mdzes su re yang phung nas mchi// skyid du re ste sdug nas mchi// skyabs dang bral ba de dag gis// skyabs mgon dkon mchog gsum po btsal// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog de// gzhan du rnyed pa ma yin te// mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa la// snying gtam 'dun gros dris pa'i blo// rtsa ba bdag 'dzin ma rig pa// skye ba med par rtogs pa'i tshe// spang blang med pas rang sar grol// rang gi gshis la 'pho 'gyur med// 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub// 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// spangs thob bzang ngan phyogs ris med// gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa// spros dang bral ba'i chos skur 'gyur// sangs rgyas dkon mchog 'di nyid yin// 'di la mos shing bsten pa rnams// skyabs 'gro dang po thob pa yin// skyabs su song ba'i phan yon la// nged rang da lta spyod pa la// mi chos mdun mar mi brtsi zhing*// thar pa'i srog rtsa mi gcod 'tshal// gnyis med 'od gsal chen po de// rtogs pas sems bskyed thob pa yin// dri med byang sems rin po che// gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje des// bag chags rtog pa'i sgrib pa rnams// bcom zhing spangs pa'i bye brag la// sa dang lam zhes mkhas pas gsungs// mig med rmongs pa'i byis pa rnams// sa lam mi 'dod ji ltar lags// goms pa mthar phyin sangs rgyas la// spang bya gnyen po gnyis med na// gzung 'dzin rnam rtog ga la yod// gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba ni// sems dang sems las byung ba yi// 'jug pa nye bar zhi ba ste// rdo rje 'chang gi zhal snga nas// sems med sems las byung ba med// zab mo bka' bstsal gsungs pas so// skyabs chen sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang*// bu skad cig tsam yang ma bral dang*// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs nas mchi// 'di spang bya gnyen po gnyis med kyang*// gti mug dag pa'i lag rjes yin// yang gang la zhen pa skye ba'i yul// rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang*// mtho dman bzang ngan thams cad kun// thugs gnyis 'dres pa'i gong ma la// 'gro ba'i don du gtong na yang*// 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa yis// chags pa gsum dang bral gyur la// sems can khams dang gong ma'i thugs// chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa des// 'khor ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho rnams// sems can rnams la ma smin na// sems can rnams kyi don ched du// bsngos pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams// sems can rnams la ma smin pas// rgyu 'bras phyin ci log tu nges// sems can kun la smin gyur kyang*// byas pas mi rtag nges pas na// skye zhing 'gag par 'gyur zhe na// dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag kun// sems can don du bsngos pas na// sems can khams rnams zad pa dang*// dge ba zad pa nyid du gyur// zad med sems can khams rnams dang*// 'gro ldog gcig tu nges pa 'o// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// stong pa nyid du gnas pas na// bsngos kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba des// phan dang gnod par mi 'gyur ro// snyam pa'i rtog pa skye na yang*// 'khor gsum dag pa'i rnam gzhag kyang*// khyad par myong bas ma phye bas// stong ngo snyam pa'i rnam rtog la// don dam bden par byas pa yin// 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa ni// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po yi// dge ba'i rtsa ba gang byed rnams// gnyis su med par gnas pas na// byed pa thabs dang ma bral zhing*// byed pa byed med rab rtogs pas// gnyis su yang ni mi 'gyur te// byed pa med pa'i byed pa 'dis// 'khrul par gyur pa'i sems can la// 'khrul pa'i rnam pa byung gyur na// 'khrul pa med pa nyid la 'god// sgyu ma'i rten 'brel zab mo 'di// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis// blo yi yul du ma gyur pas// mi ldog sems dpa' chen po la// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba zhes// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa yin// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi// yon tan dpag tu med pa yang*// 'khor bar 'jigs pa'i blo gros kyis// thar pa 'dod pa'i bsam pa yis// bsod nams bsags pa'i mthu med na// nyan thos rang rgyal gang nas byung*// thub pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho rnams// bsod nams tshogs las byung ba ste// sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan// dpe byad 'od zer rab 'bar zhing*// zhing rnams kun tu skus khyab pa// dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ye shes can// rgyu med 'bras bu las skye'am// yon tan med par gyur ba med// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su zhig zer// des na rgyu lam 'bras bur yang*// rten 'brel zab mo nyid du gnas// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi srog gcig pu// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gsung gi gces pa gsang ba'i mdzod// dam chos dkon mchog rin po che// 'di la mos shing bsten pas kyang*// chos la skyabs su song ba ste// rtag chad lta ba spangs nas kyang*// sangs rgyas sras su gyur ba yin// dam chos 'di ni gang rtogs pa// sems bskyed dam pa thob 'gyur te// 'khor 'das rang gzhan thams cad kun// gnyis med rgya mtsho cher bzhugs nas// sa lam yon tan rdzogs par byed// mthar thug rgyal ba'i yon tan sku// mi zad gter chen 'di nyid dang*// bu skad cig tsam yang ma bral cig

/yang dge dang mi dge ngos zin na// zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig pa med// sdug bsngal phung khrol bskyed pa'i gzhi// snying rus chen por mtshan gsol ba// zhe sdang rus shing chen po 'di// byams dang snying rje'i stobs su bsgyur// byams dang snying rje'i stobs 'phel na// byang chub sems la ngang gis 'jug /byang chub sems kyi gser 'gyur rtsis// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// byang chub mchog la 'god par byed// bem po sra ba'i dngos po rnams// 'og min gnas mchog dam par 'gyur// gtong ba'i shugs dang stong nyid la// bskal pa bye ba grangs med par// rgyun chad med par rtag gnas kyang*// byang chub sems kyi rgyu med na// 'bras bu sangs rgyas mi 'byung ba// khyed mkhyen pa can gyis dgongs kyang dgongs// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gsung rab 'o ma krogs pa'i bcud// byang chub sems 'di yod med las// dam chos yod med ma mchis te// rna bas thos pa tsam gyis kyang*// 'khor ba'i bag chags zad par byed// gus pas bsten nas skyabs su song*// rgyud la skyes pa'i sems bskyed de// byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin du// rang nyid gyur pas sa la gnas// stong nyid bsod nams tshogs kyis kyang*// bsam pa 'di yi stobs 'phel bas// sangs rgyas sku gsung thams cad kyis// 'gro drug sems can ma lus kun// bde chen sa la 'god par byed// byang chub sems 'di dge ba ste// 'di la 'dun par gang byed pa// de ni dge 'dun dkon mchog ste// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gdung rgyud 'dzin pa sras kyi mchog /dge 'dun dkon mchog 'di nyid dang*// bral bar ma byed rnal 'byor pa// de ltar dus gsum rgyu la gnas pas sems can khams yin pas// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho bzlog pa'i dam chos sde snod gsum// bslab pa gsum la bslab pas sku gsum 'bras bur 'grub// rdo rje theg pa gsang sngags mchog tu gang gis rab bshad pa// de yang 'di las gzhan zhig yod pa ma yin pas// skyabs mchog dam pa 'di dang khyed cag bral bar ma byed cig

/thos dang bsam pa'i shes rab kyis// spyod dang rang gi mtshan nyid la// chags dang thogs pa mi mnga' yang*// ku sā li yi gzhung lugs la// nyams len don thag chod bzhed pa// dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgyal seng bar// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// snying gtam tshig gsum bshad pa 'di// snying dang 'dra bas thugs la zhog /'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba des// 'gro rnams sku gsum thob par shog/ // 365) ༄// phyag rgya chen po gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin skyong stangs// bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// nang par dang por sems bskyed/ de nas yi dam bsgom/ de nas bla ma bsgom/ de'i rjes la phyag rgya chen po nyid pril le bsgom gsungs/ rin po ches ni thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor byas gsungs/ dkon mchog gsum sngon byung ba de yin na ji ltar du bsgrubs dgongs pa la rje phag mo gru pa dang mjal nas/ dkon mchog gsum dang 'khor ba de gnyis ka yang bsam par go gsung*/ 'khor ba bsam pa yin te/ rnam par rtog pa 'khor ba'i rgyu yin te/ de yang bzang rtog bskyed rim bsgom pa la sogs pa dge ba'i las 'dus byas pas lha dang mir skye/ ngan rtog nyon mongs pa'i kun slong byas nas mi dge ba 'dus byas pas ngan song du skye ste/ ji skad du/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// zhes gsungs so// dkon mchog gsum yang bsam pa yin te/ gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa thog ma nas yod pa rnam par mi rtog pa/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gzigs pa/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba de dkon mchog gsum yin te/ mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na// mkha' bzhin byed pa med par mngon// zhes gsungs so// de ltar 'khor 'das gnyis ka sems su go zhing*/ sems de yang rtog pa med pa mya ngan las 'das pa chen po dang*/ ro gcig dang ro mnyam chen po'i rnal 'byor zhes ming gi rnam grangs yin te/

ji skad du/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// gnyis su yod pa ma yin te// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin shes pa nyid// mya ngan 'das zhes brjod par bya// zhes gsungs so// rnam par mi rtog pa de yang rnam pa gnyis te/ zhi gnas kyi bde gsal mi rtog pa dang*/ lhag mthong gi bde gsal mi rtog pa'o// zhi gnas kyi mi rtog pa ni/ ci yang mi tshor ba gnyid log pa lta bu ste/ phyi ba dang khams gong ma'i lha 'ba' zhig bzhin no// de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin de'i rgyu ni rtsa rlung gi rten 'brel gyis 'byung ste/ rtsa gnyid log pa la sogs pa'o// gsal ba ni mig phye ba dang btsums pa khyad med pa zla ba shar ba lta bu dang*/ gnyid 'od gsal du song bas nye ba dang ring ba la sogs pa'i yul mthong ba yin/ de'i rgyu rlung dbu mar tshud pa la sogs pa yin te/ bde ba ni shin tu bde ba ste/ de yi rgyu ni phyag rgya bsten pa dang*/ gtum mo tsan+d+ra li bsgom pa la sogs pa yin no// de ltar gsum po de 'tshogs sam re re yang rung ste/ gzugs med pa dang 'dod khams su skye ba'i rgyu yin pa dang*/ lha tshe ring po bzhin du log lta dang skur 'debs kyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis smad pas spang zhing dor bar bya/ de lta bu de yang bsgom 'dod 'dod po de rnam rtog mang ba la gnas skabs kyi drang don tsam yin/ rje rin po che mtha' rtsa bas ni zhag gsum phyin chad mi 'jog gsungs/ lhag mthong gi mi rtog pa ni thog ma nas yod pa gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin ngo bo bde ba/ rang bzhin gsal ba/ rnam par mi rtog de yang nyams sgrib thams cad dang bral ba yin gsungs/ de lta bu skye ba'i rgyu yang bla ma byin rlabs dang gdams ngag ldan pa gcig dang*/ slob ma mos gus dang ldan pa zhig gis 'khrul 'khor gsum la brten nas skye ste/ re shig lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni rkang pa dkyil dkrung che chung ran par bya/

thur sel gyi rlung dbang du byed pa yin/ rkang pa g.yas phyir bton na bde ba yin/ sgal tshigs bsrang*/ lag pa spu mtshams su mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya bkan te bya/ g.yas steng du bde ba yin/ rked pa dgye dgu ran pa drang por bzhag mig gnya' shing gang tsam du dbab ste/ drang por bzhag go /ngag gi 'khrul 'khor smra brjod dang bral bar bya/ sems kyi 'khrul 'khor bya byed dang bral bar bya/ de rnams kyi rten 'brel 'dzom pa las skye gsungs/ yang phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa'i dus su/ bla mar gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ yi dam sgom pa dang*/ snying rje dang dad gus la sogs pa drag po sgom pa'i bya byed dang bral bar bya'o// de rnams bsgom pa'i dus su phyag rgya chen po sgom pa'i bya byed dang bral bar bya ste/ cig car ba yi sman chen la// rim gyis pa yi dug tu 'gyur// rim gyis pa yi sman chen la// cig car ba yi dug tu 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// spyir gnas dben par bsgom pa yin/ dben par bsgom pa'i dus su/ yid mi dga' ba dang*/ snying 'phar ba la sogs pa dang*/ tshig pa za na shes pa ha cang bsgrims drags pa yin pas/ tshogs su cha la mnyam du bsgom/ tshogs su de bzhin byung na dben par bsgom/ gang du byung ba'i dus de bzhin du gzhan du yang bsgom gsungs/ yang sgom pa'i dus su rnam rtog drag po dang*/ nyon mongs pa 'phel na/ bar du gcod pa 'jug pas thabs gang gi sgo nas kyang spang bar bya gsungs/ yang dus ma yin pa dang*/ nam gyi cha stod dang cha smad la gnyid spangs te/ gdon dang nad la sogs pa thams cad gnyid la 'khra brten pa ba yin pas gnyid spang gsungs// // 366) ༄// kun la sman pa'i rgyu 'bras rten 'brel zab mo'i bdud rtsi gtung bar gdams pa// kye ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// 'di las 'di 'byung nges pa yi// phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel 'di// dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs// lus sems gnyis kyi gnas lugs la// lugs 'byung lugs las ldog pa'i chos// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel zab mo 'di// bde gshegs bla ma'i gsung las rnyed// 'brel med tshig gi be'u bum la// zab pa'i gdams ngag re ba kun// nga bzang gi gsung skad 'brug ltar sgrogs// shi na pham por mi mchi 'am// rang rgyud pa spo'i sa gzhi la// byams snying rje'i sa bon ma btab par// 'bras bu sangs rgyas re ba kun// tug gis thug na bslu bar nges// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po yi// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel ma go bar// bzang po khyad du gsod pa rnams// rang la 'khor nas mi mchi 'am// soms dang rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// 'di ni bla ma'i gdams ngag ste// rang gzhan kun la sman pa yi// bdud rtsi 'di ni btung bar bya//

367) ༄// skal ldan sems thag chod pa'i zhal gdams nyams len sgron me// rang sems bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// gdams pa zab mo zhig btsal dgos snyam na/ chos thams cad la mi zab pa med/ sems gtan la 'bebs par gcig bla ma'i byin rlabs khyad che/ bla ma gdam la mos gus bya ba dang*/ des blo sna bsgyur ba gdams ngag zab pa yin no// bgegs la sogs pa mang bas srung 'khor dgos snyam na/ nyon mongs pa'i dug tu rnam rtog rgyun bcad dang*/ 'gal rkyen thams cad mthu rdugs par nges so// thos pa yang dgos par 'dug snyam na/ sems phyag rgya chen po gnyis med kyi ngang du sdod dang*/ chos thams cad de'i steng du gzhol zhing 'bab/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang bsgoms pas go ba yin no// las rgyu 'bras bshad pa ltar bden nam mi bden snyam na/ zhing bla ma dam pa dang yi dam yang rang sems/ chags sdang gi yul yang rang sems yin pas/ dge sdig ci byas rang sems la smin nges pas bden no// gdams ngag gi rgyus mang po yang dgos snyam na/ spyir 'dus byas mi rtag pa rang gi sems thog tu 'bros 'ded go na de yin no// nā ro chos drug la sogs pa'i thabs lam yang ma bsgoms snyam na/ tha mal pa'i sems dang bral bas phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nas snang srid yi dam lha las ldang 'jug med na/ thabs lam thams cad bsgoms pa yin no// 'gal rkyen sel ba dang mthun rkyen bsgrub pa'i las tshogs bsgrub dgos snyam na/ phyag rgya chen po gnyis su med pa'i ngang nas byams snying rje rgyun ma chad par bsgoms na/ las thams cad 'grub pa bdo ba yin no// 'dag sbyar ram dben par bsgom dgos snyam na/ rnam shes tshogs drug yul rkyen gyi rjes su ma 'brangs par dran pa yengs pa med pas 'phong dang gri skor mkhan 'thab pa lta bur ma yengs pa gnad du che'o// bla ma bzhud pa'am rang 'gro bas bsten du ma byung snyam na/

spyir thams cad sems yin/ phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nas bla ma ma brjed na bla ma dang ma bral bar bsten pa yin/ byin rlabs 'jug nges so// lta spyod sgom gsum thag ji ltar gcad snyam na/ sems gdod ma nas ma skyes shing gnyis med blo las 'das pa lta ba/ de las ma yengs pa sgom pa/ sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa spyod pa yin te/ lus ngag yid gsum gyis nyon mongs kyi las mi bsgrubs pa so sor thar pa'i sdom pa/ ci byed thams cad sems can gyi don du byed pa byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa/ de'i ched du lus lha/ ngag sngags/ sems phyag rgya chen po dang ma bral ba rig pa 'dzin pa'i dam tshig gsum gcig pa ni bstan pa spyi'i babs/ nyams len thams cad 'dus pa/ chos kun dang mthun pa rin po che'i lugs kyang lta sgom spyod gsum gcig par bzhed pas thag de ltar bcad do// 'bras bu mthar thug pa gang yin snyam na/ snang srid thams cad sems/ sems gnyis su med pa'i ye shes su rgyas pas sku gsum mi zad pa'i gter ro// grangs kyi gnas gzhan dang po yi// nyams len gsal ba'i sgron ma 'dis// skal ldan sems thag chod par gyis// 'dis ni kun la phan par shog/ // 368) ༄// phyag rgya chen po snying po don gyi gdams ngag lnga ldan dang dam tshig brgyad ldan// bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas// phyag rgya chen po snying po don gyi gdams ngag 'di la don lnga yin gsungs/ de yi gdams ngag brgyud pa dang ldan pa/ lta ba rtogs pa dang ldan pa/ sgom pa nyams myong dang ldan pa/ spyod pa ro snyoms dang ldan pa/ nges shes kyis skyon bsal ba dang ldan pa'o// dang por phyag rgya chen po don brgyud kyi gdams ngag tshig rgyud tha snyad du ma shor ba/ mi bar khyis ma chod pa zhig dgos te/ de yang dpal rdo rje 'chang nas bla ma rin po che yan chad do// gnyis pa lta ba rtogs pa dang ldan pa ni/

don spyi tsam 'jal ba de ma yin te/ bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis rang sems skye med rtogs na rnal 'byor pas/ sems nyid skye ba med pa dang*// snang grags 'di gnyis dbyer med par rtogs pa ste/ chu dang 'khyag rom mam/ til dang til gyi mar bzhin no// gsum pa sgom pa nyams myong dang ldan pa ni/ rang sems spros pa mtha' dag dang bral bar rtogs pa'o// bzhi pa spyod pa ro snyoms dang ldan pa ni/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje ro snyoms/ snang ba stong pa ro snyoms/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal ro snyoms/ nad 'byung ba bzhi ro snyoms dang ldan pa'o// lnga pa nges shes skyon bsal dang ldan pa ni/ phyag rgya chen po'i dam tshig brgyad yin te/ de yang rang sems skye med du rtogs kyang bla ma rdo rje slob dpon mi spang*/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa nas dam pa'i chos 'dul ba yan chad la zab mi zab dang*/ grogs po la sogs pa'i skyon mi brjod/ yar sangs rgyas la re ba med kyang chos spyod rgyun mi bcad/ mar 'khor ba la dogs pa med kyang kha na ma tho ba phra rags la 'dzem par blta/ ting nge 'dzin chur mi bying ba la sogs pa yod kyang rang che ba'i nga rgyal mi bya/ 'khor 'das gnyis su med par shes kyang lta spyod gzhan dang bstun/ sangs rgyas dang sems can rgyud gcig tu rtogs kyang snying rje rang shugs la skye ba/ sgom pa mnyam rjes med kyang dgon pa bsten par bya'o// phyag rgya chen po'i dam tshig brgyud pa snying po don gyi gdams ngag bsdus pa rdzogs so// // 369) ༄// yul la ma blta sems la ma blta zhes pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen jo sras kyi zhu chos// na mo rat+na gu ru/ skyabs chen bla ma dkon mchog la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// sngon sbyang tshogs chen dpag med kyis// da lta thub pa'i bstan pa la// skye ba mi lus rin chen thob// dpag med yon tan gter gyur pa// dge ba'i bshes gnyen jo sras kyis// zhus pa'i gdams ngag rin po che// skur gcig gsung ba'i gdams ngag 'di// tshul bzhin nyams su blang bar zhu// khams gsum sems can thams cad kun// mi rtag srin po'i khar chud pas// yun ring zhig tu sdod dbang med// glog dang chu bur ji bzhin du// rtag pa med par thugs la zhog

/byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// yi dam lha la nan tan bsgom// dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// bla mar mos gus tshad du bskyal// bsags pa can gyi gang zag gis// bla mar mos gus skyes pa'i tshe// rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo 'di// tshig dang yi ges ma bslad cing*// snyam tsam rtog pas ma bkab pa'i// rang byung sems nyid ngo bo mthong*// ngo bo gzugs med mthong ba po// sgra med thos pa po yang med// dri med snom pa po yang med// ro med myong ba po yang med// reg med reg pa po yang med// sems med sems las byung ba'ang med// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa'i don// tshig dang yi ges ma bslad pa// don gyi snying po rang gi sems// mtha' bral gnyug ma'i ngo bo de// sems la bya byed med pa mthong*// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// yul la ma blta sems la ma blta gsungs// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal dang*// mi mthun rkyen rnams thams cad la// gong du smos pa'i sbyor ba byas// de nas de nyid btsir gyis bzung*// de yi ngang la bzhag gyur cing*// rgyun chad med par bskyangs gyur na// sprin tshogs mkha' la yal ba bzhin// mi mthun rkyen rnams rang sar grol// des na dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis// rgyun chad med par bskyang bar zhu// // 370) ༄// 'phags pa sangs rgyas phal po che rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba dam pa// 'phags pa sangs rgyas phal po che rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba las// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig /ces gsungs so// bdag dang sems can ma lus thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dge ba 'dis// bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kun// bde ba mchog thob sdug bsngal bral nas kyang*// mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog

/bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags shing yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig de bzhin dbyer med rtogs gyur cing*/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga*// rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa'ang nga*// 'jig rten ston pa bsgrub bya nga*// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa nga*// de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// bsngo ba 'di dang mthun par 'jug /bdag ni tshe rabs thams cad du// 'di 'dra ston pa'i bla ma dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral zhing*// 'di 'dra skyob pa'i dam chos kyis// rang gzhan thams cad smin par smon// slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas// zung 'jug go 'phang la gnas pa'i// slob bzhin pa yi rnal 'byor che// zung du 'jug pa bsgoms gyur pas// spyod pa'ang de dang gnyis su med// zhes pa'i don dang mthun pa 'o// lus ngag yid gsum ma go na// bu ba glang rkang gnyis yi re mug /nyams rtogs nang nas ma skyes na// sgom kha slob byas pa'i kha na med// phar la smras pa tshur la bzlo// dper na brag cha lha mo 'dra// bu ba glang rkang gnyis yi re mug /mos gus sems la ma skyes pa// dben par bsdad pa'i kha na med// bskungs pas nyams rtogs skye mi srid// nam phyed nyi ma 'tshol ba 'dra// bu ba glang rkang gnyis yi re mug /bsod nams rang gis ma bsags par// 'gro 'dug mang po'i kha na med// gang du phyin yang rnyed par dka'// yi dwags grong khyer chen po la// bu ba glang rkang gnyis yi re mug /nyon mongs nang du ma zhi na// gdams ngag mang po'i kha na med// phan pa bas kyang gnod pa che// dug sbrul 'o ma blud pa 'dra// bu ba glang rkang gnyis yi re mug /bla ma spyi bor ma bkur na// che thabs yod pa'i kha na med// dgos pa'i nang par phung nas 'ong*// klu mchog nor bu bzhag pa 'dra// bu ba glang rkang gnyis yi re mug

/byams snying rje nang nas ma skyes par// khe grags bsgrub pa'i kha na med// zas nor god kha shor ba bas// gshed ma'i grong du phyin pa 'dra// bu da rung khyod kyis ma go 'am// dran pa rgyun chad ma shes na// lus ngag tab tab kha na med// byas pas 'grub par 'gyur mi srid// spun pa brdungs pa'i 'bras bu 'dra// bu da rung khyod kyis ma go 'am// 'di stong nyid bdud rtsi dam pa mchog /lha chos dam pa ma yin yang*// mi chos 'dun ma zab mo yin// nyams rtogs skye ba'i thabs yin yang*// rtogs pa skye ba'i rgyun yang yin// gzhan la smras pa ma lags te// yid mug rang la skyes pa yin// // 371) ༄// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len u rgyan rgyal po in+d+ra bho dhi zhes pa// na mo rat+na gu ru/ badz+ra dharma ka ya ni// u rgyan rgyal po 'dul ba 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// u rgyan rgyal po 'gro ba'i mgon// dug gsum 'khor ba'i bag chags rnams// bde chen lhan cig skyes par sbyong*// 'khor dang bcas pa mkha' spyod khrid// ces pa'i don ni bus nyon dang*// zab pa'i gdams ngag bshad rgyu yod// shin tu zab pa'i gdams ngag ni// theg pa chen po gsang sngags yin// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la// nyams len in+d+ra bho dhis byas// shi gtam tshig tu brjod pa ni// nyon mongs lam du byed pa yin// de yang rten 'brel gsum gyis 'grub// phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'o// de kho na nyid kyi rten 'brel ni// gnyis med bde chen lhan skyes su// gnyis su 'dzin pa'i bag chags sbyong*// gsang ba rten cing 'brel 'byung 'di// 'dod yon lam du 'khyer ba yin// phyi yi rten 'brel zab mo ni// 'khor dang bcas pa mkha' spyod khrid// nyon mongs ma spangs rnal 'byor pa// dbyings su grol ba ngo mtshar che// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus kyis// rtogs pa skyes pa ma lags sam// lar gyi 'dug tshul ma shes na// ci byed 'khor ba'i gzhung lam yin// sems skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin la// yod ma myong la khyad par chos// spang bya gcig dang gnyen po gcig

/nam mkhar byas pa'i mdud pa rnams// ji srid nam mkha' ma zad par// rtog pa'i mdud pa ga la zad// nam mkhar go ba rnams kyis kyang*// bzang ngan stong len mdud pa rnams// 'ching grol stong len med pa 'di// khyed mos gus can gyi ma go na// da rung mos gus bya ba'i yul// bla ma dam pa ma go bas// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten par gces// lar lta ba'i mthar thug tog tse ba// mig gi rnam shes rtog pa yis// gnyis med ye shes ngo mtshar che// ngo mtshar can gyi rnam pa drug /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams kyis bsten// med kyang ku re bgyis pa lags// nged ni 'dul ba 'dzin pa yin// khyed rang gsang sngags ci dgar spyod// 'du shes 'dod chags bral la sdom min ga la yod// gang la sdom dang sdom pa ma yin rlom sems med// 'di ni tshul khrims sdom pa rnam par 'dren pas gsungs// // 372) ༄// 'gro mgon bla ma'i dam chos sems bskyed dang bsngo ba mthil yin pa// oṃ swasti/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// ma lus gcig gyur 'gro ba'i mgon// mnyam med bla ma la btud nas// rang la brtse ba'i grogs po la// kha gsag g.yo sgyu ma yin par// snying gtam tshig gcig gdams ngag 'di// ma brjed thugs la bzhag par zhu// 'gro mgon bla ma'i dam chos rnams// sems bskyed bsngo ba mthil yin pas// yang yang dpag med byed pa de// lag len yin pas khyod rang mkhas// ma 'ongs dus na bdag nyid kyis// bla ma'i zhabs tog byed gyur zhes// smon lam tsam du 'debs pa la// dngos su grub pa ngo mtshar che// theg chen gsang sngags dam tshig ni// dam pa bla ma dam pa ste// tshig ni de yi gsung yin pas// ci gsung sgrub pa dam tshig mchog /dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas// ji ltar byas kyang tshe gcig gis// sangs rgyas thob par bshad pa de// grogs khyod rang yin no logs na med// bya dang byed pa gang la yang*// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// bkag pa gnang ba'i skabs yod pa// khyed rnal 'byor pa yi sems la dris// nyon mongs dug gsum rnam rtog rnams// dpag med skyes par gyur na yang*// spong sems mi dgos ngang du glod// chu dang chu rlabs tha dad min// rang la bde skyid byung ba rnams// bla ma'i bka' drin yin pas na// pho rgod mi bsam phud kyis mchod// 'di yis bde skyid 'phel ba yin// sdug bsngal dpag med byung na yang*// lam du btang zhing gsol ba gdab// lnga ldan grub na rab tu bshad// 'di la mdzad pa'i rgyu ru bzhed// bde dang sdug bsngal gang snang yang*// sems su go bar byas nas ni// chags sdang rtog pa rab spang la// gcig shos grags pa'i man ngag mdzod// stong dang snying rje dbyer med pa// sgom dang ma sgom spros pa yi// mtha' bral rang sems rdo rje dang*// grogs khyed la rtag tu mi 'bral zhu// dman la rngan chen mi byed cing*// bzang la chags pa mi mdzad pa'i// mnyam nyid byams pa'i chu bo de// grogs khyed kyi rgyud la shugs kyis 'bab// sbyangs ldan mkhas pa ma yin pas// nor 'khrul gong mar bzod par bzhes// dge bas lus can ma lus kun// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog/

373) ༄// gnyis med bde ba chen po'i mchod pa dam pa mdor bsdus su bkod pa// ltas ngan thams cad kyi yang rtse/ mi sdug pa bco brgyad kyi snying po/ legs pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ bde legs thams cad kyi gzhi rten/ chos thams cad kyi de nyid/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i srog snying*/ sangs rgyas sras dang nyan thos rang rgyal lha rnams dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bde skyid chos rnams 'byung ba'i gnas/ mchod pa kun gyi mchog gyur dam pa des// dus gsum 'khor 'das ma lus thams cad kun/ gnyis med bde ba chen po gcig tu mchod par bgyi'o// // 374) ༄// bstan bcos kyi rgyal po thabs snang ba'i me long zhes pa// na mo rat+na gu ru/ gting mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// 'gro kun thugs rje chen po'i lcags kyus 'dzin// bde chen go 'phang mchog la 'god pa yi// thabs mkhas bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// phrag dog zhe sdang bsam pa yis// gzhan pas rang mtho 'dod pa ni// zhe sdang mnar sems chen po yin// de yis sgrub pa byed pa ni// phrag dog zhe sdang bsam sbyor byed// ci tsam sgrub pa byas pa ltar// phan dang bde ba'i 'bras bu bcom// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang*// ring du gyur ba ma yin nam// yang khyed kyi bla ma dam des// zhe sdang bsam sbyor drag po yis// rang gzhan phung bar gyis dang zhes// rang la gdams par gyur tam ci// khe grags bsnyen bkur 'dod pa yi// ri dang thang dang thag ring du// phyin nas thos bsam sgom gsum gyi// yon tan bsgrub par byed pa yang*// 'dod chags bsam sbyor mthar phyin pas// thar pa'i 'bras bu brlag par byed// yang nged kyi slob dpon gong ma rnams// 'dod chags bsam sbyor drag po yis// rang gzhan phung bar gyis shig ces// nged la gdams par gyur pa de// nyams su len par gyur tam ci// thos dang bsam pa'i shes rab spangs// sgom pa'i shes rab skye ba'i thabs// dben pa shing drung tsog bu sogs// sbyangs pa'i yon tan mi bsten cing*// snyes

rgyab snyes pa shing nyal la sogs pa yi// gnyid rmugs sgrub pa byed pa yi// thabs rnams ston cing grub na yang*// gnyid dang rmugs pa thams cad kyis// bsam gtan bar du gcod nas kyang*// gong ma'i lhag mthong shes rab ni// nam yang skye ba mi srid na/ khyed kyi bla ma dam pa des// gnyid dang rmugs pa la sogs pa// bsam gtan sgrib pa 'di dag gis// zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong gi /ting 'dzin zung du 'brel ba ni// cis kyang skye bar 'gyur ro zhes// gdams shing bstan par gyur tam ci// bdag gi bla ma dam pas kyang*// bdag la de ltar ma gdams shing*// skyob pa shākya seng ge dang*// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang chen gyis// mdo rgyud rnams su ma gsungs shing*// grub thob brgyud pa gong mas kyang*// de ltar bshad pa ma mthong na// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams// rang gi rgyud la skyes pa dang*// skyes pa spel zhing smin pa'i thabs// ri khrod dgon pa bsten bya zhing*// nyon mongs spyod pa'i 'gol sa dben pa na// ri dwags rmas ma ltar bsnyags shing*// nyon mongs gsum gyi dmigs yul la// bskyed rdzogs log par dmigs nas kyang*// nyal zhing snyes pa la sogs pa// gnyid du ci 'gro'i 'khrul 'khor dang*// lus ngag spyod pa thams cad kyis// nyon mongs 'phel ba'i thabs bsten pa// rgyu las dang nyon mongs bsten pa las// tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar dor yang*// sdug bsngal phung po 'byung ba de// bu bdag cag rnams kyis ma shes pas// tshe 'di dang phyi ma thams cad du// phan zhing bde ba'i thabs la 'bad// tshe 'di rnyed bkur grags snyan la// rtag gam mi rtag bsam mno btang*// rtag pa med na mi rtag pa'i// rang gi lus dang grags snyan gyis// dgos pa ci yang med pa de// blo yi phugs su bzhag nas kyang*// khe grags spros pa'i ltos thag re thag bcad// 'khor ba gting mtha' med pa na// ngan song gsum la sogs pa yi// sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras bsams nas kyang*// rgyu las 'bras bu byung ba rnams// dam chos mngon pa la sogs pa// sde snod 'dzin pa'i skyes bu la// btud nas shes par bya ba 'am// nyon mongs gsum las ngan song gsum// dge ba bcu las lha rnams dang*// dge ba bcu dang byams pa dang*// snying rje bsam gtan snyoms 'jug gis// khams gsum 'khor ba'i 'bras bu smin// 'khor ba sdug bsngal nyid yin zhes// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa dang*// de yang lha gnas gong ma rnams// gong mar skyes pa'i tshul lugs ni// byams pa rgyud la skyes nas kyang*// byams pa 'dod cing chags pa dang*// byams pa bdag gir byas pa yin// ji ltar srin bu'i kha chus ni// rang las skyes pa bcings pa ltar// byams pa skyes pa'i lha gnas la// snying rje'i bsam gtan la sogs pa'i// skye ba'i rgyu dang bral ba la// 'bras bu gong mar skye mi srid// de bzhin bsam gtan bzhi po dang*// bsam gtan snyoms 'jug gong ma'i lha// gong mar skye bar 'gyur pa ni// snying rje bsam gtan snyoms 'jug rnams// rgyud la skyes shing thob pa la// 'dod cing chags pa bral ba bas// gong nas gong du 'pho ba yin// 'khor bar skye bar byed pa'i rgyu// shes nas rgyu las ma log par// 'bras bu sdug bsngal mi 'gog pas// 'gog pa'i bden pa mngon du bya// sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras sus 'gog pa'i// 'gog pa mngon du byed pa la// sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gyur ba'i lam// mngon du bya ba bslab pa gsum// so so skye bo'i khams rgyud la// ji ltar skyes pa'i rim pa bzhin// phyi dang nang la 'dod chags dang*// bral bar gyur pa'i dge sbyor ni// 'dod pa'i khams su mi skye zhing*// de bzhin dga' dang bde ba dang*// btang snyoms rgyud la skyes pa la// 'dod cing chags pa dang bral bas// rdzu 'phrul la sogs mngon shes lnga// rim gyis rgyud la skyes nas kyang*// zag pa zad pa'i shes pa ni// bdag med rtogs par 'gyur ba yin// bdag med rtogs par gyur pa yis// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i// sems dang shes rab rnam grol zhing*// dgra bcom chen po zag pa zad// las dang nyon mongs rang rgyud kyis// khams gsum 'khor bar mi skye ba// nyan thos 'bras bu thob pa yin// 'di yang gnas skabs 'bras bu zhes// slob dpon 'phags pas gsungs pa dang*// 'bras bu nyan thos rang rgyal la// rgyal sras rnams kyis smad pa dang*// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i ma rgan rnams// snying brtse med pas spangs pa la// ha cang glo ba ma rangs pa'i// rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po rnams// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// theg chen pha rol phyin drug gis// sems can thams cad smin par mdzad// de yang snying rje chen po yis// sems can smin par byed pa ni// theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi// rgyu dang lam la gnas pa yi// 'bras bu mngon du byed pa yin// 'di yang lus ngag yid gsum gyi// 'khrul 'khor gnad la brten pa yis// nyams gsum sprin gyi tshogs 'dus nas// dga' skyid spro ba'i char bab ste// nyon mongs rtog pa'i rdul 'tshub kyang*// ngam ngam shugs kyis zhi ba dang*// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa yis// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyang*// rim pa bzhin du skye bar 'gyur// de ltar nyan thos rang rgyal dang*// theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyang*// brtson 'grus can gyis 'grub pa yin// rtsa ba med pa'i mi rnams la// lo 'dab tshig gi sdeb sbyor tshogs// mang po smras kyang mi phan pas// yengs pa med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// sgrub pa snying por byed pa gces// bstan bcos kyi rgyal po thabs snang ba'i me long zhes bya ba rdzogs so//

// 375) ༄// phyag rgya chen po'i sgom chen la don gnyis ngam ngam shugs kyis grub pa// nyes pa kun las rnam grol zhing*// yon tan kun gyis brgyan pa po// rang gzhan don grub rin po che// bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad mor 'dud// lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma 'dir// 'gro don mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor pa// phyag rgya chen po'i sgom chen la// rnam pa gnyis su 'byung ba yin// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen ltar// rang gzhan don rnams 'grub pa dang*// 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa yang*// rtsub cing gdul dka' thams cad kyang*// la las bya byed mi dgos par// ngam ngam shugs kyis dul ba dang*// shin tu gdug pa'i sa phyogs su// ngang gis yun ring bzhugs pa dang*// gdul bya dag pa'i tshogs rnams dang*// ngam ngam shugs kyis byung gyur nas// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che// bslab gsum rgyas par mdzad pa ni// byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa 'am// yang na sangs rgyas sprul pa ste// deng sang dus na byung ba yi// dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po yin// gcig shos dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni// sngon sbyang dad pa'i shugs rgyas pas// dpal ldan bla ma'i mos gus kyis// phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa skyes// rtogs pa'i phyag rgya chen po yis// bag chags rnam rtog mtshan ma rnams// rtsa ba chad cing brtag mi bzod// rnam pa sna tshogs cir yang 'gyur// des na rnal 'byor chen po de// gza' gtad spyod pa nges pa med// 'di byas 'di byed 'dun ma yis// rtsis dang go rar mi chud pa// gza' gtad med pa'i rnal 'byor 'di// skyes thob sprul pa ma yin te// rang rgyud bsgrub pa'i sgom chen yin// kha tsho sna tsho ci 'dra yang*// slob pa lam la gnas pa yin// yang na dge 'dun tshogs la brten// yang na gcig pur dben par bsdad// de 'dra'i thabs dang bral ba na// rgya la gal te rnal 'byor pa// yang na gnas brtan chen por 'gyur// bar dang sdums dang gnas brtan mdzad// 'khrug dpon bud smad can du 'gyur// zang zing spros pa'i dbang song bas// rang gzhan thams cad cir 'ong yang*// da rung ma nges pa la gnas// a la la dang a dzi dzi// lar gyi spros pa'i bya byed 'dis// chos rje bla ma rin chen gyis// mthar thug sangs rgyas mi thob gsungs// skyob pa shākya seng ge dang*// stobs kyis 'khor los bsgyur ba'i mchog

/rin chen bdun dang ldan nas kyang*// gling bzhi 'khor los bsgyur ba yi// bde skyid spros pa spangs nas kyang*// rab tu gshegs shing bsod snyoms mdzad// bcud len la sogs chen po'i sman// spangs nas brkus te bor ba yi// sman rnams bsten par mdzad pa las// byang chub mchog gi shing drung du// bdud tshogs thams cad btul nas kyang*// sems nyid zhi ba'i gshis nyid du// nam gyi tho rangs rdzogs sangs rgyas// lar soms dang rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// gzung 'dzin spros pa'i rnam rtog gis// rang gzhan don rnams grub gyur pa// thos sam gzigs pa yod dam kye// // 376) ༄// rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba'i skor dge slong rgyal ba se ston la gnang ba// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// byin gyi brlabs pa 'gro ba'i mgon// rgyal sras rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang*// phyag 'os kun la phyag 'tshal lo// gang 'di dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsung*// rten cing 'brel 'byung zab mo 'di// byas dang yod par gyur pa nyid// byas pa lugs las 'byung ba ste// yod pa lugs las ldog pa 'o// de yi nyams len 'di lta ste// lhan cig skyes pa yod pa yi// dge ba'i rtsa ba rtogs pa la// yang dag shes rab zhes bya ba// khams dang gnas lugs de nyid la// log par rtogs pa'i bye brag ni// mu stegs pa dang sangs rgyas pa'i// lta ba grub pa'i mtha' rnams kyi// rtog pa thams cad spangs pa dang*// de nyid rtogs par gyur pa'i thabs// rtogs ldan bla ma dam pa la// ji ltar bsten par bya ba dang*// rtogs pa mtho dman bye brag gis// sa dang lam gyi rim pa la// ji ltar nyams su blang ba la// phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lnga// ji ltar nyams su blangs pa yis// mthar thug chos sku thob 'gyur na// chu khams gser dang nam mkha' bzhin// dag pa rnams kyis dag pa yi// yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yi// rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad kyi// tshul lugs ston pas bstan pa 'o// byas pa byas la mi rtag nyid// dge dang mi dge gang yang rung*// skar ma rab rib mar me dang*// sgyu ma zil pa chu bur 'dra// lus dang ngag dang yid rnams kyis// byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cig

/dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba yis// byang chub thob pa'i lam du 'gyur// mthar thug 'bras bu gzugs sku gnyis// thob pa'i rgyu lam 'bras bu yin// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// gnas lugs bzhi dang glo bur gyi// rkyen las byung bar nges pas na// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// bstan pa dam chos thams cad kyang*// 'di las gzhan med nges pa 'o// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// thams cad sems su ma rtogs shing*// sems nyid dgongs pas ma skyes pa// nyams rtogs gcig tu ma grub pas// byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba kun// byang chub mchog tu bsngo ba las// yod pa bsngo ba'i mig med pa// e ma yid mug skyug re bro// yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yang*// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// gdod nas dag cing skye med la// bsngo ba bsngo byed gang mthong ba// dug can kha zas za zhes pa// 'khor gsum nyes par mthong ba dang*// cis stong mi shes rmongs pa rnams// dge med sdig med ma bsngo zhes// 'khor gsum yongs dag mi dmigs pa// dmigs pa'i yul du byed pa yi// blos byas dmigs pa med pa zhes// med par smra ba snying re rje// thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab dang*// shes rab bral ba'i thabs rnams kyis// nam yang byang chub mi thob ces// ston pa'i gsung rab thams cad du// rgya cher gsungs pa ma tshor ram// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgor zhugs shing*// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song ba// ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos// bden gnyis ngo bo dbyer med dam// bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa 'am// bden gnyis ro gcig khas len pa// tshur spyon chos kyi spyan can rnams// rgyal sras rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi// yongs su bsngo bar gang gsungs pa// rang dang sems can thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge ba'i bsngo ba rin po che// 'di yi rjes su zhugs nas kyang*// rtag tu bsngo ba 'di yis bsngo// nam mkha'i khams dang chos kyi dbyings// sems can khams kyi mtha' med pa// mnyam nyid rgya mtsho chen po 'dir// bsngo ba'i rgyal po 'di dang ni// mthun par 'jug pa gang yin pa// de dang mthun pa'i rlung gis ni// sku gsum rin chen gling mchog tu// myur du phyin pa ngo mtshar che// dad ldan brtson 'grus che ba dang*// nyon mongs g.yo sgyu chung ba dang*// chos 'dis rang rgyud sbyangs pa yi// dge slong rgyal ba se ston gyis// bsngo ba 'di la bstod pa yi// dam chos gzhung dang mthun gyur pa// dge slong rin chen dpal la zhus// 'di byas dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis// bdag dang sems cad thams cad kun// rdo rje rgyal mtshan bsngo ba yis// kun bzang go 'phang thob par shog/
// 377) ༄// chos dang chos min 'byed pa sems kyi gros 'debs//

ji ltar ma rig nyes pa'i gzhi// tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed las// 'byung bar gyur na tshul bzhin du// yid la byed pa ci yi phyir// rig pa ye shes rgyur mi 'gro// des na chags sdang bral ba'i sems// mkhas pa su zhig goms mi byed// ji ltar gzung dang 'dzin pa las// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung rnams su// srid pa gsum du 'khor gyur na// gzung 'dzin gnyis med rang sems la// mkhas pa su zhig goms mi byed// dang po'i rnam rtog bdag 'dzin las// bdag gis 'di dang 'di zhes pa'i// 'du byed rnams la 'dus byas na// byas pa mi rtag rten 'brel zhes// ston pas gsungs na ci yi phyir// mi rtog pa la goms mi byed/ rang sems rtog pa la/ sangs rgyas thob pa la/ skye med du rtogs dgos sam mi dgos/ sems la rtog dpyod thongs/ chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba sems kyi gros 'debs 'di/ skal ldan rnams kyi thugs la zhog /skal med rnams la 'di ltar zhu// yar 'gag dang nya gar ma phyin na// dam par bzhugs kyang khral 'jal tsam// rang sems chos su ma song ba'i// lta ba mtho yang thos bsam yin// rang sems chos su song gyur na// ci byas don du 'gro bar mchi// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi khyad par de// rang sems skye ba med pa 'di// rtogs ma rtogs gnyis kyi khyad par las// logs na yod pa ma yin te// bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal snga nas// rang sems ye shes yin pa'i phyir// sangs rgyas gzhan du ma tshol gsung*// dngos 'dzin 'ching ba ma log par// theg pa chen por khas blangs kyang*// 'khor ba'i me dpung bzlog par dka'// gting mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba ru// rnam rtog chu srin gyi khar chud nas// skye rga na 'chi'i nad kyis gzir// nad gso 'am mi gso rang dbang che// 'dod pa'i lcags kyu 'di sna re gzer// chos brgyad kyi 'ja' tshon 'di bkrag re gsal// tshe 'di yi srad bu e re dam// de gcod dam mi gcod rang dbang che// bsags pa rab gyur gyi skyes bu kun// mi lus rin chen khyad par 'di// rnyed par dka' la 'jig par sla// de chud gson nam mi gson rang dbang che// snying nas byang chub bsgrub pa na// 'khor ba me yi phung po la// dga' ba spangs la thar pa sgrub// de sdug bsngal du mthong ngam mi mthong rang dbang che// bla ma dam pa'i drin thob nas// snying rje byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor can// smin lam rin chen dbang bzhi bskur// de smin nam mi smin rang dbang che// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'di// snga nas ma byung da mi 'byung*// don brgyud bla ma rje la mnga'// de bsten nam mi bsten rang dbang che// tshe 'di'i ltos thag rab bcad de// mos gus brtson 'grus rab bskyed nas// ltos pa med pa'i skyes bu yis// bsgrub na tshe 'dir 'bras bu thob// bsgrub bam mi bsgrub rang dbang che// tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgya ba// thabs chen he ru ka la mnga'// don gyis lhan cig skyes pa yin// rtogs sam mi rtogs rang dbang che// khams dgu 'dus pa'i ri bo la// gsang ba sman gcig zhes bya ba// nad kun 'joms pa'i sman gcig gda'// de brko 'am mi brko rang dbang che// rang rig shel sgong dag pa la// rigs drug dri ma mdangs re gsal// 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang nyid la// de phyi 'am mi phyi rang dbang che// rang rig me long g.ya' bral bar// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi gzugs brnyan gsal// gzugs brnyan chos kyis stong pa de// de blta 'am mi blta rang dbang che// bde gsal mi rtog rgya mtsho de// rnam rtog rlung gi rba rlabs 'khrugs// ngang la gnas na zhi lags te// de slob bam mi slob rang dbang che// rang sems nam mkha' dag pa la// snying rje zhen med kyi chu 'dzin 'khrigs// byang chub sems kyi char rgyun 'bab// de 'bras bu smin nam mi smin rang dbang che// ma bcos lhug pa'i sa gzhi la// mos gus dad pa'i ljon shing skyes// snang med shel gyi me tog 'bus// byin rlabs nyi ma'i 'od zer shar// de kha 'byed dam mi 'byed rang dbang che// rin chen ri bo'i bla ma la// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu mig yod// mos gus 'gyur ba med pa yis// de 'thung ngam mi 'thung rang dbang che// mos gus bla ma'i rkyen dag gis// ma bcos lhug pa'i lam la 'gro// re dogs med pa'i grogs dang 'grogs// de 'grogs sam mi 'grogs rang dbang che// snang stong gnyis med zung dang bcas// dran pa yengs med kyi bdud rtsi 'thungs// rtsol sgrub bral bar ngal cig bsos// snyems byed kyi shes pa sgyu ma yin// de blo thag bcod dam mi gcod rang dbang che// khyed kyis gsol btab yi ge yis// bsod nams thob pa gang yin pa// thos dang bsam pa tsam gyis kyang*// tshe 'dir dngos grub mchog thob shog/

// 378) ༄// snang ba sems su shes na 'khor 'das kyi lta ba'i gnas lugs go ba// dpa' bo 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku// mnyam med dpal ldan rin po che// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// snang ba sems su shes pa 'di// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// lta ba'i gnas lugs go ba yin// bde dang sdug bsngal gang snang kun// rang nyid snang bar ma go na// bstan pa 'di las phyi rol ba// des na phan dang bde 'dod pa// rang sems dag la nan tan bskyed// rang sems dag pa gang zhe na// stong nyid snying rje zhes bya ba// byang chub sems gnyis 'dres la bya// bsam pa dag par ma byas na// snang ba dag par mi 'gyur ba// dad pa can gyis ma go 'am// bsam pa dag pa'i rten 'brel gyis// snang ba'i 'char lugs rnam pa lnga// thub pa rnams kyis gsungs pa'i bka'// mdo rgyud rnams kyi brjod bya rnams// phun sum tshogs pa lnga yin gsung*// dang por rang nyid bstan pa 'di// stong pa nyid dang snying rje 'o// de yi gnas kyi mtshan nyid ni// rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs las// legs par grub pa legs bkod pa// ar mo li ka'i rdo leb ltar// mnyen zhing 'jam pa yid 'ong ba// dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba la// rin chen dbang gi rgyal po las// legs par grub pa'i dpag bsam shing*// yal ga lo 'bras me tog la// ci 'dod thams cad 'byung ba des// sangs rgyas rnams kyi phrin las ltar// bde ba skyid pa rgyas byed cing*// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal rnams// sel bar byed pa sman gyi mchog /bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang*// sdug bsngal sel bar byed pa des// byang chub mchog la 'god pa yi// snod kyi 'jig rten nyams dga' ba// rang sems stong nyid snying rje yi// rang snang de ltar byung ba yin// yul ngan la ma zhen rang sems sbyongs// tshe 'di 'am yang na bar do 'am// skye ba phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe// 'og min chos kyi pho brang ngam// yongs su bzung pa med pa yi// zhing khams bla med de dag tu// rang nyid skyid pa rang snang yin// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa'i// grogs kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa ni// theg pa chen po gsang sngags su// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnam grags pa// sa dang lam la gnas pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams// sngon gyi thugs rje smon lam gyis// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams su// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang*// lha min nam mkha' lding rnams su// 'gro ba'i don du cir yang snang*// de dag rnal 'byor dbang phyug la// mthun rkyen sgrub cing 'gal rkyen spong*// de yang 'phags pa thogs med kyis// mgon po byams pa bsgrubs pa dang*// mnga' bdag chen po mai tri pas// dpal ri khrod dbang phyug bsten pa dang*// rgyal sras nor bzang rnam thar las// shin tu rgyas par shes par bya// de ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams// rab 'byams phyogs bcu zhing rnams su// bkra shis bde legs thams cad kyis// rab tu rgyas par yongs bkang nas// sems can thams cad smin pa dang*// nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pas// ji srid nam mkha' ma zad tshe// ji ltar 'dod pa mi zad pas// sems can thams cad smin byed cing*// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten du// dbang che che bar grags pa'i lus// brgya byin dbang phyug tshangs pa dang*// stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba yis// rang dbang med pa'i mthu stobs kyis// thams cad byang chub mchog la 'god// phyogs bcu 'jig rten khams rnams su// shin tu gdug pa bdud kyi dpung*// mi bzad bgeg dang log 'dren rnams// dkon mchog gsum gyi dgrar gyur nas// rang gzhan thams cad brlags pa rnams// thugs rje che zhing thabs mkhas pas// gdug pa de yi gtsor gyur cig

/de dang mthun pa'i spyod pa yis// chags sdang rgyas pa'i gzung 'dzin cing*// tshad med snying rje'i byin rlabs kyis// thams cad 'dun cing rjes gyur na// byang chub mchog la nges bkod pa// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'di// gdul bya'i dbang gis snang ba ste// ji ltar las dang nyon mongs rnams// shin tu rgyas par gyur pa des// 'jig rten mgon po nges par 'byung*// ji ltar phrin las sna tshogs kyis// rdzu 'phrul ngo mtshar rmad byung ba// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*// mi 'bral bsnyen bkur byed pa de// rang sems stong nyid snying rje yi// rang snang de ltar 'byung ba yin// 'khor g.yog ngan la ma zhen par// rang sems sbyongs dang rnal 'byor pa// 'di ltar skyo dub med pa'i grogs// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong tshe// phan dang bde ba skyid byed pa// 'bral med gtan du 'grogs 'dod na// rtsa ba rang gi bsam pa sbyongs// byang chub gzhon nur 'dzin pa ni// nam mkha'i mdud pa dang po yin// de la 'dod dang mi 'dod gnyis// 'dod pa'i 'du byed gnyis pa yin// 'dod pas bod par 'gyur ba ste// de nas zhe 'dod bya byed rnams// 'khor ba'i 'khor lor bla mas gsungs// 'khor ba'i gnad dang 'dug lugs 'di// shes pa tsam gyis yon tan du// bkra shis sgo mang dran pa ste// chu bur rba rlabs bya byed rnams// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ma shes na// yon tan skyon gyi yang rtser 'gyur// dngos grub bar chad chen por mchi// yon tan so sor gang byung rnams// yon tan de 'byung rtsa ba ni// de dang bral ba'i yon tan de// mi 'dzin pa dang bral ba la// mi dbang de la skyabs su mchi// gong ma'i rnam thar min phyir dang*// gzung 'dzin spros dang bcas phyir dang*// sgrub pa'i mi mthun phyogs phyir dang*// bla ma mnyes pa min phyir dang*// bya ba ma yin byed phyir dang*// yon tan gong ma'i bar chad phyir// thub pa'i dbang pos spangs pa'i gnas// khyim bdag rnams kyi bya ba spangs// mi bzad gdug pa'i dug rnams kun// rma bya gser du snang ba zos// spu mdog kha dog mdzes par gyur// ngo mtshar bas kyang rmad du byung*// 'di dag gsang sngags man ngag yin// sems dang sems las byung ba'i chos// lus ngag yid kyi spyod pa rnams// gcig shos grags pa'i rten 'brel gyis// gser du bsgyur zhing gyur pa 'di// ngo mtshar bas kyang rmad du byung*// drang srong chen po nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa'i 'bras bu 'jig rten bya byed sdug bsngal rgya mtsho rab gzigs nas// thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don la mnyam par bzhag cing mnyam gzhag chen pos sems dpa' che sogs 'gro kun smin par mdzad// mnyam rjes shin tu rnam par dag pas bya byed mi mnga' dag pa gnyis ldan dri med chos kyi sku// sku dang gsung dang thugs nyid lhun grub rgyun chad mi mnga' 'gro ba ma lus smin par mdzad pa de la phyag 'tshal lo//

// 379) ༄// gzhan don phun tshogs kyi rgyu nges pa byang chub kyi sems yin pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir mthar thug pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che rang don dang*/ gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu nges pa byang chub kyi sems yin/ byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes pa'i rgyu byams pa yin pas/ dang po byams pa ni/ sems can thams cad a mar bsgoms pas shes pa 'dres shing gdung ba'i blo skyes pa de la byams pa zer/ 'di brtan por song na byams pa thob ces zer ba ste 'dus byas yin pas rtag tu brtan par dka' ba dang*/ byams pa brtan pas kyang lha'i go 'phang las gzhan mi thob pas/ a mar bsgoms pas sems 'dres shing gdung ba skyes pa'i dus su/ rigs drug na gnas pa'i ma 'di rnams kyi sdug bsngal la blta/ bsams shing bltas pas sdug bsngal ba la snying rje skye ba chos nyid yin/ snying rje skyes pa'i dus su nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can ma lus pa thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i bsam pa brtan po zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas skyed cing dam bcas te/ bsam pa des kun nas bslang nas/ de'i ched dus sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol snyam du sems bskyed cing dam bcas nas/ lus ngag yid gsum dge ba'i rtsa ba la 'jug par bya ste/ skabs skabs su dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o// de ltar byas pa'i lus ngag yid gsum la// tha mal btang snyoms nam yang mi srid de// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba thams cad kyis// 'bras bu sku gsum cis kyang thob par nges// rgyu lam 'bras bu byang chub sems su gcig /'di dang phyi ma grangs med gsum la sogs// byang chub ji tsam gcig na thob pa yang*/ brtan nam mi brtan bsam pa rang la 'dri// ji tsam dus kyi byang chub thob bo zhes// dus tshod gtso bor smra ba'i gang zag rnams// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' med pa las// de sngon phan chad grangs med ma song ngam// da yang bsam pa brtan po ma mchis na// grangs med gsum gyi byang chub mi thob snyam// des na byang chub sems la goms par bya/

rigs kyi bu don dam pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams skyes kyang rung*/ ma skyes kyang rung mi 'jig pa ste/ rigs kyi bu de'i phyir na byang chub sems dpa' rnams skra dang kha spu bregs te/ gos ngur smrig gyon pa la yang dag par dad pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ngo*// rab tu byung nas kyang chos 'di kho na thob par bya ba'i phyir/ mgo'am gos la me 'bar ba bzhin du brtson 'grus brtsams shing gnas so// rigs kyi bu gal te don dam pa med du zin na/ tshangs par spyod pa don med par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'byung ba yang don med par 'gyur ro// gang gi phyir don dam pa yod pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams don dam pa la mkhas zhes bya'o// dkon mchog sprin gyi mdo 'di las// tshangs par spyod pa'i dgos pa ni// don dam bden pa yin zhes gsungs// des na rab tu byung ba rnams// rtogs pa don dam rtogs par mdzod// // 380) ༄// grong khyer nyug na wa mo yin zhes pa ri la 'gro ba'i bstan bcos// na mo rat+na gu ru/ tshad med snying rje ma skyes na// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs mi zad pas// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// phan sems gyis dang rang gzhan skyid// dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa la// mos gus tshad du ma bskyal na// yon tan skye ba mi srid ces// mnyam med bla ma rin chen gsung*// nyon mongs sdig pa'i dbang song ba// nyon mongs spyad pa'i 'gol sa la// dben gnas ri khrod dgon pa zhes// rmongs pa khyed la su zhig zer// lhun grub rang byung phyag rgya che// blo yis bcos su med pa la// nyon mongs rtogs pa'i bsam pa yis// chags sdang skye na rdzun po yin// seng chen lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// gangs ri'i khrod du mi gnas par// bsam pa 'dod pa'i rjes 'brangs nas// grong khyer nyug na wa mo yin// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ri khrod pa// bla ma mnyes mdzad mos gus can// sgrub pa snying por mdzad bzhed nas// ri la 'gro ba'i bstan bcos 'di// kun la phan pa'i don du zhus//

381) ༄// nyams rtogs rgyud la skyes pas zang zing spros pas mi gnod pa// chos sku sems nyid gdod ma nyid nas rnam par dag /gnyis med zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// 'gro ba smin mdzad skyob pa thugs rje can// bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// mnyam med dam pa rin po che// u rgyan rgyal po 'gro mgon gyis// 'dod yon 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras kyis// tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub bsgrubs// ku res mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs// e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// rje btsun dpal ldan 'bri gung pa// brgyud pa'i gdams ngag rin po che// nyams rtogs rgyud la skyes pa yis// 'jig rten chos brgyad zang zing btsal// zang zing zas dang longs spyod kyis// slob ris nye du gnyen 'brel rnams// nyon mongs dug gsum nyes skyon sel// pha rje btsun khyod kyi spyod 'gros 'di// zang zing spros pas mi gnod pas// yang na gong ma rnams pas lhag /yang na zhabs 'dren chen po song*// 'di de gang yin ngas ma shes// 'on kyang bla ma rje btsun pa'i// rnam thar sangs rgyas yin nas mchi// sus kyang 'di las ma gleng zhig /lar sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal ba'i sras// don grub skyes bu dam pa des// stobs kyis 'khor los bsgyur ba yi// rgyal srid 'dod yon kun spangs nas// rab tu byung zhing dka' thub spyad// sbyangs pa'i yon tan brtul zhugs kyis// byang chub snying por mngon sangs rgyas// lar nged kyi rje btsun ma gtogs pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun la yang*// 'di 'dra ba yi bcos shig gda'// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams dang*// rgyal sras bdag nyid che rnams la// rnam thar tshul lugs 'di 'dra gda'// lar dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras mchog la// rang gzhan smin pa'i gnyer kha yod// rang gzhan smin pa'i thabs mchog de// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// rgyal ba rnams kyi dam pa'i chos// spros pa med dang mthun pa'i rkyen// sbyangs pa'i yon tan yin par 'dug

/yang sbyangs pa'i yon tan yin par 'dug /kwa sbyangs pa'i yon tan yin par 'dug/ // 382) ༄// rang bas gzhan gces par 'dzin dgos pa'i bslab bya dgra skyong*// oṃ swasti/ na mo rat+na gu ru/ khyed spyir 'gro ba dpag tu med pa la sku gces/ khyad par du nga 'bu 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la sku shin tu gces pa lags pas/ rang nyid srung ba la gces par mdzad par zhu/ de ji ltar byed snyam na rang bas gzhan gces par byas na/ gzhan thams cad kyis kyang rang bas khyed nyid gces par byed pa lags pas/ rang bas gzhan gces pa la nan tan shin tu che bar mdzad par zhu/ de yang yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'jig rten 'di dang ma 'dres pa'i rten gyi gang zag stong pa nyid dang snying rje zung du chud nas/ bya rgyu sems can gyi don ma gtogs pa med pa zhig la/ smon 'jug gnyis kyi sdom pa blangs nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la nan tan bya ste/ 'gro ba thams cad bu gcig pa bzhin du bskyang bar bya'o// de la nged sde pa chen po'i dpon du ni song*/ mtho dman mang po'i las la ni 'jug dgos/ byang chub sems dpa' de 'dra ba'i mi 'ong snyam na/ pha mas bu la brid pa dang*/ bkol ba dang*/ 'thab pa dang*/ brdeg pa dang*/ tshar bcad pa dang*/ rjes su bzung ba bzhin du byams pa dang snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems kyis rjes su bzung bar bya ste/ de yang mdo sde skyes rabs las/ mchod sbyin byed pa'i skyes rabs dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ dgra ji ltar gdul bar bya ba'i thabs/ mkhas pas rang nyid rgyal bar 'gyur zhing*/ gzhan thams cad kyang gnas skabs dang mthar thug thams cad du/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la 'god pa'i thabs la mkhas pa la 'bad par bya ste/ de ni byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod mdo sde zab pa dang rgya che ba rnams las 'byung bas/ dge slong ngam dge tshul chos dang ldan zhing klog mkhas pa dag snyan pa klog tu 'jug cing*/

de la mnyan nas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du nyams su blang bar zhu/ gzhan yang chos kyi rgyal po'i mdzad pa/ rang gi yul ris dang rgyal khams su chos dang ldan pa'i skyes bu dam pa thos bsam sgom gsum gyi nor gyis phyug pa rnams chos dang mthun par bya ba dang*/ phyogs ris kyi mi bsod nams dang yon tan che ba dpag tu med pa rab tu byung ba dang*/ gza' mi dad pa dang shes rab che ba rnams/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi grwa sar khral dmag las gsum las phyung nas/ yon tan rin po che slob tu btang bas nga'i pha dang ma bas lhag pa'i dpon chen po de bdag la shin tu bka' drin che zhes/ sde dang gnyen 'brel thams cad kyis skyong ba chos nyid yin pas/ 'di yang thugs la bzhag par zhu/ mdor na dkar po phyogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas tshogs ma yin pa'i phyogs dang ris su bcas pa thams cad ldog pa chos nyid yin pas/ khyed kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che bskyang ba la 'bad par zhu/ dgra bo nyes par byed pa phung bar 'dod pa rnams dang*/ yun ring du 'thab cing srog chags mang po shi ba dang*/ rmeg med par byas kyang*/ mtha' mar mdza' ba dang mthun pa ma gtogs par bya ba'i thabs mi 'dug pas/ dgra rnams la nged mdza' bar bya'o zhes dbugs dbyung nas dgra rnams rang gi gnyen du 'gyur ba mtshan nyid yin pas/ dgra rnams kyang khyed kyis dgra sar mi bzhag par zhu/ de ltar mdzad na thog mar dge /bar dang mtha' mar kun tu dge /dus dang rnam pa thams cad du// dge zhing bde dang skyid pa'i thabs// skyes chen khyed kyis nyams su blang*// bstan pa 'di yi bcom ldan dang*// de rjes zhugs pa'i dam pa dang*// yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*// bdag cag ring na gnas pa dang*// dgra dang gnyen rnams thams cad kun// khyed la re ba che bar mchis// kun gyi bsam pa rdzogs mdzad gsol// // 383) ༄// bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i bu gcig mi thub zla ba la gdams pa//

bla ma dam pa'i thugs kyi sras// bsgrub pa gtsor mdzad dad pa can// bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes pa yi// bu gcig mi thub zla ba la// ku re kyal ka zur tsam zhu// bde gsal mi rtog zhe 'dod kyis// bla ma dam pa ma spangs sam// lus ngag yid gsum bye brag gis// 'dus ma byas dang ma bral lam// bslab gsum gces pa'i tsab tsub kyis// rang byung gshis las ma g.yos sam// bla ma'i 'dug lugs ma go bas// ngo srung sdug la ma bskyal lam// grogs dang 'byar la ma reg pas// kha nyen dbang chung ma bsgrubs sam// rang sems rnam dag nam mkha' 'dra// yon tan mu mtha' med pa yi// bla ma mchog dang ma bral na// yon tan sprin tshogs 'ubs kyis mchi// rang gzhan gnyis med lhun gyis grub// 'dus ma byas dang ma bral bas// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis// rang don gzhan don lhun gyis grub// gshis nyid don dang ma bral na// nyon mongs rnam dag rang sar dag /zag pa med pa'i tshul khrims la// dus gsum 'phags pa kun gyis bsngags// bla ma stong nyid snying rje'i bdag /ri rab gser gyi ngos dang 'dra// mtho dman bya ba gang byas kyang*// thugs dgongs rdzogs shing gces par mchi// pha ma gnyen 'dun grogs bshes kyis// khur 'khur brtse sems yod gyur na// mnga' bdag srong btsan sgam po yis// gdan thog gcig nas bod khams bskyangs// bu gcig gces se dam pa khyed// gong ma'i go 'phang thob bzhed na// gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar 'di// lta bas khong du chud tsa na// bla mar shes pas sangs rgyas mthong*// dam chos 'di yi nyams len gyis// dge ba gsum po mngon du 'gyur// lhan gcig gnas pa'i grogs mched la// drin bzhag drin brtsi ma byas shing*// yon tan brjod na grags snyan 'phel// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gsung*// 'di ltar nyams su blang bar zhu// ma 'thad na yang bzod par gsol// ri khrod la 'gro thabs lam ji ltar nyams su len/

zhus pas 'di mdzad pa'o// // 384) ༄// gnyis snang gi bag chags sbyong ba blo 'das thugs kyi rdo rje ma// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// a la la ste dpe las 'das// snying rje snying rje kun gyi bdag /gnyis su med pa'i snying rje mchog /snying rje can gyi gang rtogs pa// blo las 'das pa'i snying rje ni// gnyis med snying rje can rnams kyis// gnyis snang med pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// rgyun chad med par gnas par bya// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// khams gsum srid gsum 'khor 'das kun// rig pa'i ngang la ma g.yos pa// rgyu 'bras gdod nas stong nyid 'di// gnyis med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// rig pa brtul zhugs spyod pa yis// gnyis su med par gyur pa yi// gnyis su 'dzin pa'i bag chags sbyangs// de ltar gnyis med thugs rje dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral 'tshal// blo 'das thugs kyi rdo rje zhes bya'o// // 385) ༄// sku gsum lhun gyis grub par rang sems dang mi 'bral ba mdzod ces pa// na mo rat+na gu ru/ dbyer med 'od gsal chos kyi sku// gnyug ma spros dang bral ba la// ngos gzung med par blo 'das te// 'dzin pa'i spros pa sna tshogs kyis// sems nam mkha' chen po bkab gyur na// mkhyen pa'i yon tan nyi zla de// sgrib par gyur pa gdon mi za// bu sku gsum gyi yon tan 'dod pa na// nyams myong gi rtsi la ma 'byar bar// bde chen rgyal po rang sems bsgoms// nga bdag 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog kyang*// ri bong rwa dang mo gsham bu// yod ma myong la khyad par chos// gnyis su grub pa mi srid pas// bu 'dzin pa thongs la rang sems sgoms// rtsa dang rlung dang thig le dang*// sgom dang sgom mkhan thams cad kun// gnyis med rang sar dag gyur na// thabs lam gyi dgos pa rdzogs pa yin// mnyam nyid kyi ngang la mi 'gro na// gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa sna tshogs kyis// rang gzhan don kun ga la rdzogs// bu sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa la// rang gi sems dang ma 'bral mdzod//

// 386) ༄// gong ma'i rnam thar mi 'dzin re zhes nam ra ri zom gyi mgur ma// rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag phyogs med 'du 'dzi g.yeng bas dub// nam ra ri bo'i zom la phyin// bsags pa can gyi rnal 'byor pas// gong ma'i rnam thar yi ge de// snyan pa'i ngag gis tshig tu brjod// rje gong ma'i rnam thar thos tsam na// pha la bu skyes don re chung*// byin gyis rlabs pa 'di chud re zos// 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba 'di yi re mug /rang gi spyod pa 'dis bdag re bslus// rje gong ma rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis// sems la bsam mno bag tsam byung*// rje gong ma'i rnam thar mi 'dzin re// sgrub pa nyams su mi len re// 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba mi skyung re// bya byed spros pa 'di mi gcod re// nor gyi byin len 'di mi 'jog re// rnal 'byor ri khrod mi 'grim re// // 387) ༄// 'khrul pa 'thad pa'i sbyor ba rgyu lam 'bras bu zhes pa// chos kun gdod nas ma skyes spros dang bral// rang byung lhun grub 'gyur ba med pa'i sku// skyon dag yon tan ma lus thams cad rdzogs// mnyam med bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud// 'khor 'das chos 'di thams cad kun// ma lus rang gi sems yin te// sems nyid 'gyur med chos kyi sku// rgyu gcig lam gcig 'bras bu gcig /tha dad 'dzin pas 'khor bar 'khrul// 'dzin pas 'khrul ba'i 'khrul lugs ni// rang gi rig pa 'di nyid la// 'di dang 'di zhes so sor bzung*// nga bdag yod na dgra gnyen du// ji ltar 'dzin pa de ltar snang*// bdag tu 'dzin pa gzhir byas nas// nga ni mi yin snyam pa yi// mir 'dzin shes pa drag po yis// mi nyid du ni nges pa 'di// lta ba zhes ni bya ba yin// mi las gzhan pa gang du yang*// rang nyid mi sems ma mthong ba// bag chags goms pa sgom pa yin// mi chos bcu drug ji bzhin du// legs par spyod pa spyod pa yin// lta sgom spyod pa 'di gsum gyis// mi yi skye gnas thob par 'gyur// phyi dang nang gi yul rnams la// 'dod chags drag pos yi dwags dang*// zhe sdang gti mug byams pa dang*// snying rje bsam gtan snyoms 'jug dang*// 'di ltar yin zhes thag chod cing*// nges shes gting nas skyes pa yi// lta ba nges pa de nyid kyi// ro myong goms pa'i bag chags kyi// sgom pa nyid du gnas pa yin// de dang mthun par spyod pa ni// spyod pa zhes ni bya ba yin// lta ba sgom pa spyod pa des// sgrub pa'i 'bras bu gang yin pa// 'bras bu so sor 'grub 'gyur te// rgyu 'bras gzhan du 'gyur ba min// lta sgom spyod 'bras de dag ni// rim gyis skye bar dgongs nas ni// rgyu lam 'bras bu zhes kyang gsung*// rten 'brel tshogs pas byung ba na// rten 'brel zhes kyang bya ba yin// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// 'jig rten rgyu 'bras de dag ni// 'khor gsum zhes kyang bya ba yin// 'ubs kyis hril gyis dril lags na// 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa ni// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// dmigs pa med pa nyid yin zhes// ston pa shākya seng ges gsungs// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// shes nas ldog par byed pa 'o// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang*// gnas lugs tshul lugs ji bzhin du// nyams su blangs par gyur pa yis// gnas lugs 'dug lugs ji bzhin la// 'khrul pa mtha' dag dag gyur la// 'bras bu chos sku bde chen ma lags sam// spyir tshad ldan bla ma dam pa la// gus ldan gyi slob ma dam pa des// mos gus gcig tshad du skyol lags na// gnyis 'dzin dang nyon mongs rnam rtog rnams// mthar thug gi 'bras bu chos sku de// dus skad cig gcig las 'gyur ba de// mi kha cig gi blo la ma bde yang*// kho mos gus can la bde nas mchi// lar chags sdang kho re chung ba zhig

/sems zhe sdang drag pos rbad tsa na// mi gzhan la gnod du re ba yis// rang gis rang nyid gsod pa de// mi gzhan la 'thad par mi 'dug ste// kho rang gi blo ngor 'thad pa yin// nang sems can la chags pa'i gang zag kun// gcin dang phyi sa klad pa dang*// mi gtsang rul bsungs kyi rkyal pa la// rin smar po mang pos nyos nas kyang*// yul de dang bral na mya ngan skye// bsam shes kyi mi la mi 'thad kyang*// kho rang gi blo ngor shin tu 'thad// yang las 'phro can gyi gang zag la// rin chen dbang gi rten 'brel gyis// bskyed rim goms par gyur pa las// phyi snod kun lha yi gzhal yas khang*// snod bcud kun lha dang lha mor snang*// grags tshad kun sngags su thos pa dang*// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// byin gyis brlabs nas kyang skye med ston// gdod nas sangs rgyas kyi nges shes skye// sus kyang byas pa med par go /lam dman la zhugs pa'i gang zag la// yi 'thad ces bya ba dka' lags te// khyed dang 'thad pa bsdur ba'ang min// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa'ang yin// grub thob brgyud pa'i gdams ngag kyang yin// yang dad pa can gyi gang zag la// spong pa'i bsam pa gzhir bzhag nas// pha ma nye du gnyen 'brel dang*// bde dang skyid pa kun spangs nas// sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis kyis// brtul zhugs dka' thub drag po yis// byang chub rnam gsum bsgrub pa yis// 'ching bas bcings pa'i gang zag la// ha cang 'thad pa dka' na yang*// kho rang gi blo ngor 'thad pa yin// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yis// rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad du// bde bas bde chen bsgrub pa dang*// nyon mongs lam du 'khyer ba yang*// dka' thub mchog tu 'dzin pa yis// mngon shes can la mi 'thad kyang*// in+d+ra bo dhi la sogs pa// gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor rnams la 'thad// chos kun gdod nas ma skyes shing*// spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba la// 'di yin gyi grub mtha' sna tshogs su// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// 'dzin pa'i mtha' la 'chel

zhen pa ba de// khyed rtogs ldan rnams la mi 'thad de// tshu rol mthong ba rnams la 'thad// spyir phyogs 'dzin gyi 'thad pa thams cad kyis// 'dzin pa med pa'i tshul lugs 'di// rtogs shing myong bar dka' bas na// tshad ldan gyi bla ma dam pa la// mos gus skyed la rang sems bsgom// gzhan la bzlas pa ma lags te// rang sems 'khrul pas bskul ba bas// 'khrul ba 'thad pa'i sbyor ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so// // 388) ༄// nged rang pha spad kyi shi gtam dge sbyong bya ba'i rim pa bstan pa// bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// bla med dkon mchog gsum po la// gus pas rab tu btud byas te// bya ba'i rim pa cung zad bri// snying gtam tshig gcig gi man ngag nged rang pha spad kyi shi gtam gyi dbang du byas na/ de ltar dal ba dang 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thob pa'i lus 'di thob par dka'/ 'jig par ni sla/ skye shi la ni rang dbang ni ma thob pas/ nam 'chi yang cha med/ shi nas 'khor ba gting mtha' med par sdug cing bsngal ba 'di yi mug cing mi nus pas/ rang gzhan 'khor ba las ci thar byed dgos/ de la bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gsog dgos/ ye shes kyi tshogs zab pa stong pa nyid yin/ de la shes rab zer/ bsod nams kyi tshogs zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum la brten nas gsog pa la thabs mkhas pa zer/ thabs mkhas pa de yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi rgyu 'bras kyi rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dgag par bya ba'i bslab pa dang*/ bsgrub par bya ba'i bslab pa byang chub sems dpa'i skyes pa'i rabs lnga brgya la sogs pa 'dul ba'i tshul khrims dpag tu med pa rnams kyis nyes pa spangs pa dang legs pa bsgrub pa thabs mkhas pa la bslab par gsungs so// legs par bsgrub pa'i thabs yang*/ zhing dkon mchog rin po che gsum dang*/ de gcig tu gyur pa bla ma dam pa la brten nas/

bsam pa chags sdang rmongs gsum med pa dang*/ de'i gnyen po 'phel bar byed pa'i byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems gsum dang*/ gtong ba gsum dang*/ shes rab gsum po de nyid kyi lus ngag yid kyi las kyis/ tshe 'di nyid kyi sangs rgyas thob pa mi dka' na/ gzhan zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'am/ 'khor ba'i bde 'bras lta smos kyang ci dgos pas 'di la nan tan tu bya'o// de la shin tu phra bar ji ltar bslab na/ zhing bzhi po de la dad pa dang gus pa'i sems gcad du med pa phul du byung bas/ dper na 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi rang nyid kyis ro myong bas/ bu smad dran nas ster 'dod pa ltar/ dge 'dun rnams rang gi 'khor la sbran zhing*/ dga' ba dang*/ 'thad pa dang*/ yid du 'ong ba dang*/ tshogs chen por 'gyur bas bskul bar bya ba ni/ kye gson zhig dge 'dun btsun pa rnams// sang ngam da ste zhag bdun na// nged kyi ston pa bla ma de// ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs nas kyang*// chos kyi khri la bzhugs gyur te// chos char rgyun tu 'beb pas na// de yi bar chad spang pa'i phyir// rtswa shing lo ma la sogs pa// dge 'dun phrin las mdzad par zhu// yang gcig zhu ba'i rim pa ni// kye gson zhig dge 'dun btsun pa rnams// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun nam// dam chos dkon mchog rin po che// gser 'bum la sogs byon pa la// dge 'dun bsrung ba mdzad par zhu// de ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*// sa bdag rgyal po byon pa la// gong mas mdzad pa'i rnam thar bzhin// khyed kyis legs par bskul gyur na// rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa yis// don chen 'grub par 'gyur zhes gsungs// yang gcig dge 'dun btsun pa rnams// kho bo'i bla ma rin chen de// rdzas dang yo byad sbyin pa'i tshogs// dngos po bzang bzang sngon la sbyin// bzang po 'ba' zhig ma gtogs pa// ngan pa gcig kyang mi srid pa// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// dkon mchog mchod pa'i sbyor ba yang*// spos dang mar me la sogs pa// kun la de ltar mdzad par 'dug

/'gro drug sems can thams cad la// 'di ni lhag pa'i lha yin zhes// grib ma'ang 'gom par mi mdzad na// snying nas 'thab cing gshe ba dang*// thugs kyis spong bar mi mdzad pa'i// rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa 'dir// deng sang 'jig rten mgon po yi// sku gsung thugs kyang lha bzhin blta// dge 'dun mnyam par bzhag pa dang*// mdo dang gtor ma la sogs dang*// phyag skor mdo skor mdo dbyangs dang*// chos spyod mdzad pa'i phrin las la// gnag rdzi dga' bo ji bzhin du// bar chad med par brnag pa bskyed// mtha' khob yul du skyes pa yi// da rung skye dri ma yal zhing*// mthon po'i rigs su ma skyes shing*// sprang po gcig tu sku 'khrungs pas// gang la cis 'dul ma mkhas pas// tshig ngan rgya gad gcud rgyangs dang*// shākya'i sras kyi dge 'dun dang*// rdo kha thengs gsum byed pa la/ khyed kyis tshad mar ma 'dzin par// bla ma rin chen rjes su slob// nga yang khyed la mthun 'jug byed// phra bas don chen 'grub pa yi// bya ba'i rim pa zur smos nas// zab mo stong pa ye shes tshogs// gong du smos pa de dag kun// skye med stong pa ma lags sam// skye med stong pa ma yin na// stong pa'i lung dang 'gal gyur cing*// 'thad pa dang yang bral ba yi// stong pa 'di la mkhas pa rnams// dga' ba med cing 'dor bas na// gong du smos par gyur pa yi// bya dang byed pa'i bya ba rnams// bya byed kun dang bral ba yi// mthar thug phyag rgya chen po zhes// rtogs ldan rnal 'byor rnams kyis go /rdzogs so// // 389) ༄// lta sgom spyod gsum ya ma bral bar rtag tu gnas par bya ba// 'di ltar thub pa chen po'i chos// nyon mongs gsum la chags pa dang*// sdang bar byed pa gang yin pas// lha mi la sogs gong ma yi// 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba la// nyon mongs gdug pas dkrugs pa'i yid// 'di yis thar pa mi thob ces// so sor thar pa'i me long la// bltas la nyes pa spang bar bya// 'di ni 'phags pa char ka las// spong mgu spyod pa nyid las gsungs// chos thams gdod nas ma skyes pa/

smra bsam brjod med kyi ngo bor gnas pa la/ smra ba dang bsam pa dang brjod pa rnam pa gsum gyis ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don rtogs par mi 'gyur ba dang*/ rtogs pa rnams kyis kyang rtogs pa de'i don goms par bya zhing*/ smra ba dang bsam pa dang brjod pa med pa'i spyod pas slob dpon shan+ta de ba ltar dus 'da' bar byas nas/ bla ma rin po che'i dgongs pa lta ba'i mthar thug blta bya lta byed thams cad dang bral ba/ sgom pa'i mthar thug nyams myong thams cad dang bral ba/ chags sdang med pa'i lus ngag dang tshul khrims rnam par dag pa zhes pa/ lta sgom spyod pa gcig tu gyur pa la tshegs med pas/ lta sgom spyod pa gsum ya ma bral bar dus rtag tu gnas par bya'o// 'di yang 'di 'ba' zhig tu ma zad de/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad lta ba dang sgom pa spyod pa rnam pa gsum mam/ bsam pa dang sbyor ba mthar thug pa rnam pa gsum mam/ zhing dang bsam pa dngos po rnam pa gsum la sogs pa 'grub par byed pa'i tshul lugs dpag tu med pa zhig bshad pa dang*/ rten 'brel ma 'dzoms pas myur du mi 'gro ba dang*/ yun ring du 'gro ba dang*/ gtan du mi 'grub par bar chad du 'gyur bar shes par bya'o// 'di la blun po nga rgyal can// skyu ra sgom pas 'di skad ces// grib
