la rnam pa gsum gsung ste// bzang ngan grib kyis mi gnod pa// de ni mi pho khyo ga yin// bzang po sangs rgyas byin rlabs dang*// ngan pa sdig pa'i grogs po yi// rgyu zad rkyen zad gang yin pa// dag pa gnyis ldan dri ma med// chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin// chos sku ye shes gnyis med par// gsung ba'i bla ma rnams la 'dud// // 390) ༄// spang blang gi rten 'brel ma shes na rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel log par 'gyur ba// na mo rat+na gu ru/ bram ze'i rigs su skyes nas kyang*// ston pa drang srong chen po'i bka'// dam chos 'dul ba'i sde snod la// nges pa'i shes pa skyes gyur cing*// yan lag rtsis la mkhas pa rnams// bsam sbyor mthar thug gyur pa yis// pham par gyur pa'i ltung ba bzhi// ci nus phyogs med spyad pa yis// mthar thug byang chub thob smra yang*// ston pa'i gsung dang ma mthun pas// nges pa'i shes pa ga la skye// bu kun tshul khrims rin chen srungs// yang gnyis med don rtogs kyi rnal 'byor la// spang blang gi gdams ngag zab mo dgos// spang blang gi gegs sel ma shes na// rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel log par 'grig

/tshig rtsub kyi mtshon cha rnon po yis// gnyis su med pa'i phrag dog skye// rang gzhan gnyis kyi mgo bo 'breg /lhan skyes he ru ka dpal gyis// rgyan du byas pa a re 'jigs// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'di// bred cing dngangs pa a la la// gnyis med don rtogs ma gtogs pa// sangs rgyas yin par yid ches dka'// ru tra chen po'i 'du shes skye// gdul bya snod ldan phal cher yang*// smin cing grol bar mi 'gyur bas// gnyis med don rtogs rnal 'byor pas// spang blang gnyis kyi gegs sel bstan// spang blang gi gegs sel ma go na// yul yul can gnyis su 'dzin pa'i yid// gnyis med 'od gsal ngang du bsad// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// byams dang snying rje rgyun du bskyed// rang bas gzhan gces ci bzang blta// gnyis med don rtogs rnal 'byor pas// zab mo'i rten 'brel 'di ma shes na// mnyam nyid stug po'i zhing khams na// gnyis med kun tu bzang po la// rtogs ldan byang chub sems dpas bskor// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi longs spyod rnams// ma lus rdzogs pa'i sku gyur pa// sangs rgyas yin par 'dren pa yang*// skyob mdzad mgon po rin po che// rten rab tu byung bar gyur ba la// phyi ma ngo mtshar che 'o zhes// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal gsungs// bu rang dang 'dra ba'i grogs se kun// rgyud tshod mthon por song tsa na// thabs la mkhas pa'i grogs po gces// gnyis med don rtogs rnal 'byor pa// thabs kyis ci bya snyam na yang*// ring du song ba'i sems dpa' rnams// shes rab pha rol phyin rdzogs nas// thabs mkhas bstan pa ma mkhyen na// dag pa'i sa la gnas pa yi// mgon po bdag nyid chen po rnams// gnyis med tsam du 'dzin pa'i blo// shin tu phra ba shes bya yi// sgrib pa sbyong bar nges pas na// 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal snga nas// rtog pa'i ri bo bsnyil te thal// chos rnams thams cad gnyis med de// gnyis med de yang rang sar dag

/bdag nyid chen pos bka' bstsal gsungs// de ltar mdzad na rnal 'byor pas// gnyis med gsha' mar rtogs nas mchi// shes rab thabs su 'gyur ba yin// rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel mngon du 'gyur// sangs rgyas kyi mnyam rjes mi brtsi bar// mkhyen pa gnyis po gcig tu go /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba yi// mdzod 'dzin rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur// 'di la mnyam nyid rgyud rgyal du// sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag po mchog /phyag na rdo rje des kyang gsungs// ༈ //yang mi nga ni 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po 'dra// bu sprang po lta bur gyis shig ces// 'khor la zhe 'dod byed pa 'di// snying nas yin nam ku re lags// de las de byung cang srid dam// yang mi nga ni grong 'dab kyi khyi rgan 'dra// bu seng ge lta bur gyis shig ces// 'khor la zhe 'dod byed pa 'di// snying nas yin nam ku re lags// de las de 'byung cang srid dam// yang mi nga ni 'dod yon gyis ngoms pa med// bu 'dod yon zhen pa thongs shig ces// 'khor la zhe 'dod byed pa 'di// snying nas yin nam ku re lags// de las de 'byung cang srid dam// yang mi nga ni tshong dus kyis tshong pa 'dra// bu ri dwags lta bur sdod cig ces// 'khor la zhe 'dod smra ba 'di// snying nas yin nam ku re lags// de las de 'byung cang srid dam// // 391) ༄// rgyu las byung ba'i 'bras bu ni sangs rgyas mthus kyang 'gyur mi srid pa// na mo rat+na gu ru/ bdud rtsi sa zhag lta bu yi// mchog thun mong gi 'bras bu smin pa'i gzhi// gsum ldan gyi bla ma rin po che// bsod nams bsags pa'i zhing mchog ste// mos gus byed pa'i gang zag gis// mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub rnams// 'di dang bar do gnyis su smin// zhing phun sum tshogs pa blo las 'das// theg mchog gi gsang sngags ma gtogs par// thabs khyad par du 'phags pa ma gsungs lags// dngos po phun sum tshogs pa ni// shes rab rgyal po ma da na// thabs kyi rgyal po maṃ sa ste// bdud rtsi lnga yi rang bzhin mchog

/mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams 'du bar byed// zos na nyams myong ting 'dzin skye// thabs shes gnyis po mnyes pa'i rdzas// dngos grub phun sum tshogs pa lags// sa gzhi de las me tog skye// de yis 'gro ba smin par byed// bla ma'i bka' stsal mtho dman la// lan bdun bar du gsol ba gdab// bsams shing rtag dang rang byung bsgoms// ༈ //gshe bar mi 'os rnam pa bcu// ngo mtshar med dang klan ka tshol// byis pa blun po mi gsal ba// mi mkhas mtshams kyi pha rol gnas// mkhas la las dang spyod lam las// ldang bar tshig ma bsdams dang bcu// nyes pa thams cad chos kyi sku// phyag rgya chen por spungs se spung*// rang byin gyis rlob pa 'di ngo mtshar che// spang blang med pa nyams re dga'// ji ltar dus gsum rgyal ba'i chos// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel zab mo la// da lta'i mkhos ka dgos don che chung zhes// chags sdang gti mug drag po yis// mi mgu mi rangs mi bzod kyang*// rgyu las byung ba'i 'bras bu ni// sangs rgyas mthus kyang 'gyur mi srid// 'di ltar drang srong chen po'i sras// zang zing spros pa'i mtshan ma dang*// 'dres sam yang na ma 'dres zhes// sems la blta ba goms pa dang*// zab mo sems nyid rdo rje 'di// nyon mongs rtog pa'i 'dam rdzab tu// bying ngam yang na ma bying zhes// sems la blta ba goms par gyis// 'khor ba res su 'dre byed na// sa thob pa la ring zhes pa// mkhas pa rnams kyi gdams ngag nyon// thub pa bdag nyid chen po'i chos// zhi ba 'dod chags bral ba ste// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad kun// zhi ba 'dod chags bral bar gcig /bden don bstan pa'i bye brag rnams// bram ze rtogs pa can rnams la// rnam par mi rtog pa zhes mtshon// rgyal po zhe gdug can rnams la// yid la mi byed pa zhes bstan// // 392) ༄// rang sems phyag rgya chen po 'di 'khor 'das gnyis kyi rgyal po yin zhes pa//

na mo rat+na gu ru/ rang sems phyag rgya chen po 'di// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi rgyal po yin// dngos med rnam rtog sna tshogs 'di// rgyal po de yi blon po yin// rgyal blon gnyis su med pa de// rgyal po de yi rgyal chas yin// mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa// bde chen mchog la 'god pa de// rgyal po de yi rgyal khrims yin// ji ltar nam mkha'i bya yi rjes// btsal zhing brtag tu med pa ltar// de bzhin rnal 'byor pa yi sems// btsal zhing rtag tu med pa la// khyad par btsal zhing gdung pa'i sems// bya rjes 'dra bar gnas pa la// skye dang 'gag dang gnas pa rnams// gzhan gyi snang ba ma yin nam// zhe 'dod che la ngoms pa med// mthong thos 'dod pa'i mi rnams ni// smyon pa yin phyir bltas shing srid// chos shes khrel yod ngo mtshar can// ji ltar byas kyang btub pa de// rang gi snying dang 'dra ba'i phyir// de yi gnad du gces dgu bzhag/ //

393) ༄// thub dbang sras dang bcas par gsol 'debs 'gro ba'i dpal gyur// 'gro ba'i bla ma chos kyi rje// bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal lo// thub pa'i bstan 'dzin brtul zhugs can// 'od srung chen por phyag 'tshal lo// mang du thos pa gsang sngags mchog /kun dga' bo la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// bdag gi ston pa klu dang 'dra// bdag ni char sdod bya dang 'dra// klu yi rgyal pos char phab kyang*// bya yi gre bar song ba nyung*// rje 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che// dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi zhabs drung du// 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog /nye bar 'khor du 'ong du re// mdo sde 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog /gnas brtan chen po 'ong du re// ma mo 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog /'od srung go 'phang thob tu re// yang 'od srung go 'phang thob tu re// kha tshong kha dor kha na med// dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi zhabs drung du// gtan gyi skyes bur 'gyur ba nges// rgyal ba mnyes par byed pa nges// 'byung ba dus su g.yos pa 'di// zhe 'dod phra mos mi bzlog gda'// bir+wa chen po la gsol 'debs// yang bir+wa chen po la gsol ba 'debs// ji ltar khams kyi ri khrod du// sgrub pa snying por byed pa'i tshe// 'chi ba dran pa'i blo gros kyis// sems sdug chen po skyes pa bzhin// dus 'dir dbye ba'i gnas skabs min// pha 'jig rten mgon po'i bka' bstsal pa// 'gro ba'i don la dpal 'gyur gsol// // 394) ༄// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgra chen rang sems rtogs pa gcig pur gda' zhes pa// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams// sngar yang bka' drin mi chung che// da rung byin rlabs thugs la thogs// char pa ha cang ma ches sam// bya las pa rnams mig kyang phyid// dge 'dun 'dam rdzab nang du bzhugs// char pa cung zad gcad par zhu// lo thog skye 'khrungs smin mdzad gsol// bdag med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa// bla ma mnyes mdzad mos gus can// bla ma dam pa'i thugs kyi sras// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs mdzad pa// phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor pa// goms pa klong du gyur pa la// nyon mongs khong khro ga la rigs// bla ma'i drung du byon pa legs// zhag gsum mnyes mdzad ngo mtshar che// slar yang rang gi gnas su gshegs// yang dang yang du byon par zhu// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgra bo che// rang sems rtogs pa gcig pur gda'// rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang por bzhugs// rnam par rol pa'i mdo las shes// snang ba zil gyis gnon pa la// slob dpon pad+ma rgyal po dgos// glu chung so yi bar na len// len ma myong la ci la yod// gdams ngag thub pa'i gsung rab zab// nyams myong med la ci cha yod// bla ma dam pa tshad ldan gyi// gdams ngag zab mo de 'dra bas// thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyi// gnad kyi sgo rnams 'byed pa yin// de mos gus can gyis go ba yin// myong ba med la ci cha yod// spos sna la gtugs kyang ma tshor ba// phan pa med pa ngo mtshar che// chos rin chen rgyud la ma skyes pa'i// nye gnas de dang e 'dra ang*// bdag gi bla ma bzang ba dang*// bdag kyang mos gus che bar nges// mgon po'i chos thun gcig gcig la// bdag gi dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung*// nam mkha'i me tog mo gsham bu// ri bong rwa dang sbal pa'i spu// mkhan po chen po'i nad dang lnga// gang gi su zhig ji ltar na// bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan gyi// ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs nas kyang*// don kun grub pa'i phrin las zhu// 'gro ba thams cad smin par mdzod// sangs rgyas byon pa'i dga' ba yang*// mya ngan 'das pa'i sdug bsngal yod// dga' dang mi dga' las 'das pa// rang sems mya ngan 'das pa yin// drang srong chen po sher 'byung gi

/khyi gzhug gang la mi gtug 'tshal// thub pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho la// lung khungs thams cad ga la 'ong*// rnal 'byor 'dra bar song ba des// tshogs 'khor 'dra ba bskor snying 'dod// bag pug brag phug 'dra bar bsdad pa des// glu chung 'dra ba len snying 'dod// bu zer ba bden no shin tu dga'// dang por 'jig rten spros pa bcad// bar du 'jig rten zhen pa log /tha mar 'jig rten gnas las 'phags// pha dang ma dang nye du dang*// gnyen 'brel phyogs ris thams cad dang*// bla ma rdo rje spun grogs kyi// zhabs tog che 'o rgyal ba'i sras// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rje// sna tshogs mtho dman thams cad kun// rlung gi byed par thugs su chud// gsang sngags mkhyen pa phyag 'tshal lo// dgongs pa lon la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i jo sras phyag 'tshal lo// gzu ba dpang po chen pos mi khyogs pa// de yi dus su dpon rgan yin// lto ba sgal tshigs 'byar dus su// de yi dus su drang srong yin// me ghe me ghe zer ba'i tshe// khams kyi klog mkhan chen po yis// rtsed mo sna tshogs byed pa'i tshe// pha bzang bu gces yin nam snyam// kun yin gang yang ma yin pa// rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba yin// // 395) ༄// thub pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho'i gnad ston pa sprin chen mdo'i snying po// oṃ ku ri ku ri/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// rang bzhin gcig gyur chos kyi rje// mgon po phag mo gru yi// zhabs la rtag tu spyi bos 'dud// skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs// mgon po de yi zhal snga nas// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// dam chos bla med rin po che// gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad du// legs par gsungs pa thams cad kun// lta dang sgom pa spyod pa zhes// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal to// zhe 'dod lta ba'i lta ba can// de rjes 'brangs pa'i spyod pa yis// de 'dra'i 'bras bu thob pa 'di// 'khor 'das ma lus thams cad kyi// rgyu dang 'bras bu 'byung ba'i tshul// e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams dang*// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yang*// lta dang spyod pa ji snyed pa// thams cad de dang 'dra ba las// dgongs pa rnal 'byor bzhi yang ang*// zab mo bstan pa'i ting 'dzin gyi// lta ba 'gyur med lhun grub las// 'khor 'das ma lus thams cad kyi// spyod pa rgya mtsho bsam yas pa// chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa kun// rnal 'byor pa la 'byung ba 'di// ngo mtshar bas kyang ngo mtshar te// rmad du byung zhing rmad po che// 'gyur med lhun grub ting 'dzin dang*// dbyer med rtogs pa'i lta ba dang*// de dang rjes mthun spyod pa 'di// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis// tshad du gzung bar ga la nus// mdor na rgyal ba nyag gcig las// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// chen po rnams kyi spyod yul min// tshad ldan bla mas ma bzung zhing*// zab dang rgya che'i gsung rab la// blo yi snang ba ma skyes shing*// lta spyod gcig tu ma gyur pas// 'bad pas sug drug bskyod na yang*// sbur pa bal du 'thums pa bzhin// grol bar 'dod kyang dam por 'ching*// ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos// stobs bcu 'dul ba dri med la// spyod pa'i brtul zhugs spyad nas kyang*// dpag med 'gro ba thams cad kun// smin par byed pa dam pa'i chos// 'gro ba'i mgon po'i zhal snga nas// spyod pa blang dor bral ba de// chags sdang med pa'i lus ngag yid// tho co sna tshogs ma yin pa// dgongs pa bla na med pas shes// chos rje bla ma rin chen gyi// sras kyi thu bo rje btsun pa// stag lung thang pa ngo mtshar che// skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs// zab cing rgya che dam pa'i chos// thub pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho'i gnad// sprin chen mdo yi snying po 'di'i// bdag po shes rab 'byung gnas lags// chu yi rgya mtsho'i dus tshod kyi ting nge 'dzin no//

// 396) ༄// 'gro mgon rin po che'i bzhed pa gal che zhes pa dwangs gsal blo yi mun sel// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa la springs pa/ bzhugs sa de/ bla ma rje btsun pa gong mas btab pa dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pas kyang gnyan pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs dang shugs kyis zhi bar gyur pa yin pa dang*/ gnyis pa snang ba rang gi sems yin pa'i phyir sa gzhi dang gzhi de'i bdag po thams cad zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom zhing*/ de las byung ba'i rje btsun spyan ras gzigs su sa gzhi dang yul khams thams cad bsgoms pas yul dang yul can rnam pa gnyis ka la phan pa dang bde bas bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba/ 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che'i bzhed pa 'di gal che/ gsum pa byin gyis rlob par byed pa de yang*/ bu slob chos rten sgrub pa byed pa thams cad kyis gnas byin gyis brlabs zin la/ da rung yang byin gyis rlob par byed pa'i rang bzhin can du mchis pa lags/ khyed kyi dgon pa de dpe med par shin tu legs pa gcig yod par gda' bas/ der yun ring du bzhugs nas/ 'gro ba gzhan la phan pa dang bde ba rgya chen po ci 'byung la dgongs par zhu 'tshal/ de yang gtso bor gyur pa ni/ bdag nyid dge sbyor la nan tan che bar ma byas na/ gzhan gyi rgyud byin gyis rlob par mi 'ong bar/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pa yin pas/ rje rin po che'i mdzad pa zla stod smad dang*/ snga dro phyi 'bred kyi rnam par thar pa de bzung na rang gzhan gyi don mi 'grub cing rgyud byin gyis mi rlob mi srid pas/ de ltar thugs la bzhag par zhu/ bkra shis par gyur cig/ // 397) ༄// gnad kyi nyams len shes dgos pa snying po don bsdus ri khrod dbang phyug la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyis// ston pa'i gsung rab thams cad du// 'di ltar sems kyi ting nge 'dzin// lus kyi mngon du byas pa yis// snang ba dbang du gyur ba dang*// de yi mthun pa'i rkyen rnams dag

/bsam gyis mi khyab dpag med du// 'phel bas mthong chos mngon du 'byung*// thub pa rgyal ba man chad nas// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rnal 'byor rnams// snang ba sna tshogs bsgyur ba dang*// yon tan bkod pa dpag med pa// nyams su myong bar gyur pa rnams// tshu rol mthong ba'i gang zag dang*// zhu thug byed du ga la btub// byas na dpal dro'i sdud pa yin/ khams pa lung pa'i bskol phor dang*// spyan snga chen po'i gser tshums dang*// rnal 'byor dbang phyug nag po yi// skyabs su 'gro ba'i 'dug lugs rnams// bdag cag su dang zhu thug bya// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ri khrod pa// gnad kyi nyams len ma shes na// yar lung dge bshes chen po zhes// 'jig rten gsum mgon chos kyi rje// dpal ldan phag mo gru pas gsungs// don gyi snying po bsdus pa 'di// ri khrod dbang phyug bu la gdams// // 398) ༄// dge sbyor sgrub pa'i mchod pas gong ma rnams mnyes par byed dgos pa// bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum la/ lus gus pas phyag 'tshal/ sems dang bas skyabs su mchi'o// 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che'i 'das mchod/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod pa chen po 'di la/ chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod chen pos rang gzhan gyi rgyud tshim par byed pa yin pa la/ do gcig gi gnas skabs su/ rgyu mtshan mang po zhig gis/ thugs dam dang dge sbyor la nan tan chen pos nyams su blang ba'i bsgrub pa'i mchod pa chen pos/ gong ma rnams mnyes par byed dgos par gda' bas gzhi la bzhugs pa rnams 'dag sbyar dang*/ smra bcad dang*/ dran pa ma yengs pa'i 'bad pas thugs dam la rtse gcig tu mdzad par zhu/ phan tshun du bzhud pa rnams kyang*/ spyod lam rnam bzhir dge sbyor la 'bad pa chen pos 'bad par zhu/ song nas tshur la 'ong bar bzhed pa rnams kyang*/ tshol gsog dang rtsol sgrub mdzod la rgyags bsnoms la chos bzhed pa rnams 'byon par zhu/

gsar pa chos ma tshar ba 'ga' zhig ma gtogs pa/ rnying pa rgyags med pa 'bul ba la re ba rnams rgyu mtshan mang po zhig gis zhabs tog bya rgyu med pas/ phan tshun ri khrod du sgrub pa la bzhud par zhu/ sang nas chos zab mo sha stag byed pa dang*/ sgrub pa tshul bzhin du byed pa la sogs pa chos dang mthun pa mtha' dag ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dus mchod/ bla ma rin po che'i 'das mchod lags pas/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po rnams kyi bzod pa mdzad cing*/ byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ bskyang bar mdzad du gsol/ bkra shis par gyur cig/ // 399) ༄// mkhas pa'i man ngag rgya che chung gsum gyi rim pa zhes pa// ston pa thub mgon chos kyi rje// rnga bo che la sogs pa'i mdor// slob dpon 'phags pa lung bstan pa// zhing srung thabs la mkhas pa'i dpes// rgyal sras bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams// pha rol phyin drug sbyor ba yis// ston pa'i gsung bzhin nan tan bsgrub// slob dpon 'phags pa'i rjes 'brang bya// bho dhi tsit+ta byang sems kyis// zhe 'dod med pa sbyin pa'i stobs// bden drang bsgrub pa tshul khrims stobs// snying stobs bsgrub pa bzod pa'i stobs// myur bar bsgrub pa brtson 'grus stobs// sems rtse gcig tu bsgrub pa bsam gtan gyi stobs// phyogs ma nor bsgrub pa shes rab kyi stobs// mgon po rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis// bsgrub pa 'di yi stobs shugs kyis// rgyal ba'i bstan pa bzung nas kyang*// 'gro ba sman pa'i mthu ldan mod// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ nyon mongs pa gsum dang*/ 'jigs pa dang*/ bya ba dang*/ bya ba ma yin pa mi shes pa dang bzhi spang zhing*/ nyon mongs pa rnam pa gsum gyi dbang du mi 'gro ba dang*/ 'jigs pas mi 'gro ba dang*/ bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa shes pas/ zhal ta dang bya ba thams cad bsgrub par bya'o zhes gsungs pas/ mkhas pa'i man ngag rgya che 'bring chung gsum gyi rim pa/

bram ze chen po gnag las skyes dang*/ sman chen po dang*/ sa ga ma'i rjes su 'brang bar bya ste/ las dang bya ba mtshams tshod kyis byed pas bsgrub par byed pa ni rin chen po chung ngun gyis mi 'grub pas/ chen pos bsgrub par bya ba dang*/ 'bring po 'bring gis bsgrub par bya ba dang*/ chung ngu chung ngun gyis bsgrub par byed pa gal che ba ste/ de yang 'dir bla ma thugs rje che zhing phyogs ris med par skyong 'dod pa'i bsam pas bzang ngan thams cad 'ur rgyag tu byas pas/ dngos po 'tsho ba bza' rgyu dang btung rgyu ni zad/ bya ba dang byed pa ni mi 'grub pas da phyin chad nyung ba nyung bas bsgrub/ 'bring po 'bring pos bsgrub/ rgya chen po mang pos bsgrub pa la tshod dang rim pa ma shes na/ lag skud dam chu gcig pu rang gis kyang lang mi srid pas/ ci tsam dgos pa las lhag pa/ nyal nyil bya ba la mi phan pa mi gzhag pa dang*/ nang na yod pa rnams kyang so so'i las dang bya ba gru bzhi logs brgyad du bcol zhing*/ de ma nus na gang 'dod kyang sar btang ba dang*/ logs su 'jog pa gal che bar 'dug/ //

400) ༄// sems kyi rgyal po goms na yon tan thams cad 'byung bar bstan pa// oṃ swasti/ zab cing rgya che rgya mtsho lta bu'i sku// smon lam mthar phyin 'gro ba ma lus la// theg chen chos kyi char 'beb rin po che// mnyam med bla ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// phung byed mi chos chags sdang kun gyi gzhi// g.yog 'khor nye du sdug bsngal kun gyi rkyen// rang la sems pa'i gang zag gi 'gal rkyen// 'di dag spangs nas bden pa bstan par gces// sems kyi rgyal po goms na yon tan thams cad 'byung*// nyams len brtson 'grus che na sangs rgyas sku gsum thob// 'dod chags bral bar gyur na bde ba rgyun mi 'chad// zhe sdang spang la brtson na byams pa rgyun chad med// gti mug bral na 'od gsal rgyun par gnas// rnam rtog drwa ba chod na gzhan don lhun gyis grub// dman pa'i byis pa nyams su len pa'i thabs// // 401) ༄// gser g.ya' dang bral ba ltar rang sems spros med rdo rje sgom pa// kye rgyal ba'i sras/ de la blo gros chung zhing shes rab dman pa kha cig sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rgyu mi dge ba mi spong bar bde ba dang skyid pa 'bras bu la spyod pa'i gdams ngag cig zhu zer ba byung na/ de ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang mkhyen mi srid na/ rmongs pa gzhan gyis lta shes pa ga la yang srid pas/ de lta bu khas len pa byung na bdud kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'am/ shes rab 'chal pa zhes bya ba bsam mi shes pa'am smyo ba kho nar zad do// 'o na gang zhe na/ thos dang bsam dang sgom pa yi// shes rab zab mos gang rtogs pa// mi dge ba las sdug bsngal rnams// de yi gnyen pos spong shes na// mkhas pa'i gdams ngag bsam mi khyab// nam mkha' mdzod la spyod par nges// yang kha cig nad dang sdug bsngal/ gdon dang gnod pa las dang nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa rnams ting nge 'dzin ma yin pas sel ba'i gdams ngag cig zhu zer na/

bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub kun// sems gzhan g.yengs pas byas gyur na// de nyid rig pas don med gsungs// zhes pas de nyid rig pa ni/ 'phags pa rnams dang slob dpon bram ze chen po dang*/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams yin la/ don med pa ni gnas skabs su nad dang gnod pa la sogs pa dang*/ sgrib pa gsum 'dag pa ni sems g.yengs pas mi srid pas/ de lta bu la 'dod pa ma skyed cig 'o na mu stegs byed kyi sngags kyis phan par 'dug snyam na/ de la yang sems kyi dmigs pa gcig gam/ yang na lus ngag gi gnad cig bcings pas/ bcings pa rang grol ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye/ des nad dang gnod pa 'tsho ba kho na'o// de'i gnad ka yang sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa thams cad kyang sems las byung ba kho na yin la/ de so so re re la sems gnas pa'i dus su/ gnas dus kyis bskal pa'i gnad kas rten 'brel bsam gyis mi khyab pa sgrub shes na ni/ mkhas pa rnams kyi rtsal kha la/ bsam gyis mi khyab cir yang 'gyur// de la dam chos bsam mi khyab// ting nge 'dzin yang bsam mi khyab// mkhas pa rang gi sems la 'dri// lar sems kyi gnas lugs ma go na// kun rdzob bde skyid kyi thabs rnams kun// me yi nang du bsil ba tshol// bu snying gtam tshig gcig 'chad pa de// tshe la long med kyi dus tshod 'dir// log sred tshig gi gdams ngag la// 'dod pa'i bsam pa rab bcad de// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam mchog /bde dang skyid pa'i 'byung gnas gtso// gser g.ya' dang bral ba lta bu yi// rang sems spros med rdo rje bsgom// bu log sred can gyi gdams ngag dang*// rang gi lta spyod mi bstun zhing*// mtho dman gyi gdams ngag sna tshogs kun// rtog pa'i sna kha yin pas na// mthar thug gi 'bras bur ma bsam par// 'gyur med lhun grub 'dus ma byas// bde chen rdo rje rang sems sgoms// // 402)

༄// tshe 'di'i bsam pa ma btang ba'i ting 'dzin ni khras byi'i bcum pa'i nyams rtsal dang 'dra ba// na mo rat+na gu ru/ spyir 'o cag gi mi'i lus rin po che 'di rnyed par ni dka'/ 'jig par ni sla/ 'jig rten 'dir yun ring por ni mi sdod/ sdig dang sdug bsngal thams cad kyis 'jig rten chos brgyad bsgrubs kyang mi 'grub kyi/ pha rol tu grags pa nyams pa la sogs pa'i rgyur 'gro/ grags kyang yun ring por mi sdod/ 'gro dgos pas dgos pa med/ tshe 'di'i bsam pa ma btang ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye bar yang dka' bar slob dpon shan ta de ba'i zhal nas gsungs/ spyir zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin rlung dbu ma'i nang du tshud pas bde ba dang gsal ba dang mi rtog pa stobs 'phel bas/ nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang*/ chu la mi bying ba dang*/ rdzu 'phrul mang po ston nus kyang*/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang ma bral bas/ khras byi'u bcum pa'i nyams rtsal dang khyad med/ de 'dra gcig la gtan gyi bde ba tshol na smyon pa dngos yin/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang bral bar byed pa la/ zhing bla ma dam pa rtogs pa dang ldan zhing snying rje zhe 'dod du ma song ba zhig la/ slob ma 'khor ba dang tshe 'di la blo log pa zhig gis ku re dang kyal ka med par/ zhe thag pa rus pa'i gting nas/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa'i blos gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// gcig tu byas la gsol ba gdab// bar chad gsum dang bral gyur na// gang 'dod 'bras bu myur du thob// 'jig rten blo gros sna tshogs kyis// kha dang bsam pa 'dzol gyur na// g.yo can rang gis rang bslus pas// 'phags pa rnams kyis khrel bar zad// // 403) ༄// de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskyed pa bla ma'i gsol 'debs// rje rin po che yi byin rlabs kyis/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba la de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang ba dang*/

shin tu gang ba dang*/ smin pa dang*/ shin tu smin par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa ni rje rin po che'o// rje rin po che'i sku gsung thugs/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs mnyam pa nyid lhun grub rgyun chad med pa'i gter du gyur pas/ bdag dang bdud kyi dkyil 'khor/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum rnam par dag cing*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs mnyam pa nyid lhun grub rgyud chad med par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pa rgyud la skye bar 'dod pa rnams kyi zhe 'dod kyi tshig go/ // 404) ༄// rtsa bzhi nyams pa'i dge slong dge 'dun rnams dang lhan cig tu gnas par mi bya ba// mi gnas pa dang mi bya'o// chos ni rnam pa bcu yod de/ /rnal 'byor can dang mi dga' ba'i// nan tan 'di la 'ga' tsam gyi// rjes su zhugs par gyur na yang*// khams gsum ting 'dzin mi skye na// byang chub rnam gsum smos ci dgos// 'tsho ba'i yo byad med pa dang*// tshul khrims nyams pa sdig byed dang*// log par lta bas 'jig rten gyi// bzang ngan ltas la chags pa dang*// sems 'phyor ba dang rgod pa dang*// phra ma dga' bas dbyen byed dang*// rtsub po smra bas 'phags pa smod// tshig kyal pa dang rdzun smra dang*// chags dang phrag dog bsam pa yis// gzhan gyi rnyed la mi dga' dang*// zhe sdang bcas shing gnod sems bskyed// rgyu 'bras med par blta ba 'o// gzhan yang rnam pa bcu yin te// las la dga' zhing chags pa dang*// bre mo'i gtam la dga' zhing chags// gnyid la dga' zhing chags pa dang*// zang zing tshol la dga' zhing chags// gzugs la dga' zhing chags pa dang*// sgra dang dri ro reg bya dang*// rtog dang dpyod la chags dang bcu// mi gnas pa dang mi bya ba'i// bya ba 'di la 'ga' zhig dag /byed na ting 'dzin mi 'grub cing*// grub kyang stong par 'gyur ba ni// lha sbyin la sogs 'dra bar gsungs// pha dang ma dang dgra bcom bsad// dge 'dun dbye dang sku mtshal byung*// lnga po mtshams med las yin te// nye bar rnam pa lnga po la// rang sangs rgyas pa bsad pa dang*// dgra bcom ma la mi tshangs spyod// dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor la spyod// slob dge gsod dang mchod rten bshig

/rtsa ba rnam pa lnga po las// nyes pa shin tu che bar gsungs// dkon mchog gsum la ma dad na// mu stegs can la skyabs song ste// ltas su lta ba 'dzin byed cing*// 'jig rten lha la mchod pa dang*// theg pa gsum gyi dam chos la// skur zhing bar chad byed pa ni// tshigs bcad gcig tsam yin na yang*// 'di ni shin tu lci ba yin// srog gcod pa dang ma byin len// mi tshangs spyod dang rdzun du smra// rtsa ba chad pa'i dge slong ni// dge 'dun rnams dang lhan cig tu// gnas par bya ba ma yin zhing*// dge 'dun las rnams mi bya ste// dad pas byin pa'i dge 'dun gyi// dkor la 'di ni mi dbang bas// dge slong dge sbyong ma yin par// ston pas bcas pa yin par gsungs// des na ston pa kun mkhyen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// // 405) ༄// nyams len gnad kyi man ngag bdag 'dzin rtog pa'i khrud shing skyu ra pan mo la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ skyu ra pan mo la springs pa// 'das pa'i dus gsum sngon byung ba// mgon po me tog zla mdzes de// thub dbang 'gro ba'i gnyen gyur pa// pad+ma'i bla mar rdzogs sangs rgyas// rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs bskyed phyir// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong tshe// sku gsung thugs nyid mi zad pa// rgyan gyi 'khor lor gyur pa'i phyir// bstan pa'i bdag po sras kyi gtso// mgon po zla 'od gzhon nur gyur// bdag cag kun gyi don gyi phyir// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa rnams// dwags kyi yul du rdzogs pa lags// dwags po yul gyi sde dgon dang*// de na yod pa'i sems can dang*// dwags por yongs grags bu slob rnams// mtho dman 'bring gsum gang la yang*// lha sa srong ska byur mda' gsum// rang gi gnas su 'dra ba la// bstan pa'i sgor zhugs thams cad dang*// dwags po'i bu slob thams cad la// phyogs cha phyogs ris med dam snyam// spyi dang bye brag thams cad dang*// dwags po'i bu slob thams cad kyi// bsam sa lha sa gcig pu yin// rin po che yi gdan sa de// lag pa g.yas g.yon ma spos pa'i// nga yi bu chen rnam gnyis kyis// ku re rtsed mo byas pa la// byed mkhan nga yin gzhan na med// bdag kyang dkyil na yod pa la// khyed dang gzhan lta smos ci dgos// 'on kyang gdod mtha' bar gsum du// bla ma gong ma'i gdan sa mchog

/lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// mgon skyabs zhig par gyur pa la// sbyor dngos rjes gsum gang la yang*// dga' zhing gtogs pa med mod kyang*// ston pa de yi bstan pa la// dag dang ma dag thams cad kun// mi gtsang skyon gyis bskud bskus pa'am byug pa pa 'di// 'das pa'i rgyal bas lung bstan pas// mi dga' byas pas ci zhig phan// nam mkha'i btson rar tshud pa'i mi// nam mkha' nyid la bros na yang*// nam mkha' nyid las mi thar bar// da rung khyed kyis ma go 'am// las dang nyon mongs shes bya yi// sgrib pa'i bud shing ri bo rnams// bcu chos nyi ma bdun shar bas// bsregs pa de yi 'od zer gyis// rang gzhan ma lus thams cad kyi// sgrib gsum lhag ma ma lus shing*// 'od gsal bskal pa'i me chen gyis// skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs pa'i// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// zab pa'i gdams ngag rin po che// nyams su blang ngam bris la bzhag /legs par dgongs la 'bad pa yis// nyams su blangs na mngon du 'gyur// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen ni// nged rang spad bu las ma mchis pas// 'bad pas thugs dam nyams su blang*// 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pas// nyes tshogs 'khrugs pa zhi ba yis// lha sa dar cing rgyas par 'ong*// bu slob phyogs ris thams cad kun// dga' zhing skyid pas glu snyan len// nga yi bu chen rnam gnyis kyang*// nga yi drung du e mi 'ong*// grub mtha' 'di las med dam snyam// bdud dpung nyes tshogs bcom pa la// dge sbyor gcig pu ma gtogs pa// rgyal ba la yang thabs gzhan med// de phyir 'bad pas dam chos bsgom// snying gtam tshig gcig gi man ngag /mngon mtshan med pa'i thabs sdums// bdag 'dzin rtog pa'i khrud shing*// nyams len gnad kyi man ngag rdzogs so// // 406) ༄// chos kyi stan bshams ma thag phun sum tshogs pa'i phan yon bcu thob par bstan pa//

de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos gang*// zhi ba bshad pa lung bstan pa// chos kyi stan ni bshams ma thag /phun sum tshogs pa bcu thob pa// 'khor los bsgyur ba brgya byin dang*// tshangs pa skye dgu'i bdag po dang*// ston pa'i bstan la stan thob dang*// dbang bskur ba dang byang chub kyi// snying por sangs rgyas thob pa'i bstan// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i khri// cho 'phrul chen po ston pa dang*// mya ngan 'das pa'i khri stan bcu// de dag thob par 'gyur zhes gsungs// byang chub sems dpa' dmigs med la// thal mo sbyar ba byas pa yi// rnam par smin pa gang yin pa// ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa la// thams cad 'dud dang 'drar 'gyur gsung*// chos pa bzang po yin snyam na// da rung nyon mongs kha ma bri// a log pa'i shes pa 'di yi re mug /'khrul pa'i rtog pa 'dis nga re bslus// bka' bkyon bas lta bsod re thang*// lung 'di kun tu brtags las byung*// kun tu rtog pa'ang yod ma yin// bzhad gad rtsed mo'i bar du yang*// dus ma yin pa'i tshig mi smra// dus la bab par smra ba ni// mi g.yo'i zhing der skye bar 'gyur// gces pa'i bu gsum tshad du chug /a tha ling tha ling tha ling lang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyi// rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab la// gdung rgyud so so 'dzin pa rnams// skyabs gsum bslab pa byang sems kyis// thams cad legs par 'ong du 'dra// thar pas sangs rgyas thob pa la// dga' zhing rjes su yi rang 'bul// so so rang gi pha phogs la// spyod cing rnam thar skyong ba 'di// legs shing mi 'thad med pa la// rang la gtad pa'i pha yi phogs// bla ma'i rnam thar mi 'dzin nam// myos pa yin nam chang 'thung ngam// gdon gyis brlabs sam ji ltar gyur// 'gro ba'i mgon po thugs rje can// bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas kyis// thugs rje dgongs nas byin gyis rlobs// sprang po nags khrod dgon par skyol//

// 407) ༄// dran dang shes bzhin 'di nyid chos kyi rtsa bar thub pas gsungs pa// oṃ swasti/ sprang po sro shig mi bzhar phyug po rab tu dbyung*/ /mi chos 'dun gros mi 'dri khrid la nan tan zhu/ /ka ca nga la ma zhu yod pa'i mi la slong*// kun gyi so nam bsgrub pa 'ba' zhig ma yin nam// skye dang rga dang na ba dang*// 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa chen po las// skyob par byed pa'i skyabs gcig pu// dam pa'i chos las gzhan med par// skyes chen khyed la gdams par bgyi// 'khor ba skye ba'i rgyu bzhi ni// tshogs ma bsags dang sdig byas dang*// gzhan gyi dge ba'i bar bcad dang*// dge ba byang chub ma bsngos pa'o// dgra gnyen du chod pa'i dpa' bo dang*// gnyen stong par rtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro gnyis// sems 'gyur ba med pa'i rnal 'byor la// dus rgyun chad med par ko ro ro// dran dang shes bzhin 'di nyid ni// chos kyi rtsa bar thub par gsungs// ma yengs pa dang mi 'da' ba// gnyis pos lam dang dam tshig rdzogs// //

408) ༄// rang la rang bskul nyams len zhes pa tshig rkang drug pa// sems nyid gnad du skyel ba la// gtum mo a thung gi man ngag gces// gsang sngags phrin las sgrub pa la// bskyed rim sgyu lus man ngag gces// zung du chud pa'i rnal 'byor pas// rang la rang mkho nyams su len// // 409) ༄// rgya gar byed lugs a tsar+ya'i sgrub stangs zhes pa tshig rkang bcu pa// yon tan 'byung gnas rgya gar du// byed lugs mkhas pa'i a tsar+ya// las 'phro gang mthun brtag brtag nas// yi dam gcig la sa the dam bca' btsugs// de la rtags mtshan thon pa dang*// skyon dag yon tan kun rdzogs pa// sangs rgyas gcig la thams cad 'byung*// thams cad sangs rgyas gcig yin pas// a tsar+ya yi bsgrub lugs yin// bus kyang de ltar nyams su longs// // 410) ༄// sgom zhes bya ba rnam rtog zhes pa tshig rkang brgyad pa// sgom zhes bya ba rnam rtog ste// sgom du med par rang grol nyid// gnyis snang med pa chos nyid dang*// mi 'bral rgyun chad med pa yin// 'khor ba dang ni myang ngan 'das// gnyis med sems su gcig pa la// 'khrul pas gnyis su snang ba ni// don du yod pa ma yin no// // 411) ༄// sgom pa byang chub yon tan la gnang ba'i gdams pa// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po chos kyi rje// 'gran zla med pa'i dam pa rje btsun pa// 'dun ma sbyar dogs yod do dge ba'i bshes// rjes 'jug sdug tu ma 'jug rin po che// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rje// dpal ldan drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// gsang sngags bdag po bcom ldan 'das// rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs rnams// mngon du gyur cing sdom mdzad pa// rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// rgya mtsho chen po'i mchis 'gram ltar// sgom pa byang chub yon tan khyod// khyod la rnam rtog yod mi mnga'// mnga' na ye shes pha rol phyin// gnas brtan chen po phyag 'tshal bstod// khyed kyi bla ma rin chen ni// la kha'i bya sgro ji bzhin du// rkyen gyis phar sgyur tshur sgyur byed// shing lo rlung khyer zhes kyang grags// ji ltar sngon gyi jo bo rje// dge bshes ston pas bskyangs pa ltar// skyes chen bdag nyid gong ma rnams// nye gnas mchog gis bskyangs pa yin// de phyir shin tu 'bad par zhu// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i sku// 'gro ba'i mgon po rje btsun spyan ras gzigs// byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rab phab nas// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus zhi mdzad gsol// dus gsum rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum// rje btsun 'phags mas de skad gsung*// shes rab can gyi rdor 'byung gi

/dam chos 'jam rkyang phag mo gru// 'phan yul rgan mo'i ser sngags bzhin// pha ri pha ri pha gir song*// dam chos 'di yi gleng lang ni// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel 'grig tshul yin// bu gces se nor bu rin po che// dang por dam chos ma bzung ngo*// bar du dam chos ma bcangs so// mtha' mar shor rgyu ma mchis so// dga' 'o skyid do nye gnas rnams// rul pa mchod pa gcig pus chog/ ༈ //chos rje bla ma rin po che// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ri khrod pas// thabs dang shes rab zung 'brel phul// de dben na yon tan mi skye re// gzhan du chu las bsrubs pa'i mar// rkyal pa bdun bcu tham pa de// 'bri gung pa yi longs spyod mdzod// mkhas pa la mkhas pa'i 'khor gyis bskor// rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi zhing khams 'dra// skyi shod kyi grwa sa ma lags sam// btsun po la btsun po'i 'khor gyis bskor// shākya seng ge'i zhing khams 'dra// dbu ru stod pa ma lags sam// gtum po la gtum po'i 'khor gyis bskor// phyag na rdo rje'i zhing khams 'dra// bla ma rin chen ma lags sam// gdod nas skye ba med pa yi// lhun gyis grub pa'i chos nyid de// rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal yin// gsum po tshogs pa'i rten 'brel gyis// sems su spros pa chod pa de// bsgom pa yi ni 'od gsal yin// gnyis po dbye ba med pa de// rmi lam dag tu drangs gyur na// de ni gnyid kyi 'od gsal yin// spangs thob bral ba'i blo 'das de// tshe gcig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin// sems khral chen pos thum 'phras dgos// nyal na dgon pa'i ri dwags gsung*// des na 'chi dang mi rtag dang*// rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang*// khyad par gnyid sogs sgrib pa lnga// mgo la me shor lta bur spang*// gsal ba'i rgyu ni byang sems yin// rkyen ni dran dang 'dun pa yin// gcig shos rgyun chad med pa 'o// rtag tu mnyam gzhag rgyu 'bras blta// bla ma'i gsung bzhin tshogs gnyis bsags// nags khrod gcig du gnas bcas nas// rnal 'byor dbang phyug smra bcad mdzod// bsod snyoms zas la brten nas ni// sgrub pa snying por 'gyur zhig gu// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// rang byin gyis brlab pa'i man ngag gis// snang srid 'khor 'das ma lus kun// gnyis med gcig tu 'gyur zhig gu// rje btsun bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis// rang byung phyag rgya chen po yis// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// bde chen chos skur 'gyur zhig gu// gnad du phog pa'i rma tshabs la// chen po'i kha na mi 'tshal te// chung yang 'chi ba'i bya ba byed// gnad du phog pa gtsigs su che// mkhas pa'i man ngag zab mo la// mang po'i sna mthud mi 'tshal te// gnad du phog pa gtsigs su che// nyams su blangs pas yon tan skye// bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad du// 'di la bla ma dgos so zhes// nan tan chen pos yang dang yang*// bla ma rnams kyis bka' bstsal gsungs// rdo rje lus kyi gnad gcig gis// rang byung lhan cig skyes pa yi// nyams dang rtogs pa skyes pa 'di// bu gcig ngo mtshar mi che 'am// na mo so sor thar pa rigs bdun gyis// sdom pas legs par bsdams pa yi// rnal 'byor pa yis ri khrod du// byams pa snying rje gzhir byas nas// rang gi dge sbyor gang yin la// ma yengs brtson pas nyams blangs pas// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum dang*// 'bral ba'i dus su shi 'bras 'byung*// 'di yi dus su snying rus kyis// goms pa gang che'i gdams ngag la// bcu chos sum chos nyams su blangs// bskal par rnyed par dka' ba yi// yon tan bye ba mang po yang*// bu yis tshe gcig nyid la thob// snying gtam yin pas nyams su blang*// gsang sngags yin pas zhe la zhog

/bde ba'i 'byung gnas bla ma rin po che// skyid pa'i bdag nyid bla ma rin po che// dga' ba'i rang bzhin bla ma rin po che// mkhas pa bla ma rin po che la bdud// sems 'dzin pa btang na bde ba yin// blo bya byed bral na skyid pa yin// gnas lugs mthong na dga' ba yin// sems nyid 'dres na mkhas pa yin// 'dzin pa btang na bde ba de// yul sna tshogs bdag tu mi 'dzin pas// dang po rtsol sgrub bral bas bde// bar du chags sdang zhi bas bde// tha mar ngan song spangs pas bde// gtan du thar pa thob pas bde// de bas 'dzin pa gtang na bde// bde bar 'dod pa'i gang zag rnams// khyi rgan gter srungs ma byed par// 'dzin pa gtang na bde bar gda'o// blo bya byed bral na skyid pa de// sems spros pa'i bya byed spangs pa yis// dang po 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spangs// bar du thar pa'i sa la gnas// gsum du theg chen gyi don mthong bas// bde skyid mthar thug gi sangs rgyas thob// de bas bya byed bral na skyid// skyid par 'dod pa'i dam pa rnams// bya byed rgya stag gi tshang nang du// rang dbang med par ma 'jug par// sems bya byed bral na skyid par gda'o// gnas lugs mthong na dga' ba de// sems nyid gnyug ma'i ye shes de// dang po mthong bas skyon rnams dag /bar du mthong bas yon tan rdzogs// mtha' mar mthong bas lhun gyis grub// de bas gnas lugs mthong bas dga'// dga' bar 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor rnams// mtha' gnyis kyi g.yang sar ma 'tshol bar// gnyis med ye shes kyi thang la rgyug /sems gnyis 'dres na mkhas pa de// byang chub sems gnyis 'dres pa des// zhi ba phyogs gcig sa spangs nas// dang po rgyal ba'i gdan sa thob// bar du sku gsum lhun gyis grub// tha mar sku gsum rgyun chad med// de bas sems gnyis 'dres na mkhas// kwa mkhas par 'dod pa'i kha sbyang can// nga rang rgyal 'dod kyi sbrul dong du// rang gzhan gnyis ka ma mchong bar// sems gnyis 'dres pa'i 'dun ma des// 'og min rgyal ba'i khang bzang du// rang gzhan gnyis ka bde bas rol// 'di ku re kyal ka ma lags te// bde skyid dga' dang mkhas pa yi// gdams ngag rmad du byung ba yin//

// 412 ༄// mos gus rgyal mtshan thogs la sgrub pa dang du len pa phyag chen man ngag lnga pa// oṃ swasti/ thog mtha' dus rnams kun tu bde dang skyid pa'i 'byung gnas gtso// gdod nas gnas pa lhun grub sems kyi de bzhin nyid// rang byung lhan cig skyes pa he ru ka dpal bla ma dam pa la// dus rnams rtag tu phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar 'chi// gting mtha' med pa sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'khor ba 'di// stes dbang rang dgar ldog pa nam yang mi srid pas// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal soms la sgrub pa dang du longs// shin tu gces par byas pa'i sha rus phung po 'di// 'jig cing 'gyes pas rtag tu dbang byar med pas na// brtson 'grus drag po'i shugs kyis sgrub pa dang du longs// mdza' shing dga' ba snying du sdug pa'i bshes rnams dang*// snyan grags khe bkur phan phan lta bu 'chos pa rnams// bde dang thar pa 'phrog pa'i chom rkun bdud yin pas// ngo srung ltos 'jog med par sgrub pa dang du longs// lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyi nor bu rin po che// rtag tu phan zhing bde bar byed pa grogs kyi mchog /nges 'byung tshul khrims skyon dag yon tan bskyed// rang snying dpang por tshugs la sdom pa srog bzhin srungs// bsam pa bzang yang sbyor ba rjes ngan gang yin dang*// ngan par 'dug pa'i bsam sbyor khu 'phrig za ba rnams// rtsa ba drungs phyung 'bad pas spongs la sgrub pa dang du longs// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun gyi rtsa ba ni// dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi 'byung gnas dbang phyug gtso// rdo rje 'dzin chen bla ma rin chen la// mos gus rgyal mtshan thogs la sgrub pa dang du longs// byang chub sems dang gnyug ma bsod nams tshogs// mkha' la 'phur ba rnams kyi 'dab ma ji bzhin du// gnyis med zung du 'jug pas skyon dag yon tan rdzogs// man ngag gnad dang ma bral rnal 'byor pa// 'gag dang nya ga ma spong rang 'dod can// snying rus chos su thon dang pho rus can// bla ma'i gsung mchog rdo rje rin po che// dus gsum rgyal ba gshegs pa'i gzhung lam ste// mkha' 'gro rnams kyi srog gi snying po mchog

/sgrib pa'i bud shing thams cad bsreg pa'i me// sde snod kun gyi rtsi thog snying po ste// rgyud sde kun gyi gnad kyi bcud phyung ba// sngags dang mtshan nyid kun gyi man ngag ni// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa la sogs pa'i// bla ma sangs rgyas rnams las legs byung ba// phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag lnga po 'dir// chos rnams ma lus thams cad 'dus pas na// yon tan skye bar 'dod pas goms par gyis// goms shing nges pas yon tan gang skyes kyang*// nga yi sgom du song bas nga yi nyams rtogs dang*// nga yi yon tan slob na lhag pa'i nga rgyal des// dug sdong lo 'dab rgyas pa'i me tog 'bras bu yis// rang gzhan phung bar byas na shin tu ma rung bas// brtse ba chen pos ci byed lam tu gtong zhing bsngo ba dang*// rang bzhin shes pas chags pa thams cad yongs spangs te// rang gi sems dang bla ma rnams la the tshom gang skyes kyang*// bsags pa chung bas bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pas na// gsol ba gdab cing dbang bskur bskyar ba dang*// maṇ+ḍal yi ge brgya pa'i bsnyen pa dang*// dad gus drag pos bstim pa la sogs kyis// dam tshig dri ma ma lus dag byas pas// 'bras bu tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub thob// // 413) ༄// kun rdzob 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gti mug che zhes pa tshig rkang dgu pa// na mo rat+na gu ru/ badz+ra dharma ka ya ni/ don dam rang sems 'gyur med lhun gyis grub// kun rdzob 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gti mug che// rtog pa'i bye brag gzung ba'i yul rnams la// chags sdang rmongs gsum nyon mongs gsum po yi// rjes su 'brangs pa'i lus ngag bya byed las// las de rnam par smin pas rnam smin no// lugs ldog lugs las byung ba'i rten 'brel 'di// rgyal ba rnams kyang gsung mdzod zab mor gsungs// dam chos 'di las gzhan med go bar gyis// // 414) ༄// byang chub sems kyi gser 'gyur rtsis bags chags thams cad kha bsgyur ba'i gdams pa//

sems dang dngos po'i gnas lugs rtogs pa skyes// rtogs pa skyes pa'i skyes bu yis// bsam pa'i sa bon bag chags la// sa bon snang ba zhing yin te// dngos po lus ngag yid nyid do// byang chub sems kyi gser 'gyur rtsis// bag chags thams cad kha bsgyur bas// sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor bsgyur// bu bsgoms pas go ba rnyed pa yin// spros pa chod la rang sems bsgom// mthong chos skyes gnas myong 'gyur dang*// lan grangs gzhan la myong ba rnams// spang bya gnyen po'i rim pa des// mkhas pas sa dang gser phye ste// gser gyis lcags rnams gser du bsgyur// de tshe gser las ma gtogs pa// lcags rnams btsal yang mi rnyed do// de la sku dang rgyan sogs kyis// rang gzhan don grub dga' bar byed// sred pas len pa'i phyag 'tshal lo// srog gsum gtogs pa'i mchod pas mchod// skyug nad log pa'i sdig pa bshags// yon tan mthong bas rjes yi rang*// rin po che la zhe 'dod byed// nad kyis gdung pas 'on gsol 'debs// kun gyi zad med gter chen bsgrub// // 415) ༄// lha bdud du mi 'bebs pa'i gdams pa tshig rkang nyer gnyis// na mo rat+na gu ru/ rtse gcig nyams su blangs pa yis// nyams rtogs 'phel ba'i dus tshod du// bla ma dam pa dran pa 'am// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal tshogs// rang la byung ba'i dus tshod du// rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de// gzhan du lus pa ma yin te// snang ba rang sems yin pa'i phyir// rang gi lte ba'i 'og tu bsgom// de la gus 'dud ma yengs dang*// de yis de yi 'dug lugs smra// bu smras pa go na nyams rtogs can// dgra bo'i yul du dpa' bo yin// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// bar du gcod pa'i rkyen ngan dang*// sdug bsngal phung po grangs med la// bu gcig rnam dag 'gres su mdzod// 'di gzhan la smras pa ma yin te// ri khrod dgon pa rnal 'byor pa// bla ma gzhan du lus pa la// mos gus gdung shugs drag po yis// lha bdud du mi 'bebs gdams pa yin//

// 416) ༄// rlung lnga sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i ngo bor bstan pa'i tshul tshig rkang dgu pa// rlung ni lnga po 'di dag ni// sangs rgyas lnga yi ngo bo ru// gnas nas las kun byed pa'i ming*// srog 'dzin snying khar mi bskyod pa// thur sel rin 'byung 'doms na ste// gyen rgyu lkog mar 'od dpag med// me mnyam lte bar don grub ste/ khyab byed tshigs rnams thams cad la// rnam par snang mdzad tshul du bzhugs// //

417) ༄// thag chod drug gi gdams pa zab mo// oṃ swasti/ tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum dang ma bral na sgom ma sgom med par thag chod/ nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa dang ma bral na 'khor ba las mi 'da' bar thag chod/ stong pa dang snying rje'i ngang du ma song na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi thob par thag chod/ ci byed tshe 'dir bslangs na phung 'dre snying la zhugs par thag chod/ dug gsum gyi rtog pa byung na sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bur smin par thag chod/ bla ma la mos gus bskyed na skyon dag cing yon tan rdzogs par thag chod/ thag chod drug pa// // 418) ༄// ri khrod dben pa bsten par gdams pa tshig rkang nyer bzhi// tshul khrims phung por gnas bcas shing*// 'grus skyong dran pas rtse gcig tu// yengs pa med par bsgom pa yi// mi yi seng ge dben pa bsten// 'jig rten 'dod pa'i yon tan ni// rmi lam du yang mi 'dod pa// dben pa'i dgon pa nags khrod du// rnal 'byor dbang phyug gnas par byed// chags sdang mtha' la mi gnas shing*// rtag tu mnyam gzhag 'ba' zhig gis// bsam gtan sgrib pa spong byed pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug dben pa bsten// rul pa'i lus dang zas gos la// mi rtag don med shes nas kyang*// rtag par sems nyid sgom byed pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug dben pa bsten// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs shing*// chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid// sems kyi de nyid bsgom pa yi// rnal 'byor dbang phyug dben pa bsten// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum 'di/// sangs rgyas sku gsum lhun grub tu// rtogs pas 'khrul pa spong ba yi// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ri khrod bsten// // 419) ༄// gsang sngags kyi gnad ma longs pa bstan pa tshig rkang bcu bzhi// bla med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de// grangs med bskal bas bsgrub snyam na// gsang sngags gnad kyis ma longs so// wa la za ma snying re na// bla ma rin chen gdan sa de// phag mo gru 'dir bya snyam na// gdug pa'i 'dre la ma longs so// wa la za ma snying re na// sdug chung bkra shis rin chen de// lung mdo gcig tu 'chi snyam na// mos gus gnad kyis ma longs so// wa la za ma snying re na// bkra shis rin chen dkon gnyer spro// de yang nam mkha'i me tog 'dra//

// 420) ༄// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bstod pa chos nyid 'khor lo// ri bo ta la'i gnas mchog dam pa na// sa bcu'i dbang phyug mgon po spyan ras gzigs// ji srid 'khor ba stong par ma gyur tshe// 'gro ba sgrol mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gangs ri'i mdog can zla ba nya 'dra'i zhal// zhi ba'i spyan dang 'dzum pa'i mdangs mnga' zhing*// ral ba'i thor tshugs 'od dpag med kyis mdzes// skyon med brjid pa'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba'i sku la phyag bzhi rin chen brgyan// gnyis ni thal sbyar lhag ma pad phreng 'dzin// zhabs gnyis dkyil krung pad ma'i gdan bzhugs shing*// dri med 'od zer 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo// 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i rang lus ri bo la// dbang phyug rab ldan rang sems snying rje ni// ji srid bdag 'dzin zad par ma gyur tshe// mi zad thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// dge ba'i sku mdog byang sems rgyas pa'i zhal// bde ba'i spyan dang phan pa'i 'dzum mnga' zhing*// 'gro ba 'dren 'dod bla ma spyi gtsug mdzes// rnam dag ye shes zhal la phyag 'tshal lo// kun mkhyen tshad med bzhi ldan dgos 'dod rgyan// byams dang brtser 'brel dga' ba btang snyoms 'dzin// bden gnyis zung 'jug tshogs gnyis gdan bzhugs pa'i// phrin las lnga yi 'od ldan phyag 'tshal lo// gshis nyid 'gyur med chos sku'i ri bo la// ye shes pha rol phyin rdzogs bde chen nyid// ji srid kun gzhi zad par ma gyur tshe// 'khor 'das mi zad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gdod nas dag pa kun tu bzang po'i zhal// chos nyid spyan ras spros med 'dzum mnga' zhing*// yon tan rab rdzogs mnyam nyid thog mar mdzes// rang byung lhan skyes zhal la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag med bzhi ldan mi zad 'khor los brgyan// dngos dang dngos med ro gcig 'dus ma byas// re dogs mtha' bral bden gnyis gdan la bzhugs// ye shes lnga yi 'od ldan phyag 'tshal lo// sku gsum dbyer med byang chub sems kyi sku// lus dang snang ba bskyed pa'i lhar bsgoms na// tha mal lus 'di bde gshegs skur grub pa'i// dri med rgyal ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nang gsang ba'i dngos po thams cad la// skye med tshangs pa'i rang sgra 'gro drug grags// de nyid thos sam 'dzin tam klog pa rnams// skyon med tshangs pa'i gsung grub phyag 'tshal lo// snang ba'i sems dang stong pa'i chos nyid la// skye 'gag gnas pa'i spros pa nyer zhi ba// sgrim glod med par gang rnams bsgom byed pa// mi rtag 'od gsal thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten gsum mgon spyan ras gzigs dbang gi

/sku gsung thugs la phyi nang gsang gsum gyis// bstod pa 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba rnams// lus ngag yid gsum gnod pa dag gyur cig /dge ba 'di yis tshe rabs thams cad du// sdug dang mi sdug tha mal la brten pa'i// chags sdang gti mug rnam rtog zhi gyur nas// byams dang snying rjes rang sems rtogs par shog /rje btsun 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi bstod pa chos nyid kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba rje rin po che 'bri gung pas g.yo ru dang dbye chung phug tu ri khrod mdzad pa'i tshe na dang po zhal gzigs pa'i dus su mdzad pa'o// // 421) ༄// chos 'dod na kha sang ngas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin gyi bca' khrims nyan dgos gsungs pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum gyis 'gro ba thams cad rgyal bar gyur cig dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa/ slob dpon til+li pa chen po'i gsang tshig dpal ldan nā ro pa chen po'i thugs kyi yang snying*/ 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo gru pa'i gsang gtam/ rgyud sde rin po che bzhi'i thugs bcud/ sde snod rin po che gsum gyi lde mig gtsigs dang rgya mdud kyi bka' rgya can gyi chos 'di/ mod pa kho na min/ dkon pa zhig yin/ yun ring por ma byas pa yin pa la/ slob ma mos gus can gyis gsol ba drag tu btab pas bya snyam pa yin pa la/ khyed rnams kyis bya dbang mi ster bar 'dug kha sang bca' khrims ji ltar byas pa bzhin du mi nyan na/ khyed kyi chos mi byed pa yin/ khyed rnams bla ma'i bka' gcog/ ci dran dran byed pa la chos gal che rgyu med/ da chos 'dod na kha sang ngas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin du bca' khrims 'di yin pas/ chang khung rtsad bcu chos ma ran pa mi 'dzud pa dang*/ bla dbye'i dkyil du gsar pa 'jog pa dang*/ rnying pa bla dbye'i gong 'og tu bzhugs pa dang*/ mkhan slob dang jo bo dang bzhugs par zhus pa min par khri khug pa de la mi sdod pa dang*/

skad ma btang gi bar du mi 'byon pa dang*/ gsar pa la skad byung ba'i dus su/ thang la byon nas ser srungs su byed na ga ler byon nas mal mal du bzhugs pa dang*/ phibs 'og tu mchod pa bshams pas bskos pa ma gtogs pa mi 'ong ba dang*/ 'di rnams kyi bkod pa legs par ma byung gi bar du chos byar ma btub pa yin/ ha bzhad gad dang gang snga la rgyug pa'i chos zab mo 'di 'dra ba de sngon gar byung*/ da gar 'byung*/ zan rdog re re la gang spang byed pa yin snyam mam/ dge 'dun gyis legs par bshams pa 'di kho na bzhin du mdzad par zhu/ chos skad ma byung gi bar du spyil bor bzhugs nas thugs dam la nan tan dang*/ gsol ba 'debs pa la nan tan dang*/ mos gus la nan tan mdzad par zhu/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig/ // 422) ༄// bdag med rtogs pa'i chos rnams rgyun du med par dgongs pa dge bshes gung par springs pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gung pa la springs pa/ khyed kyi 'bul ba yon bdag zhang dpal la skur ba de dag phyag tu legs par thengs/ da rung yang 'bul ba rgya chen por bsgrub pa la phyi nang gi bar chad mi 'ong bar byin gyis rlabs dang*/ bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar thugs la gdags par zhu/ gsung ba de'i ngos nas/ byams dang snying rje byang sems kyis// rang rgyud smin cing gzhan rgyud dang*// snang srid byin gyis brlabs gyur na// bkra shis bde legs thams cad 'byung*// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// bdag med rtogs pa'i chos rnams la// rgyun chad med par dgongs lags na// phun sum tshogs pa'i gter dang 'phrad// 'bul ba rgya chen bsgrub pa la// kha sbyang mkhan dang snying sdug dang*// ser po tso rjes byi po la// glo gtad snying bzhag spang nas kyang*// khrel yod ngo tsha shes pa yi// yon bdag dra ma ngo che can// dad dang dran dang shes ldan la// blo gtad byas na 'grub par 'dug

/de las gzhan pa swā hā zhes// nam mkha'i pad+mo 'dzin par bas// legs par thugs la dgongs la mdzad// sman mchog rgyal po a ru ra// rdog ma gsum zhig 'bul zhing mchis// // 423) ༄// dad gus kyi rgyal mtshan thogs pa reb ston rgyal mtshan 'bum la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gcig pu// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// rang gi chos las skyes pa'i bu// reb ston rgyal mtshan 'bum la springs// khyed kyi 'bul ba zhabs tog dang*// bsnyen bkur bgyis pa thams cad kun// skye sa mtho zhing rigs rgyud bzang*// dad dang gus pa'i rgyal mtshan thogs// dkon mchog gsum la mos gus che// bsod nams tshogs la nges pa skyes// tshong dpon yon chen zhang la dpal// bdag nyid che la bskur ba rnams// thams cad legs par phyag tu thengs// yi ge mi 'khyams pa yi rten// bdag gi dbu zhu gsol 'phro cig /khyed la 'bul gyis dbu la gsol// 'di lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// rgyan gyur dpal ldan rin chen gyis// dbu la gsol ba'i rgyal mtshan lags// 'phags pa klu sgrub a ti sha// bla ma gong ma'i dbu zhu lags// thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen la// btsun por bzhugs pa'i btsun zhu lags// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis// mchod cing bkur ba'i rin chen lags// gang gi dbu la thogs pa la// gnyer kha go cha chen po mchis// thugs kyi dgongs nas bzhes par zhu// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med cing*// zung du 'jug pa'i rdor dril 'di// lhan cig skyes pa'i phyag mtshan mdzod// khyed kyi pha jo bla ma de// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pas// 'khor 'das ma lus thams cad la// khyab cing 'gro 'ong ma mchis na// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du// gang nas 'ongs nas gang du bsdad// thugs dam sa phyogs de nyid 'phel// da rung rdzas dang yo byad dang*// 'bul ba rgya chen sngar bzhin zhu//

// 424) ༄// yon bdag dbang rtse la ched bstod dang phyag gnang bcas bskur ba'i springs yig/ oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ yon bdag dbang rtse rgyal la springs pa/ khyed tshe snga ma bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pas/ skye ba mi'i lus rin po che ni thob/ skyes bu dam pa gong ma rnams la dad pa dang gus 'dud rlabs po che byas pas/ rigs rgyud khyad par can du ni sku 'khrungs/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyud byin gyis rlabs pas/ bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag tu ni gyur/ zhing rnam par dag pa dkon mchog gsum la 'bul ba rgya chen po byas pas/ de ltar phun sum tshogs pa mi zad pa'i gter chen po dang ldan par bzhugs pa thams cad la sku drin che/ sgos bye brag gi dbang du byas na/ khyed yab sras gnyis/ nga'i bu'i dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ yon bdag gi rtsa ba dkon mchog rin po che gsum gyi bdag por gyur pas/ gong slad du yang 'bul ba rgya chen po bkur ba de dag kyang phyag tu legs par thengs/ da res kyi gnas skabs su yang*/ na bza' rin po che bkur ba ji ltar dgongs pa bzhin du phyag tu legs par thengs/ yi ge mi 'khyams pa'i rten byin rlabs legs par byas pa'i rung dar kha gsum bskur nas mchis// // 425) ༄// gnang bkag gi don bkrol ba shākya'i dge sbyong shes rab 'byung gnas la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// 'gro ba'i bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de'i zhal snga nas/ nga'i bcas pa rgyal po'i khrims dang 'dra'o// zhes gsungs pas/ rjes su 'brang ba'i bslab pa blangs pa ma gtogs pa/ sems can thams cad la bcas pa yang med/ bcas pa las 'gal ba'i nyes pa yang mi 'byung ngo zhe na/ 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa ni sems can thams can kyi don du thugs bskyed cing*/

tshogs rnam pa gnyis bsags nas khams gsum gyi mgon por gyur pas/ sems can thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ni rgyal po'i khrims yin te/ de yang ston pa'i gsung dang du mi len pa log par lta ba can thams cad dang*/ rlabs po che'i nyes par song ba mtshams med pa lnga'i las byas pa la sogs pa ni/ skyabs su song ba'am bslab pa'i gzhi phran tshegs yang gnas par mi nus pas/ phrin las rnam pa bzhis tshar bcad pa dang*/ dus la bab na rjes su gzung ba ni rgyal po'i khrims kyi bya ba dang po/ bsags pa chung ba shan pa dang*/ mi gsod pa'i khrims thob pa/ nyi ma tha dad pa'i bsnyen gnas sam sna gcig bsrung ba ni rigs ngan gdol pa'i bcas pa khrims gnyis pa/ bya ba sna tshogs byed pa'i rgya mtshor ltung ba la/ sna 'ga'am/ yongs rdzogs sam/ tshangs spyod srung ba'i dge bsnyen ni rgyal po'i khrims gsum pa/ dge tshul la nyes byas so// zhes ming tha dad par btags kyang*/ pham pa byung na dge slong dang khyad par med par/ dge sbyong du mi rung zhes pas/ gzhan yang de dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ tshig na smad kyang don na smad pa med pa dbugs dbyung ba'i gsung*/ bsgrub par ma nus pa la gsung ba bcas pa bzhi pa/ bcas pa lnga pa dge slong yin te/ rgyal po'i bu'am/ blon po chen po'am/ dmag dpon la nyes pa 'di byas na khyod la nyes par 'di ltar 'gyur zhes tha dad par bcas pa thams cad ni/ rang bzhin gyis sgrub par nus pa'am nus pa la thabs mkhas pa 'ba' zhig gis gsungs pa las/ gzhan ma yin par shes par bya'o// yang bcas pa ni dge ba yin la/ rang bzhin ni mi dge ba yin pas/ bcas pa dang rang bzhin gcig na/ mun pas mun pa bsal bar mi nus pa bzhin du/ bcas pa dgag bya 'gegs byed ma yin par 'gyur ro zhe na/ rang bzhin gshis kyis mi dge ba de thams cad mkhyen pas mkhyen nas bca' ba ni/ thugs rje chen pos sems can rjes su bzung ba dang gcig

chos la slob dpon gyi dpe mkhyud med pa dang gnyis/ stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi brnyes pas 'khrul pa mi mnga' ba gsum gyis/ dgag bya nyon mongs pa dang de dag rjes su 'brel ba'i las spong ba bcas pa las/ ston pas nyes pa bsgrub pa'am/ mun pas mun pa sel ba'i dpe ni/ rang bzhin gyi thog tu bcas pa yod ces pa de'i don spyi ma go ba kho na'o// yang bcas pa dang rang bzhin tha dad par 'dod pa ni/ bcas pa'i gzhi lung ma bstan yin/ sa brko me reg chu la rtse ba gos dang zas dang snod spyad las gyur pa thams cad rang bzhin bsrung ba'i ched du gsungs te/ de yang mi na ba'i dus na/ dgag bya dang ldan pas dgag bcas/ na ba'i rkyen dang ldan na dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sgrub bcas/ dgag dgos gang yang mi dmigs pa'i dus na gnang bcas yin pas/ gnas skabs gsum du bcas pa gsum byung ba yin zhes pa yang*/ 'dir gzhi med cing 'thad pa ma yin te/ thams cad mkhyen pas nyon mongs pa gsum dang rjes su 'brel ba'i las ni gtan du gnang ba med cing bkag pa yin pa dang*/ gnang ba ni ltung ba gnang ba ma yin te/ gzhi dang bsam pa sbyor ba mthar thug bzhi dang ma 'brel bas/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad du 'gro ba dang*/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad las/ mya ngan las 'das pa sgrub pa dang mi sgrub pa bsod bzhag ste/ dgag bcas las log tsam gnang ba dang*/ sgrub bcas ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad kyis/ sgrub pa mya ngan las 'das pa sgrub par nges pa/ sgrub par bcas pas nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims kyi dbang du bya ste/ smyug tshal bregs pas a mra'i tshal zhes pas go bar bya'o// yang lus ngag yid gsum gyi las/ gshis kyis dge ba dang ni mi dge ba dang lung du ma bstan pa gsum du gsungs pa las/ mi dge ba mtha' dag dgag bcas/ dge ba mtha' dag lung du ma bstan pa gnang bcas su 'dod pa kha cig yod de/ spyir sdom pas bsrung tshad dge ba rgyun chags su 'dod pas/

lung du ma bstan pa khas blang du med pa dang*/ byang chub sems kyi dbang byas pas lung ma bstan dge ba'i rtsa bar 'gyur pa dang*/ bden pa mthong bas bden pa 'ba' zhig tu nges te/ lung du ma bstan pa mi 'grub par/ 'gyur ba'i phyir mi dge ba ltung ba a cang yang che ste/ lung ma bstan du gyur pa yang ltung bar nges so// yang rang bzhin gar yod kyi thog tu bcas pa yod na/ 'phags pa dgra bcom pa la ni dgag bya med de 'on kyang bcas pa yod do zhe na/ dgag bya bzhi po las dang lam ma sgrib pa dang*/ ngan song gsum du skye ba dang*/ bya ba dang byed pa mang ba dang*/ gzhan ma dad par 'gyur ba bzhi kha yod pas/ ston pas 'geg par 'gyur te/ gnas skabs kyi dgag bya las brgya rtsa gcig la dgra bcom pa thob nas ltu+ung ba byung ba gnang ba yin no zhes ston pas gnang ba med cing rten de nyid las ldang bar gsungs pa dang*/ mthar thug gi dgag bya sangs rgyas kyi phrin las dang*/ yon tan dang 'bras bu thob pa la sgrib ste/ lam gong du 'gro rgyu yod par bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung pas/ lam la yang sgrib/ sa bon bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa ma spangs pas/ de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i las dang 'brel pas 'bras bu ngan song du yang 'gro ba nges par/ bka' lung sman gyi gzhir ston pa'i phrin las bstan pa las gsungs/ gzhan ma dad par 'gyur ba yang yod do// dge slong sde snod gsum pa dgra bcom pa la/ klu gdug pa dang 'dra/ khyi zugs pa dang 'dra zhes smras pas/ nyes pa de nyid la 'chags pa byas kyang skye ba lnga brgyar klu gdug pa dang khyir skyes nas dgra bcom pa thob kyang*/ las kyi lhag mas 'di ltar gyur zhes pa la sogs pa rgya cher dpag tu med pa gsungs pas/ ston pa'i sras 'phags pa bdag nyid chen po rnams rang gi don thob kyang*/ gzhan srung ba ni gong ma dang 'dra ste dgag bya shin tu lci ba dang*/ bya ba dang byed pa mang ba'i dgag bya yang rang gi ngor byas pas lam gong du 'gro rgyu yod na tshogs rnam pa gnyis rgyun chad med par gsog dgos la/

de yang don med pa'i bya bas mi 'grub cing klog pa dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ bya ba phrin las kyi 'khor los rang gzhan gyi don bsgrub par byed dgos pa la/ gzhan gyi rjes su 'jug pa'i 'khor ram/ gang zag mang po bya ba dang byed pas g.yengs pas/ 'khor lo gsum gyi rang bzhin gyis don bsgrub par ma nus pa shākya las gyur pa lnga brgya lta bu dang*/ gnas brtan dgra bcom pa rgyal po lta bu 'khor rgya chen po smin par byed pa yang*/ rang gi lam du gzhan 'dzud dgos pa ma lags sam zhes go bar bya'o// de la spyir rgol ba 'di lta bu thams cad ni rgyu nyon mongs pa gsum gyi rjes su 'brang pa'i las kyis 'bras bu sdug bsngal mi 'byung ngo zhes pa dang*/ dgag pa'i bslab pa lung ma bstan nam don med pa yin no zhes ston pa la skur ba 'debs la yang bsgrub pa'i bslab pa 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad las yang dag pa'i lta bas dgag sgrub gnyis kyi bslab pa shes par bya ste/ de yang dgag bya las dang nyon mongs pa dgag pa/ dgag par bya ba'i thabs 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims kyis/ 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden par 'gro bar shes pa ni yang dag pa'i lta ba de'i rtog pa rtogs pa/ de'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi bya ba dang byed pa spangs shing mthun pa'i rkyen sgrub pa ni yang dag pa'i rtsol ba/ 'tsho ba rnam par dag pa la gdams pa'i skabs ni yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba/ de la sogs pa 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad tshul khrims rin po che/ 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa byang chub rnam pa gsum thob par mi 'gyur zhes log par lta bas skur pa 'debs pa kho nar zad do// yang dam pa'i chos 'dul bar/ dgag bya las dang nyon mongs pa bkag na byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod bsdus pa byang chub sems dpa'i sa/ de bsdus pa sdoms pa nyi shu pa la sogs par mi dge bar gnang ba'i skabs yod par gsungs pa de ji lta bu zhe na/ 'di nyid kyi dbang du byas te bsdus pa'i sdom pa/

snying brtser ldan zhing byams phyir dang*// sems dge ba la nyes pa med// ces gsungs pas/ snying brtse ba'i phyir na go bar zad la/ sems dge zhes pa ni/ 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug rnam pa gsum dang bral bas/ ma chags pa dang*/ zhe sdang med pa dang*/ gti mug med pa ni dge ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum po de la nyes pa med par thub pa'i gsung rab spyi dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod mtha' dag la bsgrub pa'i sgrub par gsungs te/ de yang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che phal cher ni/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po sa chen po la rab tu gnas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pas sems can smin pa dang grol bar byed pa 'ba' zhig tu 'dug pas/ de'i spyod par gsungs pa las des kyang gzung ba dang 'dzin pa gnyis med cing*/ gnyis med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas/ rang nyid nyes pa'i skyon dang bral bar 'gyur zhing gzhan de dang gnyis su med par gyur pas rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i thabs mkhas pas/ rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs par 'gyur te/ 'dir phyogs gcig la nyes par mtshon na/ 'phags pa dkon mchog 'byung ba nas/ drang srong chen po mes rgyal po sde mi pham pa la/ ngas bdag nyid kyang ma mthong na chom rkun pa ga la mthong zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal po khros nas rkang lag bcad pa las/ rgyal po chen po khyod nyid kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil yan chad du/ rgyal po sde mi pham pa tshol cig ces btsal bas ma rnyed pas/ drang srong chen pos smras pa go bas/ drang srong nyes pa med pa'i rkang lag bcad pa la 'gyod pa skyes pa la/ yang rgyal po chen po nga'i rkang lag bcad pa yang de ltar shes par gyis shig ces gsungs pas/ rgyal pos mi skye chos la bzod pa thob/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan par gsungs pas/ nyes pa chen po thams cad las rang nyid ldang ba dang*/

spyod pa rgya chen po thams cad ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i thabs la mkhas pa/ gti mug pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kho na gsungs par mthong ste/ bdag blo shin tu dman par gyur pas bdag ni byang chub sems dpa'o zhes/ byang chub sems dpar khas blangs pa tsam gyis/ nyes pa rlabs po che'am phung khams chen po la bkag pa med par spyod pa 'di dag rang nyid kyi blo la ma shong zhing*/ shin tu 'jigs pa/ rab tu 'jigs/ kun tu rab tu 'jigs par byung bas/ bdag la dga' ba zhig yod na/ sems bskyed pa'i rjes su 'brang zhing*/ ma chags pa dang*/ zhe sdang med pa dang*/ gti mug med par lta spyod rnam pa gnyis las don dam pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa drug gi rang bzhin du nyams su blang bar bya ba dang*/ dus tshod gcig la sems can ni mi mdzad/ phung khams rlabs po che chos yin na nyams su blang long yod pas/ dang por rang nyid rkang bu tshugs pa gal che bar bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pa yin par tshor ro// yang dge ba dang mi dge ba gshis yin pas/ mi dge ba bar du gcod pa'i chos yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pas gnang ba med na/ gsang sngags su 'dod pa la spyod pas 'grub par gsungs pas/ rnam pa thams cad du bar chad du 'gyur ba ni ma yin no zhe na/ 'dir sangs rgyas thams cad bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i yon tan dang ldan par gsungs pa la/ gsang sngags kyi sangs rgyas de la yon tan de dag med pa yin nam yang na de bzhin gshegs pa gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi stobs dang*/ mi 'jigs pa rnam pa bzhi brnyes pas/ ngas bar du gcod par gsungs pa'i chos kyis bar du gcod par mi 'gyur ro zhes lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi rgol bar mi nus so zhes gsungs pa de rdzun pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pas ni gnyis su mi gsungs pas 'dul bar ni gzhi dang bsam pa sbyor ba mthar thug gi yan lag rnam pa bzhi tshang ba dang ma tshang ba'i bye brag gis ltung ba che 'bring du bzhag ste/

gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa'i spyod pa la ni yan lag rnam pa bzhi po de mi snang ba dang*/ gal te yan lag rnam pa bzhi las gang yang rung ba gcig snang na yang de ni gsang sngags su mi 'gyur te/ tshe 'di nyid du 'jigs par byed pa thams cad kyis gtses nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bsad cing ngan song du khrid par gsungs pa dang*/ bdud ma traṃ ru ṭa dang*/ bram ze tsa nag kya la sogs pa mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal bar ltung bar dpag tu med pa gsungs pas mi dge ba gnang ba ni med do// 'o na 'dod pa la spyod pas 'grub par gsungs pa de ci yin snyam na/ de ni bcom ldan 'das gyi thabs de nyid la brten nas/ don rtogs par khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir/ chos kyi sgo tha dad par gsungs pas/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya bsten pa ni dug lnga rnam par dag pa/ srog bcod pa ni rnam par rtog pa 'od gsal gyi ngang du gsod pa/ chang 'thung ba ni kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi gsol bar gsungs pa yin pas/ de lta bur gyur pa ni 'dul bar 'ang bkag pa med pas so// 'o na grub thob pa la 'dod pa'i longs spyod rnam pa sna tshogs la spyod/ de rnams kyis 'dod pa de lta bur spyad pa ma yin pa cis shes zhe na/ de ni 'bras bus rgyu dpog pas/ slob dpon rgyal pos 'dod chags ma spyad/ slob dpon lwa ba pas/ phyi dro'i kha zas ma zos/ sor phreng can gyis mi ma bsad pa'i bden pa'i byin rlabs byas pas grub par gsungs nas bden pa nyid kyis 'grub kyi/ rdzun pas ni ma yin pas/ ston pas babs mkhyen pa nyid yin zhing dam bcas pa brtan par khong du chud par bya'o// yang bdag med pa gnyis ma rtogs na/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub mi thob ces gsungs pas/ bdag tu 'dzin pa dang ldan na nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyang mi thob na/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub lta smros kyang ci dgos pa la/

mchod pa dang 'bul ba thams cad ched du bdag tu bzung nas 'bul ba de ci yin zhe na/ de shin tu yang mad de/ 'on kyang 'khor gsum du rtogs pa bdag dang bdag gi yul nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad smin pa dang*/ dus gsum gyi 'phags pa thams cad mchod pa ni yul/ de smin par bya ba'i thabs pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang bcu/ bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam pa bzhis sems can gyi don byed pa dang*/ tshogs gnyis kyi 'phags pa mchod par byed pa bdag dang*/ 'khor 'das dang mchod cing smin pa'i thabs rnam pa gsum gyis khams gsum gyi 'khor ba las mi 'da' zhing*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi zhi ba phyogs gcig tu mi ltung ba ni/ bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas/ bdag dang sems cad thams cad bde ba dang ldan pa dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral ba dang*/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba 'di ni mya ngan las 'dar mi ster ba/ 'khor ba 'ba' zhig sgrub pa/ gzugs sku gnyis rgyun chad med par 'byung ba'i rgyu/ mya ngan las 'da' bar mi gnas par bzhed par gda'/ 'khor bar mi gnas pa ni bdag dang 'khor 'das dang*/ mchod cing smin par khyad par gyi chos/ 'khor gsum gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par khong du chud cing dmigs pa med pa ni 'khor bar mi gnas pa ste/ de ltar yang bram ze chen po'i zhal snga nas// 'khor bar mi gnas mya ngan 'das mi gnas// zhes pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa nas/ mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa zhes pa dang*/ theg pa chen po mtha' dag thabs shes rab zung du 'jug pa 'dis ma bsdus pa med par thugs su chud par mdzad par zhu 'tshal/ de ltar spyir sems can thams cad bdag tu 'dzin pas 'khor bar 'khyams kyang*/ bdag tu bzung nas mchod pa phul ba dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa bsngo ba byas pas shing las me byung bas de nyid sreg par byed pas kyang 'gal ba med/

byang chub sems dpa' rnams bdag nyid la bsten te tshogs rdzogs par byed pa'i phyir yang 'gal ba med/ rtogs pa thob nas kyang*/ de bzhin gshegs pas nga dang nga 'dra ba zhes pa'am/ ngas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs zhes btags pa tsam du gsungs pas kyang 'gal ba med/ yang gtsang bdag bde dang rtag nyid dang*// yon tan pha rol phyin pa 'bras// zhes pas bdag med pa de nyid dam pa'i bdag 'khor 'das thams cad kyi gshis de la bdag ces btags pas kyang 'gal ba med pas/ gang du bsngo ba dang*/ bsngo bar byed pa po dang*/ bsngo ba rnams de dang 'brel ba 'thad pa nyid lags so// rje 'gro ba'i mgon po'i bka' stsal don gyi gnad bkrol shākya'i dge sbyong shes rab 'byung gnas la gnang ba'o// rdzogs so// //

426) ༄// rje phag mo gru pa'i nye gnas 'gran gyis do med sgom gzhon la gnang ba// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rje brtse ba can// 'gro ba'i bla ma chos rje rin po che// rang sems lus su rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// lus sems gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun pa// dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa// sku gsung thugs kyi bya dang byed pa yis// tshar gcod rjes gzung mdzad pa'i mkhyen rab can// 'gro ba'i bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// rje phag mo gru pa'i nye gnas mchog /'gran gyis do med sgom gzhon pa// chos rje rin chen mi bcom zhu// bcom na ngo tsha skyugs kyang ldog /mi gzhan gyis thos na ji skad smra// sang drung du 'gro ba'i dus tshod na// ngo so bzang po ji ltar gsol// skyes mchog bla ma rin chen gyi// lan gcig sras su gyur yang myong*// de nas bu de bu mor song*// bu mo bran gyi bran mor song*// deng sang bran mo bzang mor song*// gsol ba 'debs so gsol ba 'debs// gsol ba 'debs so rin po che// 'gro ba'i bla ma chos kyi rje// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na// 'gran gyi don med rje btsun pa// mi la chen por gsol ba 'debs// bla ma de yi byin rlabs kyis// zab pa'i gdams ngag ma lus pa// ngas shes pa'i nges shes gting nas yod// de ltar lags na byin gyis rlobs// 'khrul par gyur na bzod par gsol// dpon po yin pas nyams re dga'// khams nas byon pas 'o re brgyal// nye gnas yin pas snying du sdug /dgos pa dam pa'i chos 'di dgos// rgyal ba'i sras po shākya ye shes kyis// gong ma bstod pa'i dbyangs kyi rim pa 'di// rang byung phyag rgya chen po de nyid dang*// dbyer med gcig tu grub pa'i spyod pa yin// slob dpon chen po dpal ldan nā ro pas// 'dod chags 'od gsal bde chen zung du 'jug

/zhe sdang 'od gsal skye med zung du 'jug /gti mug 'od gsal rtog med zung du 'jug /byang chub sems las byung gyur cing*// tshad med snying rje chen pos dam pa'i chos// lhar bcas 'jig rten kun la bstan pa yi// bsod nams dri med mtshungs pa med pa des// phyogs bcu rgyal ba'i zhing du rnam par grags// dpag med gdul bya smin par mdzad pa la// rjes su yi rang byang chub chen por bsngo// rgyal bas gang 'dod dris nas mdzad// nyams myong gsang ba mi bshad gsung*// gnod pa bzod pas don rnams 'grub// ji skad smras pa de bzhin byed// rigs shes sems can dbang don shes// rigs gsum sdud pa'i thabs la mkhas// chos dang zang zing phan gnod drod// shes na 'gro ba smin par 'gyur// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// mthong dang thos dang dran pa dang*// reg par gyur pa tsam gyis kyang*// rnam par grol bar nges gyur na// ci phyir yi mug bskyed par byed// nyi ma nub nas shar na dga' ba la// gzho chu gyen la log na dga' ba la// 'tshal pas 'khrug pa thengs nas dga' ba la// gces sems dam chos go na dga' ba la// // 427) ༄// skyo bsangs su gsungs pa'i tshigs bcad thor bu phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// gnyen gyur dpal ldan rin po che// nyes pa'i skyon rnams dag mdzad cing*// 'phags pa'i nor rnams ma lus pas// 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa yi// ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba yi// rje rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// dam chos 'di yi gleng slangs ni// stod lung jag pa'i shar mo yin// snang ba sems su rtogs pa yi// ting nge 'dzin la bsam mi khyab// 'bri gung dpal gyi dgon pa 'dir// chos kyi rgyal po rin po che// chos dang tha mal bka' stsal la// bor rgyu med par go lags na// dam pa'i chos shig 'di na gda'// 'dzam gling nor gyis bkang gyur kyang*// bud med kyi a pha rabs chad yin// sa steng chos kyis gang gyur kyang*// dge 'dun med pa'i bdag po ci// gnad ka rgyu mtshan gang gis kyang*// pha la bu 'di dgos par gda'// bu go 'am shes sam ti se ba// 'di gzhan la bzlas pa ma lags te// yab sras lnga yi gsang gtam yin// gal po che la ngo dga' med// dgos pa'i tshig 'di snying la zhog

/nged kyis bla ma rin po che// khong 'jig rten mgon pos de skad gsung*// gzung 'dzin gnyis dang ma bral na// lnga brgyar bsgoms kyang a chu ta// bla ma'i grub mtha' ma shes par// nye gnas byas pa'i yus po che// rang rgyud smra ba'i mkhas pa de// gzung 'dzin sgrog tu ma chud dam// lta ba mthon po'i thal 'gyur te// blos byas stong par ma shor ram// ku sā li yi sgom chen la// de na med de de na yod// bu bse ru dpal la klad pa med// klad pa med de phog gsol yod// 'di de na med de 'di na yod// pha yi rin chen dkor mdzod de// gces se bu yis ma shes na// gces se med kyang btags pa tsam// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// 'gro ba smin par byed pa 'di// las kyi rjes su 'jug pa las// bya thabs gzhan na med pa 'di// rgyal ba'i sras kyi dgongs lags sam// chen po rnams kyis dgongs lags sam// rna brgya ba yis dgongs lags sam// bu rnal 'byor dbang phyug ri khrod pa// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras gcig pu// dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyud 'dzin// thub pa chen po'i gsung bzhin du// sbyangs pa'i yon tan spyad pa yis// bsgrub pa mdzad pa'i dam pa khyed// sku khams ci bder bzhud par zhu// 'bral ba med pa thugs la zhog /jo bo chen po rje lha cig /bod kyi yul du bzhugs pa la// mnga' ris yul du lo gsum ste// dbus su lo bcu tham pa gsung*// mkhas pa chen po lo tsā ba// dgung lo sum cu rtsa lnga nas// lnga bcu rtsa lnga'i bar du ni// dpag med tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bskyangs// ku tra spos su mi rung bas// dgung lo sum cu rtsa lnga nas// bdun cu tham pa'i bar du 'o// thub pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// nor bzang zhes bya'i skyes mchog de// da lta dga' ldan gnas na bzhugs// nor gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// rnam par grol bas smin mdzad gsol// brjod bya rjod byed brjod pa la// rmongs pa med pa'i dam pa khyed// don gyi snying po go lags na// tha snyad tshig gis ci zhig bya// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho la// na bza' rin chen drubs la stsol// mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*// cis kyang thob par nges pa yin// khyi sngags rma sngags 'gug sngags gsum// sngags gsum gyi phu rtser bzhugs bzhugs nas// yon tan rnams sad la ma shor ram// mi chos skyong ngam lha dam skyong*// dge 'dun skyong ngam sdig pa skyong*// sangs rgyas skyong ngam bud smad skyong*// pha chos kyi rgyal po rin po che// 'gro ba'i bla ma ston pa po// rgya gar yul du byung ba yi// grub thob rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis// snying khrag zhal du skyugs pa yi// gnad kyi rgyu mtshan zab mo rnams// dge 'dun tshogs su gsungs na yang*// sus kyang go ba ma rnyed pas// rabs chad rgad po zhal tshabs che// mang po'i dge 'dun yi re mug
