/de go 'am rtogs sam sher 'byung dbon// sngon gyi rgyal ba bsnyen bkur bas// da lta mchog gi rigs su skyes// 'jig rten mgon gyi sras gyur pa// mos gus pad+mor rab phye ste// gnyis med ye shes bdud rtsi yis// thugs kyi dpal be'u rab bkang zhing*// mtha' yas 'gro ba smin mdzad pa// skyes bu chen po khyod la 'dud// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// dbang bskur mchog thob gdung 'dzin cing*// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i bdag /ji srid 'khor ba ma stong tshe// 'gro kun smin par mdzad la 'dud// rgas kyang dam chos mi byed pa// wa la za ma snying re na// gzhon yang de dang 'dra ste mchi// glang rgan 'dam du tshud pa bzhin// rang nyid brgal bar ma nus shing*// grol bar yang ni ma nus pas// gzhan phan mdzad pa a la la// chag legs par gzab pa'i gdong pa 'dra// rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs la// go ba med pa'i rnal 'byor pa// grub pa thob kyang 'o re brgyal// ci tsam nyams su blangs pas phung*// skyon med yon tan rdzogs 'dod na// 'bri gung dpal gyi dgon pa der// smra gcad skyu ra nga la gtug /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na// rdzas dang zang zing yod yod pa// dka' ba mang po bsgrub pa kun// chud zos stong par ma btang ngam// ngur smrig rgyal mtshan rin thang che// na bza' phul dang bsod nams che// da rung phul dang dad can rnams// mi rgod rgyal ba'i snying yang 'khrul// gcig shos rung ba'i man ngag la// tshwa las dwangs snyigs 'byed par byed// sha tshas shin tu nye bar byed// 'dod chags rtog pas bdag re bslus// zhen pa'i shes pas bskyangs gyur cig /gser gyi bu chung bdar na yang*// sol ba nag po gcig tu nges// 'di nas dpag tshad lnga brgya'i pha rol na// 'dre yungs zhing khal bdun gyi grangs rnyed 'dug /thub pa chen po rgyal ba'i bka'// dbang phyug chen po'i dkyil 'khor na// gdug pa'i lha 'dre bsam mi khyab// bcom ldan rje btsun dkyil 'khor na// gdug pa'i lha 'dre bsam mi khyab// dur khrod chen po gnas brgyad na// gdug pa'i lha 'dre de dang 'dra// so gcig pa yi rigs dang yang*// de bzhin ne le'i rigs la sogs// bsam gyis mi khyab gnas pa de// lha 'am mi 'am sangs rgyas yin// 'di lha 'am mi 'am sangs rgyas yin// bdag tshad med snying rje chen po yis// gces pa'i nye gnas rnams la ni// snying dang 'dra bar gdams pa yin// gnod pa mthong dang thos pa dang*// 'ong zhing gsod par byed pa yang*// thabs kyi mthun par 'gyur ba'i phyir// khe mtshams bya zhing dga' ba sgrub// dgos pa'i dus su med pa de// mi rabs chad pa'i snga rtags yin// mi dgos dus su yod pa de// 'dul khrims 'jig pa'i snga rtags yin// khyod dang 'dra ba mang po yod// lar khyod dang 'dra ba mang po yod// khyad par dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams// byis pas gnam sa ma mthong bas// ltad mo gar lta ci cha yod// dam chos rin chen klog pa la// seng ge'i khri yang chung ba la// 'bol stan gcig la 'dzems ci dgos// sang kha chags sna ral sprang mo yis// co do

skra nas bzung 'drud tsam na// de yang bskur sti chen po yin// 'di gzhan la bzlas pa ma lags te/ khyed 'bri gung pa la bzlas pa yin// rang byung phyag rgya chen po de// rtogs pa'i mi la skul ma 'debs// rnal 'byor nyin mtshan med par gnyid// don 'di yang rgya shug tshig gu tsam// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa nam mkha' mtha' med la// bu slob rnams kyis ri dbang rtse tsam mthong*// 'bri gung pas kyang khab kyi mig tsam ste// khab mig tsam yang ngo mtshar shin tu che// ji ltar me tog 'gyur ba ltar// 'dus byas thams cad de dang 'dra// ji ltar shing thog 'brul lhung ba ltar// mi rtag 'chi ba de dang 'dra// byis pa 'ja' tshon bda' ba bzhin// mdza' bshes 'grogs pa'ang de dang 'dra// mi lus rin chen thob dka' na// rab tu 'byung ba rnyed par dka'// khyed la 'chi ba mi 'ong ngam// cis kyang rab tu 'byung bar zhu// gsad pa rang gshed 'khor lo 'di// mngon par byang chub mchod pa la// bla ma dam pa'i drin gyis go /byang chub snying por bzhugs pa yi// ston pa shākya'i rgyal po yis// byams pa chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis// srod la bdud kyi sde rnams bcom// chos 'di'i nyams myong rtogs pa cig /gzhan la ma lus rang la yod// 'di yi brtul zhugs spyod pa gcig /snying nas bsgrub par mi byed re// legs par dgongs dang rin po che// 'khrul na 'khrul tshabs mi che 'am// mi chen po 'khrul ba'i dus tshod du// rang phung gzhan phung gnyis ka mchi// chos dang po ti brtsigs pa 'di// gang du bzhugs kyang 'gro don mdzad// mchod gnas bla na med mod kyi// skyel 'dren gong ma'i rnam thar min// sa dang gzhi dang lha khang 'di// btsan po'i rdog rten yin na yang*// nang 'khrug rtsod pa 'phel ba'i rgyu// 'di yang gong ma'i rnam thar min// rta dang gnag dang lug khyu rnams// gdan sa'i zhabs tog yin na yang*// gzhi med nam mkha'i me tog 'di// bla ma gong ma'i rnam thar min// kha smras kha mchu'i gleng gzhi yang*// za tshol phongs pas byed mod kyi// sgyu gsum rang la 'du bas na// 'di yang gong ma'i rnam thar min// 'khrug pa 'thab mo rtsod pa yang*// snying rjes gzhan don mthong ba dang*// bstan pa'i ched du byed mod kyi// bla ma gong ma'i rnam thar min// ri khrod dgon pa'i spyil gseb tu// sgom ma ban mo'i chas bab pas// 'dod ldan dga' ba skye na yang*// 'di yang gong ma'i rnam thar min// legs par dgongs dang rin po che// 'khrul na 'khrul tshabs mi che 'am// 'khrul pas rang nyid tshad mar mthong*// smyon pa'i nang nas smyon par song*// dge 'dun g.yog mdzad nye gnas rnams// sbyin bsreg thal ba 'pho ba la// khrel shor byi pos 'phrang tshas bcad// dbus sa rtsub zer ba 'di re bden// ngan la chad pa mi gcod pa// 'di 'jigs po yin nam thugs rje yin// 'di na mi med nags tshangs su// thams cad kun gyis go bar zad// tha gang ne'u gyi snye ba glu+u// thams cad de 'drar shes gyur na// ji ltar dga' ba skyes par 'gyur// snying rje chen po cis mi skye// rgad po tshul 'bum thugs rgyal ang*// lha na mo bcom ldan 'brug sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po yis// gsung dbyangs tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas sangs rgyas pa'i// bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus thams cad rnams// ston pa sangs rgyas de dang 'dra bar shog

/rje rin po che'i zhal snga nas skyo bsangs su gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa thor bu phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa rdzogs so// // 428) ༄// ran pa'i sa la bzhag pa gces zhes pa tshig rkang bcu drug/ nga yi nye gnas 'khor dang yon bdag rnams// 'phan yul gyi a ce khye'u ma skyid// de tshod tsam zhig yin pa 'dra// rje 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rje// mi bzang po la po skyid med// 'khor dang 'bangs dang rigs ngan brin// ran pa'i sar ni bzhag pa gces// rkang rgyan mgo la btags pa bzhin// thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen la// thos dang bsam dang sgom pa la// rigs rus lang tsho go chas brgyan// 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i bu// de la khyod kyi rgyal srid gtod// mgon pos pha 'babs byin pa'i rdzas// ngan log gso ba'i bag chags can// de la re ba ma che spongs// // 429) ༄// bya ba gtang bar bskul ba blang bar mi bya khyad du mi bsad zhes pa// lar skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi bya ba btang*/ spros pa bcad/ ri khrod kyi dgon par sgrub pa tshul bzhin du byas pa'i dus su/ kye e ma ho/ ngo mtshar che/ rmad du byung*/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'dir/ thub pa'i bka' bzhin du byed pa sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pa/ ri khrod kyi dgon pa bsten pa/ 'di lta bu zhe nas thams cad dga' ba dang*/ dad pa dang*/ gus par gyur pas ci yod tshad thams cad 'bul/ dgos dgon pa 'bul/ de la ltogs sdug 'phongs pa ma khyags pas dgon pa blangs/ dgon pa gnas dang 'brel/ gnas gzhi kha smras dang bral/ kha smras rtsod pa byed pa'i khral dmag las dang gos rang la 'bab/ 'jigs su rung ba'i g.yang sar ma tshor bar rang dbang med par 'gro ba yin pas/ blang bar ni mi bya/ gus par ni mi bya/ khyad du mi bsad/ bstod pa byas la bzhag ces gsungs so// //

430) ༄// dge slong tshul khrims grags la springs pa dum bu gnyis// oṃ swasti/ na mo rat+na gu ru/ bu rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po yis// 'jig rten gyi bya ba rgyab tu bskyur// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la btugs/ bla ma'i gdams ngag nyams su blangs// zab mo dam chos nyams len gyi// sdig dang sgrib pa'i bud shing tshogs// stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can// dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes kyis// bcom dang shin tu bcom par byas// dga' bo skyid do rgyal ba'i sras// bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu byung ba yin// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal tshogs// brjod kyis lang bar ga la 'gyur// ji ltar bstan pa'i gdams ngag gi /gnad kyis nyams su blang bar bya// de las gzhan pa yod mi srid// ༈ //oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ nga'i bu'i dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ mos gus kyi rgyal mtshan thogs pa/ mnyes pa rnam pa gsum gyis bla ma dam pa mnyes par mdzad pa/ dge slong tshul khrims grags la springs pa/ khyed sngon bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pas/ skye ba mi'i lus rin po che thob nas/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa la zhabs 'bring dang*/ zhabs tog mnyes pa thams cad kyis mnyes par mdzad pa dang*/ nga 'bu yang*/ bu'i dam par mdzad nas/ zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog rgya chen po yang du mdzad cing bsnyen bkur ba shin tu phyag yang bzang*/ thugs la btags/ slad kyis don zhu ba/ gong du yang yang gdams ngag cig skur gsung ba yin pa la/ bskur ba'i yi ge bas kyang*/ khyed rang gi thugs dam bsgom pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che la mos gus byas pas dge sbyor thugs rgyud la skye snyam pas yi ge ma bskur ba lags/ nga'i ngos nas kyang bskur ba'i yi ge yang dad pa dang gus pa'i grogs su tsam ma gtogs pa/ khyed rang gi snga ma'i thugs dam bla mas legs par bstan pa/ rin po che'i gsung*/ byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// mgon po rin chen bsgom pa dang*// rang byung lhan skyes phyag rgya che// rgyun chad med pa'i sems nyid de// rgyun chad med par goms pa dang*// dge ba byang chub mchog tu bsngo// chos lnga 'di dag ma gtogs pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// ma rnyed rnyed par mi 'gyur zhing*// thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyang*// 'di las gzhan pa med pa'i phyir// rgyun chad med par goms par bya// bu gcig khyed la gdams pa'i don// tshe 'di mi rtag glo bur ba// myur du 'jig cing 'chi ba dang*// 'dus byas dngos po gang la yang*// blo gtad med par dgongs nas kyang*// chos lnga 'di la nan tan bya// dge slong tshul khrims grags la gdams pa// rdzogs so//

// 431) ༄// chos sku phyag chen rang nyid lags zhes khang gsar mkhan chen la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ nga'i bu'i dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag mkhan po chen po khang sar pa'i spyan sngar springs pa/ khyed tshe snga ma phan chad la bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pas mi'i lus rin po che thob/ dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma dam pa gong ma rnams bkur bas rigs rgyud khyad par can du sku 'khrungs/ sngon sbyangs ye shes kyi tshogs sad pas/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che la rab tu byung nas/ yul dbus bstan pa'i bdag po/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la shar ba lta bu'am/ rin po che gter sbas pa lta bu bla ma yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi spyan sngar/ thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa'i spros pa thams cad ni bcad/ bdag nyid chen po de rnams mnyes pa rnam pa gsum rab kyi mthar phyin pas ni mnyes par mdzad/ khyad par du nga 'bu la yang mnyes pa rnam pa gsum mtha' dag thams cad kyis/ mnyes pa'i rab gong na med pa thams cad kyis mnyes par mdzad cing*/ rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes don dam pa'i bden pa/ spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral ba thugs su chud pas/ tshe gcig gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas par bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bzhed pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa lags te/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis// skye 'dir sangs rgyas mchog nyid du// sems bsgom pas ni sangs rgya 'o// rin chen sems las phyir gyur ba'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// ces gsungs pa dang*/ slob dpon bram ze chen po'i zhal snga nas/ sa dang lam dang sangs rgyas thams cad ro gcig pa/ gnyug ma'i yid ni yid la dris/ zhes pa la sogs pa dpag tu med pa gsungs pas/ don dam pa'i bden pa/ sems nyid kyi gshis mthar thug phyag rgya chen po de nyid thugs su chud pa las/

gzhan bya rgyu ci yang ma mchis/ 'on kyang chos kyi sku phyag rgya chen po rang nyid lags mod kyang*/ chos kyi sku yi phrin las kyis// rang gzhan smin par mdzad pa'i tshul// sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa dang*// brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab kyis// 'gro ba smin par mdzad par zhu// rang gzhan gnyis su med pa'i phyir// gzhan don mdzad pa thams cad kun// rang don yin par thub pas gsungs// dper na ston pa bcom ldan gyis// 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa la// rang nyid byang chub sangs rgyas nas// 'gro kun bde la 'god pa de// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// bu gcig dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis// 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa'i tshul// sngar bzhin thugs la gdags par zhu// // 432) ༄// gnyis med ting 'dzin la rgyun chad med par skyong ba tshig rkang nyi shu pa// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rin chen gyis// zhabs kyi pad+mor gtsug gis 'dud// mgon po de yi thugs kyi sras// skyes bu chen po khyed la zhu// skye rga na 'chi chu bo bzhi// sdug bsngal gting mtha' med pa de// rang las skyes pa'i rnam rtog yin// thar pa mya ngan 'das pa de// lhun gyis grub pa'i mi rtog pa// rang la yod pa 'di nyid yin// rnam rtog 'khrul pa'i rgya mtsho de// lhun gyis grub pa'i mi rtog dang*// gnyis su med par rtogs pa de// bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs yin// gnyis su med pa'i ting 'dzin la// rgyun chad med par bskyang bar zhu// byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus dang*// ji bzhin tshul khrims rin chen dang*// rang gzhan 'khor 'das thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge ba byang chub mchog tu bsngo// // 433) ༄// byams snying rje'i sgom khrid dang mdo sngags nyams len gyi skor// 'jig rten gsum mgon chos kyi rje/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs btud nas/ chos kyi rgyal po rin chen gyi/

gsung sgros cung zad yi ger 'bri/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ byams pa ni rnam pa gsum ste/ sems can la dmigs pa dang chos la dmigs pa dang*/ dmigs pa med pa'i byams pa dang gsum du gsungs/ de nas dang po sems can la dmigs pa'i byams pa ni/ pha'am ma'am rang la phan btags pa de las skye yi/ gzhan la mi skye bas dang po kho nar/ rang la drin che ba gcig gi drin dran par byas pa la brten nas de la gdung ba'i bsam pa skyes pa de la byams pa zhes ngos 'dzin pa yin pas/ de ngos bzung nas yang nas yang du gdung ba'i bsam pa ci skye bya/ de la nan tan shin tu che bar zhag bdun tsam du bsgoms pas gdung sems de tshad du 'khyol nas 'ong*/ de nas rang gi rtsa ba'i a ma'i drin dran par byas nas/ a ma la de kho na bzhin du zhag bco lnga bsgom/ de la gdung ba'i shugs chen po skyes pa dang*/ snying rje 'phar mdog yod pas 'gro ba gcig gam gnyis nas mang po bar du ched du gzhug la bsgom/ de yang 'dzam bu gling pa tsam la zhag bco lnga bsgom/ de nas stong gsum tsam dang*/ de nas rim gyis phyogs bcu khor yug tu sems can thams cad la bsgom/ de nas sems can ma lus pa la de ltar bsgom pas mthar thug cing*/ byams pa tshad med par gyur pa'i dus su yang rtsa ba'i ma nas/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dran pa'i sgo nas snying rje bsgom ste/ de tshegs mi che bar skye bar 'ong*/ de nam skyes pa dang*/ bdag gi ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam du sems bskyed/ de la byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems zhes zer/ byang chub kyi sems des kun nas blangs nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyis pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod cing dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba dang*/ sngags kyi lugs kyis bskyed rdzogs gnyis bsgom zhing rjes la bsngo ba 'dir/

theg pa chen po ma 'dus pa med pa lags so// khrid kyi rim pa 'di ni shin tu zab pas yi ger ma bris pa lags te/ gsung bzhin du bgyis pa lags pas nan tan chen por nyams su blang bar zhu/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon nas/ bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig/ // 434) ༄// sa thob pa'i yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis kyi lung khungs dang bcas pa// ngo mtshar rmad du byung ngo ngo mtshar ci yang mthong*// mi yi gnas su lha rdzas dkon yang ngas 'dir mthong*// dpal chen bla ma de yis bdag la gnang ba yi// dngos po 'di la khyed cag thams cad ltad mo ltos// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// ji ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mkha' la rab gsal bas// ngar snabs 'tsher ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ji bzhin du// bdag kyang de 'dra 'jig rten mgon po bla ma'i drin// rjes su dran par gyur pas 'dir ni rnam par g.yo// chos 'di byed lo tsam yang ngo mtshar 'di dran na// snying nas byas na snying nas ngo mtshar ci 'dra ang*// chos rje bla ma mchog des bdag cag rgyal gyur cig /'phags pa'i sa thob pa'i yon tan 'byung tshul ni/ rim gyis pa/ cig car ba/ 'ga' zhig yod 'ga' zhig med pa/ re re 'byung la gzhan mi 'byung ba/ rnal 'byor pa rang gi snang ba/ yod kyang gzhan gyis mi mthong ba/ yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis kyi lung khungs dang rnam pa drug las/ de la dang po rim gyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ tshul khrims las ting nge 'dzin/ ting nge 'dzin las shes rab skye bar gsungs la/ de yang rgyal po chen po ma skyes dgras tha dad pa rab tu byung ba las mthong ba'i chos la myong bar 'gyur ba'i 'bras bu ji lta bu thob pa zhus pa las tshul khrims kyi phung po sbyangs pa las ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po zhi gnas 'byung la de la rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung nas/

zag pa zad pa/ zad pa shes pa dang mi skye ba shes pa/ shes pas shes rab dgra bcom pa gsungs pa lta bu'o// cig car ba ni mdo nas/ sa dang po thob nas rab tu byung ste bsgoms na gzod yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis 'byung ba dang*/ yum rgyas pa nas/ sa thob nas sa sbyang ba ston pa/ spang bya spangs nas da gzod yon tan skye ba 'thad pa dang*/ grangs med gsum gyi khas len yod na/ gsum gyi bcu cha re re sbyangs pas brgya phrag bcu gnyis po thob par rigs pa'o// 'ga' zhig yod la 'ga' zhig med pa ni/ sangs rgyas bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa shes bya'i sgrib pa spangs pas thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan ma lus pa thob pa yin la/ sa bcu man chad gtsor tshogs mi 'dra ba gtso bor sbyangs pa re re las/ re re'i yon tan 'byung la/ gzhan mi 'byung ba ni/ mo'u 'gal gyi bu chen po dang*/ nor bzang gi bla ma brgya rtsa bcu lta bu'o// rnal 'byor pa rang gi snang ba ni/ mngon par rtogs pa skyes nas/ nyon mongs pa gsum bsal gzhag med pa/ chos kyi sku 'ba' zhig tu mthong zhing*/ sku gsum du bum pa la ngo sprad pa lta bu'o// yod kyang gzhan gyis mi mthong ba ni/ ār+ya na gardzu na sa thob pa'i yon tan dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma pham pa slob dpon 'phags pas bstan pa dang*/ 'dus pa chen por bdud kyi bu mo lnga brgyas sems bskyed pa dang bzod pa chen po thob pa las sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs kyi me tog gi gdugs rgyal ba rnams kyi dbu la snang ba mthong ba lta bu'o/// / 435) ༄/ /'bad rtsol drag po ma yin par lhun grub chen po'i ngang du sdod pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor pa tshe 'dir phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'dod pas/ 'jig rten gyi bsam pa/ log pa'i rtog pa/ nga'am bdag ces nga bdag tu 'dzin pa'i shes pa/ de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad/

tshe 'di'i rnam par rtog pa mtha' dag spangs nas/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis 'phangs pa'i bsam pas/ bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis nyams su blang bar bya ste/ nyams su len lugs de yang bskyed rdzogs gnyis rang gi 'dug lugs su rtogs par byas nas bsgom par bya ste/ med pa btsal btsal po/ bsgoms pas 'ong 'ong po/ bsgrubs pas 'grub 'grub po cig re nas 'bad pa dang rtsol ba drag pos/ rtsa rlung thig les 'bad pa ci tsam zhig byas kyang rtsa a ba dhu tī yang sha'i ltar ltar po/ rlung bum pa sha sha shu shu yang 'gro 'ong rtsab rtsub can/ thig le dwangs snyigs kyang chu khams mer mer po/ dhu tir chud na rgyu ma la g.yos pa 'dra kha g.yos rkyang pa las cang srid dam ste/ byas pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu// ji ltar bsgoms kyang rgyal ba'i gsung dang 'gal// byar med lhun gyis grub pa don dam chos sku yin// de dang ma bral rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi /mi bya mi bya rtsol ba'i las mi bya// byas na ci tsam byas pa 'dus byas yin// lhun grub chen po'i ngang la sdod cig gu// bsngo ba la 'bad// // 436) ༄// bstan pa'i gnas tshad gsungs kyang nges don du mya ngan mi 'da' chos kyang mi nub zhes pa// thub pa chen po chos kyi rje// bskal pa bzang por gsungs pa ni// lnga stong lnga brgya phrag bcur gsungs// slob dpon 'bum ṭig mkhan po yis// lnga brgya tha ma dus kyi tshe// bstan pa gnas par ma gyur kyang*// shes rab pha rol phyin pa yi// 'dul ba'i snying po gsar pa thob// nyams len byed pa mang bar gsungs// zla ba'i snying por nyis stong gsungs// 'dul ba phran tshegs nyid du stong*// sprin chen nas ni lnga brgya gsung*// chos nyid rang gi ngo bo las// ma g.yos tha dad snang ba'i mdor// bdun stong brgyad brgyar gnas par gsungs// thub pa chen po nyid kyi sras// sang ga par pa ta zhes pas// bstan pa nub par 'gyur ba'i tshul// zla ba'i snying po'i rjes 'brangs nas// rgyal po chen po dpung dmar can// dgra bcom pa dang mang du thos// rnam pa gnyis la brten nas kyang*// thub pa'i bstan pa nub par gsung*// dgra bcom chen po dge ba'i bshes// bdag nyid chen po de nyid kyis// ston pa mya ngan 'das nas kyang*// ston pa bdag nyid chen po yis// gnas brtan chen po bcu drug nyid// sum cu rtsa gsum man chad dang*// gling bzhi 'jig rten khams nyid dang*// khyad par 'dzam bu gling nyid du// skyes chen de dag bzhugs nas kyang*// mar la 'grib pa zad pa dang*// yar la 'phel bar gyur pa yi// lo grangs drug brgya'i bar du yang*// bstan pa rin chen gnas 'gyur zhing*// de nas thub pa'i gsung rab rnams// thams cad bsdus par gyur pa kun// mchod rten chen po byas gyur nas// thams cad mya ngan 'da' zhes gsungs// de rjes 'phags pa rang rgyal rnams// lo ni nyis khri bar dag tu// 'byung bar 'gyur bas 'gro ba yi// tshogs gnyis rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang*// de nas rje btsun byams pa byon// byams mgon byon pa'i bstan pa la// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// gang gis bya ba byas pa rnams// 'dus pa gsum du 'gyur zhes gsungs// thub pa chen po rgyal ba'i bka'// nges pa'i don ston gsung rab tu// sangs rgyas mya ngan mi 'da' zhing*// dam pa'i chos kyang mi nub ste// dge 'dun rgyun chad med par gsungs// de yang mya ngan 'das pa nas// 'di ltar sbrang bu mchu snyung mchus// rgya mtsho'i gting du thug ces dang*// rlung dmar zhags pas bcing du rung*// kha yis dbugs kyis ri rab sgyel// zer bar gyur pa de sla yi// ston pa mya ngan mi 'da' zhing*// rtag par gyur pa'i dam pa'i chos// nub par gyur ba ga la srid// dam pa'i chos kyang mi nub na// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgyun chad cing*// thub pa chen po rgyal ba yis// ji ltar gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'i gzhi// dgongs pa dgongs gzhi dgongs pa'i gsung*// ji ltar gsungs pa'i dam chos kyi// don dang mi 'gal ma shes na// glen pa mgo bo 'khor nas mchi// ban rgan 'chol pa kha sla ba// de la dad pa'i nye gnas kyis// yi ger bris par gyur pa la// 'thad dang 'gal ba byung ba yang*// sgro skur bral ba'i blo gros kyis// btang snyoms chen por bzhag la btang*// dam pa'i chos la rgyus chung zhing*// dad pas gang zag rjes 'brang ba// kye ma nga yi dam chos zhes// 'dzin par byed pa'i ban rgan bzhin// khyed kyi bla ma dam pa de// thub pa'i gsung las gzhan pa yi// dam pa'i chos gcig yod na ko

/de la su zhig dad cing gus// ston pa'i gsung las mi gzhan pa'i// zab pa bla med dam pa'i chos// dkon mchog gsum po rtag gyur na// de la ngo mtshar che rgyu ci// ji ltar byis pa'i rmi lam la// pha ma dga' ba skye na yang*// rmis pa'i 'khrul pa rdzun du bas// //

437) ༄// jo sras la snying khong nas byung ba'i gdams pa bstan pa// rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// pha bdag las skyes pa'i jo sras la// snying khong nas byung ba'i gdams ngag bstan// sdig nyon mongs rnam rtog nyes tshogs kun// chos sems nyid stong par rtogs pa des// skyon 'khor ba'i nyes tshogs bcom par nges// a dzi/ rgyal po chen po ma skyes dgras// mtshams med lnga sogs nyes tshogs kun// stong par rtogs pa'i skad cig la// skyon rnams dag cing yon tan rdzogs// sgyu lus phung po 'di nyid la// mi gtsang rdzas gyur sum cu gnyis// rtag tu yod pa ma shes sam// gang ni bzang la gang ni ngan// khyad par khyed kyi gcig shos te// spang bya gnyen po gnyis med par// khyed kyi nyams su blang bar zhu// a ti sa ma pa ṭa'o// // 438) ༄// phag gru'i gdan sar bzhugs pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen por gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ mgon po phag mo gru pa'i gdan sa na bzhugs pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po la gdams pa/ spyir gnyid mi 'ong ba'i rgyu ngal dub med pa dang*/ nyin par gnyid pa dang*/ rnam par rtog pa mangs pa dang*/ rdo rjes 'og gi rnal 'byor la ma gnas pa dang*/ rnam pa bzhis 'byung ba yin gyi/ grib kyis kyang cung zad 'byung ste/ nyes pa'i dri ma de gang yin ngo shes par byas nas/ de las bzlog pa'i gnyen po mang du thos pa gdams ngag gzhan la rag ma lus phan yon che ba/ dpal ldan 'bri gung pa'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi las rnyed pa mtha' dag thugs su chud par bya ba dang*/ rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// nyes tshogs ltas ngan sna tshogs pa// bzlog par byed pa'i gdams ngag ni// skyon yon tan du 'gyur ba/ bar chad dngos grub tu 'gyur ba/ bdud chos skyong du 'gyur ba/ skyon dag cing yon tan rdzogs pa'i gnad/ bcu chos dang sum chos ma gtogs pa la bdag po med pa ni khyed rang gi khums/

dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras bcas pa la yang med dam snyam pa'i bsam pa yod pa lags pas 'bad pa chen pos nan tan che bar mdzad par zhu/ phyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba mtha' dag thams cad kyang*/ snang ba rang gi sems las gzhan med pa'i phyir gong ma gcig pus skyon 'dag pa dang*/ yon tan rdzogs pa dang phun sum tshogs pa khong du chud par bya'o// 'gro bas byang chub mchog thob shog/ // 439) ༄// dam chos dpal gyi chos drug 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum gyi tshul bstan pa// bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// bla med jo bo dkon mchog la// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud// skyabs su mchi 'o byin gyis rlobs// mgon po bcom ldan rin po ches// chos dang dus dang tshod dang yang*// bdag nyid 'khor dang gang zag rigs// shes pas nyams par mi 'gyur zhes// legs par gsungs pa 'di yi don// dam chos dpal gyi chos drug thabs// rab 'byams stong nyid rgya mtsho yin// de don nyams myong rtog pa yin// rgas 'khogs nus pa zad pa'i dus// dus dang bdag nyid shes pa yin// 'khor dang tshod dang gang zag gsum// deng sang phan chad bsgrub nus shing*// phun sum tshogs pa ma glas gnas spos pa te// thar pa'i sa bon gzhag pa'i phyir// thams cad rab tu byung ba dang*// 'bad pa byas par gyur pa la// dga' zhing rjes su yi rang ngo*// 'das pa'i dus tshod bstan pa yin// da ltar dus tshod bstan pa la// dam chos nyams su len pa ni// dad ldan g.yo sgyu kha bsag med// na so gzhon zhing brtson 'grus che// nyams su len pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// ri bo 'bugs shing rgya mtsho skems// de yang dad ldan gtong phod che// sham thabs khral la ltos pa med// bco lnga bcu drug yan chad nas// bzhi bcu lo grangs man chad la// dam chos ston pa'i dus tshod yin// yab kyis ngo sras khrid pa dang*// a pos sras po khrid pa dang*// rgas pa la sogs nyes tshogs kyis// grwa pa skyong ba'i dus tshod min// 'khor dang gang zag tshod rigs pa// gdams pa bla ma gong ma'i bka'// da lta'i dus su bstan pa 'o// ma 'ongs dus tshod bstan pa ni// bdag 'dzin nyon mongs dug rgyas pas// a po shi ba'i rjes shul du// gdan sa bya byed shom ra yis// sde 'khrugs nyes tshogs bsam mi khyab// thub pa'i bstan pa zad du nye// lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma 'dir// ston pa'i sku gdung rgyas pa dang*// mchod cing bkur sti mi byed pa// gnod pa sna tshogs byed pa kun// bden nam rdzun pa'i tshul lugs kyi// gong ma'i gdan sa rnams la ltos// dang po 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi// lto gos nar dang kha bsags kyis// mgo skor brid pa'i sdug bsngal rnams// til phung bzhin du bsdus nas kyang*// mnar med rdo rje dmyal ba dang*// ngan song gsum du lhung ba 'di// de sngon mgo bo 'khor na yang*// a dzi snying yang ma rje 'am// rang rang gnas su ci dgar sgur// bag kyang 'dug na cis ma legs// rjes kyi bya ba bstan pa 'o//

// 440) ༄// rang gi rig pa 'jig rten thams cad kyi byed po tshangs pa yin zhes pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo// srid pa dkor rje drang dkar zhes bya ba de/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi byed pa po tshangs pa/ gdul bar shin tu dka' bar 'dod pa yin/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi byed pa po de/ bcom pa dang*/ brlag pa dang*/ tshar gcad par ci tsam du 'bad kyang*/ rang nyid la de ltar byas par 'gyur ba yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang rang gi rig pa 'jig rten thams cad kyi byed pa po tshangs pa yin/ de skye ba med cing rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag par rtogs pa'i dus su/ tshangs pa chos kyi sku phan pa dang bde ba thams cad kyi byed pa po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ de'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa yin pas de spong dgos/ de spang ba la thabs mkhas pa'i bsam pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/ de'i rjes su 'brangs pa ku sā li'i tshogs gsog gis bdag 'dzin spong ba/ rang gzhan snod bcud thams cad spangs nas sangs rgyas su byed pa 'di/ lan gsum mam/ bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig byas pa'i 'og tu lus bdud rtsir zhu bas/ rang gzhan snod bcud nyes pa'i dri ma sbyangs nas/ sangs rgyas su gyur pas kyang blo bde/ rang yi dam gyi lha gcig tu bsgrubs pas sangs rgyas su gyur pas kyang blo bde/ sems nyid rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa smra bsam brjod 'das lhun gyis grub cing 'gyur ba med pas kyang blo bde/ phyir lus pa ni khab tsam yang med/ ma nyan pa ni spu tsam yang mi 'dug rgyun chad med par ri bo'i khrod du rnam par dag pa'i de kho na nyid dang ma 'bral ba 'di las/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas la yang gzhan mi mnga' na/ nged rjes su 'jug pa lta smos kyang ci dgos pas/ 'di kho na nyams su blang*/ ang ang ang*/ de yang dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// 'jig rten gsum mgon rin chen gyis// gnyug ma byams chen ting 'dzin gyis// srod la bdud kyi dkyil 'khor btul// zhes pas mngon no// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig/

// 441) ༄// srung 'khor zhal gdams gtum po sum brtsegs// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ ma shi'i bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ dus de ring nas bzung sang da tsam gyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol snyam du dam bca'/ bsam pa de yi ngang las jo bo thugs rje chen po bsgom/ de'i thugs kar khro bo mi g.yo ba bsgom/ de'i thugs kar yi dam gyi lha bsgom/ gza' mi rnams bsrung bar 'dod na/ gza' mi gang bsrung ba rnams bsgom la bzlas pa ci nus tshad du bya/ skabs skabs su/ bdag dang 'khor dang 'das thams cad kyis/ dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig ces yang dang yang du bsngo ba 'bad la bya// // 442) ༄// gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon nor bu bzang po'i gtor chog kha zas phud gtor byed thabs pha ma gnyis kyi gdams ngag ma ṇi bha dra// pha ma gnyis kyi gdams ngag ni/ dang por sems bskyed nas/ yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ kha zas ci za ba'i phud la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la cung zad phul ba'i rjes la gtor ma'i rgyu dum zhig phud la sder ma'i grwar bzhag nas za 'thung nam tshar ba'i dus su/ gtor gzhong zhig gi nang du zan dum de bcug nas/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po byang chub sems dpa' nor bu bzang po la/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dgos 'dod kyi dngos po mtha' dag tu bsams nas/ sngags 'dis dbul bar bya ste// oṃ ma ṇi bha dra hūm̐/ zhes lan bdun brjod/ se gol bdun gtogs nas de'i rjes la mdo gdon/ gtor ma gtsang sar dbul/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo/

dkon mchog la mchod pa/ long sprang la yon/ skyes bu dam pa la bla'i mchod gnas su byed pa ni dam tshig go/ // 443) ༄// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho bdag 'dzin spong ba gcig pur 'da' ba// skyabs bla na med pa'i bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che/ lhag pa tshul khrims dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab dang gsum gyi bdag nyid du gyur cing*/ de bdag dang*/ bdag gi 'khor dang*/ rdzas dang*/ yo byad dang*/ longs spyod dang*/ grags snyan du 'dzin pa thams cad/ tshul khrims kyis tshar bcad cing spangs/ ting nge 'dzin gyis mi 'ong ba'i sgo gtan pa dam por bcug nas/ shes rab kyis gzung 'dzin rnam par dag pa/ rten med pa nam mkha' dang 'dra bar gyur pa/ ston pa'i bstan pa yin pa la/ ming bzang po ni de gsum rgyan du thogs nas/ ming bzang po'i bdag 'dzin dang*/ khe dang grags pa dang*/ rnyed bkur mang po dang*/ bzang po yin no bsgrub par 'dug ste/ ston pa'i gsung bstan pa de dang*/ khyod kyang mthun par 'dug gam/ ston pa'i bstan pa rin po che// bdag dang bdag gi gzung 'dzin gnyis// spangs shing spong bar gsungs pa dang*// spangs shing rnam par spangs pa yis// bdag 'dzin 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho rnams// spangs shing spangs par gyur pa yis// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' ma de// spangs par mdzad pa'i ston pa dang*// spang thabs bslab pa rnam gsum dang*// nyams len 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las// med cing rnam par dag pa dang*// lta dang sgom dang spyod pa dang*// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba// nam mkha' lta bur rab gnas pa// don dam ngo bo nyid kyi sku// mnyam pa nyid la gnas pa dang*// rtag tu 'di dang mi 'bral shog /'di 'dra 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dang*// dus rnams kun tu 'grogs pa dang*// thub pa'i dgongs pa gnyis med pa// mkha' ltar dag pa rdzogs par shog

/sdig pa'i grogs po ming bzang po// thos dang bsam dang sgom pa dang*// lta ba sgom pa spyod pa dang*// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i tshogs// bdag dang 'dra ba med do zhes// ji ltar byas pa thams cad kyis// ming bzang 'khor dang bcas pa yi// bdag 'dzin mnga' thang rgyas pa'i thabs// res 'ga' ri bo'i rtse la bsgom// ri bo'i rtse la gnas pa'i tshe// shal ma ri yi rtse mor gnas// res 'ga' chu bo'i 'gram du bsgom// thal tshan chu bo rab med ang*// res 'ga' nags kyi nang na zhugs// ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal 'jigs// res 'ga' thang la spyod lam gzob// lhar bcas 'jig rten rkun po 'dis// thar pa'i nor rnams 'phrog 'phrog 'dra// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// rang la snying brtse yod pa'i mis// chom rkun 'di la blo ma gtod// chom rkun 'jigs su rung pa la// blo gtod snying bzhag ma mdzad cig /stong nyid nyi zla 'phrogs nas kyang*// bdag 'dzin gzung 'dzin mun khrod du// dmyal ba ngan song mtha' med du// bdud kyi rgyal pos skyur skyur 'dra// byang chub sems kyi yon tan brjod// khong gzhan don mdzad pa yin no mchi// byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// rtog pa thams cad spang pa'i sems// 'gro 'ong spros pa bcad pa dang*// da rung phrad mjal ma thub pas// khyod kyi 'khor dang gnyen 'dun dang*// khyod la dad cing gus pa dang*// btud par gyur pa'i slob ma kun// khyod ci 'dra ba de yis shes// rgyal po'i bsam pa 'bangs kyis ston// mang po'i bshad bshud ci zhig 'tshal// 'khor gyis spyod pa gsal bar bstan// rje yi mdzad pa 'bangs kyis byed// de sngon phan chad dad rdzas kyis// dpag med 'khor dang gnyen 'dun rnams// khrod nas skyes chen gang du bzhud// skyob mdzad skyob pa chen po yi// bstan pa nub khar byung ba yi// dpon chen bzhi dang khyad ci gda'// legs par bsams nas dpon chen bzhis// ston pa'i zhal mthong gsung yang thos// rgyal po'i gsung rab rgya chen du// tshogs kyi lam par gsungs pa lags// kye ma rje btsun ming bzang po'i// bu smad da lta ga na yod// thub pa'i bstan pa 'jig pa yi// bcom ldan 'das kyis nyes ci byas// mkhan slob bla ma gong ma la// 'di tsam gnod pa skyel ba yi// de tsam khyod la ci zhig bya// kye ma kye hud ming bzang po'i// 'khor gyi tshogs dang lhan gcig tu// bzhud par gyur pa re ma dga'// byang chub sems dpa' 'di 'dra na// 'jig rten chom rkun ci 'dra ang*// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// bdag ni bdag la bdag cag gis// rnyed mang bkur sti mang po byas// bdag la mang po dga' bo zhes// de 'dra'i snyems pa 'chang gyur na// shi ba'i 'og tu 'jigs pa skye// skyob mdzad mgon po'i gsung re mad// skyabs su mchi 'o bla ma rnams// skyob mdzad mgon pos bskyab tu gsol// bskal pa dpag med sngon rol na// dus rnams rtag tu skyob mdzad cing*// skyob par mdzad pa'i mgon po mchog

/bdag 'dzin 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// skyob mdzad yi dam lha la skyabs// 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// skyob bar byed pa'i dam chos la// skyabs su mchi 'o bskyab tu gsol// sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa cher mthong na// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// phyi yi rdzas dang yo byad dang*// slob ma nye du 'khor 'bangs kun// spangs pas 'bral bar mi 'gyur te// lta ngan bdag dang bdag gi dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa spang pa la// rdo rje 'chang chen bcom ldan 'das// 'jig rten mgon po gong ma dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// da ni rjes su mi slob re// bdag 'dzin bzung dang 'dzin pa rnams// spong bar byed pa'i gnyen po rnams// spang bya gnyen pos gang spong ba// 'bad pa'i brtul zhugs ci spyad kyang*// mu stegs byed kyi brtul zhugs kyis// dka' thub drag po ci spyad kyang*// dka' thub nas ze gang za ba// ma bkab gos gyis 'tsho byed pa// ston pa rdzogs byed 'khor bcas lags// bdag dang bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di// rang gi sems su mi gda' 'am// rang gi sems su gda' lags na// rang sems rtogs pa ma gtogs pa// thabs gzhan gda' 'am dgongs par zhu// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' med pa// bdag 'dzin spong pa ma lags sam// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyang*// bla med byang chub rin po che// byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// rnam rtog spangs pa rang gi sems// rnam dag nam mkha' lta bu de// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// mnyam med mgon pos bstan pa de// lhag pa tshul khrims rin po che// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gshegs shul mchog /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skems pa'i me// nyon mongs dug chen 'joms pa'i sman// sems rta kha blan dka' ba la// mthun pa'i gzer chen brgyab pa'i srab// rang sems thar pa'i grong khyer du// 'gro bar byed pa'i cang shes la// legs par bsrab cing kha lo bsgyur// ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med// tshad med snying rje chen po las// nges par byung ba'i byang chub sems// nye bar zhi ba'i grong khyer du// phyin par gyur pa'i dus kyi tshe// 'dir yang gnod byed chom rkun mang*// bsam gtan sgo 'phar dam po yis// ma yengs dran pa'i stobs kyis bcad// lhag pa ting 'dzin bslab pa yin// ting 'dzin 'di la gang gnas pa// rnam grol ye shes phung po nyid// chu bo rgyun phyogs 'bab pa 'am// nyi mas mun pa gsal ba ltar// rtsol sgrub med par ngang gis 'char// 'ching ba'i thag pa gcod par zhu// thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen 'di// rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen la// rgyal ba'i yon tan dpag med pa// 'byung bar thugs kyis dgongs par zhu// bdag 'dzin spong ba gcig pur 'da'o//

444) ༄// the tshom gcod pa'i zhus len snying po spyan snga sher 'byung gis bsgrigs pa// 'khor 'das bdag po bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bdag /mnyam med bla ma mchog dang rnal 'byor ma// spros med mkha' ltar gzigs la phyag 'tshal 'dud// 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan rin chen la// rtse gcig sgrub pas mnyes byed ri khrod pas// the tshom gcod phyir khrid du zhus pa'i chos// brtse bas tshogs la gsungs pa bri bar bya// spyir thabs dang shes rab sgom pa de tshig dang don mtshon pa yin/ de chos yin rgyu med/ mos gus kyis bla ma de'i tshig des mtshon pa'i don nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pa skye/ de don yin pas skyong ba yin/ dus rtag tu lnga ldan la ldab rkyang byed pa yin/ dang po kho nar nang par gyi dus su lam du gtang*/ sems bskyed yi dam gyi lha bsgom/ 'di dang po'i sngon 'gro yin/ de nas byams pa'am/ snying rje'am/ yi dam gyi lha'am/ bla ma'am gang yin pa nyin mtshan kha sbyar la 'bad/ bsngo ba de yid la dran pa tsam yin no// rnam rtog dang dge sbyor dbye ba med pa chos kyi skur rtogs pa las/ gong du 'gro rgyu'i bogs med/ bu chung rkang bu tshugs pa yin/ de gzod dben par bsgom dgos/ yon tan dpag tu med pa skye/ phyag rgya chen po gsha' ma yod pa la/ phyag rgya chen por mi 'gro ba 'ga' zhig byung na/ mi 'gro ba de rgyun bsrings pas phyag rgya chen por 'gro ba de la bsgom zer/ snga ma lta ba zer ro// nyon mongs dang rnam rtog phyag rgya chen por go yang*/ rang rgyud du 'chor bar 'dug dran pas zin na de nyid phyag rgya chen por 'ong bar 'dug pa de nas bcu chos dang gsum chos lags mod/ bcu chos dang gsum chos kyi rtog pa/ rags pa dang*/ 'bring ba dang*/ phra ba lung ma bstan rnam pa gsum mo// ngas lo gnyis bsgom shes pa de gang yin na/

mi rtag pa dang*/ byams snying rje shes pas so// thabs lam la sogs pa gong mas kyang de rang du 'gro bas/ chu la chu bzhag rab/ 'bring thabs lam/ tha ma 'khrul 'khor ro// phyogs gcig tu sdod yun ring na/ dge sbyor gyi shugs chad pas rnam par rtog pa 'ba' zhig tu 'ong*/ de la maṇ+ḍal dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur dang gtum mo dang*/ thabs lam tshos bogs 'don/ glang bu rgyab chad la sngags dang*/ phyag rgya dang dge rtsar bsngo/ gsos par bya/ rgyu 'bras la nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ sgyu ma dang dngos por 'dzin pa gsum mo// shes pa rtse gcig tu dmigs drag na/ nad du 'gro ste/ rtsol drag pa'i skyon/ sgom ma shes pa'i skyon/ yul la ma blta sems la ma blta shig dang*/ gang la'ang mi brtson de ni byang chub sems dpas brtson/ ri khrod kyi dgon par rtsol sgrub mi byed par lhug pa gal che'o/ bla ma sna tshogs su 'gyur ba de rang gi bsam pa sna tshogs su 'gyur ba'i mtshan ma yin/ nyin par dge sbyor la rtsol sgrub mi dgos/ mtshan mo gnyid khug tu mi 'ong bas rmi lam 'od gsal 'dzin pa gal che gsung*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nyan thos srod dang tho rangs la mi nyal bar sbyor ba la brtson pa'i rgyu mtshan yang 'di yin/ gzhan gyi grib de mngon par shes pa dang 'dra bar 'ong*/ gsang sngags rnying ma tshe ring ba sman mchod kyis yin/ ci tsam du dge sbyor 'phel ba de tsam du mi mthun pa'i phyogs skyon de bas che ba 'ong*/ kwa kha gcig dge sbyor 'dre rtags yin/ nad 'dre yin/ drag sngags kyis 'dre gcun pa la drag sngags su byed de/ spang bya dang gnyen po phyin ci log tu song bas gtan mi phan te/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'ba' zhig go /rtsa ba'i byams pa dang chags pa gcig mod kyi/ a ma la bsgom pas chags pa dang bral bar byed/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang ma 'dres pas tshangs pa'i gnas su skye/ rgya chen po la byams pas de'i bdag por 'gyur/

byas pa la mi rtag pa 'khor ba'i chos yin/ ma hā mu dra dang bo dhi swa twas dbang byas pas rtags dang 'gyur ba med pa'o// grang ba'i dus su gtum mo bsgom/ de dang 'dra bar mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad la'o// spyir skyon la bros pas mi phan/ gtum mo'i rlung sems gnyis las/ rlung sems nyams su blang ba'i thabs spyan sngar bstan pa de yin/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor nyams su len pa'i dus su/ rje btsun chen po'i 'khrul 'khor gnad drug bcing ba'i man ngag byas la nyin mtshan kha sbyar la bsgom/ 'gro ba dang*/ 'chags pa'i dus su dmigs pa 'ba' zhig la ma yengs par bya/ skabs skabs su snga ma de ltar nyams su blangs/ phyag rgya chen por rang shugs kyis gnad du 'gro/ gtum mo'i bogs 'don zhag bcu bdun la de kho na bsgom/ sgyu lus kyi bogs 'don la nyin mtshan kha sbyar nas nyams su blangs pas ting nge 'dzin rab mchog bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' byon pa'i dus su/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyad pas/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub mi thob pa rang dbang med/ lus ngag yid gsum 'khrul 'khor gsum gyi man ngag gis nyams su blang*/ slob ma gcig pu byung yang des chog /sham thabs khral len khri tsho bas// nyams su len pa gcig gcig dga'// rnying pa kha cig ri khrod du// bla ma dam pa mnyes pa'i phyir// rang gzhan gnyis kyi don bsgrub pa// rnal 'byor seng ge 'dir mchod do// rnying pa kha cig nor gsog cing*// lha dang yi ge kha smras tshol// phung ba'i 'dre 'di dgos med pas// so so rang rang gnas su dengs// shan shun ma phyed gsar pa 'ga'// bskyang bar bya phyir gong ma yi// rnam par thar pa'i rjes 'jug pa'i// brtas par gyur pa'i thabs 'di brtsam// rgas pa shi dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ bla ma byang chub kyi sems yin pas so// ri la 'gro ba khe grags re sa med pas dur khrod dang 'dra ste mi sgom kha med/

khrid byas pa tshig gi phreng bas mi phan nyams myong dgos/ sgrub pa ma byas pa'i ri khrod bla ma dpal dang ra bye lo tsā ba dang 'dra ba yin no// dge sbyor mang po thams cad rmi lam lam gyi tshod 'dzin yin/ gtum mo lam gyi dngos gzhi yin gsung*/ des na gzhan la rtsol sgrub med do// thams cad ma grub pa gzhi de la rtog pa chu las chu bur 'byung*/ gnad du gang 'gro nyams su len pa las nu ma gdams ngag mang po ra dang gzhug ma dang 'dra'o// yid gdung bas ma tshugs pa'i dus su bstim/ nyon mongs dang rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bya/ rigs 'dzin no ba glang skyong ba ltar ste/ thabs dang shes rab kyi bogs 'don pa gal che/ thams cad kyi sngon du bsod nams kyi tshogs 'gro bas don 'grub/ 'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'dzin pa ste/ sangs rgyas thob pa 'dzin pa yin/ gnyid drag po/ 'dod pa spyod pa drag po/ rdeg pa la zhugs pa drag po gsum dharma drag po la grub thob zer ro// phan btags par drin du mi gzo ba mtshams med kyi las yin/ skyon byung ba la rdzu zer ba de ma zhus par ma zer ba bsam gtan pa dga' bo lta bu'o// ri la dge sbyor 'phel bas sa g.yo ba yi ge drug pa'i dpe dang 'dra'o// ri drin che ba ri bo dang drang srong dang 'dra/ rtsa rlung lnga la rtog pa lnga la ro gcig gces so// cho 'phrul bag la nyal rkyen gyis slongs pas gos dang nor la sems zhugs na thams cad la 'dra'o// bdag med rtogs shing byams snying rje skyes nas don bya/ nad dang bdud lhar bsgom pa dran pa ma yengs par brtson 'grus bskyed/ lnga ldan gyis nyams su blang rgyu'i rtog pa 'dzin pa chen po la zer ro// lus dngos po'i gnas lugs ci la zer na/ da ltar 'dzin pa'i shes pas lus der nyon mongs dang rtog pa thams cad do// byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems skyes pa'i dus gnad 'brel ba can du bsgom/

za rgyu ma rnyed na tshogs bsag yan lag bdun pa mang po bya/ gzhan mi srung bar rang bsgom/ bsrung na dang por rang bsrung ba gal che'o// dge sbyor gnad du ma song na 'khrul 'khor gyi sbyor bas gcun/ nan tan chen por bsgrub na rtsa'i mdud pa dral/ gnad du ma phog pa'i sems 'dzin/ dus la ma bab pa'i brtul zhugs goms pa med pa'i ri khrod/ pho tshod med pa'i bya byed byas pa'i rjes la ngan nas mchi'o// rtsa zug rlung zug mdze/ rnam par rtog pa dang mi rtog pa'i khrid do// sgom ma shes na zhe 'dod/ sgom shes na zhe 'dod med pa'o// yul la chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis bar do'i lus gsum/ bla ma bya ba rang gi sems kyi de nyid la zer ba yin/ slob ma gces par byas pas tshar la sdang bar byung ba na/ de la chags pa dang*/ gsol ba gsum ma btab pa'i skyon yin/ phra men lha ma yin phyin kha log/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba la zer ba yin/ rmi lam du dge ba dang mi dge ba byas pa dang*/ ma gnyid pa'i dus su byas pa phan gnod mi bcu 'gyur ram/ brgya 'gyur gyis che ste/ mthong chos mngon sum du 'byung ngo*// sum chos bsgoms pas rmi lam du bde ba rgyas nas sad na de rang gis bya/ rmi lam res zin res mi zin pa'i rgyu bzhi dang*/ de las gnad du song ba de las ldog pa'o// rlung log 'byung ba'i rgyu ni/ tung tung dang tsab tsub tu song bas lan no// bla dwags mi dwags pa dang ban dhe chos med yon bdag pas tshar bcad pa'i gtam rgyud dang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba byas pas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis mi thub/ phyag rgya chen po bla ma yin/ de dang ma bral bas bla ma dang ma bral/ ri khrod du bsgoms pas zhal bzhugs na sku'i rim gror 'gro/ rang shi yang bla ma dang gcig tu 'dres nas 'gro bas drung du 'ong bas gtso che ba ma yin nyon mongs pa spyod pa'i grogs dang rten rnyed nas bla ma mi dran pa skyon yin/

bde ba dang skyid pa'i dus su mkhar lan dang rtsed 'dzings dang ri ltad la sogs pa ye mi bya/ bde skyid des bde skyid dge sbyor 'ba' zhig tu bsgrub/ sdug pa'i dus su dge sbyor byed dgos te 'ong ba dka'/ byung na bogs che/ des na ston pas bde bas bde ba bsgrub par gsungs pa yin/ skyon dang nyes pa gang byung yang byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ byang chub kyi sems dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ bla ma dang phyag rgya chen po gang bsgom pa/ skyon de sos de nyid du shes par bya/ sna 'gebs pa dang lto za ba phyi'i srung ba/ gsang ba'i srung ba khu ba ma nyams pa/ bdud rtsi lnga lus la gnas pa/ nang gi bsrung ba dpa' mo'i go cha'o// bogs ni blo ldog rnam bzhi ci skye yin/ bhe ra ba dang 'dre gnyis sems gcig la gnyis su byas pas 'khrul lo// rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa'i chos/ thub pa chen po'i gsung rab rgyal po'i dkor mdzod lta bu/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis sdud ma shes pas ni 'thor du bcug brgyud pa gong ma'i gdams ngag gsang sngags thams cad kyi yang snying*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi srog rtsa ni kha zags su btang*/ nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pa'i chos dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa lta bu ni/ mi chos kyi 'dam rdzab du rul du bcug bla ma sangs rgyas kyi gsung tshu rol mthong bas/ dpag par dka' ba/ dbang gi rgyal po lta bu ni/ ste'u dang zer dang*/ lo la sogs pas khyi khung du phyung ba'i slob ma slob ma yin snyam pa'am/ ngo re tsha skyu ga re bro/ gnod pa thos dang mthong ba dang*// 'ong zhing gsod par byed na yang*// thabs kyis mthun par 'gyur ba'i phyir// kha mtshams bya zhing dga' ba sgrub// phyogs ris med pa'i 'gro don gyis// phyogs ris zhe 'dod spros pa chad// zhe 'dod med pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rig pa ngar ldan rang mthong skye// srog chags phra mo ban ban 'di// rgyu gang las byung ba'i 'bras bu yin// ston pa snang mdzad chen po de// rgyu gang las byung ba'i 'bras bu yin// kwa a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// yul dman dang phra ba'i nyes skyon spongs// zab dang rgya che'i chos la 'bad// dam chos 'di yi gleng langs ni// yog pa mthong ba'i chags sdang yin// lho bal gyi 'bul ba bsod nams kyi tshogs su 'gro bar gcig kyang*/

sbed pa dang*/ 'phyar ba dang*/ tshogs su 'bul ba dang*/ de la sna khrid 'tshol ba zab/ byin rlabs kyi rkyen gcig gis gzhan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug rdzogs nas sangs rgya/ byin rlabs kyi rkyen zhig gis bstan pa'i dgrar gyur na rdo rje dmyal ba 'gro ste/ mar khrid kyi ded dpon du gyur pa'i skyon no// lus ngag yid gsum dum khrigs kyi bsngo ba/ bla ma dam pas yon tan skyed/ yi dam lhas bar chad sel/ bla ma gong ma la bkur sti bya ba'i thabs so// blos btang ba dang*/ blos bzung nas grol ba'o// rnam par shes pa gar yod pa'i sar 'du/ lus ngag yid gsum gnas dang longs spyod du bcas pa'o// gtam la nyan na 'bri/ chu bo gaṅga dang rten 'brel lo// snyigs ma'i zhing 'dzin pa'i dang po sems bskyed pa bde ba bdag gir mi bya/ bstan pa'i gdams ngag bdag gir bya/ bstan pa'i gdams ngag bdag gir ma byas par/ bde ba bdag gir byas na/ bcu chos dang sum chos ma go ma go bas nyams len ma shes/ des khu ba nyams/ 'dod pa'i don ma grub pa yin/ sgrib pa lnga mngon du rgyu glo bur du spong*/ rtse gcig bsgom btab pas 'ong ba min/ spros bral byin rlabs kyis go ma bcos pa bzhag thabs yin/ rtogs pa'i gnad kas tha mal du mi 'ong*/ dge sbyor gsha' ma zhig bya snyam pa'i dus der/ bar du gcod pa 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan rang nyid gcig pus gtso bor rang nyid kyi don du dge sbyor byas pa'i skyon yin/ de la byang chub kyi snying po'i rdo rje'i gdan sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin rlabs pa'i dpe/ don dam byang chub kyi sems su bstan/ bar chad dang po byung ba yul shor/ rting du byung ba nyes skyon slongs pas de nyid bsgom/ byams snying rje dang mos gus dang gsol ba gdab/ maṇ+ḍal dbul/ rab gnas rten 'brel rgyu rkyen 'dzom/ tshogs pa bsgrub pa tshogs pa'i skad cig la las sbyor bya/ mu dra skyong pa la shes pa bkug pas skyo/

btang ba 'byams pas re dga'/ mtha' bral byang chub kyi sems kyis ma bslang na nad mi sol/ sol yang ldog lar spang gnyen gnyis su song na dug gsum yin/ des na byang sems bla ma yi dam sku bzhi gang du bsgoms kyang sos/ spyod lam cha mnyam thabs shes rab bogs 'don/ nad dang rlung log gi rgyu byas pa yin/ bla ma dam pa'i zhal snga nas/ tshogs skyong ba dka' ste/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad la mi blta ba 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga la ma chags pa/ lus dang srog la mi blta ba/ dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyud 'dzin pa/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la gces spras su byed pa/ sems can gyi khams smin pa dang grol ba'i go cha bgos pa/ brtson 'grus kyi shugs me ltar 'bar ba/ bzod pa'i go cha rdo rje lta bu bgos pa/ thabs dang shes rab kyi rgyal mtshan bzung ba/ rgyu sems can la 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i nges shes brtan pa'o// a ma a la la dge 'dun gyi tshogs skyong zhing bskyangs pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par 'dod na/ rdzas dang yo byad kha rje dang dbang thang*/ bsod nams dang bsags pa la mi brten cing mi gnas na chos 'ba' zhig gis 'tsho zhing de rnams la mi gnas pas/ 'khor dag cing bzang po sha stag tu 'gyur la/ chos ma gtogs pa gzhan la re ba med pas/ chos 'ba' zhig so nam du byas pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur ba ngo mtshar che ste/ bla ma slob ma la mi mgu/ slob ma bla ma la mi mgu ba ni 'di dag thob par 'dod pas/ de ma byung ba'i dus su 'khon pa kho nar snang ngo zhes de dag mi 'dzin pa'i dam bca' can dag de skad zer ro// chos bya snyam pa'i dus su bdud kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i rten gyi gang zag 'ga' zhig gis/ dge 'dun ci 'khrugs/ dge sbyor ci tshogs yon bdag pa la kha ze ci tshod blta bar 'dug pas/ nga la slob dpon re na rgyun 'di tsam gcig mi mdzad par zhu/

sprang long yang 'khyar/ tshe ma phyid nam ma langs/ mi chos dang lha dam gang yang med pa/ nga 'dra ba'i grwa ba/ so nams su nor mi gsog gtan srid du chos gsog pa dang gcig spyi'i nye gnas bla ma'i gsung bzhin dgos pa mtha' dag bsgrub pa dang gnyis/ drung gi nye gnas rang gi zhe 'dod kyi rjes mi 'brang zhing*/ bla ma'i gsung bzhin du byed pa gsum po 'di dang mi ldan na/ nga gsum ga mi 'chang*/ khyed kyang drung du ma gnas/ gdug pa'i me sbar bas thar pa'i sa bon 'tshig nyon mongs kyi sprin gtibs pas dkar po'i lo tog bcom/ 'dod chags kyi dug khol bas 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi 'joms/ a la la re 'jigs/ a la la re 'jigs/ a la la re 'jigs/ 'ubs kyis hril gyis dril lags na// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de// skyabs 'gro thun mong nas bzung nas// gsang 'dus phyag rgya chen po'i bar// thub pa'i bka' rnams ma lus pa// sdom pa gsum gyis bsdams pa rnams// gsang sngags rig pa 'dzin pa yi// sdom pa bla ma rin chen gsung*// de la gnas par gyur pa ni// phyag rgya bzhi po bstan pa yang*// gsang sngags dam tshig nyid du nges// bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi nyams len 'dir// gtso bo dpal ldan nā ro pas// lus sems gnyis kyi gnas lugs su// gsungs pa nyams len rim pa dang*// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa rnams// slob dpon chen po til+li pas// dpal ldan nā ro pa la gdams// de yi nyams len zab mo 'di// brgyud pa rin chen bcud phyung nas// slob ma rnams la gdams pa yin// 'gro ba'i bla ma nyid kyi phyag bsam la// snying po snying po'i gsung tshig 'ba' zhig dag /dus tshod gcig tu btab pa 'di dag kun// ban dhe shes rab 'byung gnas bdag gis bris// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig/

445) ༄// mnga' bdag rgyal po jo sing la 'bangs rnams byams pas skyong bar gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ se ba byang chub gling gong nas// chos kyi rgyal po chen po yis// bla ma dam par bkur gyur pa// shākya'i dge slong ldom bu bas// mi rje lha yi dpon dang sras// byang chub sems dpa'i gdung rgyud mchog /mgo nag yongs kyi spyi rje ste// rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul pa mchog /chos kyi rgyal po jo sing la// gdams shing zhu don gsol ba'i mdo// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon gyur pa// dpal ldan stag lung thang pa dang*// kho bo sprang po ldom bu gnyis// khyed kyis bla ma dam par bzung*// rgyal po'i khrims kyi bya ba dang*// 'bangs kyi so tshis mdzad pa yang*// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs tog tu// chos kyi rgyal po'i lugs su mdzad// da yang sngar bzhin thugs la thogs// rgya gar rgya nag bgrod byed cing*// zam pa bzhi la rten bcas nas// rab byung khrims kyis 'tsho ba yi// 'gron po phan tshun rgyu ba rnams// rgyal po rnams kyis skyong ba las// gnod pa bskyal ba ma mchis pas// gong ma rnams kyi tshul bzung zhu// rdo rje gdan dang dpal gyi ri// u rgyan la sogs rgya gar na// sangs rgyas pa dang mu stegs byed// thams cad kun gyi rnal 'byor pa// mthu dang nus pas dgos pa yi// 'di tsho yon bdag rtsa ba yin// bal yul gtsang dang dbus kyi dang*// rten dang dge bshes rnal 'byor pa// thams cad kun gyi ma ma yin// nga dang stag lung thang pa sogs// 'di la shin tu byams pa zhes// rgyal khams thams cad phung ba'i 'dre// sprang po nor shor sum brgya la// gya la ba zhes grags pa 'dis// mtho dman thams cad phung tshod 'dis// de bas mang na de bas phung*// mgo nag mtho dman thams cad kyi// spyi rje gung khab mi yi dbang*// 'phrul gyi rgyal po chen po yis// gya la ba dang 'gron po rnams// nyid kyi sras dang khyad med par// byams pas bskyang bar mdzod cig dang*// thams cad sras dang 'dra bar mchi// zhe 'dod phra mo'i rjes 'brangs nas// byi la 'bar ba nag po ltar// dal gyis skam pa'i mchus bzung nas// tho bas drag tu brdung snyam nas// zab tu re bas gsang na yang*// dar gyi nang du bre gtums pa// thams cad kun gyis shes so zhes// 'jig rten mgon po bla mas gsung*// des na chos kyi rgyal po yis// dgra gnyen thams cad mnyam par mdzod// bzang ngan thams cad rang du 'ong*// phyogs med sprang po ldom bu yis// sa chen 'di yi bdag po la// zhu don gsol bar mi rigs kyang*// sngon gyi rgyal po mkhas pa rnams// byis pa bud med sprang po yi// bden tshig gtsug gis len pa la// srog snying nyid du gyur pa dang*// skyid sdug gcig tu gyur pa yi// bla ma'i gdams ngag gang yin pa// mi dbang khyed kyis bkur bar rigs// sras dang gdung rgyud kun la yang*// thugs kyi gter du gtad par zhu'o//

// 446) ༄// tshad ldan bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub dgos par rje btsun gyi spyan sngar zhu ba// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ nga'i bu dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ yon bdag gi rtsa ba/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bla ma mnyes pa rnam pa gsum gyis bla ma dam pa mnyes par mdzad pa/ rje btsun gyi spyan sngar zhu ba/ spyir dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyang bla ma dam pas lung bstan pa las yon tan thob pa ni 'gro ldog nges pa yin pas/ khyed kyi bsam pa de ni shin tu bzang*/ spobs pa de ni shin tu dge ba lags so// de yang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas// ye shes cung zad dbang ba dang*// snang ba sems su shes pa dang*// gzhan phan rtag tu bsgom pa yi// bla ma tshad ldan gar bzhugs sar// bsgrubs na tshe 'dir dngos grub thob// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal gsung*// gsung bas sgrub pa byed pa'i gnas// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi drung du// ci byas thams cad tshogs gnyis lhun gyis grub par 'grub par the tshom med/ bla ma'i thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs na/ de las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub rgyu med pa lags pas khyed bla ma dam pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen de'i drung du bzhugs pa rang gis dge sbyor lhun gyis 'grub/ tshogs gnyis zung du rdzogs/ rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs par 'grub pa the tshom dang som nyi med pa lags pa de thugs su chud par mdzad nas de kho na bzhin du mdzad par zhu 'tshal// // 447) ༄// gsal la mi g.yo ma yengs bzhag ces pa gces pa'i snying po rin chen mdzod// oṃ swasti/ zhal snga nas kyi man ngag bden pa'i byin rlabs rnam pa lnga dang ldan par byas nas/ yi dam lha gcig pu/ mar me rlung gis mi bskyod pa ltar// gsal la mi g.yo ma yengs bzhag /bying dang rmugs dang gnyid byung na// 'phags pa bye ba nyi shu pa'i// rnam par thar pa'i rjes su bslab// rgod dang rtog pa'i rjes 'brangs shing*// rang gi rang nyid ma chun na// rnal 'byor dbang phyug bhu su kus// nyes pa'i skyon rnams tshar gcad bya// lus sems cha mnyam gnas gyur na// ston pa byang chub shing drung du// bzhugs nas byang chub brnyes pa yi// 'khrul 'khor de ltar goms par bya// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rjes// 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag gsungs// mi rtag rtag par 'dod pa yis// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dbang song bas// ngas 'di byas zhes 'dag sbyar dang*// chur 'jug med 'jug g.yang sa yi// brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i mu stegs pa// ston pa'i thabs dang bral ba rnams// shes rab ting 'dzin ji ltar skye// thabs dang shes rab ga la rnyed// mkhas pa rnam gsum shes byas nas// ting 'dzin dbye ba sna tshogs kyis// gnas skabs mthar thug yon tan bskyed// skyon rnams sel bar thugs la zhog

/gces pa'i snying po rin chen mdzod// bstan chos 'di'i ming yin no// // 448) ༄// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag thugs la zhog ces shes rab rgyal mtshan la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rje// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// zhabs kyi pad+mor rab btud nas// 'gro ba'i mgon po rje btsun pa// mnyam med mi yi seṅge mchog /thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen la// don gyi snying po bdud rtsi'i bcud// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// don gyi snying po rgya mtsho yis// thugs kyi dpal be'u rab bkang nas// 'jig rten gsum mgon chos kyi rje// dpal ldan drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// mnyam med bla ma rin chen gyi// thugs kyi dgongs pa bla med pa// rang byung lhan cig skyes pa mchog /lhun gyis grub cing 'dus ma byas// sems nyid chos sku bde chen gyis// snang srid dbang du bsgyur mdzad cing*// gdul bya skal ldan pad+ma'i tshogs// byin rlabs nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis// kha 'byed mdzad pa'i rje btsun la// bla ma dam pas zhus lags na// thub pa chen po chos kyi rje// byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas pa// skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po yis// gdul bya smin par mdzad pa'i tshul// zab dang zhi dang spros dang bral// 'od gsal 'dus byas ma yin pas// gdul bya thams cad smin par mdzad// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad dang*// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa rnams// 'di las gzhan med gong mas gsungs// tshig dang yi ge bsam mi khyab// thag rul sna yi 'breng rul dang*// yin lo byas lo byed lo yi// tshig tshogs sprin phung 'khrigs na yang*// mi rtag glo gtad snying gzhag med// chos kyi rgyal po'i zhing khams su// sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu yi// skyes bu dam pa khyed bzhugs pas// sangs rgyas nyid kyi dam pa'i chos// sems nyid 'od gsal 'gro 'ong med// rang byung phyag rgya chen po yis// 'gro ba smin par mdzad par zhu// snying po so nam 'di lags pas// 'gro ba smin par mdzad par zhu// mi rtag tshe la glo gtad med// snying rje'i dbang gyur ma rgan rnams// khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa la// skyob par byed pa'i skyabs gnas mchog

/bu las gzhan med thugs kyi dgongs// nor bzang bla ma bsten pa ltar// khyed kyi mos gus zhabs tog kun// rgyun chad med par mdzad pa rnams// bla ma rnams kyi phyag tu thengs// dbul zhing 'phongs pa'i sdug bsngal bsal// mkha' las char pa bab pa yis// sa gzhi lo tog smin pa ltar// gdul bya rgya mtsho mang po kun// bsdu dngos bzhi yis smin pa kun// skyes bu dam pa khyed kyi drin// bu slob rnams kyi zhabs 'bring dang*// zhabs tog rgya chen byung ba yang*// bdag gis sha chang bud med dang*// 'dod yon log pa'i chos rnams kyis// rang gzhan mang po ma bslus pa// khyed kyi zhabs tog yin nam snyam// byis pas a tho me tog 'thu ba ltar// mdzes dgu 'tshol gsog ma khom zhing*// dbus gtsang pre ta'i grong khyer du// bsgrubs kyang 'grub par mi 'dug cing*// khyed kyang phongs par mi bzhugs pas// thebs len yig rten ma mchis pa// tshogs shing 'dus pa'i grwa pa la// bzod pa dam pa gsol ba lags// dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kun// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu// bsngo ba chen pos bsngo bar zhu// phyag bum ril ba spyi blugs dang*// kha che gur kum phul gang dang*// dbu zhu to pi gsol 'phro gcig /bskur nas mchis pa yig rten lags// bu gcig shes rab rgyal mtshan la// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag mchog /snying po bla na med pa yis// nges par gdams kyi thugs la zhog /thugs la brtse ba'i a pa yang*// 'od gsal ngang du mya ngan 'das// rtsa ba'i bla ma rin chen yang*// rang gi sems las gzhan pa med// phun sum tshogs shing 'gal rkyen spangs// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du// spun dang 'brel par mi blta zhing*// mtho dman gtogs 'dod ma che bar// zhabs kyi drung du bsgom pa de// shin tu ngo mtshar che 'am snyam// snying gtam yin gyi thugs la zhog /dbu zhu to pi gsol 'phro gcig

/bskur nas mchis pas gsol bar zhu// ༈ //'gro ba'i bla ma ston pa yis// gang gis shing sdong 'khyer gzigs nas// nyid kyi sras la bka' bstsal pa// shing 'di tshu rol pha rol dang*// dbus su chags par ma gyur cing*// skam la ma phyin mi dang yang*// mi ma yin pas ma bzung nas// klong du ma nub khong ma rul// nyes skyon 'di dang bral gyur na// rgya mtsho chen por phyin 'gyur gsungs// de la dge slong tshu rol gyi 'gram zhes bya ba ni nang gi skye mched drug gi tshig bla dwags yin no// pha rol gyi 'gram zhes bya ba de ni phyi'i skye mched drug gi tshig bla dwags yin no// dbus su thogs pa zhes bya ba de dga' ba'i 'dod chags kyi tshig bla dwags yin no// skam la phyung ba zhes bya ba de ni nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal gyi tshig bla dwags yin no// mis gzung ba zhes bya ba ni/ 'di ltar 'di na la la rab tu byung ba dang khyim pa 'dres par gnas te/ dga' ba mtshungs pa dang*/ bde ba mtshungs pa dang*/ bde na bde ba dang*/ sdug bsngal na de sdug bsngal zhing 'phral gyi bya ba byung zhing 'byung ba rnams yang dag par blangs te/ mthar 'byin par byed pa lta bu yin no// mi ma yin pas bzung ba zhes bya ba ni/ ji ltar 'di na la la tshul khrims sam/ brtul zhugs sam/ dka' thub bam tshangs par spyod pa bsten pa 'dis bdag lha 'am/ lha gang yang rung ba gcig tu gyur cig ces smon lam btab nas tshangs par spyod pa lta bu'o// klong du nub ces bya ba ni/ ji ltar 'di na la la bslab pa phul nas babs pa lta bu yin no// khong rul pa zhes bya ba ni/ ji ltar 'di na la la tshul khrims 'chal ba/ sdig pa'i chos can khong myags shing 'dzags pa/ shing rul pa lta bur gyur pa/ lug bong ltar spyod pa dge sbyong ma yin la dge sbyong du khas 'che ba/ tshangs par spyod pa ma yin par tshangs par spyod par khas 'che ba yod pa lta bu yin te/

dge slong khyod kyis gal te de bzhin du/ tshu rol gyi 'gram du ma thogs zhes bya ba nas/ mya ngan las 'das pa las bab par gyur ro// zhes bya ba'i bar du gsungs nas/ tshe dang ldan pa de dgra bcom pa sems shin tu rnam par grol bar gyur to// thub pa chen po chos rje yi// sras kyi thu bo nye sde la// bka' bstsal legs par gsungs pa'i don// khyod kyi 'khor 'di mdzes pa dang*// shin tu mdzes pa'i rgyu mtshan smros// bdag drung rab tu 'byung 'dod la// sbyangs pa'i yon tan nus sam dris// nus zhes mchi na rab tu phyin// des na shin tu mdzes pa yin// ston pa nyid la zhus pa las// su yis sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi// bsngags pa gsung ba de dag kun// thub chen rgyal ba'i yon tan smra// sbyangs pa'i yon tan 'dzin pa la// ston pa blta ba'i dus rnams la// bkag pa med ces bka' bstsal gsungs// thub chen rgyal ba yab sras kyi// rjes su slob par byed pa rnams// sbyangs pa'i yon tan gtsigs bzung nas// rab tu byung dang chos ston pas// thub pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs par nges// // 449) ༄// dus deng sang nga la sgom chen med zhes pa'i zhal gdams kyi gsung mgur// oṃ swasti/ phyogs bcu mi chen thams cad kyis// thugs la btags nas byon na yang*// dus deng sang nga la sgom chen med// dad can 'bul ba'i char bab kyang*// dus deng sang nga la sgom chen med// tshogs pa rnam grangs mang na yang*// dus deng sang nga la sgom chen med// dung pad de pud de mang na yang*// dus deng sang nga la sgom chen med// dbyangs tsa re tsi re len na yang*// dus deng sang nga la sgom chen med// yon bdag mos gus che na yang*// dus deng sang nga la sgom chen med// dge 'dun mdun skol mang na yang*// dus deng sang nga la sgom chen med// dge 'dun rnams kyang mos gus che// 'bad pa brtson 'grus che ste mchi// bla ma'i byin rlabs zad pa 'dra// lo gsum sgrub pa byed par zhu// dus deng sang sgrub pa ma byas na// rgad po 'chi ba btang du thug

/bu go 'am shes sam dgos se kun// // 450) ༄// sngags bla med kyi gdams zab gnad bsdus ri khrod dbang phyug rnams la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ 'gro ba'i mgon po rin chen gyis// bla med theg chen gsang sngags kyi// gnad bsdus gdams ngag zab mo 'di// ri khrod dbang phyug rnams la gdams// de yang ston pa bcom ldan gyis// phyi rol ji bzhin nang ji bzhin// legs par gsungs pa 'di yi don// ro snyoms thabs lam zab mo yi// ro snyoms gnyis med phyag rgya che// thabs kyi gdams ngag zab mo 'dis// shes rab mnyam nyid bogs 'don byed// mnyam nyid phyag rgya chen po yi// thabs mkhas gnad rnams go bar byed// de gang zhe na/ gangs kyi chu shin tu bsil ba des grang rlung shas che ba rnams rkang lag 'khums pa dang*/ nad rnam pa sna tshogs byung ba yi khrag dang mkhris pa shas shin tu che ba rnams la gangs kyi chu shin tu bsil bas phan pa yin/ de nyid la sgom bzang ngan med/ 'byung ba bzhi las grub pa'i lus/ phyi rol gyi tsha grang rnam pa gnyis kyi cha snyom ma shes na/ khe grags kyi snying rus kyis gri rnon pos rked pa bcad na 'tsho ba mi nus pa 'dra/ ba tshwa'i chu 'am bal yul lta bu'i tshad pa'i yul du bsdad na tshad pa'i nad kyis na ba la sogs pa'i nyes pa byung ste/ gangs kyi chu bsil bas phan te de yang snga ma dang 'dra/ sgom bzang ngan med/ mtsho ma dros pa ni chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa bsil drod snyom pa nad thams cad la phan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas ti se la nad byung na ma pham gyis phan pa yin/ ri dang gnas tha dad pa thams cad la tshad pa dang bsil ba dang*/ mnyam pa thams cad de ltar shes par bya/ nad kyi 'byung ba ro snyoms 'di// yi ger bkod las byung ba yi// 'gro ba'i dge ba ma lus kun// bla med byang chub mchog thob shog/ //

451) ༄// gangs ti se u rgyan me nyag khyi than gsum na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams la sprengs pa/ oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po chos kyi rgyal po bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po nas/ mgon po phag mo gru pa rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sras dam par gyur cing*/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa gangs ti se dang*/ u rgyan/ rgya mi nyag khyi than gsum gyi rgyal khams yan chad na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun sgrub pa rtse gcig tu nyams su len pa rnams la/ skyabs bla ma dang dkon mchog grogs chos byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa/ byang chub kyi snying po ma thob kyi bar du/ mi 'bral ba/ rdo rje spun grogs ma gtogs pa/ mi chos dang phyogs ris dang*/ dbus gtsang khams gsum dang*/ nga dang*/ kho dang*/ khyod dang phyogs dang ris med pa lags/ rgya la'am gal te/ nga khyod phyogs ris byung na/ phyogs ris des mi stongs/ bla ma dang dkon mchog chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyis spong bar gyur nas mtha' ngan lam du 'gro bar 'gyur ba yin te/ dper na skyu ra smra bcad pa la skyu ra khri tsho bco brgyad kyis ma stongs/ yul dbus gtsang gi bla ma dang*/ grogs po dang*/ bu slob rnams kyis stongs pa lta bu yin/ kye kye kye/ pha ma nye du gnyen 'brel dang*// nga bdag phyogs ris spangs pa yi// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ri khrod pa// ma ma tshan tshan ma mdzad pa// sgrub pa snying po byed pa yis// skyes bu dam par bkur bar zhu// dper na khyed kyi bla ma des// bla ma bu slob ma bsam shing*// dbon po pha rgyud bu spun skyu ra gcig gcig gis// so chas 'bad pa byas na yang*// bla ma bu slob gnyen 'brel rnams// khyod la gcig pus chog par gyis// snyam par bsams nas 'brel ba gcod// gzhan gyis gnod pa sna tshogs sgrub// de dang 'dra bar shes par mdzod// ma ma tshan tshan phyogs ris rnams// nga bdag 'khrul pa'i rnam rtog gis// bcings pa'i rtog pa spongs mdzod la// sgrub pa tshul bzhin mdzad pa yang*// yar lam mar lam ma gtogs pa// ji srid lo lnga'i bar nyid du// sgrub pa snying por mdzad par zhu// khyed rnams mthun par bzhugs pa dang*// sgrub par mdzad pa'i gtang rag tu// chab tsha zho gsum 'bul zhing mchis// khog gang mdzad nas gsol bar zhu// gnas dang dus dang ting 'dzin dang*// yi dam grogs kyi thabs rnams kyis// ting 'dzin rgyal po bskyed pa yi// ro snyoms gnad kyi man ngag gcig

/bskur bas de yang nyams len mdzod// chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal khams su 'tshe ba med pa tsam ma gtogs/ gdod mtha' bar gsum 'dzam gling gang na yang rgyal po rnams la rdzas dang yo byad kyi dngos po med pas ming btsad ltogs su thogs pa yin/ jo bos khyed rnams la dngos po ster rgyu mi rnyed/ rnyed na yang rgyal po rnams ni bya ba mang ba/ byed pa mang bas nga mi 'dod ces/ shākya'i sras kyi dge 'dun gyis mi len pa yin/ de sngon phan chad jo bos phyogs thams cad du bskyangs/ da phyin chad jo bos khyod la 'bul ba byed pa thams cad ma len cig jo bo la slong 'phro ma byed cig nga'i jo bo mnga' ris su bzhugs su chug cig nga'i bka' ma bcag cig yon bdag jo dge dang yon bdag pa rnams kyang*/ sgom chen pa la mos gus ran tshod tsam gyis chog pa yin/ shugs kyis rgyab nas skyong ba yin/ khyed kyis yod tshad gcig la byin yang chos su 'gro ba'i ngang phan pa shin tu dka' ba yin pas/ bdag nyid dang ni gzhan la'ang rung*// sdug bsngal yin yang gang phan dang*// phan dang bde ba rnams bya ste// bde yang mi phan mi bya 'o// zhes gsungs pas de'i rjes su 'brang bar bya'o// sgom chen pa rnams kyang rang la rgyu rkyen ci 'os tsam yod kyi bar du ti se la sgrub pa byas na legs/ rgyu rkyen med par bsod snyoms dang*/ slong phro mang pos thams cad sun phyung ba yin te/ de bcom ldan 'das kyis bkag pa yin/ de nas 'tsho ba ma 'dang na ni ti ser ma bsdad par/ 'tsho ba sla ba/ dge sbyor 'phel ba/ lho bal gyi mthar sdom pa 'chor ba yin pas/ skad rigs mi gcig pa lho bal gyi mtha' ma yin pa/ bod kyi rgyal khams gang yang rung bar bsdad nas sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad par zhu/ de yang ma ga dha yi byang chub shing drung du// thub pa chen pos rdzogs pa'i byang chub brnyes// slob dpon til+lis rgya gar shar phyogs su// dpal ldan nā ro bla ma'i zhabs drung du// rje btsun lo tsās de dang 'dra ba nyid// rje btsun mi la rang gi yul nyid du// dwags po bla mas dmyal gyi se ba lung*// phag mo gru pas dwags lha sgam po ste// bla ma rnams kyang yul phyogs tha dad du// sgrub pa'i gnas der grub pa thob pa las// ti se 'ba' zhig don du gnyer ba ni// nang pa sangs rgyas pa la gtan med de// tha dad dgon pa rnams su thugs dam mdzod// bu la snying gtam snying por gdams// rdzogs so//

// 452) ༄// dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi bu slob skyes bu rnams la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi nga'i bu yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mgon po phag mo gru pa'i rjes su slob pa/ bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum la gces spras su 'dzin pa/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che/ rang gi srog pas kyang phangs par 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi spyan sngar zhu ba/ bdag yon tan shin tu chung bar gyur pa/ gcig pu gnyis su med par ri khrod kyi dgon par sgrub pa tshul bzhin du byed pa yin pa la/ khyed phyogs ris kyi bdag nyid chen po rnams kyis/ nga la sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byung ba lta bu gcig tu bkur zhing zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog ni byas/ chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid kyi sgro 'dogs kyi spros pa ni bcad/ nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pas rang rgyud ni tshims/ gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa go bas chos mthong zhing mngon du ni gyur/ bdag nyid chen po rnams la gdams pa/ sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar/ thub pa chen po de nyid kyi gdung rigs lha sbyin dang*/ ko ka li ka la sogs pa rjes su phyogs pa dang*/ 'phags pa drug sde cho ma cho dgu mdzad pa rnams la thub pa chen po de nyid kyi sras dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang*/ ston pa dang bstan pa la snying nye zhing gtong mi phod pa'i khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dang*/ dge bsnyen ma sa ga ma la sogs pas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par 'dod pa'i mdzad pa dang*/ rgyal po shag gi rigs ma yin pa/ bram ze grong nya gro ta can du sku 'khrungs shing bram ze chen po'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i 'od srung chen po dang*/ shā ri'i bu dang mo'u 'gal gi bu chen po dang*/ rje'u rigs su sku 'khrungs pa 'phags pa rab 'byor dang*/

rna ba bye ba ri dang*/ 'breg mkhan las rab tu gshegs pa nye bar 'khor ba dang*/ gzhan yang yul tha dad pa nas 'dus shing rigs tha dad pa las rab tu byung ba/ thub pa chen po'i sras bsten pa ni yun thung*/ rigs rus ni tha dad/ brtul zhugs ni mi 'dra ba las rab tu byung ba rnams kyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par byas shing*/ legs pa'i skar ma dang*/ lha sbyin dang rjes su phyogs pa la sogs pa yun ring por bsten pa/ bstan pa la gnod cing sems can dmyal bar 'gro ba de rnams rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis chad pa ston pa'i bstan pa sngon byung ba dang*/ deng sang rjes su zhugs pa rnams kyi nyams su blang ba'i rim pa/ nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i chos rnam pa bdun yin par gsungs pa las kyang yang dang yang du 'du ba las nyams par mi 'gyur gsungs pas/ khyed kyi yul phyogs tha dad pa rnams su yang dang yang du 'du ba dang*/ bsten yun ring bar khas 'che zhing chang dang bud med dang nyes spyod la 'jug pa tshar gcod pa dang*/ dpung pa snyems na bcom ldan 'das kyis tshul shing mang po'i sbyor ba ngan byed kyi rjes su phyogs pa ci 'dug pa dang*/ bzang po'i rjes su phyogs pa ci 'dug pa dang*/ gang mang ba bltas nas de'i phyogs dang bcas pa gzhom par bya ba'i tshul lugs 'phags pa shā ri'i bu dang mo'u 'gal gyi bu chen pos lha sbyin phyogs dang bcas pa pham par byas pa ltar bcom pa dang*/ phyogs log bya ba dang*/ ser mo bshu ba dang*/ bla ma dge 'dun dang bcas pa la 'dis 'di byas yi ge bskur ba la sogs pa tshar bcad par bya ba dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lor snyad btags nas sha chang gi za rgyan byed pa tshar gcad pa dang*/ mi chos kyi gnod pa byed pa la ji ltar 'os pa'i chad pa bgyid pa dang*/ sgrub pa snying por byed cing chos dang mthun pa thams cad bkur bas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur bas de ltar du 'bad par zhu 'tshal//

// 453) ༄// ston ma sgom btsun ma dang dge bsnyen ma sgom chen ma la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ thub pa chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gyi sras rgyal ba thams cad kyi 'khor rnam pa bzhi/ dge slong ma dang*/ dge bsnyen ma bcom ldan 'das kyi yum skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo go'u ta ma dang*/ dge bsnyen ma sa ga ma'i rjes su slob pa/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che la gces spras su mdzad cing*/ bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum mig gi 'bras bu ltar bsrungs ba/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis kyis rang gi rgyud smin cing dag par byas nas/ gzhan rgyud smin cing dag par byed pa'i rab tu byung ba/ brtul zhugs kyi khur khur nas sgrub pa tshul bzhin du mdzad pa'i ston ma sgom btsun ma rnams dang*/ dge bsnyen ma bsgom chen ma rnams la gdams pa/ de sngon phan chad bdag na so gzhon pa dang*/ chos dang bya byed kyi brtson 'grus slob ma smin par byed pa'i thabs la mkhas pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la yang 'khor rnam pa bzhi 'dug sgrub pa tshul bzhin du byed pa la ni/ jo mo rje btsun ma lha rje ma dang mang po gcig gis bstan pa'i so ga bzung nas gda' snyam nas/ chos zab pa dang rgya che ba thams cad tshogs dang dpag tu bstan pa lags/ de phyin chad 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du'ang grwa pa bzang 'bring ngan gsum yod pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i dug gi stobs chen po 'phel bas/ rang nyid bsregs cing gzhan bsreg par byed pa mang bar gyur ba dang*/ rang nyid kyi kha dang zhal ta 'bad pa byas kyang byas pa bsgrub pa'i rten gyi gang zag nyung ba dang*/ skyes bu dam pa dbang chen po 'dzin pa phan pa dang bde ba la dga' bas/ gzung ba'i yul med na 'dzin pa'i shes pa nye bar zhi bar gong ma rnams kyis bca' khrims shin tu dam par byas pas/ btsun ma dang sgom ma nga'i drung du yar la mi 'byon par zhu/

de ltar gyur na bla ma ni khyod yin/ nyams su ji ltar blang snyam na/ gdams ngag gzhan med sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis chos thams cad kyi snying po lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du bsrungs pas/ ting nge 'dzin rang dbang med par skye/ sems rang shugs kyis dul/ de la ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa dang*/ sems kyi bslab pa zhes zer/ sems dul ba las rang gi sems kyi gshis nyid spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral ba yod med dam gzung 'dzin gyis stong pa/ sems kyi 'dug lugs/ lus kyi 'dug lugs/ snang ba'i 'dug lugs 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi 'dug tshul mngon du mi 'gyur kha med pas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i babs/ gsum po 'di las mi 'da'/ bdag la dad pa dang gus pa yod pa thams cad kyang*/ tshe snga ma phan chad dam/ 'di yi slob mar gyur pa yin pas nga la yang sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i 'du shes kyi mos gus tshad du bskyal/ bsngo ba dang sems bskyed gnyis po legs par khong du chud par byas nas yid kyang bsam/ ngag tu yang brjod/ lus ngag yid gsum 'bad pa chen pos nyams su blang bar bya/ 'dir phyin yang de bas med/ 'di bas sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams gar phyin yang nyams su blang ba'i rim pa 'di las med pas nan tan chen pos nyams su blang bar zhu/ thub pa'i sras 'khor rnam pa bzhi rab tu byung ba dang*/ dge bsnyen ma rnams la gdams pa'i gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa lags pas nyams su blang bar zhu'o// // 454) ༄// 'phags pa sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i le'u nas gsungs pa bzhin mi 'bral bar gdams pa// 'phags pa sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i le'u nas/ de la ji ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos chos thams cad nam mkha' dang 'dra bar shes zhe na/ lha'i bu khams gsum pa ni sems tsam du zad la/ sems de yang gzugs med pa/ bstan du med pa/ thogs pa med pa rnam par rig byed ma yin pa sgyu ma lta bu ste/

sems de yang sems kyi chos nyid kyis btsal yang mi rnyed do// sems gang gis sems yongs su btsal ba'i sems de yang mi rnyed do// sems de mi dmigs pas chos thams cad mi dmigs so// chos thams cad mi dmigs pas chos gang yang mtshan ma rdzas su yang dag par mi mthong ste/ chos thams cad la chags par mi 'gyur ro// chos thams cad yongs su ma grub pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' dang 'dra bar shes so// yang srid gsum thams cad sems las 'grub par 'gyur/ sems de yang ni rang bzhin mthong ba med/ yang bka' bstsal pa/ bdag nyid dang ni gzhan dag gi /gnyis ka'i sdug bsngal rab shes nas// bdag gi sdug bsngal zhi byed cing*// gzhan gyi sdug bsngal kun zhi byed// sems can thams cad byang chub sems// sems de la ni 'dogs par byed// sems la chos rnams thams cad kyang*// don gcig tu ni 'dogs par byed// sems can kun gyi bsod nams gang*// dus gsum gyis ni bsdus pa dang*// sangs rgyas kun gyi bsod nams gang*// de dag kun gyis rjes yi rang*// dge ba de dag thams cad kyang*// sems can kun la sbyin par byed//
