sangs rgyas kyi ni ye shes phyir// lhag pa'i bsam pas 'jug par byed// sems ni skyes pa thams cad kyang*// byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo// chos nyid ma gtogs sems can nam// byang chub kyang ni mthong ba med// de ni sems dang byang chub kyang*// rnam pa gnyis su mi mthong ste// byang chub de yi mtshan nyid dag /sems kyang de yi mtshan nyid yin// mnyam pa nyid kyi chos rnams mnyam// de ni gnas pa yod min te// mdzangs pa thabs la mkhas pa ni// dkar po'i chos kyis rgyal bar 'gyur// dbyings de la ni 'phel ba med// chos kyi dbyings ni bsam mi khyab// sangs rgyas chos rnams tshol ba la// rtag tu chog par 'dzin pa med// bdag ni dkar pos rgyas so snyam// de ni sems kyis bsam mi byed// de ni gang du bsngo ba yi// byang chub de yang mchog mi 'dzin// sbyin pa mi rtog sbyin par byed// rlom sems med par tshul khrims bsrung*// rtag tu bzod pa sgom byed la// sems can la yang gnas pa med// sems dang lus ni dben pa yis// rtag tu brtson 'grus rtsom par byung*// rtog med bsam gtan phun sum tshogs// shes rab kyi ni pha rol son// sems can rnams kyang smin byed la// de ni dmigs pas gnas pa med// zhing yang yongs su sbyong byed la// lhag par 'dzin pa'ang yod ma yin// de ni sangs rgyas ye shes tshol// yi ge rnams la'ang chags pa med// de ltar spyod pa de la ni// byang chub rnyed par dka' ba med// tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang*// smon pa med la mos na ni// de la tshad kyang med par 'gyur// yang de nyid nas/

byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na/ re shig skye ba ngan pa len par 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'/ byang chub sems dpa'i ming gi rnyed pas 'tsho bar 'gyur byed la/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la mi slob pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos spong ba yal bar 'dor zhing zlog par mi byed pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhan dag gi rnyed pa'i bar chad byed cing bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod pa dang*/ lus kyi las dang*/ ngag gi las dang*/ yid kyi las sam bsrungs pa dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni 'gro ba ngan par 'gro bar 'gyur ro// yang de nyid nas/ mo'u 'gal gyi bu/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nyid na/ gling chen po bzhi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na/ tshangs pa'i gzugs kyis chos ston te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu 'byung ba dang*/ gos ngur smrig mi ston pa yang yod do// de bzhin du brgya byin dang*/ de bzhin du skye ba thams cad kyis kyang chos ston to// stong gsum 'di na ji ltar mos pa'i sems can la mos pa bzhin du chos ston te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med pa gzhan dang gzhan dag tu yang chos ston to// de la ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad 'jug par mi nus so// mo'u 'gal gyi bu/ dper na/ zla ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni// gzhal med khang nas mi g.yo la// grong dang grong khyer grong rdal dang*// rgyal po'i pho brang kun tu snang*// de bzhin thub mchog sangs rgyas ni// rang gi zhing las ma g.yos la// dpag med rgyal ba'i zhing du snang*// sems can ji ltar smin gyur par// de ltar rgyal bas chos ston to// zhus pas rgyal ba mchog gang lags// lan du sgyu ma'i skyes bu la// dman dang mchog gi khyad bzhin du// thams cad khyad par med pa ni// chos kun sprul pa'i ngo bo nyid// chos kun rang bzhin nyid stong pa// kun tu brtags las byung ba ste// de dag ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin// rnam par bsgrub par byed mod kyi// chos kyi dbyings la skye 'jig med// chos dbyings ston pas thugs chud phyir// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan// sgrib med thogs pa med pa yis// rnam par gzigs par gyur pa yi// sangs rgyas zhing khams de dag na// sems can ji snyed yod pa kun// snga phyi med par mir gyur la// rgyal po 'khor los sgyur bar gyur// rgyal po de dag re re la// de snyed dag gi 'khor yod kyang*// 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po ni// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la// rgyal ba'i spu yi khung gcig nas// re re'i mdun du de bzhin gshegs// dge slong dge 'dun bcas pa rnams// yang dag ston par mdzad na yang*// gcig gis gcig kyang mi shes te// rang rang de bzhin gshegs pa mthong*// spu yi khung bu thams cad kyang*// sngar bzhin rdzu 'phrul ston pa yis// de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi// brgya 'am stong ngam 'bum gyi cha// grangs sam cha 'am bgrang ba 'am// dpe dang rgyur yang mi 'gyur bar// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal to// 'khor los bsgyur ba de dag gi

/bsod nams phung po mang po des// de bzhin gshegs pa'i ba spu yi// khung gcig yongs su 'grub par 'gyur// de ltar ston pa bcom ldan gyis// mo'u 'gal bu la bka' bstsal to// 'di ltar zab dang rgya che ba'i// mdo rgyud mang po mthong ba'i tshe// bdag gi bla ma'i bka' bstsal dran// phar gcig tshur gcig rtsod pa yis// lam gcig drang por bstan pa yang*// rgyal ba yin zhes smra ba la// bla ma'i gsung la nges shes skyes// ma lus 'gro ba thams cad la// sangs rgyas 'du shes bskyed pa yi// gtan tshig zab mo 'di na gda'// rgyal ba'i lung rnams kun gyis shes// sgom chen thol ler dris pa'i lan// a la la zhes lan gsum zer// rgyal ba'i dam chos rin chen dang*// dus rnams rtag tu mi 'bral shog /'di 'dra ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes// mgon po phag mo gru pa dang*// skad gcig tsam yang mi 'bral shog /dus rnams rtag tu mnyes pa dang*// mnyes shing ci mnyes byed par shog/ //

455) ༄// theg chen gnad kyi snying bsdus rgyal ba'i gsung rab dus gsum gsal byed// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos rje phag mo gru pa la phyag 'tshal lo// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ khyod kyi bla ma la khyad chos thun mong min pa mang po yod zer yang*/ rtsa ba bsdus sa med pa thar thor rnam par 'thor ba yin/ yun ring por dbang po rab dang ldan pa'i rten gyi gang zag cig nye gnas su byas/ yun ring du bsten nas gzod go ba srid snyam na/ bsdus pa'i don 'di lta ste/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas rgya ba'i rgyu/ byang chub kyi sems ma gtogs pa yod dam med/ de med par thams cad zhal mthun pa yin la/ de yang smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa sngon du 'gro ba can yin/ de yang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po phag mo gru pa dang*/ jo bo chen po rje lha gcig gi lugs kyis/ byang chub kyi sems sdom pa rten can du bzhed pa yin te/ gang gi phyir zhe na/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa pha rol tu phyin pa lnga dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sngon du 'gro ba can yin pas/ de yod na byang chub kyi sems skye/ med na mi skye ste/ de ltar yang bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du/ sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ bsgoms pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa bas sems bskyed do zhes pas sngon la tshad med pa rnam pa bzhis blo sbyangs pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro khyad par can byas pa dang*/ rgyu'i gtso bo bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyes pa las skye bar/ thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad du gsungs shing*/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis nges pas/ sems 'di skyes na 'jug pa skye byed kyi rgyu bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyes pa/

smon pa brtan pa rnam pa gnyis gzhir gyur nas 'jug pa blang ba rnam pa gsum ste/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rjes su 'brangs nas mthar rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya ba dang*/ 'phags pa 'dul ba gtan la dbab pa nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa'i mdo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang*/ sdom pa nyi shu pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas nyin mtshan cha drug tu bya ba dang*/ rje btsun mi 'khrugs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas gom pa 'degs 'jog gi bar du yang mi brjed par bya ba dang gsum/ gang zag dbang po'i bye brag gis shes par bya zhing nyams su blangs pa ni gzhir gyur pa/ byang chub sems de las sbyor ba byang chub kyi sems/ dngos gzhi pha rol tu phyin pa drug ldan/ rjes 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa mi dmigs pa'i bsngo ba dang bcas pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgrub rgyud/ jo bo chen po rje lha gcig gi rjes su 'brangs pa'i nyams len/ blo ldog rnam pa bzhi las sems nges par sbyangs nas theg pa chen por nges pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa sgrub rgyud dang bshad rgyud du bcas pa'i gnad dang man ngag rgyas pa dang bsdus pa thams cad du shes par bya'o// de yang gang zag dbang po rab tu gyur pa byang chub kyi sems kyi mthu rgyas pa/ ltogs pa zas kyis gdung pa ltar myur du sangs rgyas nas sems can gyi don bya bar 'dod pas/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi sgor 'jug par bya ste/ de yang rgyud sde rin po che rnam pa bzhir ma 'dus pa med la/ de yang mgon po rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ rgyud sde rin chen bzhi po ni// bya ba'i rgyud dang spyod pa'i rgyud// rnal 'byor rgyud dang bla med do// zhes pa nas/ bzhi pa dngos sgrub kun gyi gter// zhes pa'i bar du gsungs la/ zab pa'i man ngag gi gnad nyams len gyi bka' stsal ni/ bya ba'i rgyud kyis bya ba sgrub/ spyod pa'i rgyud ni spyod pa yin// rnal 'byor rgyud kyi thabs gnas nas// bla med rgyud nyid bsgom pa yi// rgyu mtshan gnad rnams bka' bstsal pas// mgon po de yi gsung bzhin bsgrub// de la theg chen gsang sngags dang*// pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa yi// khyad par gang zhes bsam pa kun// dbang nyid khyad par yin no zhes// nges shes gtan tshigs dang bcas par// khong du chud par bya ba 'o// bla med rdo rje theg pa 'di// sgrub pa'i rten gyi gang zag dang*// gegs sel bogs 'don thabs rnams dang*// rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu yi// gegs sel yon tan bskyed pa dang*// skyon rnams dag par bya ba dang*// gnas skabs mthar thug 'bras bu kun// ji ltar mig dang ldan pa yis// lag pa'i mthil du bzhag pa yi// skyu ru ra yi 'bras bu bzhin// mgon po phag mo gru pa dang*// dpal ldan 'gro mgon a ti shas// legs par bstan pa'i dam tshig la// nan tan chen por ma gnas na// bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu gang yin pas// gsang sngags yin no byas na yang*// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// thog mar phung ba sna tshogs kyi// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor gnas nas kyang*// bar du phung ba gnas med dang*// rdo rje dmyal ba 'jigs kyang 'jigs// tha mar gting mtha' med pa yi// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho bsam las 'das// de phyir gsang sngags dam tshig ni// zab pa'i phyag rgya bzhi yi gnad// mkhas pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis// lag mthil skyu ru ra la blta// lha dang bcas pa'i sa lam gyi// gegs dang bar chad sel ba dang*// yon tan rgya mtsho skyed pa yang*// dka' bar gyur pa ma yin na// brgya phrag stong phrag khri phrag dang*// 'bum phrag la sogs 'khor rnams kyi// yon tan skyed pa smos ci dgos// thams cad mkhyen pa bcom ldan 'das// rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs pa dang*// mgon po bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang*// phag mo gru pa'i bka' stsal 'di// nyams su blangs pas nyams su myong*// nyams su myong bas rang rgyud tshims// de bas tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor nyid// skyong bar 'dod pa'i brod pa skyes// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa yi// theg chen gnad kyi don bsdus pa// zab cing rgya che nam mkha' 'am// rgya mtsho chen po lta bu 'di// mgon po phag mo gru pa yi// bka' drin dran nas bris pa 'dis// mgon po de yi thugs dgongs mchog

/nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// bde thob sdug bsngal bral nas kyang*// bla med byang chub mchog thob shog /rje rin po che mgon po phag mo gru pa'i thugs kyi dgongs pa/ rnal 'byor pa ri khrod kyi dgon par sgrub pa snying por byas shing*/ dka' ba nyams su blangs shing*/ lus srog gdon ltor btang nas nyams su blangs pa'i nyams myong*/ snying dang 'dra ba'i slob ma rnams la gnad kyi snying po/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab dus gsum gsal byed ces bya ba// rdzogs so// // 456) ༄// dam pa'i chos la nan tan gyis shi khar mi 'gyod tsam re mdzod ces pa// oṃ swasti/ phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud// mgon po dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis// legs gsungs chos la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mchog /bsam med yid la mi byed pa// rang byung phyag rgya chen po 'di// mthar thug rdzogs pa'i byang chub yin// thog ma bar dang mtha' mar dge /dran pa rgyun chad med pa yis// skyong ba ting 'dzin rgyal po yin// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam zhes// sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i bla mas gsung*// rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// nam mkha' yongs su dwangs ba la// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba de// dkar nag khra bo'i sprin tshogs kyis// nyi ma bsgribs na ji ltar gsal// nyon mongs 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho tshogs// rnam par rtog pa ma yin nam// rang byung phyag rgya chen po de// de dang bral ba yin na ko /su yis su la ji ltar dri// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can de// rnam par rtog las byung gyur na// de las grol bar byed pa de// rang gis gang la ji ltar 'grol// bu gcig legs par dgongs dang kye/ /gsum po gang gis kyang mi phan/ /phyag rgya chen po bsgoms pas phan// // 457) ༄// rnal 'byor sgom chen dang grwa pa sogs 'byung ba zhes pa//

oṃ swasti/ bla ma yi dam dkon mchog la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// sngon yang bka' drin mi chung che// da rung byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rje gong ma rnams kyi bka' drin gyis// yon tan med pa'i sprang po la// phyogs ris med pa thams cad kyis// nga 'bu thugs la shin tu btags// thub pa'i gsung gi rjes su 'brangs// mthong tshad thams cad rab tu byung*// rab tu byung ba'i grwa pa la// nor bu dbang gi rgyal po ltar// dgos 'dod thams cad thams cad byung*// gangs khrod 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor byung*// ri khrod 'grim pa'i sgom chen byung*// tshogs dpon che dgu mang po byung*// dge bshes rnams kyi grwa pa byung*// sde pa rnams kyi gnas dpon byung*// gnas gzhi rnams kyi gza' mi byung*// sa bdag rgyal po'i sku rkyen byung*// 'dun gros byed pa'i gtso bo byung*// bu chung gso ba'i mthu chen byung*// tshong lug 'ded pa'i sna khrid byung*// skrad pa rnams kyi dpon po byung*// sgom ma rnams kyi bdag po byung*// yon bdag mo yi bu rdzi byung*// bsha' lug gsod pa'i bshan pa byung*// khyim phugs 'degs pa'i rkun ma byung*// bstan pa'i dgra bo chang 'thung byung*// e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// ming la bla ma rin chen zer// bla ma yul gsum phyogs na med// rin chen zer ba 'di re bden// byung lugs 'di 'dra re re la// mang po mang po byung ba des// bzang ngan 'bring gsum bgrang ma lang*// bcas bcos kha ta byas ma lang*// tshar bcad rjes gzung byas mi lang*// gting mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba 'di// rang log rang dngas mi srid pas// rang la snying brtse yod pa rnams// dam pa'i chos la nan tan mdzod// shi khar mi 'gyod tsam re mdzod// rang la snying rje lta rtog mdzod// // 458) ༄// chos kyi rgyal po tsha rong jo bo bla zhang gi sdug sdum byed pa//

oṃ swasti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// 'khor 'das kun gyi bdag nyid mchog /'gro ba'i mgon po rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi pad+mor gtsug gis 'dud// 'gro ba'i mgon po de nyid dang*// bka' brgyud bla ma dam pa dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyis// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs mdzad pa// mgon po dpal ldan rin chen gyi// gdan sar bzhugs pa'i skyes chen la// zhu ba 'bul ba'i tshig gi don// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// spyi gtsug nor bu rin po che// bla med mchog gi gdan sa de// dus gsum rgyal ba'i mchod rten yin// rgyal ba'i mchod rten bla med par// gong ma rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis// khyed nyid dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs// nga dang 'dir bzhugs dge 'dun gyi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad// gong gi phrin las chen po de// kun gyi thugs su ma shong zhing*// ha hu zer brjod mang na yang*// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag bzhin// mtho dman brjod pa rang sar zhi// bdag gi bla ma dam pa yis// gdan sa brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur du// sngon bas lhag par 'ong ngo zhes// bka' bstsal gsungs pa bden no zhes// nga yang mngon shes can du btang*// ngam shod klung na bzhugs pa yi// che 'bring chung gsum thams cad kyang*// khyed las bsam rgyu mi gda' zhing*// 'di na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun dang*// bod khams yongs kyi 'gro ba kun// dga' zhing blo bde rjes yi rang*// bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs thams cad du// mun pa med cing snang bar gyur// dgongs pa rdzogs mdzad skyes chen khyed// gdan sar bzhugs pa'i zhabs tog tu// g.yor po spyi dang bye brag gis// dad gus mdzad pa'i byed tshul dang*// skye 'gro kun gyi dga' ba dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang*// bdag kyang dbugs byung dga' ba yi// thugs dgongs thugs la bzhag nas kyang*// gdan sa dpal gyi phag mo gru// dpal gyi rdo rje gdan mchog der// bdag gi bsam pa ma rdzogs tshe// thugs kyi g.yo 'gul mi mdzad par// rgyun chad med par bzhugs par zhu// gong gi mdzad pa kho na ltar// khyed rang dge 'dun skyong ba dang*// mtho dman bya byed btang ba des// phyogs su ma lhung ngo mtshar che// skyes bu dam pa'i nang cha bstan// thams cad kun gyi gting tshod rig

/mkhas dang btsun dang bzang ba dang*// bzang po bzang po thams cad kyang*// ring du ring du bsring tsam na// zha ngon zha ngon chen por thal// de 'dra de 'dra mang po des// ngam shod lung pa skyug nag log /cha la je 'jigs je 'jigs thal// nged rang spad kyi rnam thar la// ha ya hu ya ci zer yang*// 'dam gyis ma gos pad+ma 'dra// dri mas ma gos rin chen 'dra// gsal zhing dag pa shel sgong 'dra// blo bde skyid pas rgyal tshab 'dra// gsol ba 'debs pas sangs rgyas 'dra// 'dra lugs mang ste brjod mi lang*// snga ma bzhin du mdzad par zhu// dam chos rin chen ma gtogs pa// phan nam snyam pa a dzir gda'// thugs la zhog dang rin po che// chos kyi rgyal po tsha rong ba// bla zhang phyogs ris ma mthun yang*// gcig pu khyed nyid bsam pa yis// snying nas nga la snying sdums phul// khyed rang gcig pu ma gtogs pa// gzhan du ma bsams rgyu mtshan des// skad cig tsam yang 'bral mi phod// khong dang bdag cag thams cad kyis// thugs dgongs re ba rdzogs mdzad nas// mtho dman 'di kun gang du yang*// skyo bsang thugs dgongs mi mdzad zhu// khyed cag ngam shod pa rnams kyi// thugs rten skyo ba bsang ba'i phyir// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// gdung rten bkra shis 'od 'bar 'di// dgongs pa rdzogs phyir bzhugs pa lags// 'di dang mnyam du bzhugs par zhu// 'gro ba'i bla ma gcig pu nyid// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// thugs kyi dgongs pa bla med mchog /bod khams spyi dang de bzhin du// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// bde zhing sdug bsngal bral ba dang*// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs// gdan sa dpal gyi phag mo grur// bdag gis zhabs tog ci byas pa'i// dge ba gang des 'gro ba kun// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu// rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog thob shog

/rin chen yab sras bdag cag dang*// dus gsum dkon mchog thams cad la// sdang zhing 'tshe ba thams cad kyang*// mgon po phag mo gru pa yi// bla med gdul bya mchog nyid du// rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog thob shog /bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis// mi shes 'khrul pa'i dbang song nas// nyes par gyur pa srid na yang*// bla ma yi dam chos skyong dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dkar phyogs kyis// bzod pa dam pa bzhes nas kyang*// bu gcig bzhin du bskyang mdzad gsol// bla ma rin chen byin rlabs kyis// bdag la byams sam sdang yang rung*// mthong ba dang ni thos pa dang*// reg pa dang ni dran pas kyang*// 'khor ba'i nyes skyon sdug bsngal dang*// bral nas bde chen mchog thob shog /jo bo bla zhang gi sdums byed pa'i gtsigs su khyed gdan sar bzhugs par chad

kha chad byas pa yin no// khyed ri pa de rnams gdan sa der bzhugs par zhus pa yin/ chos nyams su len pa mtha' dag phag mo grur dge sbyor la btang ba yin pas/ 'dag sbyar dang dge sbyor la 'bad par zhu/ su tshur byung yang nga dang mi mthun pa yin no// gzhan thams cad kyang de rang du bzhugs par zhu// khyed rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa yin no// // 459) ༄// dran dang shes bzhin bag yod thub pa'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes su gsungs pa// oṃ swasti/ thog ma bar dang mtha' mar dge /rang gzhan gnyis kyi don chen grub// bla ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas// phun sum tshogs pa rnam lnga 'di// lhun gyis grub cing rtsol ba med// rgyun chad med par gyur pa de// ngo mtshar rmad byung rjes yi rang*// thub pa chen po rgyal ba'i sras// dran dang shes bzhin bag yod pa// thams cad bsams nas byed pa ni// thub pas mkhyen pa'i ye shes gsungs// // 460) ༄// dpal ldan phag mo grur spyan snga rin po che'i mdun du phul ba'i 'bul tho// oṃ swasti/ dpal ldan phag mo gru'i nags tshal na// legs par bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog /spyan snga rin po che zhes yongs grags pa// dam pa khyed la cung zad zhu ba'i don// pha jo jo jo yon bdag sgom pa yis// dpe med rag sdir kha 'phyang bdun dang yang*// ting kha gnyis dang dgu po 'bul ba 'di// 'di 'dra gong du ma byung mi 'byung bas// sdug pa'i dngos po phul bar gyur pa 'di// zhal du 'du ba'i dngos po 'ga' zhig la// bsgyur nas cis kyang zhal du gsol bar zhu// gzhan yang ja srang rtse mo sum cu tham pa dang*// mar tshud grod ling tsho la stug pa dang*// gan ta gcig dang sha rkyal gcig kyang 'bul// bdag gi bsnams phying gnam ga sngon po dang*// phyag shan rgyal po me nyag 'ga' gri dang*// glong thang ze tse rdo rje sgur chung 'bul// g.yang shun ser po 'di yang bzhugs gdan mdzod// khungs nas byung ba'i chags bu gsol bar zhu// de yi nang tshangs g.yang mo'i na bza' mchis// zhes gdugs khra bo gcig dang rgya nag gi

/yul nas byung ba'i chu gdugs ngo mtshar can// chab dang tshad pa skyob par byed pa nyid// nyid kyi dbu la gsol nas mdzad pa mdzod// bdag gi nye gnas rgyal po shag ye yis// bdag gi na bza' ras phyam gsol 'phro dang*// rje btsun ras pa'i char dar yug gcig dang*// yon skyabs grongs pa'i rgun 'gyed bre gsum mo// byang chub yon tan nye gnas rgyal po yis// ja srang stong dang gsum brgya ja phud lags// nye gnas gnyis sogs khams gsum sems can gyi// tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir bzhes par mdzad du gsol// slob dpon chen po dge bshes rgya ston la// chab tsha rtse mo zho gang 'bul zhing mchis// ri pa rnams la gser zho sum cu dang*// zab chen kha the'u ma nyams yug gsum dang*// dmar ser srubs gsum dar yug drug dang yang*// mdzo gcig 'bul bas skyes chen rnal 'byor pa// mi yi seng ge ri khrod dbang phyug rnams// thugs dam 'phel zhing dgyes par dgongs par zhu// sangs rgyas dpal gyi shol du mkhan po chen po bzhugs// dkon mchog dpal dang tshul 'bar dbon po la// dar yug dmar po ja zho gcig dang sder gsum 'bul// sder gyi bar na shing tog ku shu gsum gsum mchis// // 461) ༄// nga yi snying gtam tshig gsum rin chen phyag rgya me tog/ oṃ swasti/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal mi g.yo zhing*// rten 'brel zab mo'i skur gyur rje btsun rdo rje 'chang*// mi pham mgon po thugs rje spyan ras gzigs// chos rje chos kyi rgyal pos rgyal srid skyong*// thub pa mar me mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// e ma ngo mtshar 'di 'dra ba// dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa de// nga dang 'dzin pa zad pa'i ming*// ngar 'dzin gyi rtsod pa ma zhi na// chen por gyur kyang bzang po min// nga med bdag dang bral ba la// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin par bzhed// bod yul dbus kyi rnal 'byor pa// chen po bzang por grags pa yi// mnga' bdag rgyal bu thub pa dang*// dge bshes grwa pa'i mngon shes bzhin// nga rgyal ches na smad pa'i rgyu// nga rgyal zad pa'i bdag med de// srid pa'i nang na chen po mchog

/med kyang ku re zhus pa lags// kun la med pa'i chos gcig pu// rang gi sems nyid kho na yin// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can la// gzhi la bye brag tha dad med// ma rig 'khor ba'i 'khrul rtog dang*// rang byung ye shes chen po gnyis// gzhi la bye brag tha dad med// khams gsum 'gro drug sdug bsngal dang*// sangs rgyas sku gsung phrin las gnyis// gzhi la bye brag tha dad med// 'khor 'das gnyis med ro mnyam la// tha dad ma byed rnal 'byor pa// nga ni dus gsum sangs rgyas yin// dus gsum sangs rgyas nga yin pas// nga dang dus gsum sangs rgyas la// 'phrin las gcig tu bzhugs pa la// mos gus rgyun chad ma mchis na// yon tan mi zad gter dang 'jal// rang sems yid bzhin nor bu la// gsol ba thob cig rnal 'byor pa// slob dpon bram ze chen po dang*// dpal ldan til+li nā ro la// zab mor grags pa'i chos zhus te// sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa dang*// snang ba lhan cig skyes pa gnyis// ming gcig tha dad ma mchis pas// gsum po'i gdams ngag gcig tu go /gcig zhu rang la ngos gzung med// ma bcos bzhag pas bde ba che// bsgom rgyu rdul tsam ngas ma mthong*// yengs su med do rnal 'byor pa// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// nga ni nam mkha'i dbyings na bzhugs// 'khor 'das thams cad nga la shong*// nga ni bar snang khams na bzhugs// thabs dang shes rab dbyer mi phyed// nga ni ri rab rtse na bzhugs// gsang skad chen pos 'o dod 'bod// nga ni dur khrod brgyad na bzhugs// rnam par rtog pa zas su za// nga ni 'og min gnas na bzhugs// rtog med ye shes gos su gon// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// kye kye rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// thabs kyi lha sku sgom gyur nas// de yi bya ba rdzogs gyur na// de nyid brtan par gyur pa na// sa bdun non te mchog mi thob// rtsa rlung bsgom pa'i sgom chen rnams// skyon med dmigs pa mthar phyin yang*// rang sangs rgyas dang khyad par med// blos byas stong pa bsgoms gyur kyang*// sa brgyad thob pa'i rgyu rkyen med// slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis// dang po las kyi sbyor ba yis// sa brgyad thob par bzhed na yang*// nga dang dus gsum sangs rgyas gnyis// dbyer med gcig tu gyur pa yis// sa lam brtsi rgyu ma mthong bas// rang sems bsgom zhig rnal 'byor pa// e ma ngo mtshar 'di 'dra ba// bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen ni// mtshan dang dpe byad dpal 'bar zhing*// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// sems nyid rdo rje 'chang chen de// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'khor gyis bskor// rgyun chad med pa'i chos gsung zhing*// 'bral ba med pa'i grogs dang bcas// mchod pa chen pos mchod gyur cing*// re ba med pa'i rgyan dang bcas// dogs pa med pa'i gdan la bzhugs// 'phel 'grib med pa'i zhabs tog mdzad// rang sems bla ma yin no rnal 'byor pa// na ning dus kyi ding sang na// nga yi bu yi dam pa ni// zhabs tog can gyi rnal 'byor pa// nyis stong bdun brgya ri la song*// 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod du// khri tsho gsum dang stong tsho brgyad// bdun brgya lnga bcu rtsa drug la// zab mo bcu chos gsum chos bshad// khyed zhabs tog mkhan gyi bu slob la// chos la nye ring mi byas shing*// 'khor la bzang ngan ma byas te// mos gus rten cing 'brel 'byung gis// rim pa tha dad gyur kyang ni// chos la phyi nang med do rnal 'byor pa// do gcig dus kyi de ring la// bu zhabs tog can gyi dam pa yis// gser srang brgya dang drug cu phul// lus dang srog la mi blta zhing*// dad gus chen po'i thugs dgongs kyis// 'bras dang chab tsha'i bsnyen bkur mdzad// gnyis su med dang thugs dam las// dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa phul// 'bul bar che'o rnal 'byor pa// e ma ngo mtshar 'di lta bu// gzhan don rnams kyi chos gcig pu// byang sems yin no rnal 'byor pa// tshogs chos rnams kyi chos gcig pu// rgyu 'bras yin no rnal 'byor pa// khrid chos rnams kyi chos gcig pu// mi rtog yin no rnal 'byor pa// phyag rgya bzhi yi ye shes kyis// skad cig nyid la rtogs gyur pa// 'bras bu rnams kyi chos gcig yin// dmigs pa rnams kyi chos gcig pu// bla ma yin no rnal 'byor pa// bogs 'don rnams kyi chos gcig pu// mos gus yin no rnal 'byor pa// gegs sel rnams kyi chos gcig pu// stong nyid yin no rnal 'byor pa// phrin las yin pa'i 'gro mgon gyis// sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa de// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// gcig tu rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// mthong chos myong nges zab mo 'byung*// tshe gcig lus gcig 'di nyid la// rdo rje'i skur gyur rdo rje 'chang*// yin pa'i rgyu mtshan zab mo de// bu khyod dang nga gnyis gcig pa bzhin// tha dad ma byed rnal 'byor pa// nga yis bshad pa'i chos rnams la// khyod kyis ma go gang yang med// khyod kyis go ba'i chos rnams la// nga yis ma bshad gang yang med// nged kyi rgyu mtshan zab mo de// ngas kyang gzhan la bstan pa med// khyod kyang nga la mi zhu ste// ku re bag tsam bya ba ni// nga yi ming 'di shes par mdzod// nus ldan blo gros u rgyan yul// nag po dge ba bsil ba'i tshal// gtum byed bden smra ha ha rgod// nyi 'od sgron ma so sa gling*// 'dzi na byang chub dpal gyi ri// bde byed dga' ba srin mo'i gling*// nyi zla i mi rtsi ka li// dbyangs ldan lkugs pa na ga ra// rin chen dpal nyid kha ba can// res 'ga' sbyin bdag chen po yin// res 'ga' mu stegs byed 'dul cing*// res 'ga' bstan bcos chen po byas// de ltar rnal 'byor dbang phyug la// ku re kyal ka zhus pa yin// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// rgyal po me dbon rnam gsum yang*// tha dad ma byed rnal 'byor pa// chen po gsum gyi 'phrin las kyang*// rlung sems gnyis kyi byed pa yin// nga yi snying gtam tshig gsum yin// kun la med pa'i chos gcig pu// rin chen phyag rgya me tog yin/

/'di khyod rang byed dam gzhan la ster// ngas kyang bya ra byed pa yin// bsngo ba bsngo byed bsngo mkhan gsum// dmigs pa med par thim par shog /rdzogs so// // 462) ༄// mi chos kyi 'dun ma sa re si re zhes pa dge slong chos kyi ye shes la gdams pa// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dad ldan g.yo sgyu chung ba dang*// bsod nams bsags pa che ba dang*// sgrub pa snying por byed pa yi// dge slong chos kyi ye shes kyis// rang gi bla ma dam pa la// 'jig rten mi chos kyi 'dun ma yi// rnam bzhag ji ltar byas lags na// phan par 'gyur ba zhus lags pas// bla ma'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung*/ spyir mi chos kyi 'dun ma rnam par bzhag pa 'di la/ shin tu mkhas shing rab tu byung ba 'am/ legs par bslabs pa med pas kyang*/ 'di tsug byas na legs par 'ong bar 'dug pa'i nyams myong ni yod pas 'dir cung zad brjod par bya'o// de yang gang zhe na/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba dang byed pa thams cad kyi ni bde ba dang skyid pa sgrub pa yin pas/ bde skyid sgrub pa'i thabs chags pa'i bsam pa gtong ba ma gtogs pa/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis btsal yang gzhan pa mi rnyed pa nyid du nges te/ des na chags pa'i bsam pa spang bar bya'o// de la gnyis te/ phyi yul la chags pa dang*/ nang sems can la chags pa'o// de gang dang gang la chags kyang*/ nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ phung 'dre thams cad kyi gzhi ma/ yon tan thams cad kyi bar chad/ bde skyid thams cad gtan nas zad par byed pa chags pa yin te/ de yang nang sems can la chags pa'i dbang du byas na shin tu phra zhing chags rin mi chog pa srog chags grog sbur lta bu gcig la yang*/ 'di nga'i yin snyam du bsam nas chags shing zhen na/ rdzas dang yo byad kyi dngos po dpag tu med pa dang*/ rang gi nye du dang gnyen 'brel dang*/ 'khor dang 'bangs rang nyid dang bcas pa'i che na srog gi bar du gcod pa/

'bring rdzas dang yo byad/ tha ma grags pa dang snyan pa tshun chad kyis bar du gcod pa chen por 'gyur pas/ rtag tu yid mi bde zhing sdug bsngal drag pos gdung bar 'gyur ba dang*/ phyi yul la chags pa'i dbang du byas nas yang*/ shin tu phra ba til gyi phub ma tsam chags na yang nyes pa gong ma dang 'dra bar 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de skad du yang*/ til gyi phub ma tsam gyi zug rngus kyang*// nges par sdug bsngal chen po 'byin par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ chags pas bde 'gro mi thob ste// thar pa'i srog kyang gcod par byed// zhes gsungs pa 'di yang tshe phyi ma dang yang 'ba' zhig la gsungs pa ma yin te/ mthong chos su gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'o na grog sbur dang til gyi phub ma la su chags snyam na/ de bas ni dngos po tsam du ma grub pa tshig rkyang pa re re la bdag tu bzung nas chags pa'i dbang gis phung kham chen po la 'gro ba dang*/ shin tu skyug bro zhing btsog pa mi gtsang ba rkyal bu gang la yang*/ khyi bzhin du chags pas phung kham chen por 'gyur ba mthong na/ gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos pas chags pa thams cad zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas spang bar bya'o// 'o na de nged kyis spong mi nus snyam na/ de spong ma nus na bde ba dang skyid pa mi 'dod pa yin mod/ bde skyid mi 'dod pa la ni sus kyang ci byar mi 'dod par zad do// de ltar shin tu phra ba'i chags zhen thams cad kyis kyang nyes pa chen po de lta bu 'byung na chen por gyur lta smos kyang ci dgos pas/ tha na bzas gos yan chad/ 'khor dang longs spyod chen po yul ris rgyal khams thams cad kyi bdag po gyur nas/ longs spyod na ci tsug 'ong snyam na chags zhen zhes bya ba bsam pa la zer ba ma gtogs pa gzhan med pas/ rang gi bsam pa chags shing zhen pa dang 'chums pa'i dbang du mi gtong zhing*/ rang gang mos kyi gnyen pos bzlog nas chags zhen med pas ni 'dod pa'i yon tan mtha' dag la longs spyod kyang skyon du mi 'gyur bas/

bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ zhen pa nang du log na 'dod yon rgyan du che// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thabs mkhas pa dang*/ chags zhen spangs pa'i phun sum tshogs pa ma gtogs pa gzhan med pa dang*/ chags zhen spangs pas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan thams cad bral ba dang*/ rnam par smin pa'i tshul du gyur pas so// de la khyod kyi mi chos kyi mdun ma 'di yin na lha chos kyi dam pa ci lta bu gcig yod snyam na/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba yin pa las/ 'di thog mar dge ba cung zad tsam zhig smos par zad de/ bar dang mtha' mar dge ba ni sa dang lam la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi yon tan dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mtha' dag tu shes par bya'o// yang 'o na chags zhen med pa ma gtogs pa mi chos kyi mdun ma gzhan yang med dam snyam na yod de/ zhe sdang med pa dang gti mug med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba zhes bya ba thog ma dang*/ bar dang mtha' mar dge ba yod kyang*/ gsha' mar rgyud la skyes na/ re re la gsum ga tshang bar 'gyur ba dang*/ yang chags pa med na ci zhig rtsod// sred dang bral la yang sred med// des na chags zhen med pa la// dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi chos// ma lus thams cad tshang bas na// lha chos dam pa 'di las gzhan// yod par 'gyur ba ma yin pas// bu gcig chags zhen spangs nas kyang*// shin tu dben pa'i nags khrod du// ri dwags rmas ma bzhin du bsdad// sngon gyi drang srong chen po rnams// shin tu dben pa'i nags khrod du// chags zhen spros pa bcad pa yis// bdag med gnyis kyi don rtogs nas// rang gzhan ma lus thams cad kun// bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa de// bu gcig da rung ma go 'am// yang 'dod chags med pa bde ba ste// zhe sdang med pa skyid pa yin// gti mug med pa phun sum tshogs// bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'di// rang la snying brtse yod pa rnams// cis kyang nyams su blang bar zhu// mi chos kyi 'dun ma sa re si re zhes bya ba rdzogs so//

463) ༄// 'bri gung pa'i chen po bzang po mkhan slob nye gnas gces se rnams la gdams pa// bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// ngas mi tshe phan 'das khyed rnams kyi khe grags/ mi chos kyi 'dun ma dus thams cad du byed ma myong*/ do gcig lha chos las log mi chos la zhugs pa min/ khyed rnams la zhag gcig gi zhu ba 'di ma phul na/ rjes na mar bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa re re yang mi bsrung*/ mthon dman gyi chos kyi bya ba sna re re yang mi 'grub par 'dug pas/ slob dpon gdan sa ba dang*/ mkhan slob rnam pa rnams dang*/ dpon sgom pa sku 'khor phyogs ris dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba mtha' dag bsgrub par zhu/ mi chos kyi bya ba gtan nas mi bsgrub par zhu/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams ni/ mthu dang nus pa rgya che zhing 'bar/ rnal 'byor pa rnams ni "E thub pa'i bstan pa rnams kyi chos min pa bya rgyu med pa yin tsam na/ bstan pa rin po che'i zhabs tog der mi 'gro dbang med pa yin pas/ thams cad kyis 'bad pa chen po mdzad par zhu/ de yang 'bri gung pa'i chen po dang bzang po mkhan slob dang nye gnas chen po dang gces se rnams kyi gtan gyi so nam gcig ngas bsgrubs pa min/ tug gis thug pa'i dus sus kyang bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa bsrung ba gcig kyang med/ 'bri gung pa la phung chen po 'di dus gcig byung ba yin pas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la bsam par zhu// // 464) ༄// sde snod gsum nyams su blang ba'i gdams ngag don bsdus pa bstan rim rin po che'i rgyal mtshan// bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam lha// bla na med pa'i jo bo dkon mchog gsum// gus pas btud de de yi gnas thob phyir// bya dang bya ba ma yin cung zad bstan// 'di ltar yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ rgyu dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/

bar du bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags/ mtha' mar rdo rje gdan gyi spo la srod la byams pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bdud btul/ tho rangs ye shes kyi mes shes bya'i bud shing thams cad bsregs nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas so// de ltar rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas nas/ bcom ldan 'das des chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa gsum bskor te/ rigs can rnam pa gsum smin par mdzad nas/ rtswa mchog gi grong khyer chen po'i shing sa la zung gi tshal/ gyad stobs po che 'byung ba'i gnas su/ bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin du/ phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so// bcom ldan 'das de'i bstan pa sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum ste/ 'dul ba'i sde snod dang*/ mdo sde'i sde snod dang*/ mngon pa'i sde snod do// lam nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas na/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang*/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa dang*/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa ste/ bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum mo// de'i nyams su blang ba'i rim pa ji ltar bya zhe na/ rim gyis pa'i dbang du byas te/ rang gi rgyud la skye bzhin pa'i nyon mongs pa 'di lus ngag tu thon na bsam pa nyon mongs pa/ nyon mongs pa de'i rjes su 'brang ba'i lus kyis byas tshad/ ngag gis smras tshad/ yid kyis bsams tshad ni/ las de ltar byas pa de smin pas sdug cing bsngal ba ni rnam par smin pa/ de ltar las dang nyon mongs pa dang*/ rnam par smin pa'i tshul du khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad 'khor bar 'khyams pas/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal zhes bya'o// sdug bsngal 'di spong ba la las dang po pa nyon mongs pa rags pa spong ba la lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ nyon mongs pa 'bring por gyur pa'i dus su/

lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa/ nyon mongs pa phra bar gyur pa spang bya dang gnyen po gnyis su med pa la dgongs nas/ shes rab kyi bslab pa ste/ bslab pa gsum du bzhed do// yang bsam pa nyon mongs pa dang*/ de'i rjes su 'brang ba'i las spong ba ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ de spangs pas sems las su rung zhing ting nge 'dzin skye ba ni/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ ting nge 'dzin de yun ring du bsgoms pas gzung ba dang 'dzin pa/ yul dang yul can gnyis kyis bsdus pa thams cad don dam pa'i bden pa dang*/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa'am/ chos nyid dang*/ chos can la sogs pa ma 'dres par rtogs pa ni lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa ste/ 'di rnams rim gyis de kho na bzhin du skye ba ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa/ bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum/ lam rim gyis skye bar nges pa kho na'o// da res 'di nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang*/ mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung dang*/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi bya ba dang*/ byed pa thams cad 'dod chags kyi dbang du mi 'gro ba/ zhe sdang gi dbang du mi 'gro ba/ gti mug gi dbang du mi 'gro ba/ mdun pas mi 'gro ba/ lar rab tu byung ba ni chos dang mi mthun pa thams cad spong ba yin pas/ chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba thams cad la/ bya ba dang byed pa thams cad so sor ma 'dres par shes pa ni bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa shes pa/ byas pa dang ma byas pa shes pa zhes bya'o// de la 'dod chags kyi dbang du mi 'gro ba gang zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dod chags 'dod chags dang bral bas sems rnam par grol ba dang*/ shes rab rnam par grol ba'o// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum mthar phyin pa/ rnam par grol ba mthar phyin pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba mthar phyin pas grub par bzhed pa dang*/

yang ltung ba sde lngar las dang nyon mongs pa dug gsum che 'bring rnam pa gsum du gsungs pa'i dbang du byas na/ las de la 'dod chags la gnyis te/ phyi yul la chags pa dang*/ nang sems can la chags pa'o// phyi'i yul ni sems can las gzhan pa/ zhing dang gzhi dang khang pa dang spyil po dang*/ rdzas dang yo byad/ ka ca dang*/ thi gu dang*/ skud du dang*/ khab bu dang*/ gri chung yag pa la sogs pa snying du sdug cing shes pa chags pa 'di la chags pa zhes bya ste/ de la sems chags pa chags pa'i yul du 'dzin pa'i shes pa skad cig ma de la/ shes pa phyi ma chu la chu bzhag pa'am/ mar la mar bzhag pa bzhin du gyur nas/ shes pa gcig tu gyur/ shes pa gcig tu 'dres/ shes pa gcig tu 'thas pas/ shes pa 'di nyid du nges te/ mtho bar yang mi 'phags/ dma' bar yang mi ltung*/ 'di nyid du 'gyur ba ma lags sam/ de ltar gyur na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ chags pas bde 'gro mi thob ste// thar pa'i srog kyang gcod par byed// ces gsungs pa 'di'i don rang nyid kyis go zhing*/ nyams su myong ba yang skye ste/ bu 'o na nga rang yang snying re rje/ chags rin mi chog pa la chags/ zhen rin mi chog pa la zhen pas/ rta rnga chur bcug pa la srog chags su gyur pa bzhin/ e ma kye ma kye hud/ bdag kyang skud pa'i lus dang*/ gri bu dang*/ khab bu'i lus su gyur pa shin tu yang mi bzad cing*/ shin tu yang 'jigs na/ bdag 'di las ji ltar thar bar 'gyur snyam pa'i 'jigs pa chen po skyes nas/ phyi'i rdzas dang yo byad mthong na 'jigs pa skye/ nang rang gi chags sems la 'jigs pa chen po skye/ de skyes pa'i dus su tshul 'chos pa bzhin du skyo shas che ba dang*/ shin tu mi brtan par gyur nas/ jo bo 'ban gung rgyal bzhin spang bya la gnyen pos btsan chod du bcad cing spong bas myur du chags pa dang bral bar 'gyur ba la tshegs med pas/ gnyen po btsan chod phag sna gtun bu 'ba' zhig la 'bad nas spang bar bya'o// nang sems can la chags pa ni/

pha ma nye du gnyen 'brel/ gnag rta dang phyugs zan/ shag po shag mo la chags pa rnams kyang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis lus spyi dang bye brag la chags pa'i dbang gis yul de'i shig dang sro ma dang mngal gyi srin bur skye ba la sogs pa gsungs pa ni/ yul de la sred pas shin tu yang nges te/ sred len gyi dbang gis so// 'o na de ltar gyur na/ yul de ltar gyur pa dang*/ de'i de dang de dag tu gyur pa la/ e ma su zhig dga' bar 'gyur/ ji ltar dga' ba skye/ kye ma 'di la dga' ba ni shin tu 'jigs na/ 'jigs pa de nyid bcom ldan 'das kyis/ sbru+ul gdug shin tu gdug pa dug shin tu rno ba'i khar tshud pa ni shin tu bla yi/ chags pa spyod pa ni de ltar ma yin no// zhes pa la sogs pa dpag tu med pa gsungs pas/ 'dir yang gong ma bzhin spang ba la 'bad par bya ste/ mdor na phyi yul la chags pa dang*/ nang sems can la chags pa bsam pa 'di lta bu'i rjes su 'brang zhing 'gro bar mi bya bar gsungs so// zhe sdang che 'bring rnam pa gsum du bshad pa las/ zhe sdang chen po mnar sems rim pa dgu/ mi 'dis nga la gnod pa 'di dang 'di da sngon phan chad byas so// da ltar byed do// phyis byed par 'gyur ro// bdag dang mdza' ba rnams la gnod pa byas so// byed do// phyis byed par 'gyur ro// bdag dang mi mdza' ba rnams dang mdza' bar byas so// byed do// byed par 'gyur ro// snyam du sems pa gang yin pa 'di ni yul dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ sbyor ba'i ngos nas zhe sdang chen por 'gyur ba ste/ yul ni phyogs dang phyogs ris su gyur tshad bsam gyis mi khyab cing dpag tu med pa zhig la zhe sdang mnar ba'i sems skye bar 'gyur ba dang*/ sbyor ba ni dgra dpag tu med pa pham par byed pa'i sbyor ba/ dmag dang 'khrug pa chen po la sogs pa byed pa dang*/ 'di ltar bsam pa byas pa dang po'i zhe sdang gcig pu de/ gong nas gong du gsos btab cing*/

su mthong thos tshad dang*/ bsam tshad dbang po drug gi yul du gyur tshad zhe sdang 'ba' zhig gi rgyur 'gyur nas/ e ma bsam pa 'di ni 'bar ba/ rab tu 'bar ba/ mnar ba/ rab tu mnar ba/ kun tu rab tu mnar ba/ 'di 'dra ba'i sems 'di 'dra bar gyur na/ sems 'di 'dra ba'i lus su 'gyur ram mi 'gyur/ rgya la'am gal te 'gyur na 'di 'dra ba'i lus de la/ mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba zhes bya bar 'gyur ba'i rgyu 'di yin nam gzhan yin/ brtag par bya zhing bsam pas blo shin tu nges pa skye ste/ go ba dang rtogs par 'gyur ba yang*/ bsam pa rgyu 'dis 'bras bu dpag pa dang*/ 'bras bu mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba 'jigs su rung ba de yang*/ rgyu bsam pa 'di lta bu zhig la skye bar nges pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mya ngan las 'das pa chen por/ nga'i slob ma rnams kyi chos ni 'bras bus rgyu dpog cing*/ rgyus 'bras bu dpog pa'o// zhes gsungs pas/ rgyu zhe sdang chen po 'di las 'bras bu dmyal ba chen por skye bar nges so// zhe sdang 'bring po ni mnar sems rim pa dgu mi skye bar gcig la sogs pa ci rigs par sbyar ro// chung ngu ni chung ngu dang phra mo ste/ mdor na skad cig ma'i shes pa rjes med pa gcig pu zhig skyes pa yan chod la bya'o// 'di yang yul dang bsam pa dang sbyor ba che 'bring rnam pa gsum du gyur pa ni/ zhib tu sde snod gzhan du shes par bya ste/ mdor na zhe sdang phra rags gang skyes pas kyang*/ rang shes pa sdug cing 'bar zhing mnar bar 'gyur ba 'dis 'bras bu dmyal ba la sogs par skye bas/ slob dpon gyi spyod pa la 'jug pa las kyang*/ zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig pa med// bzod pa lta bu'i dka' thub med// de bas bzod la nan tan du// sna tshogs tshul gyis nan tan bskyed// ces gsungs pas/ bu sngon dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po zhig la/ nu bo sdang ba zhig yod/

de la chung ma gsos mo zhig yod pas/ kho bor cing yang yang 'gro bar brtsams pa las/ dge bshes kyi zhal nas/ mna' ma la/ 'o kho la ma bsam thes med de/ nga kho na'i ngor kho la cis kyang sdod gsung ba kho na dang 'dra bar/ bu khyed kyang chos 'di la lta shin tu yang bya dka' ste/ nga kho na'i ngor chos 'di la nan tan gyis shig ces/ ngas de skad du khyed la mi zer bas/ rang gi bsam pa skad cig ma 'di ci ltar du skye ba 'dis 'bras bu ji ltar 'byung ba/ rgyu bde ba ltar 'dug pas 'bras bu sdug bsngal ji ltar 'byung ba 'dod chags rgyu 'bras dang*/ rgyu sdug bsngal las 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung ba zhe sdang rgyu 'bras lta bu dang*/ rgyu sdug bsngal las 'bras bu bde ba 'byung ba tshangs par legs par spyad pa/ rnam par grol ba lta bu dang*/ rgyu bde bas 'bras bu bde ba byang chub sems kyis sangs rgyas 'byung ba lta bu phra ba dang*/ rags pa'am myong bar 'gyur ba dang mi 'gyur ba la sogs pa/ rang gi bsam pa 'di gcig pu'i steng du rang nyid kyis nyams su myong bar bya/ rtogs par bya/ khong du chud par bya/ nges par byas nas/ rang nyid kyis nyams su blang bar bya ba ma gtogs pa/ pha ma dang nye du gnyen 'brel dang*/ bla ma gcig pu'i ngor chos byed pa de ni/ chos byed pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam mo/ rtags tsam 'dzin pa/ rtsid bu chu ldud pa/ byas lo dang byed lo/ slob ma dang 'khor ram/ chos byed pa btags pa tsam po 'dis/ grangs su bgrang ba gcig pu las/ zhe thag pa nas mna' 'dril ba lags te/ slob ma'am 'khor ram/ chos byed du zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas mi btub pa lags pas/ chos rang gi sems la bya/ bsam pa bzang ngan 'di gcig pus 'bras bu bde sdug 'byung bas/ zhe sdang skad cig ma gcig kyang mi skye ba dang*/ skyes pa spong ba dang*/ dge sbyong gi chos bzhi la gnas pa dang*/ bzod pa rnam pa gsum dang du blang ba dang*/

byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis rang gi rgyud sbyang bar bya'o// gti mug gi dbang du mi 'gro ba ni/ gti mug ni thos bsam sgom gsum gyis spang bar bya ba'i yul de'am/ rten 'brel shes pa la bya ste/ rten 'brel la gnyis/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba lugs las 'byung ba 'khor ba rgyu dang 'bras bu bstan pa dang*/ lugs las ldog pa mya ngan las 'das par bstan pas gti mug spong te/ rten 'brel kho na la rmongs pa gti mug go /de la rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba 'di ltar du shes par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ mkha' la rlung brten de la chu yi phung po brten// de la sa chen 'di brten de la 'gro ba brten// sems can las la spyod pa'i rgyu ni de 'dra ste// zhes pas lugs 'byung bstan/ nam mkha' gang la gnas yin don 'di bsam par gyis/ zhes pas de las ldog pa bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po cung zhig smos te/ bu gcig zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas/ nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgyar/ dgos 'dod char bzhin 'bebs pa gcig snam phrag nas phyungs lag mthil du gtad pa bas kyang lhag pa/ lhag pa min re yang skan pas/ bu 'di sems la zhog shog 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i rgyangs ka rnam bzhag gi chos/ don spyi tsam po la blo ma spro bar/ da lta'i shes pa sems nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa 'od gsal zhing*/ ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa 'di las bzang ngan 'bring gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa gsum skye ste/ ngan pa'i rnam par rtog pa 'dod chags dang zhe sdang*/ nyon mongs pa de'i rjes su 'brang ba/ de'i rjes su 'brang ba'i las/ las de'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pas 'bras bu ji ltar 'byung ba gong du bstan pa bzhin du yin la/ 'bring po ni byams pa dang snying rje'i bsam pa rnam par rtog pa rgyud la skyes pas/

de'i rjes su 'brang ba'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi las dang bya ba/ de las byams pa'i lus dang snying rje'i lus lha'i gnas rigs rnams su ji ltar skye ba 'bring du bstan pa dang*/ bsam pa byang chub kyi sems de'i rjes su 'brang ba'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las/ las de'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku/ dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang 'grub par 'gyur ba ma lags sam/ rgya la'am gal te rgyu bsam pa de las 'bras bu de ltar mi 'gyur na ni/ yang na ni rgyu las 'bras bu mi 'byung ba'am/ bsam pa de las ma byung ba'i 'bras bu skye na ni/ gzhan gyis byas pa'i dge ba'am mi dge ba'i 'bras bu rang nyid 'gyur ba la sogs par mi 'gyur ram/ de gang du'ang mi 'gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'phags pa sa lu ljang pa'i mdo nas/ sa bon rnam par shes pa zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rje btsun bram ze chen po'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon zhes gsungs pas/ rgyu bsam pa des khyad par du byed pa'i chos lus ngag yid gsum gyi las/ las de smin pa ni 'bras bu rnam par smin pa/ de skye zhing 'gag pa ni mi rtag pa/ de rgyun mi chad par 'khor bas na 'khor ba/ skyid med pas na sdug bsngal/ gcig la gcig brten pas na rten 'brel/ rgyu rkyen gyis bskyed pas na rgyu 'bras/ gting ngam phugs med pas na sab sob bam kun rdzob/ bden pa med pas na rdzun po/ rnal ma min pas na 'khrul pa ste/ mdor bsdus na ji srid bsam pa gcig yod na/ las dang las kyi rnam par smin pa 'khor ba dang chos thams cad yod la/ 'di med na mi 'byung bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'phags pa lang kar gshegs pa nas/ ji srid sems 'jug yod kyi bar// theg pa'i mtha' la thug pa med// ces pa dang*/ rten 'brel 'di dag sems gcig gis bsdus par sa bcu'i mdo nas/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis po 'di ni sems gcig pu'o// zhes gsungs pa dang*/

slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ thub pas rten 'brel gsung de dag /nyon mongs las dang sdug bsngal dang*// gsum po dag tu zad par bsdus// zhes gsungs pas/ yid ches par byas la/ dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las bzang ngan 'bring gsum ji ltar byas pa bzhin du 'byung ste/ byas na ni 'byung ba/ ma byas na ni mi 'byung*/ gser khur nas rgya gar du 'gro yang mi dgos/ bse ru khur nas rgya nag tu 'gro yang mi dgos/ tsha khyer nas mon skor yang mi dgos/ btsod khyer nas byang du 'gro yang mi dgos/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi bsam pa 'di yin pas/ bsam pa bzang po ma skyes pa bskyed/ skyes pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar bya/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i sems ma skyes pa mi bskyed/ skyes pa spang ba'i phyir 'bad par bya'o// de ni rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba tshigs su bcad pa gsum gyi don bstan nas/ de ni rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba lugs las ldog pa tshigs su bcad pa gcig gi don/ nam mkha' gang la gnas yin don 'di bsam par gyis// zhes pa de nyid kyang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyas pa nas/ nam mkha' ni shar gyi phyogs na mi gnas/ de bzhin du phyogs bcu na mi gnas shing*/ dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs pa ci yang ma yin par gsungs pa ni dpe yin te/ dpe des mtshon pa'i don ji ltar gong du bstan pa'i nyon mongs pa yang go las kyang go rnam par smin pa yang go na/ de gsum gyi 'byung sa gang yin pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dpe de'i don 'di bsam par gyis zhes gsungs pas/ soms dang gsum po de'i rtsa ba gang las byung*/ phyi rol gyi yul nam mkha'am/ bem po la sogs pa 'di rnams nyon mongs pa'am/ las sam rnam par smin pa yin nam/ de ma yin na 'di gsum skye ba'i gnas/ nang gi nam mkha' rtsa ba rang gi sems nyid gcig pu yin par shes par bya ste/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sna tshogs nas/

phyi rol nam mkha' ma yin zhing*/ sems kyi nam mkha' zhes gsungs pas/ 'di la ni skye ba'am 'gag pa'am/ gnas pa'am/ yod pa'am/ med pa'am/ chad pa'am/ rtag pa'am/ dbu ma'am/ rdzogs pa chen po'am/ phyag rgya chen po'am/ chos kyi sku'am/ a tsi pa lo/ gnod sbyin ba ku la/ byis pa sdigs pa'i 'jigs 'jigs/ mi mang po ji ltar btags pa rnams kyis/ byis pa sdigs shing 'jigs par byed kyang*/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po sems nyid rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes rtogs pa'i a pho rgad po rnams ni ming tha dad pa'i tshig 'jigs 'jigs rnams kyis/ byis pa ltar 'jigs shing bred par mi nus te/ dper na ri dwags rgyal po seng ge ral pa can gyi drung du/ wa mo zhung gis skad rigs cho ma cho dgu/ ji ltar zugs kyang*/ ri dwags kyi rgyal po chen po de bred pa'am dngangs par mi nus pa bzhin no// de ltar sems nyid don dam pa'i bden pa 'di rtogs pa'i rim pa'i dbang du byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das rje btsun byams pa la sogs pas/ sa bcu lam rnam pa lnga'i bdag nyid du gsungs te/ lam rnam pa lnga'i dbang du byas na/ don dam pa'i bden pa mthong lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rtogs par byed pa'i bla ma sprul pa'i sku'i mtshan thos pa dang*/ zhal mthong ba dang*/ gdams ngag gis rjes su bstan pa thos pas/ tshogs lam che 'bring rnam pa gsum bgrod nas/ sbyor ba'i lam mthong lam dang sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin nges 'byed/ drod dang*/ bzod pa dang*/ rtse mo dang*/ chos kyi mchog cha bzhi rgyud la skyes pa ni sbyor ba'i lam mo// de kho na la brten nas mthong lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pas/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa sa bcu bgrod pa ni/ spang bya mthong bas spong ba dang*/ sgom pas spong ba'i rim pa rje btsun byams pas gsungs pa dang*/ sa bcu'i mdor pha rol tu phyin pa bcur rim pas rdzogs pa'i ngos nas bzhag pa dang*/

yang de nyid nas yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis la sogs pa yon tan gyi khyad par 'gyur gyi/ bye brag bcus bzhag pa dang*/ gsang sngags nas rten cing 'brel ba bcu gnyis dag pas sa bcu gnyis su bzhag pa dang*/ dbu ma'i mdud pa rnams grol ba las rtsis pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab kyang*/ don de dag thams cad 'gal ba med par/ don dam pa'i bden pa mthong lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu 'char ba'i tshe/ yon tan 'od zer gyi drwa ba 'gyed pa dang*/ las mun pa thams cad sel ba dang*/ dus nam langs pa dang*/ nyi ma shar ba dang*/ nyi ma dros pa la sogs pa bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba phyi dang nang dang gsang bas bsdus pa dpag pa la dgongs nas/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba dang*/ gnyis pa dri ma med pa dang*/ gsum pa 'od byed pa dang*/ bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba dang*/ lnga pa sbyang dka' ba dang*/ drug pa mngon du gyur pa dang*/ bdun pa ring du song ba dang*/ brgyad pa mi g.yo ba dang*/ dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros dang*/ bcu pa chos kyi sprin dang*/ bcu gcig kun tu 'od dang*/ bcu gnyis ma chags pad+ma'i spyan dang*/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la sogs pa dpag tu med pa gsungs pa dang*/ slob dpon chen po 'phags pas/ don dam pa'i bden pa de la gcig dang tha dad pa thams cad dang bral zhing rgyu lam 'bras bu med pas/ gzhi skye med 'bras bu skye ba med par bstan pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar por don dam pa'i bden pa nam mkha' lta bu la bya che 'bring chung gsum 'phur ba'i dpes/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bden pa rtogs pa'i tshad che chung gi khyad par gsungs pa dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa chen por rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba 'di gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ nyan thos gsum gyis rab dang 'bring dang tha ma rnam pa gsum du rtogs par gsungs pa dang*/

bcom ldan 'das kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa/ rang bzhin gyis mya ngan las 'das pa 'ba' zhig tu bstan pa dang*/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos don dam pa'i bden pa 'di gcig pu rtogs pas/ phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dpag tu med pa rtogs pa'i thabs dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa gsungs pa dang*/ slob dpon chen po grub pa thob pa rnams kyis sngags dang mtshan nyid de rnams kyi don gsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ bstan bcos dpag tu med pa gsungs pa rnams/ don dam pa'i bden pa 'di skye bar byed pa'i la la ni rgyu la dgongs/ la la ni lam la dgongs/ la la ni 'bras bu la dgongs/ ngo bo dang rang bzhin dang mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ sa mtshams rnam par bzhag pa tha dad pa la dgongs nas gsungs pa rnams dang*/ ji ltar byas kyang mdzo pho'i rgyus ni mdzo bdag bag tsam che ste/ kha brgya rnga ma stong g.yugs kyang kho rang shes pa la kho rang rgyus che ste/ mi shes pa la dris na/ 'thad pa'i bshad pa mang yang 'phrad kyang ngo mi shes pa kho na yin pas/ mdor na lag tu blang ba'i rim pa kun rdzob kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i gser 'gyur gyis rtsis bsgyur nas/ bsngo ba rin po che 'jigs pa med pa'i gter mdzod du sbas pas/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi mi zad pa'i phun sum tshogs pa gzhan gyi don du gzugs kyi sku 'byung ba dang*/ lugs las ldog pa sems kyi de bzhin nyid zhi zhing nye bar zhi ba/ rang gi don phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba dang*/ lugs las 'byung ba dang*/ lugs las ldog pa gnyis med ro gcig tu gyur pas/ rang don phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa dbyer med pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen por 'gyur bar gces pas/ bu jo jo 'di la nan tan shin tu che bar nyams su blangs na gti mug gis mi 'gro ba kho na'o// 'dun pas mi 'gro ba ni/

'dir gshis drang por gyur pa gcig la/ rang gi zhe 'dod tha dad par bsgyur ba la bya ste/ lus kyi las sam/ ngag gi las bya ba sna tshogs tha dad pa gang la 'jug kyang*/ bzang po dang 'bring dang tha ma rnam pa gsum du 'gyur te/ ngan pa ni dug rnam pa lngas rang nyid 'dod pa la chags pa dang*/ zhen pa dang*/ 'chums par byed pa dang*/ zhe sdang ba dgra pham pa dang*/ dma' dbab pa dang*/ tshar bcad pa'i ched du byed pa dang*/ gti mug log par lta bar byed pa dang*/ phrag dog la gzhan mtho dogs pa dang*/ bzang dogs pa dang*/ khyad du bsad/ gcig tu ci chud snyam pa'i bsam pas byed pa dang*/ nga rgyal gyi 'dun pa nga tsam pa gang na yod/ gzhan bas nga mtho snyam pa'i 'dun pa bya ba dang byed pa/ bla ma dam pa dang dge 'dun gyi zhabs 'bring dang*/ zhabs tog ci byed pa 'di dag thams cad rang gi zhe 'dod drag po de nyid kyi dbang du bya ste/ byed cing bzang byas pa la ngan pa yin/ ngan pa byas na ni bzang po yin zhes pa la sogs pa/ 'jig rten yongs su grags pa'i dbang du byas pas/ sgo bzang po/ mtho dman du smra ba zhes grags pa/ dper na lha sbyin gyi rjes su phyogs pa bzhin/ lha sbyin dge 'dun gyi dbyen byed par rtsol ba la/ rjes su phyogs pa rnams la/ rjes su phyogs par ma byed ces pa dang*/ gros thob ces bsgo bas/ de dang lha sbyin ni chos bzhin du byed pa drang por byed pa yin/ zhes 'dun pa ldog par ma nus shing*/ 'dun pas smra ba dang*/ zhe 'dod de'i phyogs su byed pa 'dun pas byed pa/ byed pa ngan pa'i 'dun pa 'di rnams su bu cig khyod kyis spang bya ste/ 'jig rten 'dir yang yun ring po mi sdod/ nga rang ci mtho/ nga rang yang ci rgyal/ nga rang yang ci legs bsam kyang*/ nga rang yul gsum phyogs na med/ phyin ci log gi 'khrul pa/ nga rang gzung ba'i ral gri la/ nga rang ci bzang gi dar btags pas/ nga bdag med kyi skyabs gcig pu/

bla ma dam pa'i ske ba ral gris gcod par byed pa bu gcig khyod kyis phod dam/ sha khrag mi gtsang ba'i rkyal pa/ sdug bsngal gyi phung po 'dus pa/ rus pa sor bzhi chags pa tsam yang mi bzod pa khyod kyis ma dran nam/ ming rkyang pa nam mkha'i rlung dang 'dra ba 'di la yang bdag tu gang na btub legs par soms la/ ngar 'dzin pa dang lus su 'dzin pa dang ming du 'dzin pa gsum spang bar bya ba dang*/ rang gi grogs po dang*/ shag po dang*/ nye du dang*/ gnyen 'brel dang*/ rang nyid yul gang la zhen cing chags pa dang*/ 'chums pa/ de la rang gis phar la ji ltar 'bad kyang tshur nyes par blta ba dang*/ ma bltas zhing mthun yang myur du ma rungs par 'gyur te/ slob dpon chen po 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ don rnams kun la mi gsal ba'i// ngan pa rnams ni 'jing bsdongs nas// go 'phang mtho yang brlag gyur te// srin bu ra ba'i khar phyin bzhin// zhes gsungs pas/ de 'dra'i phyogs kyi zhe 'dod dang 'dun pa spang ba dang*/ nye du gnyen 'brel thams cad kyis kyang rang la mi stongs/ chos brgyad gang bsgrubs kyang*/ grub pa nyid kyis shin tu phung ba yin pas/ phyogs 'di rnams ngan pa'i 'dun pa mtha' dag gis mi 'gro zhing spang bar bya'o// 'bring po'i 'dun pa ni yod bla ma dam pa des/ chung phud bu tsam nas bskyangs/ grogs po bzang po 'di rnams kyang drin che/ lus na so bdo zhing zho sha yang rgyas/ bya ba dang byed pa'i dus la bab pas/ zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog byed pa'i 'dun pa la ni 'bring yin te/ 'di la yang grogs med/ de 'dra byas pa'i 'bras bu ji lta bu gcig tu gyur te/ phal cher lung du ma bstan pa kho nar 'dug pas/ 'bring po 'di yang zhog la thongs/ yang dbang po rab tu gyur pa rang nyid kyis/ 'dun pas yul thams cad kyang rab tu bsgyur/ dngos po thams cad kyang rab tu bsgyur/ lta sgom yang rab gcig yod/ spyod pa yang rab gcig bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po btang bar bya ste/

zhe thag pa snying khong pa'i gting nas nyon mongs pa dug lnga bsam pa 'bring po man chad lta a cang yang che ste/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi bsam pa tsam yang skad cig mi rgyu ba'i blo bcad chen pos thag sbad kyis bcad/ mna' hril gyis bskyal/ dam bca' cag gis bya/ rang phye rang la gtor/ su tsam sus ma phod/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyang mi las brdungs pa yin/ grub thob chen po yang byas na 'byung ba yin/ nga'i skal pa yang sus bcad/ pho rem can yang 'dir gsal/ khyo ga yin min yang 'dir shes snyam du bsam zhing*/ man kal gsum gnyis khar bcug nas/ gang la bltas kyang*/ gang gsum sgo nas kyang*/ ngas bzang po zhig byed kyang byed/ 'ong yang 'ong snyam du thag sbad kyis bcad la/ 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad du nyams su blang bar byas na/ 'bras bu myur du 'grub pa la tshegs med de/ sngon rje btsun chen po mi la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po de/ rje mar pa lho brag pa la/ dpal ldan nā ro pa chen po'i chos drug rgyud gzhung gdams ngag dang bcas pa/ tshig dang yi ge'i rnam pa gzhung na ji ltar grags pa bzhin du dka' ba drag pos/ yun ring por nyams su ni blangs/ zwa tsha med gsol ba la sogs pa/ lus dang srog la ma bltas pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa byas kyang nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pa lta a cang yang che ste/ rlung gnad du 'gro ba tsam yang ma byung na/ rnal du song ba'i dus gcig na rmi lam du tha rgod shin tu sra ba zhig la/ mdzo bzang po dor cig lcags thong so dbal ma gcig dang bcas nas rmos pa la/ thong ma non nas shin tu sdug pa zhig rmis pas/ de nyid kyis go cha chen po bskyed nas/ gcig tu bla ma'i byin rlabs che// gnyis su gsang sngags gdams ngag che// gsum du rnal 'byor bsgom sran che// tha ba sra yang phed de mchi// zhes gsungs nas/ thugs kyi dpa' chen po bskyed nas/ nyams su blangs pas sngar gyi rmi lam de las thong so sa la zug ches nas yar la 'then pa dka' bar rmis pa dang*/

nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pa khyad par du 'phags pa 'khrungs shing*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa brnyes pa lta bu yin pas/ nang par tho rangs dang por 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa las rgyu dang 'bras bu 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam zhing blo nges par byas nas/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis rgyud brlan nas/ brlan pa dang bangs pa dang*/ 'bol ba dang mnyen ltabs kyis gyur pa'i dus su/ lhag pa'i lha dang bla ma bsgom zhing*/ yul dang yul can gnyis su med pa/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa mtha' dag gis stong pa'i stong nyid/ lta ba rtogs pa dang ldan pa/ sgom pa nyams myong dang ldan par byas nas/ 'di'i dus su bu bya byed zhe 'dod ma che zhig dogs pa mi 'cha'/ nyam nga mi 'cha' bar/ shes pa lhug pa nyid du zhog la thongs/ mnyam gzhag dus su bya rgyu mi btsal bar/ mi ro bzhin du dran med chen por zhog de nyid rgyun bsrings pas mnyam par bzhag pa de nyid kyis lus dub nas/ yul 'dod pa 'byung ste/ de'i dus su dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba byas nas/ don dang ldan pa dang*/ chos dang mthun pa dang*/ bla ma dang dge 'dun mnyes pa de lta bu'am chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba la zhugs pas/ sngar gyi sgom de bas shin tu bzang ba zhig 'dir skye/ mnyam par bzhag pa dang rjes khyad med/ rang gi ske bcad na yang*/ khong khro tsam yang mi skye na/ de la lan ldon pa lta smos kyang ci dgos par 'ong*/ gong ma rnams kyi zhal snga nas kyang*/ mnyam gzhag ci yod rjes kyis shes// gsung ba'i don go yang 'di yin// de ltar gyur na rang nyid mngon par rtogs pa'i chos su 'gyur bas/ klog mkhan yang mi dgos/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba'i sngags 'chang bas/ mchu 'gul 'gul yang mi 'tshal/ don shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin du song bas/ 'gro ba'i bde skyid thams cad kyang 'byung*/ dran zhing brtan pa dang 'gyur ba med pas gtso bo yang che/

nyam nga ba'am/ bag tsha ba'am/ shi dogs pa'am/ srog la mi ltos pas dpa' bo yang yin te/ mdor na bu khyod kyis mnyam par bzhag pa dang rjes gnyis med par kha lta rkyang pa'i rjes su ma 'brangs par/ rgyun chad med par nyams su blangs na/ nyams su blangs pa 'di nyid kyis rang gi drung na 'dug pa'i 'khor rnams kyang 'dun par gyur nas dag pa'i 'khor sha stag tu 'ong*/ bya ba dang byed pa ci byas pas kyang*/ bla ma dang gong ma thams cad mnyes/ rdzas dang yo byad ci yod pas kyang bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog tu 'gro/ khyod la mi 'dis ngan pa byas so byed do// phung shom mo shom par 'gyur ro la sogs pa phra ma dang rdzun dang dbyen gyi phyag rten dang skyes mi 'ong zhing*/ sdig pa'i grogs po thams cad kyang rgyun 'chad par 'gyur/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang legs pa byed pa thams cad dang thos bsam sgom gsum gyi yon tan gyis brgyan pa rnams/ pad+ma'i mtsho la ngang pa bzhin du 'du zhing*/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos thams cad kyis/ rgya mtsho chen po'i chu bo bzhin dang*/ klu'i dbang po rnams kyis char legs par phab nas/ gong bzhin du yon tan dpag tu med pas gang ba dang*/ shin tu gang ba dang 'phel shing shin tu smin par 'gyur ba la yang tshegs med de/ mdor na phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lnga'i skyon thams cad ni 'gags/ yon tan thams cad kyis rgyas nas/ skyon thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur bas/ nyams su blang ba 'ba' zhig la 'bad par bya'o// de ltar ngan pa dang 'bring po'i 'dun pas 'gro bar mi bya zhing*/ bzang po'i 'dun pas nyams su blang ba'i rim pa bstan nas/ bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa shes par bya ba/ byas pa dang ma byas pa shes pa bstan pa ni/ gong du ji ltar bstan pa'i chags par bya ba ma yin pa dang*/ ma chags par bya ba dang*/ zhe sdang bya ba ma yin pa dang*/ zhe sdang spang bar bya ba dang*/ gti mug bya ba ma yin pa dang*/

gti mug med par bya ba dang*/ 'dun pas 'gro ba ma yin pa dang*/ lam nyams su blang ba zhes pa spyir bstan nas/ bye brag gi bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa 'ga' zhig bstan par bya ba ni/ bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa gang yin pa dang*/ de dus shes pa dang*/ ji ltar nyams su blang ba dang gsum las/ dang por bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa ni/ bya ba ma yin pa dngos dang brgyud pa thams cad du/ rang dang gzhan thams cad la gnod pa/ sdug bsngal thams cad bskyed par byed pa mi bya zhing spang ba dang*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug thams cad du rang gzhan thams cad la phan pa dang*/ bde ba bskyed par byed pa 'di nyams su blang bar bstan pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang*/ dam pa rnams kyis chos thams cad kyi don mdor bsdus te bstan pa 'di kho na'o// de ltar bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa sems can thams cad kyi khams rgyud la phan pa dang gnod par gnas pa de sus shes snyam na/ 'di thams cad mkhyen pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho nas mkhyen pa kho na'o// thams cad mkhyen pa de rgyu gang las byung zhe na/ sngon gyi thams cad mkhyen pa rnams kyi chos nyams su blangs pas/ da ltar dang phyi ma'i thams cad mkhyen pa 'grub pa la/ sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba yin no// de lta bu'i thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'grub par byed pa'i rgyu/ sangs rgyas kyi chos de gang zhe na/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes stobs bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa dang*/ dus gsum las dang las kyi rnam par smin pa mkhyen pa dang*/ khams du ma can gyi 'jig rten mkhyen pa dang*/ sems can gzhan dang gang zag gzhan gyi mos pa sna tshogs dang*/ mos pa du ma mkhyen pa dang*/ dbang po rab dang tha ma shes par bya ba mkhyen pa dang*/ kun tu 'gro ba'i lam de dang der 'gro ba mkhyen pa dang*/ dbang po dang*/ stobs dang*/ byang chub kyi yan lag dang*/

bsam gtan dang*/ rnam par thar pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ snyoms par 'jug pa dang*/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang*/ rnam par byang ba rnam par 'god pa mkhyen pa dang*/ dus gsum gyi gnas ma nor ba mkhyen pa dang*/ lha dang mi yi rnam par dag pa mkhyen pa dang*/ zag pa rnams zad pa'i phyir sems rnam par grol ba dang*/ shes rab rnam par grol ba zag pa med pa yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen pa dang*/ bcu po de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs te/ de la bslab par bya'o// de la slob pa la sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po rnams kyi yang spyod yul ma yin na/ nged kyis ji ltar bslab snyam na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab 'di kho na yin te/ rje btsun byams pa la sogs pa rnams kyi gsung rab kyi lung drangs nas/ de'i rjes su 'brang zhing don go ba'i bstan bcos mdzad pa'i phyir ro// ye shes de'i rjes su 'brangs pas skyabs su song bas na/ sde snod gsum shes pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ dgra bcom pa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug gi bar du gong nas gong du shin tu mkhas pa dang*/ yon tan 'phel bar 'gro ba yin te/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ ye shes med na yon tan 'phel med byang chub med// rgya mtsho 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas chos kyang med par 'gyur// zhes pas/ mngon par rtogs pa'i chos dang lung gi chos mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'di la sbyong ba ni rgyu/ sbyangs pas mkhas su 'gro ba ni yon tan/ thob pa ni 'bras bu'o// mkhyen pa'i ye shes gsung rab mtha' dag yin pas brjod par mi nus pas/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa las dang bya ba la 'jug pa'i bye brag bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pas nyams su blang bar bya ba/ rgyu rang la bag tsam yod pa smos par bya ba ni/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug dang 'dun pa dang*/ bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa mi shes pas/

gnas skabs dang mthar thug thams cad du phan par 'gyur pa gnas ma yin pas spang bar bya ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs shing rje btsun dpal chos kyi grags pa la sogs pa mkhas pa rnams kyi sgra dang*/ tshad ma'i bstan bcos/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa'i bye brag /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes thob par byed pa'i rgyu nges pa spyi la bslab par bya ba dang*/ bye brag rang gi las dang bya ba phra mo cig byed kyang*/ snying gis bsam/ gom pas gzhal/ sor bcu brang du bkram/ nyal lugs phyi gan du nyal ba gnad du zab/ ga re da su yin/ rigs gang gi rigs yin/ rus gang gi rus yin/ nus 'bung ci tsam zhig yod/ bsod nams che chung yin/ nga las dang bya ba ci tsam zhig la dbang*/ las dang bya ba 'di byas na gnas skabs su cir 'gyur/ mthar thug cir 'gyur bsam nas 'jug par bya ste/ 'jug pa de yang bcom ldan 'das kyi phun sum tshogs pa lnga'i rjes su 'brang nas bsgrub na/ bya rgod kyi spu gseb tu pha wang nyal ba'am/ chu bo rgyun gyi phyogs su 'bab pa'am/ dbyar gyi dus su rtsi shing dang nags tshal thams cad rgyas pa bzhin du/ myur du 'grub pa la tshegs med pas/ lnga po 'di la 'bad par bya'o// de la bya ba gang dang gang byed pa'i ston pa'am/ slob dpon de yang rang gang byed pa de kho na la mkhas pa ni/ ston pa rab yin pa ma gtogs pa/ gang bzang dang ci bzang cha med pa'i bzang po yin bya ba'i tshig gi rjes su 'brang ba'i bzang pos rang la mi phan te/ so sor ma 'dres pa jag pa la jag dpon/ tshong pa la tshong dpon/ dmag mi la dmag dpon/ las pa la las dpon/ so so gang la mkhas pa de la brten na/ de'i don 'grub par 'gyur bas/ ma nor bar shes par bya ba dang*/ bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa rnams kyis ni thos pa dang bsam pa dang*/ sgom pa gang 'dod kyi bla ma so sor bsten par byas la/ gnas gsum lhan cig tu bsten pa ni gang yang mi 'grub pa ni a cang yang che ste/

sde snod gsum po so sor slob pa lhan cig tu gnas pa tsam yang bdud kyi las su gsungs pa dang*/ de bzhin du bsam pa'i dus su tha dad pa bsam pa dang*/ dmigs pa gcig la sems 'jog pa'i dus su dmigs pa gzhan dang gzhan dag dang dmigs pa med pa la 'jog pa ston pa yang gti mug can yin pas/ thos bsam sgom gsum yang bye brag tha dad pa so sor ma 'dres pa'i ston pa la bsten par bya ba ni ston pa phun sum tshogs pa'o// de la chos phun sum tshogs pa gang zhe na/ chos ni mtshan nyid 'dzin pa ste/ so so gang dang gang 'dod pa de yin pas/ gang 'dod pa de kho na la thes phur nes phur byas pa las/ gnam sngon po 'dod pas ni sa gro bo/ me tsha bo 'dod pas ni chu grang mo/ dkar ba 'dod pas ni gnag pa/ gang ci yang rung ste tha dad pa gzhan dang gzhan dag nyams su blangs na mi 'grub par 'gyur bar nges te/ dper na bod kyi sman pa mi mkhas pa rnams/ nad pa gces pa gcig gis bos pa'i dus su/ nad ngos ma zin/ gang la gang 'gro cha med pas/ gces pa gcig tu yid la byas nas/ sman bzang zer tshad/ rin che tshad/ bungs che tshad/ dus gcig tu btang bas nad pa shi ba ltar 'ong ba yin pas/ chos rang gi zhe 'dod so sor ma 'dres par sal le sing nge ji bzhin du shes par bya'o// mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i chos so so rang nyid bsgrub par bya ba de bsgrub pa'i gnas ni/ so so ma 'dres pa ste/ tshong pa rnams kyi gnas ni tshong dus/ chang la dga' ba rnams kyi gnas ni chang tshong ma/ dge 'dun rnams kyi gnas ni gtsug lag khang*/ nyams su len pa rnams kyi gnas ni dgon pa ste/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ drang srong sgrub pa rnams kyi gnas ni ri khrod/ lha'i sgrub pa rnams kyi gnas ni gangs gseb/ mkha' 'gro sgrub pa rnams kyi gnas ni dur khrod la sogs pa gnas so so ma 'dres par bsgrub par gsungs pas/ gnas so so ma 'dres par nges pa can du bya'o// gnas der gnas shing chos de nyams su len pa'i rten gyi gang zag des/

dus la mkhas par bya ste/ dus la mkhas pa ni/ dbyar gyi dus dro ba'i tshe/ dgun gyi las dang bya ba byed pa dang*/ dgun grang ba'i dus su dbyar dro ba'i las dang bya ba byed pa dang*/ mkhas pas bsten pa'i dus su rmongs pa la bla mar byed pa dang*/ dben par gnas pa'i dus su tshogs kyi bya gzhag byed pa dang*/ tshogs kyi bya gzhag byed pa'i dus su dben par sdod pa la sogs pa/ dus tshod de dang de'i bya ba de snga ba dang phyi bar gyur na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byis pa skye ba'i dus su ma btsas nas snga ba dang phyi bar gyur na de gsha' mar mi 'gyur ba la sogs pa/ dus la bab pa dang ma bab pa/ dus dang dus ma yin pa shes par bya ba dpag tu med pa gsungs pas/ bu khyod kyis kyang bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa mtha' dag gi dus shes par byas la/ dus la bab na ni bya/ dus la ma bab na ni mi bya/ mi 'grub pa'i dus su ni mi bya/ bya ba dang mi bya ba gang zhe na/ lus kyi las dang*/ ngag gi las dang*/ yid kyi las so// de ltar gang 'dod pa don yod pa de la shin tu mkhas pa'i ston pa'am/ slob dpon de la brten nas/ des bstan pa'i chos gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa de/ de nyid dang rjes su mthun zhing 'grub nges pa'i sa phyogs gnas phun sum tshogs pa der/ mthun rkyen grogs dgos pas/ so so rang dang gang mthun pa'i grogs so sor ma 'dres pa/ mi dang rta phyugs dang*/ pha tsha dang*/ zor ba dang*/ the gu dang*/ 'breng bu dang*/ khab dang*/ skud pa dang*/ dril bu dang*/ cang te'u la sogs pa so so gang dgos pa/ mthun pa'i rkyen thams cad tshags bya'o// 'dir yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ rang gi don phun sum tshogs pa grub cing*/ gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pas/ sems can thams cad smin pa dang grol bar 'dod pa'i blo gros can rnams kyis/ bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa rnams la mkhas dgos pas/ bcom ldan 'das rje btsun byams pa'i zhal snga nas/

rgyal sras rnams kyis mi slob pa// de ni gang yang yod ma yin// zhes pa dang*/ yang rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas par ma byas na// 'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen pa thob mi 'gyur// zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa dang*/ rang nyid zhi ba phyogs gcig bgrod pa rnams kyang*/ dgag pa dang sgrub pa'i bslab pa bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa ma shes na mi 'grub pa dang*/ sprang po ber ka thogs pa gcig kyang*/ lnga po 'di la ma bsten nyi ma gcig kyang tshe mi phyid de/ sprang po de brten sa mi su la yang mi brten pa dang*/ rang gi sgrub rgyu slong mi shes pa dang*/ grong yod par mi slong med par slong ba dang*/ nyin par dus su mi slong mtshan mo'i dus su slong ba dang*/ grogs dang mi 'grogs dgra dang 'grogs pas ni/ lto kham gcig tsam yang rnyed mi srid na/ bya ba gong ma gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos pas/ 'bad pa drag pos nan tan chen po zhe thag pa nas bsten par bya ba la 'bad par bya'o// de yang ming tsam du bstan nas/ bye brag gang gis nyams su blang bar bya ba bstan pa ni/ deng sang dus lnga brgya'i tha ma la ni bab/ thub pa'i bstan pa ni 'jig tu nye/ skye shi la dbang ni ma thob/ rang nyid kyang myur du 'gro dgos pa yin pas/ dus da lta rang nyid kyis ci byas kyang 'ong*/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig gsum la bla ma dam pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro dang*/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma dang*/ dregs byed thams cad dpang du btsugs nas dam bca' ni thal/ 'di las gzhan du smos sa dang bsam sa ni med/ sgyid lug dang snyom las kyis kyang ma phan/ ji ltar byas kyang 'phyor po'i rta bzhin du/ 'gro na 'gro dbang med la/ sdod na sdod dbang med kyang*/ snying nas gsha' mar chos byed na rgyug na rgyug dbang yod pas/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu/

sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dngos dang 'dra ba'i bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+ma la gtug cing*/ lhag pa'i lhar bzung ba dang*/ des bstan pa'i chos lam bslab pa rin po che gsum nyams su blang bar bya zhing*/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa/ bla na med pa rmad du byung ba'i theg pa snying por gyur pa/ tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgyas pa'i chos sangs rgyas kyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i chos kyis rang gi rgyud tshim par bya ba dang*/ de ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i dus rang gi shes pa la dris shing bogs 'don pa/ spyod pa dus tshod dang 'brel ba rgyal po gzhon nu'am/ gsang ba sngags kyi spyod pa'am/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'am/ mnyam gzhag chen po'i spyod pa/ sgom ji ltar yod pa'i dus de dang 'brel bar shes par bya ba dang*/ gnas de dang mthun par gnas par bya ba dang*/ grogs de dang mthun pa'i rkyen de dang mthun pa dang 'grogs par bya zhing*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs spang bar bya ba dang*/ lnga po 'di la ni/ rang nyid kyis nyams su blang bar bya ba shin tu gal che bas 'di ni rang nyid kyis nyams su blang zhing*/ de yang spyir bcom ldan 'das kyis/ sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la brten to zhes// yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal bas de skad gsungs// zhes pas/ chos de dge ba'i bshes gnyen la yod pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya'o// sangs rgyas kyi chos phyin ci ma log pa/ yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las byung ba gang zhe na/ spyir khyi sngags dang*/ sgal sngags dang*/ gzhon nu ma 'gugs sngags dang*/ log pa'i bstan bcos thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa la bar du gcod pa/ sha chang za thabs la sogs pa 'di la zer ba ma yin te/ bslab pa rin po che gsum kho na la gsungs pa yin pas/ bu khyod kyis mo 'debs pa dang*/ rtsis gdings pa dang*/

des de zer la sogs pa mi kha btsag mi dgos/ mi che ge mo zhes bya ba zhig la/ gdams ngag mang ge mo zhes bya ba yod/ de slob tu 'gro zer nas gsho 'grogs la 'gro yang mi dgos/ gdams ngag des ci btub/ kho rang tsam zhig byung yang dgos pa ci yod/ gsho 'grogs la yang mi rgyug par/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang*/ bslab pa rin po che 'di gsum la bslab pa yin pas/ 'di 'ba' zhig la nan tan shin tu che bar bslab par bya'o// de yang gong du ji ltar smras pa bzhin du/ gsum po 'di yang lta ba dang sgom pa spyod pa gsum gyi tshul du nyams su blang bar bya'o// dang po lta ba mngon pa'i sde snod kyi tshul du nyams su blang bar bya'o// mngon pa snod dang bcud kyis bsdus pas gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rtog pa mang du btang bas lta bar mi gtub snyam na/ snod kyi 'jig rten dang bcud kyi sems can thams cad rang gi bsam pa 'di gcig pu las 'byung bar gsungs te/ de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis/ sangs rgyas phal po che'i mdo las/ 'jig rten sna tshogs las las byung*/ las kyang sems las byung*/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems yin gsung*/ 'o na sems de ci 'dra byas na/ gdod nas skye ba med pa nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu yin gsung*/ yang rje btsun chen po de nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ mngon par chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gtan la 'bebs/ stong nyid cis stong na bcud gzung ba dang 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyis stong pa yin gsungs pas/ mdor na 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi sems/ sems gdod nas skye ba med pa nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu 'di nyams su blang ba'i lta ba lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa'o// de ji ltar nyams su blang zhe na/ mdo sde'i sde snod lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lnga'i tshul du sems rtse gcig tu nyams su blang bar bya ste/

de ltar rtse gcig tu nyams su blangs nas/ lta ba dang sgom pa de'i gegs sel ba dang*/ bogs 'don par byed pa 'dul ba'i sde snod dang*/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa nyams su blang ba'i rim pa bstan pa las 'dun pas mi 'gro ba'i gnas skabs su/ bogs 'don gyi gdams ngag tu bstan nas/ 'dir ni gegs sel ba cung zad cig bstan te/ bu gong du bstan pa bzhin du/ nga'i ngor chos gyis mi zer/ bstan pa'i sgor ni zhugs/ sems can bsam pa can yin mod/ 'di ltar so so thar pa'i sdom pa/ las dang po pa yan chad sa bcu'i dbang phyug man chad kyis nyams su blang bya ni yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin pa ni nges/ 'di nyams su ma blang na 'khor ba dang ngan song gi chad pa ni 'ong nges pas/ 'di la nan tan shin tu che bar bya ste/ 'dir nga'i bu lon bre phul dang mtho dman 'di rnams la 'di ltar gyi bya ba'i kha ta bya mi dgos/ tshul khrims rin po che dang*/ dam chos rin po che la nan tan byas na/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi don dang*/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi bya ba dang*/ snying po 'di kho na yin te/ 'di la nan tan shin tu che bar bya/ tshul khrims rin po che dang*/ chos rin po che rnams kyi nang nas dgag par bya ba'i bslab pa/ nyes pa dang ltung ba mtha' dag ni bya ba ma yin par shes par bya'o// des ni byas pa dang ma byas pa shes pa bstan pa'o// rje btsun bla ma mchog dang ston pa sangs rgyas dang*// dam pa rnams kyi dgongs pa bcud phyung ba// nyams su blang ba'i rim pa kun la grags pa 'di// thub pa'i gsung rab sde snod rin chen rnam gsum las// nyams su blang ba'i bslab pa gsum po 'di// lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum du gsungs de dag /'khor 'das chos kun sems nyid stong par shes pa ni// lta ba shin tu rnam par dag ces dam pa rnams kyis gsungs// dus rnams kun tu nyams su blang ba'i rim pa ni// ting 'dzin rgyal po la sogs mdo sde'i sde snod du// phun sum tshogs pa lnga yis nyams su blang zhes pa// 'jig rten mgon po rje btsun bla mas bka' bstsal gsung*// de dang 'brel ba'i spyod pa gegs sel bogs 'don ni// thub pa'i dbang pos 'dul ba'i sde snod rgya mtsho las// dgag dang bsgrub pa'i bslab pa rgya cher gang gsungs pa// thog ma bar dang tha mar nyes par gyur pa yi// dgag par bslab pa ston pas gsungs pa la// las dang lam la mi sgrib bya byed mi mang zhing*// rang gzhan kun la phan no gang gis zer ba de'i// mgo bo tshal ba bdun du 'gas par cis mi 'gyur// de phyir khyod kyis lus dang srog

la ma ltos par// dgag par bya ba'i bslab pa srog dang bsdos la srungs// ting 'dzin gegs dang bar chad thams cad gcig pu des sel bas// cis kyang nges par thub pa'i dbang pos bka' bstsal gsungs// gegs dang bral bas bogs rnams thon par 'gyur ba ni// rje btsun bla ma mchog dang thub pa'i dbang pos gsungs// nyams su blang ba'i rim pa 'di ltar bstan pa 'dis// 'gro kun bslab pa mchog la gzhol bar gyur nas kyang*// bstan pa'i rim pa rgyud la skyes par gyur pa yis// thams cad bla med byang chub go 'phang mchog thob shog /thub pa'i gsung rab sde snod gsum dang bslab gsum 'di// ngang pa'i rgyal pos chu la 'o ma len pa ltar// rje btsun gsung gi lta sgom spyod pa bsdus pa 'di// bla ma med pa'i tshig phyir 'brang la bzod par gsol// sde snod gsum nyams su blang ba'i rim pa rin po che'i gdams ngag /don bsdus pa rin po che'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba da ta/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥswahā/ dge'o//
